Method: DSpark 提出半自回归架构，将并行主干与轻量级顺序模块耦合，引入块内依赖建模以缓解后缀衰减；并采用置信度调度验证，基于估计的前缀存活概率和引擎吞吐量特征动态调整每个请求的验证长度。

Result: 在跨域离线基准测试中，DSpark 显著优于当前最先进的自回归和并行草稿模型；部署于 DeepSeek-V4 在线服务系统后，相比 MTP-1 基线，在匹配吞吐量水平下将每用户生成速度提升 60%-85%，并实现了此前无法达到的性能层级，推动了服务系统的帕累托前沿。

Conclusion: DSpark 通过建模草稿中的词元依赖关系并自适应调控验证长度，有效解决了并行推测解码中接受率衰减和验证浪费问题，在高并发交互式 LLM 服务中实现了显著的性能突破。

Abstract: Speculative decoding accelerates Large Language Model (LLM) inference by decoupling draft generation from target verification. While recent parallel drafters efficiently propose long token sequences in a single forward pass, they suffer from rapid acceptance decay due to a lack of inter-token dependencies. Furthermore, indiscriminately verifying these extended blocks wastes critical batch capacity on tokens with high rejection risks, severely degrading throughput in high-concurrency serving systems. We introduce DSpark, a speculative decoding framework that unifies high-throughput parallel generation with adaptive, load-aware verification. To maintain draft quality, DSpark utilizes a semi-autoregressive architecture, coupling a parallel backbone with a lightweight sequential module, to introduce intra-block dependency modeling and mitigate suffix decay. To optimize system efficiency, DSpark employs confidence-scheduled verification, dynamically tailoring the verification length for each request based on estimated prefix survival probabilities and engine-specific throughput profiles. On offline benchmarks across diverse domains, DSpark substantially improves the accepted length over state-of-the-art autoregressive and parallel drafters. When deployed within the DeepSeek-V4 serving system under live user traffic, DSpark successfully mitigates verification waste. Compared to the established production baseline (MTP-1), DSpark accelerates per-user generation speeds by 60 to 85 percent at matched throughput levels. More importantly, by preventing severe throughput degradation under strict interactivity constraints, it enables performance tiers that were previously unattainable, shifting the Pareto frontier of our serving system.

</details>


### [82] [The Changing Role of Symbolic Methods in Artificial Intelligence](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.05168)
*Jun Sun*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出压缩原理：显式符号推理并非智能的基本属性，而是计算模型简化现实时的计算后果。模型越丰富，所需符号推理越少，但符号方法将日益成为人机交互的关键界面。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现代基础模型在大幅减少显式符号推理的情况下取得了惊人成功，这挑战了传统AI将符号推理视为智能核心组成的观点，需要重新审视符号方法的作用和本质。

Method: 提出压缩原理（Compression Principle）和建模-推理权衡（Modeling-Reasoning Trade-off），从计算模型是对现实的简化表示这一基本前提出发，推导出符号推理的必要性与模型信息压缩程度之间的关系。

Result: 符号方法的传统成功和现代基础模型的有效性都可以用同一框架解释；同时揭示了一个悖论：AI越强大越不透明，符号方法作为人机接口反而变得更加重要。

Conclusion: 符号方法的未来不在于作为智能系统的计算引擎，而在于作为人类与日益强大的AI系统之间的符号化接口，用于需求指定、行为验证、系统监管和信任建立。

Abstract: Why do intelligent systems need to perform explicit symbolic reasoning? Computer science has traditionally regarded symbolic reasoning as a defining component of intelligence. Yet the remarkable success of modern foundation models raises a fundamental question: if increasingly capable AI systems can operate with little explicit symbolic reasoning, what role do symbolic methods actually play?
  This article argues that explicit symbolic reasoning is not a fundamental property of intelligence, but a computational consequence of operating on simplified models of reality. We propose the Compression Principle: every computational model is a simplified representation of reality, and explicit symbolic reasoning compensates for information omitted during model construction. From this principle, we derive the Modeling--Reasoning Trade-off: as computational models preserve richer representations of the world, the need for explicit symbolic reasoning correspondingly decreases. This perspective provides a unified explanation for both the historical success of symbolic methods and the remarkable effectiveness of modern foundation models.
  Paradoxically, the same development makes symbolic methods increasingly important for humans. As intelligent systems become more capable and more opaque, symbolic representations increasingly serve as interfaces through which humans specify requirements, verify behavior, regulate autonomous systems, and establish trust. We therefore argue that the future of symbolic methods lies not primarily as the computational engine of intelligent systems, but as the symbolic interface between increasingly capable AI systems and the humans who build, govern, and depend upon them.

</details>


### [83] [AgentGym2: Benchmarking Large Language Model Agents in De-Idealized Real-World Environments](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.05174)
*Zhiheng Xi,Dingwen Yang,Jiaqi Liu,Jixuan Huang,Honglin Guo,Baodai Huang,Tinggang Chen,Qi Zhang,Zhonghang Lu,Chenyu Liu,Jiajun Sun,Jiazheng Zhang,Dingwei Zhu,Xin Guo,Junzhe Wang,Zhihao Zhang,Yuming Yang,Junjie Ye,Minghe Gao,Dongrui Liu,Jiaming Ji,Guohao Li,Tao Gui,Qi Zhang,Xuanjing Huang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: AgentGym2是一个新的评估框架，基于真实世界的端到端工作需求，衡量LLM代理在嘈杂、不明确环境中探索工具、执行流程、组合工具和保持鲁棒性的能力。实验表明，即使GPT-5等SOTA模型也在此基准上表现不佳，揭示了当前代理能力与现实应用需求之间的巨大差距。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基准测试在简化、理想化的环境中评估语言代理，依赖预打包的工具接口，忽略关键步骤，假设输入干净且完全指定，低估了真实部署的难度。现实环境中存在不确定性和噪声，代理必须主动探索环境以发现新工具，亟需更真实、更严格的评估框架。

Method: 提出AgentGym2评估框架，包含基于真实世界端到端工作需求的任务实例。评估维度包括：推理与规划、端到端流程执行、通过探索发现工具、为未见任务组合工具、对噪声和未明确信息的鲁棒性。在15个专有和开源模型上进行实验。

Result: 在15个专有和开源模型上的实验表明，即使是Gemini和GPT-5等SOTA系统在AgentGym2上表现挣扎，揭示了当前代理能力与现实应用需求之间存在显著差距。

Conclusion: AgentGym2能够更真实地评估语言代理在现实世界中的表现，当前的SOTA代理能力与实际部署需求之间仍存在巨大差距，需要进一步研究以弥合这一差距。

Abstract: Language agents, i.e., LLM agents, progress rapidly and are increasingly deployed in production environments. This trend underscores the urgent need for rigorous and realistic evaluations. However, most existing benchmarks evaluate agents in simplified, idealized settings. They typically rely on pre-packaged tool interfaces, overlook critical steps, and assume inputs are clean and fully specified. Consequently, they understate the difficulty of real deployments, where uncertainty and noise are ubiquitous and agents must proactively explore the environment to uncover new tools. To bridge this gap, we present AgentGym2, a new evaluation framework with task instances grounded in real-world end-to-end working demands. Beyond reasoning and planning, it measures agents' ability to execute end-to-end procedures, discover tools via exploration, compose tools for unseen tasks, and remain robust to noisy and underspecified information. Experiments on 15 proprietary and open-source models show that even SOTA systems like Gemini and GPT-5 struggle on AgentGym2, revealing a substantial gap between the capability of current agents and the demands of real-world applications.

</details>


### [84] [CP-WSP: A Declarative CP-SAT Framework for Configurable Multi-Constraint Workforce Scheduling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.05177)
*Vipul Patel,Anirudh Deodhar,Dagnachew Birru*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出CP-WSP框架，基于CP-SAT求解器，通过14个硬约束和15个软约束的统一加权惩罚函数，实现带中点控制的强制休息排班、 acuity加权工作量公平、多粒度时间分辨率、跨周稳定性及跨午夜班次等高级排班需求，支持JSON配置无需代码修改，并提供了36个配置的基准测试套件。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有CP排班公式通常仅建模6-12个约束的简化实例，缺乏对强制休息排班（含中点位置控制）、 acuity加权工作量公平、子班次时间粒度、跨周排班稳定性以及24小时运营中常见的跨午夜班次模式的显式支持。

Method: 采用声明式CP-SAT框架，设计14个硬约束（数学上不可违反）和15个软约束（统一加权惩罚函数），关键技术创新包括：班次窗口变量分解（支持强制休息排班及中心性控制）、 acuity加权工作量公平、30分钟至2小时的多粒度时间分辨率、跨周排班稳定性、网格偏移预处理技术（处理跨午夜班次），所有配置通过JSON规范实现无需代码修改。

Result: 在INRC-II基准（小时级和班次级粒度）以及36种合成配置上进行了评估，验证了框架的有效性和可复现性。

Conclusion: CP-WSP为劳动力排班提供了一种高度灵活、可配置且约束完备的解决方案，填补了现有CP方法在强制休息排班、工作量公平和多粒度时间分辨率等关键功能上的空白。

Abstract: Workforce scheduling is an NP-hard combinatorial optimization problem requiring simultaneous satisfaction of labor regulations, coverage requirements, employee preferences and operational objectives. Existing CP formulations typically model simplified instances with 6-12 constraints at shift-level granularity and critically lack explicit support for: mandatory break scheduling with midpoint placement control; acuity weighted workload equity; sub-shift temporal granularity enabling demand-driven staffing; inter-week schedule stability; and cross-midnight shift patterns common in 24-hour operations. This paper presents CP-WSP: a declarative CP-SAT framework enforcing 14 hard constraints as mathematically inviolable requirements (zero regulatory violations by construction) while optimizing 15 soft objectives through a unified weighted penalty function -- all configurable via a JSON specification with no code changes required. Key contributions include: a shift-window variable decomposition enabling mandatory break scheduling with centrality control; acuity-weighted workload equity; multi-granularity temporal resolution from 30 minutes to 2 hours; inter-week schedule stability; a grid-offset preprocessing technique for cross-midnight shifts; and a reproducible 36-configuration benchmark suite for community comparison. Evaluated on INRC-II benchmarks at both hourly and shift-level granularity and on 36 synthetic configurations.

</details>


### [85] [Rethinking On-Policy Self-Distillation for Thinking Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.05184)
*Simran Kaur,Narutatsu Ri,Yinghui He,Liam Fowl,Sanjeev Arora*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 特权自蒸馏会削弱思考模型的长推理能力：在多个模型和数学基准上，avg@16准确率最多下降17%，且退化程度与特权上下文量、推理预算正相关。问题源于特权教师重塑了高熵分叉位置的token级学习信号，降低了思考模型的分叉率（如自我修正、回溯标记），而指令模型反而受益。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 探索自蒸馏（特别是特权上下文蒸馏）能否有效提升思考模型（thinking models）的性能。直觉上，思考模型可利用测试时推理吸收特权信息实现自我改进，但实际效果未知。

Method: 在Qwen3和OLMo系列共5个思考模型上，对比特权上下文自蒸馏与on-policy蒸馏（OPD）的效果；通过分析rollout中的token级分叉率、自我修正标记频率等指标诊断退化机制。

Result: 1) 特权上下文自蒸馏导致AIME24/25、HMMT25上avg@16准确率下降最多17%；2) 退化随特权上下文量和推理预算增加而加剧；3) 特权OPD反而逆转了普通OPD带来的提升；4) 特权上下文降低思考模型的分叉率（如回溯、验证、对冲标记），但提升指令模型的分叉率。

Conclusion: 特权自蒸馏对强思考模型有害，根源在于特权上下文在高熵分叉位置压制了有益的修正和推理分歧信号。提升思考模型的自蒸馏需关注token级信号，特别是修正和推理步骤。

Abstract: Self-distillation is a promising recipe for self-improvement in language models. In this setting, a model can serve as its own teacher when given privileged information, such as a solution to a math problem. This seems especially appealing for thinking models, which can use test-time reasoning to absorb the privileged information. Surprisingly, we show that privileged self-distillation degrades thinking models on long reasoning traces: across five Qwen3 and OLMo thinking models evaluated on AIME24, AIME25, and HMMT25, privileged-context distillation causes a relative drop of up to 17% in avg@16 accuracy. The degradation scales with the amount of privileged context withheld from the student and is most pronounced at long rollout budgets, where thinking models otherwise obtain their largest gains. This failure mode is not specific to self-distillation: on-policy distillation (OPD) improves thinking models, but privileged OPD reverses these gains. Our diagnostics link this failure mode to how privileged teacher context reshapes learning at high-entropy forking positions, where multiple continuations remain plausible and may lead to different reasoning paths. Privileged context lowers fork rates in thinking-model rollouts but not in instruction-model rollouts. This leads to an interesting dichotomy, where privileged context can help instruction-tuned models but hurts stronger thinking models. The effect is visible when the student begins a self-correction branch, where privileged OPD penalizes sampled reconsideration tokens that vanilla OPD supports. Thinking models trained with a privileged teacher produce fewer verification, backtracking, and hedging markers, even after length normalization. These findings indicate that self-distillation for strong thinking models requires attention to token-level signal, especially around correction and reasoning steps.

</details>


### [86] [ClassicLogic: A Knowledge-Driven Benchmark of Classic Puzzle Games for Evaluating Compositional Generalization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.05185)
*Mahnoor Shahid,Hannes Rothe*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: ClassicLogic是一个新的基准测试套件，通过四个经典逻辑谜题（数独、KenKen、数墙、不等式）来评估AI的组合泛化能力，其核心是层次化、显式的知识库结构，支持从基本规则到多步组合策略的细粒度推理评估。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有组合泛化基准多聚焦于语言任务，缺乏复杂、显式的组合结构，难以评估AI在结构化问题求解中的组合推理能力。

Method: 构建了四个经典逻辑谜题（数独、KenKen、数墙、不等式）的基准套件，核心创新是为每个游戏建立层次化、显式的知识库，将复杂求解策略形式化定义为更简单基础策略的组合。

Result: 该基准支持从基本规则学习到多步组合策略应用的细粒度推理能力评估，谜题难度经过数学验证且逐步递增。

Conclusion: ClassicLogic为推进神经符号系统及其他高级AI推理系统提供了具有挑战性的新测试平台。

Abstract: Compositional generalization, the ability to understand and produce novel combinations of known components, remains a fundamental challenge for modern artificial intelligence. While few benchmarks exist, many focus on linguistic tasks and lack complex, explicit compositional structures. We introduce ClassicLogic, a new benchmark suite designed to evaluate an agent's ability to learn and compose problem-solving strategies. The benchmark consists of four classic logic puzzles: Sudoku, KenKen, Kakuro, and Futoshiki. Its core innovation is a hierarchical, explicit knowledge base for each game, where complex solving strategies are formally defined as compositions of simpler, foundational strategies. This structure allows for fine-grained evaluation of an agent's reasoning capabilities, from learning basic rules to applying multi-step compositional strategies to solve puzzles of increasing, mathematically validated difficulty. The open-source benchmark provides a challenging new testbed for advancing neuro-symbolic and other advanced AI reasoning systems.

</details>


### [87] [Reason, Reward, Refine: Step-Level Errors Corrections with Structured Feedback for Physics Reasoning in Small Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.05199)
*Raj Jaiswal,Dhruv Jain,Rishabh Dhawan,Sree Krishna Uppalapati,Shin'ichi Satoh,Tanuja Ganu,Rajiv Ratn Shah*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出了一种步骤级奖励框架，通过识别首个推理错误、生成结构化反馈并训练模型自我修正，在不依赖人工标注和真实解的情况下，显著提升了小语言模型在物理推理任务中的准确率，将计算错误从56.9%降至23.5%，理解错误从22.3%降至12.0%，但概念性错误仍是最难解决的失败模式。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 小语言模型在物理推理中存在结构性失败：任何步骤的错误会向前传播，污染后续所有推理；同时受限于领域知识不足、多步推导中的幻觉以及分布敏感性，现有方法难以有效纠正。

Method: 提出步骤级奖励框架：1) 识别首个推理错误位置；2) 生成针对性结构化反馈；3) 通过带KL正则化的策略梯度训练模型自我修正，不依赖真实解作为生成目标，无需偏好数据构建，外部验证器仅在训练时使用。

Result: 在五个物理基准上，相比CoT提示提升17-20%，相比最强基线提升10-16%；计算错误从56.9%降至23.5%，理解错误从22.3%降至12.0%，概念错误从89.7%降至68.7%。

Conclusion: 步骤级奖励框架有效缓解了小语言模型在物理推理中的错误传播问题，计算错误和理解错误得到显著改善，但概念性错误仍是最顽固的失败模式，需要进一步研究。

Abstract: Physics reasoning fails structurally in small language models: an error at any step propagates forward, corrupting every inference that follows. Limited domain knowledge, hallucination under multi-step derivation, and distributional sensitivity compound this failure. We propose a step-level reward framework that identifies the first reasoning error, generates targeted structured feedback, and trains the model to revise its solution via policy gradient with KL regularization, without exposing it to ground truth solutions as generation targets. Unlike annotation-dependent step-level methods, no preference data construction is required and the external verifier operates exclusively at training time. Across five physics benchmarks, our framework delivers accuracy gains of 17-20% over CoT prompting and 10-16% over the strongest baseline, reduces calculation errors from 56.9% to 23.5%, and reduces miscomprehension errors from 22.3% to 12.0% in the best observed cases. Conceptual errors reduce from 89.7% to 68.7%, yet persist as the hardest failure mode across all conditions.

</details>


### [88] [EvoAgentBench: Benchmarking Agent Self-Evolution via Ability Transfer](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.05202)
*Xingze Gao,Chuanrui Hu,Hongda Chen,Pengfei Yao,Zhao Wang,Yi Bai,Zhengwei Wu,Yunyun Han,Xiaofeng Cong,Jie Gui,Yafeng Deng,Teng Li*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出了EvoAgentBench基准，用于评估LLM智能体在长程任务中的自我进化能力，其核心不是信息记忆，而是程序性知识（搜索、调试、验证等可复用流程）的跨任务迁移。基准覆盖四个智能体领域，通过提取轨迹级Ability、构建领域Ability Graph来测试程序性迁移效果。实验发现当前方法均无法在所有设置下保持正向收益。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有智能体评测仅测试单回合任务解决能力，记忆评测仅关注信息保留而非程序性知识复用，缺乏专门评估智能体通过经验积累实现程序性迁移（自我进化）的基准。

Method: 从智能体执行轨迹中提取Ability（可操作单元），规范化后构建领域特定的Ability Graph，连接具有程序性重叠的任务。每个测试任务都由训练侧已验证的Ability提供支持，采用528/267的训练/测试划分，测试两个脚手架和三个骨干模型。

Result: 精心设计的Ability内容可以跨模型家族可靠迁移，但没有任何现有自动方法能在所有设置下保持正向收益。

Conclusion: EvoAgentBench将自我进化评估从聚合准确率比较转向对经验编码、路由和吸收的细粒度诊断，为智能体自我进化研究提供了更精确的评估框架。

Abstract: Agent self-evolution in long-horizon LLM systems is largely procedural: useful experience is not merely stored information, but reusable procedures for searching, debugging, and verification. Yet current evaluations do not isolate this form of transfer. Agent benchmarks test single-episode task solving; memory benchmarks target information retention rather than procedural reuse. We introduce EvoAgentBench, a benchmark for agent self-evolution via Ability-guided transfer across four agentic domains: web research, algorithmic reasoning, software engineering, and knowledge work. EvoAgentBench extracts trace-grounded Abilities from agent executions, canonicalizes them into operational units, and builds domain-specific Ability Graphs linking tasks that share procedural overlap. By design, every test task is backed by verified training-side Ability support. Across a 528/267 train/test split, two scaffolds, and three backbones, curated Ability content transfers reliably across model families, but no current automatic method sustains positive gain in all settings. EvoAgentBench shifts self-evolution evaluation from aggregate accuracy comparison to fine-grained diagnosis of experience encoding, routing, and uptake. The benchmark is publicly available at https://huggingface.co/datasets/EverMind-AI/EvoAgentBench.

</details>


### [89] [MoP-JEPA: Hard-Assigned Predictor Mixtures for Stochastic JEPA World Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.05238)
*Zhi Song,Ximing Xing,Zhenchao Tang,hanbo Huang,Tianxu Lv,minghao Yang,Zhongzheng Niu,He Bing,Lusheng Wang,Jianhua Yao*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 论文证明标准JEPA世界模型在随机环境中预测失败，并提出MoP-JEPA的硬分配预测器方法，通过多模态预测和验证协议显著提升规划性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准JEPA世界模型使用单一确定性预测器通过潜在回归训练，但在随机环境中，回归最优预测器输出后继嵌入的条件均值（各后继状态之间的点），这不对应任何真实状态，导致结构性的预测崩溃。

Method: 提出MoP-JEPA方法，使用硬分配（hard-assigned）的混合预测器；每个预测器头负责一个后继模式。配套验证协议包括：输入无关码本控制、打乱上下文测试、路由器门控读出、转换精度守卫、以及验证路由准则（模型盲提转换图，仅用真实结果校验）。

Result: 在OGBench离线数据上，单预测器滚动规划表现差（0.02-0.09成功率），而基于预测模式的规划达到0.85，超越确定性、门控MoE和变分预测器。在验证路由准则下，方法在所有三个迷宫中超越最强软替代方案2-5倍。在真实环境中执行，在最难迷宫中排名第二（共七个基线）。

Conclusion: 多模态动力学决定了JEPA世界模型能否规划；硬分配混合预测器是最小且可验证的解决方案。

Abstract: JEPA world models predict the next latent state with a single deterministic predictor trained by latent regression. We show that this fails structurally when the environment is stochastic: at a branching transition, the regression-optimal predictor outputs the conditional mean of the successor embeddings, a point between the true next states that corresponds to no state at all. We prove this collapse for deterministic and gated mixture-of-experts predictors, and prove that MoP-JEPA's hard-assigned predictors converge instead to a quantizer of the transition distribution: one head per successor mode, enumerable in a single forward pass, which is the interface a planner consumes. On official OGBench offline data with leak-free evaluation, planning over single-predictor rollouts performs poorly ($0.02$--$0.09$ success) while planning over our predicted modes reaches up to $0.85$, ahead of deterministic, gated-MoE, and variational predictors on every task. Because multi-prediction evaluation invites coverage freeloading, a verification protocol is part of the method: an input-agnostic codebook control, a shuffled-context test, router-gated readouts, transition-precision guards, and a verified-route criterion in which the model proposes its transition graph blind and ground truth is used only to check the result. Under this criterion our method outperforms the strongest soft alternative on all three mazes ($2$--$5\times$), and the protocol identifies the remaining gap in that baseline's raw scores as routes through predicted transitions that do not exist. The same model executes in the real environment, placing second of seven against the published OGBench baselines on the hardest maze. Multimodal dynamics decide whether a JEPA world model can plan at all; a mixture of predictors with hard assignment is a minimal and verifiable fix.

</details>


### [90] [MetaSkill-Evolve: Recursive Self-Improvement of LLM Agents via Two-Timescale Meta-Skill Evolution](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.05297)
*Zefeng Wang,Minxi Yan,Jinhe Bi,Sikuan Yan,Volker Tresp,Yunpu Ma*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出MetaSkill-Evolve框架，通过双时间尺度机制使智能体技能改进实现递归：任务技能快进化和元技能慢进化，在三个基准测试上超越无技能、静态技能和单层进化基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有自改进智能体虽然能从执行轨迹重写技能文件，但改进过程本身是静态的、非递归的——即"如何改进"的元能力被一次性编写后固定不变，无法随着任务经验持续优化。

Method: 提出MetaSkill-Evolve双时间尺度框架：每个分支携带任务技能s和元技能m=(ψ,σ,α,π,ε)，分别参数化分析器、检索器、分配器、提议器和进化器五个组件；任务技能在快循环中进化，元技能在慢循环中通过相同管道自我进化，无需额外模型或目标函数。

Result: 在OfficeQA、SealQA、ALFWorld三个基准上，使用单一冻结骨干网络，相比原始骨干分别提升+23.54、+16.09、+1.92个百分点的测试准确率，超越所有基线。

Conclusion: 元技能的递归进化是可行的，且能显著提升智能体在长期、开放式任务上的表现，为自进化智能体提供了更通用的框架。

Abstract: Recent LLM agents tackle increasingly long-horizon, open-ended tasks, and external skills, reusable procedural knowledge supplied to the agent, further extend this capability. However, a fixed, hand-authored skill is rarely optimal, and cannot adapt to the diversity of tasks an agent encounters. Self-improving agents address this by rewriting their own skill files from execution traces, yielding meaningful gains on challenging benchmarks. Yet such self-evolution remains non-recursive: it improves only the task skill (what the agent does) while the improvement procedure (how it improves) is authored once and held fixed. We introduce MetaSkill-Evolve, a two-timescale framework that makes agentic skill improvement recursive: every branch carries both a task skill $s$ and a branch-local meta-skill $m=(ψ,σ,α,π,\varepsilon)$ whose five components parameterise the Analyzer, Retriever, Allocator, Proposer, and Evolver agents of the improvement pipeline. Task skills evolve on a fast loop while the meta-skill evolves on a slower one under the same pipeline applied to itself, with no additional model or objective. With all five pipeline agents sharing a single frozen backbone, MetaSkill-Evolve outperforms no-skill, static-skill, and single-level evolution baselines on three agentic benchmarks (OfficeQA, SealQA, ALFWorld), improving held-out test accuracy over the raw backbone by +23.54, +16.09, and +1.92 points respectively.

</details>


### [91] [Evaluating and Understanding Model Editing for Medical Vision Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.05310)
*Guli Zhu,Chenwei Wu,Liyue Shen*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: M3Bench是一个面向临床的多模态模型编辑基准，包含16,276道题目，涵盖多种解剖、模态和专科领域，评估编辑的可靠性、精确性和泛化能力。实验发现梯度方法迁移强但局部性差，记忆方法局部性好但泛化不足，归因于VLM潜在空间几何特性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有通用多模态模型编辑基准无法反映临床领域的真实需求和变异性，亟需一个面向临床的评估基准。

Method: 构建M3Bench基准，包含16,276道题目，覆盖多种解剖结构、成像模态和医学专科，支持单次和序列编辑；在6种医学和通用VLM上评估4种代表性编辑方法。

Result: 梯度方法迁移强但局部性差，记忆方法局部性好但泛化不足且超参数敏感；失败原因可归因于VLM潜在空间几何特性及编辑方法对其结构的改变。

Conclusion: M3Bench为临床多模态模型编辑提供了严格的压力测试基准，并为更安全的部署后模型修正提供了可行指导。

Abstract: Model editing promises a fast, targeted way to correct post-deployment mistakes in medical vision-language models (VLMs) without costly retraining. However, existing multimodal model editing benchmarks focus on general-purpose tasks and do not reflect realistic clinical domain requirements and variability. To address this, we introduce M3Bench, a clinically grounded benchmark for multimodal model editing that evaluates whether an edit remains reliable, precise, and generalizable under the challenges of image and text variation, modality and protocol shifts, clinical knowledge composition, and temporal progression. M3Bench contains 16,276 questions spanning diverse anatomy, modalities, and specialties, and supports both single and sequential edits.
  By evaluating 4 representative editors across 6 medical and general VLMs, we find that no method excels across all criteria. Gradient-based editors achieve strong transfer but suffer from catastrophic locality violations, whereas memory-based methods preserve locality but lack compositional generality and exhibit high backbone-dependent hyperparameter sensitivity. We further attribute these failures to the latent space geometry of VLMs and how different editing methods shift its landscape. Overall, M3Bench establishes a rigorous clinical stress test for multimodal model editing and offers actionable guidance for safer post-deployment adaptation. The benchmark is publicly available at https://github.com/BioMed-AI-Lab-U-Michgan/M3Bench .

</details>


### [92] [OptiAgent: End-to-End Optimization Modeling via Multi-Agent Iterative Refinement](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.05346)
*Adriana Laurindo Monteiro,Nayse Fagundes,Gabriel Mattos Langeloh,Gustavo de Oliveira Kanno,Priscila Louise Aguirre,Thiago Costa Rizuti da Rocha,Victor Leme Beltran*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出OptiAgent多智能体框架，能根据自然语言描述自动生成运筹学问题的数学建模和可执行代码，采用多循环验证架构和四种专用反馈机制，在LP、MILP和非线性规划基准上达到SOTA性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有方法在将自然语言描述的运筹学问题自动转化为数学公式和可执行代码时，存在建模错误、代码缺陷等多样化的失败模式，缺乏系统性的检测与纠正机制。

Method: 提出OptiAgent多智能体框架，优先强化数学建模步骤，由专用智能体提取决策变量和约束等结构；设计多循环验证架构，包含四种专用反馈机制分别针对误解、结构缺陷、数学不一致、验证失败和代码错误；采用模块化设计增强可审计性。

Result: 在LP、MILP和非线性规划共4个基准测试中，在3个上达到SOTA，在剩余1个上保持强竞争力。

Conclusion: OptiAgent通过多智能体协作和专用反馈机制，有效提升了自然语言到数学建模的准确性和可解释性，在运筹学问题求解中表现出色。

Abstract: We propose OptiAgent, a multi-agent framework that, given a natural language description of an Operations Research problem, is able to output a solver-ready mathematical formulation as well as executable code. Our architecture prioritizes the mathematical modeling step, where dedicated agents extract structures, such as decision variables and constraints, enabling iterative self-correction. We introduce a novel multi-loop validation architecture with four specialized feedback mechanisms, each targeting a distinct failure mode such as misinterpretation, structural defects, mathematical inconsistencies, validation failures, and code errors. Alongside accuracy, our modular design improves the process of solving optimization problems by improving transparency, as each agent exposes its reasoning and feedback, making the full modeling process auditable. Our framework achieves state-of-the-art performance on 3 out of 4 benchmarks across LP, MILP, and Nonlinear Programming tasks, while remaining highly competitive on the remaining dataset.

</details>


### [93] [Graph Sparse Sampling: Breaking the Curse of the Horizon in Continuous MDP Planning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.05359)
*Idan Lev-Yehudi,Vadim Indelman*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出图稀疏采样(GSS)算法，通过共享未来轨迹替代树状分支结构，实现了在连续状态/动作空间中的在线规划，具有多项式级理论保证和优异的实证表现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 连续域中的不确定性规划计算量巨大，树搜索方法（如MCTS）的分支结构在最坏情况下会导致采样预算随搜索深度指数增长，尤其在连续状态或动作空间中，规划器面临无限分支层次的搜索难题。

Method: 提出图稀疏采样(GSS)算法：采用无分支的图结构，对多个候选决策共享采样的未来轨迹，而不是为每个候选动作独立采样后继节点；利用启发式方法聚焦计算资源，同时构造适合GPU的大批量数据处理。

Result: 为GSS证明了有限样本性能保证：在全秩或低秩生成模拟器（通过平滑备份）以及离散或采样的连续动作空间下，满足适当重叠、正则性和动作覆盖条件时，边界对规划视界呈多项式依赖；在连续控制仿真中，GSS在长视界任务上显著优于树基规划器，或达到近最优性能。

Conclusion: 无分支的图规划可作为在线控制的一种互补设计原则，有效避免树状稀疏采样的指数级视界依赖问题。

Abstract: Planning under uncertainty in continuous domains is essential for autonomous systems, yet computationally demanding. Tree-based search methods such as Monte Carlo Tree Search (MCTS) remain popular, but their branching structure can require sampling budgets that grow exponentially with lookahead depth in the worst case. From a tree perspective, continuous state or action spaces become especially challenging, since the planner must decide where to search in an infinite branching hierarchy. We propose Graph Sparse Sampling (GSS), an online planning algorithm that shares sampled futures across many candidate decisions, rather than sampling separate successors for each candidate action. This branch-free graph exposes large GPU-friendly batches, while using heuristics to focus computation. We prove finite-sample performance guarantees for GSS covering full-rank or low-rank generative simulators via smoothed backups, and discrete or sampled continuous action spaces. Under suitable overlap, regularity, and action-coverage conditions, these bounds have polynomial dependence on the planning horizon, formalizing when shared futures can avoid the exponential horizon dependence of tree-shaped sparse sampling. We demonstrate continuous-control simulations where GSS substantially outperforms tree-based planners on long horizons or achieves near-optimal performance, supporting no-branching graph planning as a complementary design principle for online control.

</details>


### [94] [SovereignPA-Bench: Evaluating User-Owned Personal Agents under Evolving Intent, Platform Mediation, and Consent Constraints](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.05363)
*Dylan Zongmin Liu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出了SovereignPA-Bench基准，用于评估个人代理在用户主权方面的表现，包括隐私、同意、证据、负担和操纵抵抗力。实验表明，完全主权脚手架优于直接方法、记忆-only、同意-only、证据-only、ReAct/工具使用、安全提示和法官守卫基线，同时减少了隐私泄露、同意违规、过度让步和操纵捕获。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基准评估工具使用、网页导航、桌面控制、个性化、推荐和演化上下文，但很少评估代理是否维护用户主权——即在推进用户当前利益的同时尊重隐私、同意、证据、用户负担以及对操纵性激励的抵抗。

Method: 提出SovereignPA-Bench基准，将代理可见的ObservableState与仅评估者可见的HiddenLabels分离，报告任务成功、对齐、隐私、同意、证据、操纵、负担和可审计性等组件指标。评估120个主权压力场景，涵盖4个模型家族和8个策略基线，生成3,840条冻结提示轨迹，并进行240个项目的盲审3-注释者审计。

Result: 完全主权脚手架在所有基线上提升了主权分数，同时减少了隐私泄露、同意违规、过度让步和操纵捕获。人类审计在隐私和同意方面具有高度一致性，在操纵方面一致性较低，识别出平台说服判断的主观前沿。

Conclusion: 个人代理评估必须超越任务完成，向具有代表性、同意感知、证据为基础的行动发展。

Abstract: Personal agents are becoming persistent user-owned intermediaries: they remember preferences, filter platform-mediated information, use tools, and negotiate with services. Existing benchmarks evaluate tool use, web navigation, desktop control, personalization, recommendation, and evolving context, but rarely ask whether an agent preserves user sovereignty: advancing the user's current interests while respecting privacy, consent, evidence, user burden, and resistance to manipulative incentives. We introduce SovereignPA-Bench, an executable benchmark for evaluating user-owned personal agents under evolving intent, platform mediation, privacy boundaries, consent constraints, evidence requirements, and burden tradeoffs. The benchmark separates agent-visible ObservableState from evaluator-only HiddenLabels, reports component metrics for task success, alignment, privacy, consent, evidence, manipulation, burden, and auditability, and preserves paired scenario ordering for model and policy comparisons. We evaluate 120 sovereignty stress scenarios across 4 model families and 8 policy baselines, yielding 3,840 frozen-prompt trajectories with raw prompts, outputs, provider-form responses, parsed actions, recomputable metrics, hard-set analyses, qualitative cases, and a blinded 3-annotator audit over 240 items. Full-sovereign scaffolding improves sovereignty score over direct, memory-only, consent-only, evidence-only, ReAct/tool-use, safety-prompt, and judge-guard baselines while reducing privacy leakage, consent violation, over-concession, and manipulation capture. Human audit shows high agreement on privacy and consent and lower agreement on manipulation, identifying the subjective frontier of platform-persuasion judgments. These results show that personal-agent evaluation must move beyond task completion toward representative, consent-aware, evidence-grounded action.

</details>


### [95] [LLM-as-a-Verifier: A General-Purpose Verification Framework](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.05391)
*Jacky Kwok,Shulu Li,Pranav Atreya,Yuejiang Liu,Yixing Jiang,Chelsea Finn,Marco Pavone,Ion Stoica,Azalia Mirhoseini*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出LLM-as-a-Verifier框架，通过将验证器的评分从离散分数扩展为基于logits分布的连续分数，实现了验证在评分粒度、重复评估和标准分解三个维度上的扩展，在多个基准测试上达到SOTA，并能用于强化学习提供密集反馈。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的LLM验证方法通常使用离散评分，难以区分正负候选解之间的细微差异。作者希望将验证能力作为新的扩展轴，通过连续概率评分实现对解决方案更精确、更鲁棒的验证。

Method: LLM-as-a-Verifier利用评分token logits的概率分布计算期望作为连续分数，替代传统的离散打分。该方法支持三个维度的扩展：(1)评分粒度细化；(2)重复评估；(3)标准分解。同时设计了基于连续分数的成本高效排序算法来选择最佳候选解。

Result: 在Terminal-Bench V2 (86.5%)、SWE-Bench Verified (78.2%)、RoboRewardBench (87.4%)和MedAgentBench (73.3%)上达到SOTA。连续评分在三个维度上的扩展均带来了验证准确率的提升。此外，该方法还可为RL算法（SAC和GRPO）提供密集奖励信号，提升样本效率。

Conclusion: 验证可以作为大语言模型能力提升的新的有效扩展轴。LLM-as-a-Verifier框架无需额外训练即可提供细粒度反馈，在代理任务验证和强化学习训练中均展现显著优势，具有广泛的应用前景。

Abstract: Scaling pre-training, post-training, and test-time compute have become the central paradigms for improving the capabilities of LLMs. In this work, we identify verification, the ability to determine the correctness of a solution, as a new scaling axis. To unlock this and demonstrate its effectiveness, we introduce LLM-as-a-Verifier, a general-purpose verification framework that provides fine-grained feedback for agentic tasks without requiring additional training. Unlike standard LM judges that prompt LLMs to produce discrete scores for candidate solutions, LLM-as-a-Verifier computes the expectation over the distribution of scoring token logits to generate continuous scores. This probabilistic formulation enables verification to scale along multiple dimensions: (1) score granularity, (2) repeated evaluation, and (3) criteria decomposition. In particular, we show that scaling the scoring granularity leads to better separation between positive and negative solutions, resulting in more calibrated comparisons. Moreover, scaling repeated evaluation and criteria decomposition consistently lead to additional gains in verification accuracy through variance and complexity reduction. We further introduce a cost-efficient ranking algorithm for selecting the best solution among candidates using the verifier's continuous scores. LLM-as-a-Verifier achieves state-of-the-art performance on Terminal-Bench V2 (86.5%), SWE-Bench Verified (78.2%), RoboRewardBench (87.4%), and MedAgentBench (73.3%). Beyond verification, the fine-grained signals from LLM-as-a-Verifier can also serve as a proxy for estimating task progress. We build an extension for Claude Code, enabling developers to monitor and improve their own agentic systems. Finally, we show that LLM-as-a-Verifier can provide dense feedback for RL, improving the sample efficiency of SAC and GRPO on robotics and mathematical reasoning benchmarks.

</details>

### [96] [Benchmarking the Benchmarks: A Validity Audit of Tool-Calling Evaluation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.02577)
*Vishvesh Bhat,Jay Vaghasiya,Muhammad Ahmed Mohsin,Asad Aali*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文对四大工具调用基准（BFCL v4、τ2-Bench、LiveMCPBench、MCP-Atlas）进行了系统性的有效性和可重复性审计，发现评估器与人工判断之间有18.5%的不一致率，并揭示了确定性基准和LLM评判基准的多类失效模式，包括LiveMCPBench评估结果波动高达18.9个百分点，足以改变排行榜结论。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 工具调用基准被广泛用于排序语言模型代理，但其评分常被当作地面真理，而评估器本身的有效性未被验证。现有基准缺乏对评估器自身可靠性的系统审计。

Method: 对BFCL v4、τ2-Bench、LiveMCPBench和MCP-Atlas四个主要基准族进行系统性审计，由专家审查496个基准任务，计算评估器与人类判断的不一致率，并分类分析失效模式。引入统一的工具调用评估失败分类法，提出Tool-Veritas和Harness Lab。

Result: 共发现92处评估器与人类判断不一致，不一致率为18.5%。确定性基准存在脆弱状态匹配、轨迹锁定、错误地面真理、基于子串的通信失败和奖励基准未对齐等问题；LLM评判基准存在评分标准漂移、幻觉完成、仅答案评分和显著的运行间方差。LiveMCPBench在23次重复评估中得分范围从57.9%到76.8%，跨度18.9个百分点。

Conclusion: 当前工具调用基准的得分可能反映的是评估器伪影而非代理能力。亟需可重复、可审计且与人类判断对齐的评估器。建议采用分解式指标分别测量工具调用、任务完成和结果验证，并介绍了Tool-Veritas和Harness Lab作为解决方案。

Abstract: Tool-calling benchmarks are increasingly used to rank language-model agents, yet their scores are often treated as ground truth without validating the evaluators themselves. We present a systematic validity and reproducibility audit of four major tool-calling benchmark families: BFCL v4, τ2-Bench, LiveMCPBench, and MCP-Atlas. Across 496 expert-reviewed benchmark tasks, we find 92 evaluator-human disagreements, corresponding to an 18.5% misalignment rate. The failures are not isolated annotation mistakes: deterministic benchmarks exhibit brittle state matching, trajectory lock-in, incorrect ground truths, substring-based communication failures, and reward-basis misalignment, while LLM-judge benchmarks exhibit rubric drift, hallucinated completion, answer-only scoring, and substantial run-to-run variance. In LiveMCPBench, 23 repeated evaluations of the same setup produce scores ranging from 57.9% to 76.8%, a spread of 18.9 percentage points, large enough to change leaderboard conclusions. These results show that current tool-calling scores can reflect evaluator artifacts rather than agent capability. We introduce a unified taxonomy of tool-calling evaluation failures, release trace-level audit artifacts and corrected evaluation components, and argue for decomposed metrics that separately measure tool invocation, task completion, and outcome verification. Our findings suggest that progress in tool-using agents requires benchmarks whose evaluators are themselves reproducible, auditable, and aligned with human judgments of task success. We further introduce Tool-Veritas, a configurable benchmark that combines deterministic state verification with optional qualitative judging, and Harness Lab, an open-source system for benchmark execution, trace inspection, repeated-run comparison, and evaluator debugging.

</details>


### [97] [When Not to Write Memory: Governing False Promotion from Correlated Agent Traces](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.02579)
*Yijiashun Qi,Xiang Xu,Yuxuan Li*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文提出GovMem，一种依赖感知的记忆写入治理策略，用于判断语言代理是否应拒绝写入记忆。在合成测试中将错误提升率从0.597降至0.040，但在真实标注数据中表现高度保守（召回率0.448，审查负担0.692），最终在外部编码代理场景中无一自动提升安全。结论主张应将代理记忆写入视为风险控制的证据治理系统。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长寿命语言代理会从其执行轨迹中写入可复用的记忆，但关键安全问题不仅是代理应该记住什么，还包括何时应拒绝写入记忆。跨代理的重复观察不一定是独立证据——同一主张可能来自共享源、被共享提示诱导、在新环境下过时，或仅在狭窄范围内有效。该问题被定义为记忆写入路径治理问题。

Method: 提出GovMem，一种保守的诊断性参考策略，包含四个步骤：估计依赖感知的支持度、检索反例、分配作用域、输出三种决策（提升/拒绝/需审查）。

Result: 在合成压力测试中，错误提升率从0.597降至0.040，召回率保持0.960；在120个候选的内部真实标注数据子集中，依赖感知提升将错误提升率从0.371降至0.032，但保留集错误提升率为0.111，审查负担0.692，直接召回率0.448；在133个外部编码代理候选的人类裁决中，无一是安全可自动提升的，11个验证门阳性全部被驳回。

Conclusion: GovMem主要作为诊断性的治理设计点，而非通用验证或高效自动记忆写入器。代理记忆写入路径应作为风险控制的证据治理系统进行评估，且需要更广泛的外部覆盖和下游危害证据才能做出更强有力的主张。

Abstract: Long-lived language agents increasingly write reusable memories from their own execution traces. The key safety question is not only what agents should remember, but when they should refuse to write memory at all. Repeated observations across agents are not necessarily independent evidence: the same claim may be copied from a shared source, induced by a shared prompt, stale under a new environment, or valid only in a narrower scope. We study this failure mode as a memory writepath governance problem. We introduce GovMem as a conservative diagnostic reference policy that estimates dependency-aware support, retrieves counterevidence, assigns scope, and outputs one of three decisions: promote, reject, or needs-review. In controlled synthetic stress tests, GovMem reduces false promotion from 0.597 to 0.040 in the default setting while preserving 0.960 recall, at an explicit review burden. In a project-internal 120candidate human-labeled real-trace subset spanning 79 recorded traces and project reports, dependency-aware promotion reduces false promotion from 0.371 for source+scope to 0.032 overall, but held-out false promotion remains 0.111 and the method is highly conservative, with 0.692 review burden and 0.448 direct recall. A final human adjudication of 133 high-impact external codingagent candidates is more severe: none are safe for automatic promotion, and all 11 verification-gate positives are rejected as boilerplate, shared-tool artifacts, file dumps, or non-reusable debugging traces. These results support GovMem primarily as a diagnostic governance design point, not as a generally validated or efficient automatic memory writer: agent memory write paths should be evaluated as risk-controlled evidence-governance systems, while broader external coverage and downstream harm evidence are still needed before stronger claims.

</details>


### [98] [Better Together, in the Right Order: Classical-then-LLM Optimization for SE](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.02583)
*Srinath Srinivasan,Tim Menzies*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: SNAP2方法通过将廉价经典学习器的结果作为LLM的种子输入，在软件工程配置任务中取得了优于纯LLM和经典优化器主导方法的效果，且成本更低（减少30% token消耗，速度提升1.4倍）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有工作多由经典优化器主导搜索循环，LLM仅用于辅助子程序。作者认为反向思路——用经典学习器结果播种LLM——可能更有价值。

Method: 提出SNAP2方法：先用廉价经典学习器快速获得结果，再将这些结果作为种子输入给LLM进行精细化处理，让经典学习器做廉价工作，LLM负责收尾。

Result: 在超过100个SE任务上，SNAP2在85%的任务中达到顶级性能，优于单独LLM（75%）及其他经典优化器主导的方法。同时token消耗减少约30%，运行速度提升1.4倍。

Conclusion: 不应孤立研究经典学习器或LLM，两者结合的价值很大，且结合的顺序至关重要——先用经典学习器再做LLM提升的方式比反向做法更有效。

Abstract: A growing body of work combines large language models (LLMs) with classical optimizers for software engineering (SE) configuration tasks. Often, the classical optimizer is in charge: it owns the search loop and calls the LLM only to assist in subroutines (e.g. to warm-start the first generation, propose a mutation, or stand in as a surrogate). We report that there is much value in the reverse approach: seeding an LLM with the results from a cheap classical learner.
  We call this method SNAP2. Applied to over 100 SE tasks, it is the single best of all methods studied, reaching the top tier on 85% of tasks, ahead of the same LLM run alone (75%) and ahead of every method in which the classical optimizer retains control. It is also less expensive: relative to the LLM-alone method, it uses roughly 30% fewer tokens and runs 1.4x faster, since the classical setup performs the inexpensive work, and the LLM is invoked only to finish.
  We conclude that it is unwise to study classical learners or LLMs in isolation: there is much value in combining the two, and in the order that combination is applied.

</details>


### [99] [The Moving Target: A Longitudinal Audit of Trustworthiness Drift Across Twelve Checkpoints of Open-Source Chat LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.02587)
*Zhichao Fan,Yanhang Li,Zexin Zhuang,Xian Sun,Yingshuo Wang*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文审计了四个开源模型系列（Yi、Qwen、Mistral、Gemma）在连续检查点间的信任基准分数漂移，发现相邻检查点间的分数变化显著高于无漂移的零假设，证明信任分数不应跨检查点沿用，而应作为绑定检查点、带日期的制品，以纵向模型卡形式报告。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 模型卡片引用的信任基准分数未记录测量时间，且同一分数常被直接沿用至同一发布线的后续检查点，忽视了模型权重可能发生的变化，导致信任度量的不可靠。

Method: 对四个开源模型系列（Yi、Qwen、Mistral、Gemma）各三代检查点，在固定信任基准集上使用多种提示模板进行审计，计算相邻检查点间的平均绝对漂移，并与基于独立性的无漂移零假设进行比较。

Result: 相邻检查点间的平均绝对漂移显著高于无漂移零假设，且该差异在剔除单个基准、剔除单个系列或改用严格评分后仍然存在。

Conclusion: 信任分数不应跨检查点沿用，而应作为绑定检查点、带日期的制品；建议采用纵向模型卡进行报告。封闭API、更大模型、标准基准协议和固定月度节奏规则不在审计范围内，需单独评估。

Abstract: Model cards quote trust-benchmark scores without recording when they were measured, and the same number is routinely carried across successive checkpoints of one release line as if the model behind it had not shifted. We test whether it has shifted by auditing four open-source release lines, Yi, Qwen, Mistral, and Gemma, at three successive generations each, on a fixed basket of trust benchmarks under multiple prompt templates. Mean absolute adjacent-generation drift lands well above an independence-based no-drift reference null, and the gap persists when we drop a benchmark, drop a release line, or switch to strict scoring. We therefore conclude that a trust score attached to a release line should not be carried forward to the next checkpoint without remeasurement; it should instead be reported as a checkpoint-bound, dated artefact, which we package as a longitudinal model card. Closed APIs, larger models, canonical benchmark protocols, and fixed month-cadence rules lie outside the audited scope and require their own evaluation.

</details>


### [100] [OmniPresent: Generating Coherent Presentation Suites from Scientific Papers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.02590)
*Qianli Ma,Jipeng Xiao,Siyu Wang,Zhiheng Tian,Wangyu Feng,Shibo Wang,Chang Guo,Shuochen Chang,Qingyang Liu,Zhipeng Zhang*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文提出OmniPresent框架，将静态研究论文自动转化为海报、幻灯片、视频等动态媒体套件，通过统一的HTML表示和自纠错机制保证内容一致性，并发布包含千篇论文的OmniPreBench数据集及评估协议，实验表明该方法在准确性和视觉吸引力上显著超越现有基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有自动化方法将海报、幻灯片、视频等呈现形式孤立处理，导致整个呈现套件在语义上缺乏一致性；而将静态论文转化为动态媒体对有效传播至关重要，但手工制作劳动强度大。

Method: 提出OmniPresent框架：(1)采用可渲染HTML统一表示实现集中式内容规划；(2)引入自纠错的验证-修复循环(verify-and-repair)，主动解决跨模态冲突；(3)构建OmniPreBench数据集（超千篇论文及配对制品）并设计基于VLM的评估协议。

Result: 实验结果显示该方法生成的呈现套件在质量和忠实度上显著超越多个强基线，在准确性和视觉吸引力方面均表现优异。

Conclusion: 统一化、可纠错的端到端框架能够有效解决多模态呈现内容的一致性问题，为学术成果的自动化传播提供了可行方案。

Abstract: Transforming static research papers into dynamic media such as posters, slides, and videos is essential for effective dissemination but remains a labor-intensive challenge. Existing automated approaches often treat these formats in isolation and consequently fail to maintain semantic consistency across the entire presentation suite. We address this fragmentation by formalizing the task of unified presentation suite generation and proposing $\textbf{OmniPresent}$ to orchestrate the creation of coherent deliverables. Our framework adopts a renderable HTML representation to enable centralized content planning and a self-correcting verify-and-repair loop that actively resolves conflicts across modalities. We further facilitate scalable research in this domain by releasing $\textbf{OmniPreBench}$, a comprehensive dataset comprising over one thousand papers with paired artifacts, and establishing a rigorous VLM-based evaluation protocol. Empirical results confirm that our method generates high-quality and faithful presentation suites that significantly surpass strong baselines in both accuracy and visual appeal.

</details>


### [101] [Attributing Structured-Output Gains in Function Calling: Interface Alignment versus Procedural Transfer](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.02595)
*Wanyi Chen,Daoyuan Chen,Fang Kong*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文提出一个四层增益归因协议，用于区分结构化输出基准测试中提示注入带来的技能提升究竟源于接口对齐还是程序性迁移。实验表明，大量表观增益实际上来自格式合规性而非技能迁移。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 结构化输出基准测试同时奖励任务决策和接口合规性，因此提示注入的函数调用增益需要归因后才能被解释为可迁移技能。现有方法无法区分这两种贡献。

Method: 提出四层增益归因协议：(1) 规范化重新评分；(2) 格式控制；(3) 修复/平衡归纳；(4) 可移植性检查。应用于BFCL基准测试，并用API-Bank、MATH-500和MultiHop-RAG进行范围限定。

Result: 格式仅提示在BFCL关键单元格中匹配或超越完整技能；修复/平衡归纳消除了最大子前沿增益；API-Bank目标原生增益与长度匹配的通用程序性提示差异在0.5个百分点以内。

Conclusion: 格式合规性是一种有用的工程能力，但结构化输出分数需要审慎解读。推荐使用规范化指标、平衡归纳和格式仅基线来进行函数调用技能增益归因。发布了BFCL-CANONICAL数据集。

Abstract: Structured-output benchmarks reward both task decisions and interface compliance, so prompt-induced function-calling gains require attribution before they can be interpreted as transferable skill. We introduce a four-layer gain-attribution protocol for prompt-prepended skill injection, combining canonicalized rescoring, format-only controls, repaired/balanced induction, and portability checks. Applied to the Berkeley Function Calling Leaderboard (BFCL) and scoped with API-Bank, MATH-500, and MultiHop-RAG, the protocol shows that several apparent gains are better attributed to interface alignment than to procedural transfer: format-only prompts match or exceed full skills in key BFCL cells, repaired/balanced induction removes the largest sub-frontier gains, and API-Bank target-native gains are matched within 0.5 percentage points (pp) by length-matched generic procedural prompts. These findings treat format compliance as a useful engineering capability while clarifying what a structured-output score certifies. We release BFCL-CANONICAL and recommend canonicalized metrics, balanced induction, and format-only baselines for function-calling skill-gain attribution. Code and data are available at https://github.com/couragec/skill-injection-attribution.

</details>


### [102] [AgentLTL: A Trace-Verification Framework for Measuring, Enforcing, and Training Procedural Compliance in Tool-Using LLM Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.02599)
*Laïla Elkoussy,Julien Perez*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文提出AgentLTL，一种基于一阶线性时态逻辑的语言，用于对LLM智能体的轨迹进行程序化规则约束，支持在线拦截和微调奖励，实验证明该方法能显著提升模型在程序化任务中的合规性和准确性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有评估方法仅关注最终答案正确性或LLM评判，忽略了安全关键场景中过程本身的正确性，因此需要一种能够表达和评估智能体执行过程是否符合程序化规则的方法。

Method: 提出AgentLTL语言（基于FO-LTL），用于描述智能体轨迹的程序化规则；该框架支持两种用途：1) 在线拦截（block-and-warn harness）：在工具调用前检查前缀是否合规；2) 微调：将合规性评分作为密集奖励信号进行强化学习。

Result: 在排序、分支、迭代和接地等任务基准上，block-and-warn拦截方法在7个模型中的5个上提升了合规性；使用相同奖励进行微调，在未见过的工具别名等保留模式上，准确率和合规性分别提升了38和17.5个百分点。

Conclusion: 模型学习到了程序化结构而非简单记忆表面工具名称和程序，验证了AgentLTL框架在引导智能体行为遵守程序规则方面的有效性。

Abstract: Tool-using LLM agents are usually evaluated by final-answer correctness or LLM judges. Neither captures how an answer was produced. In safety-critical settings, the procedure itself is part of correctness. In this paper, we introduce AgentLTL, a language derived from First-Order Linear Temporal Logic (FO-LTL) that expresses procedural rules over agent traces. It yields a deterministic, judge-free compliance score. In this framework, a single specification drives two usages. The first is harnessing: the constraints score completed traces, or gate tool calls by checking each prefix online, before execution. The second is finetuning: the score serves as a dense reward. On a benchmark spanning ordering, branching, iteration, and grounding, block-and-warn harnessing improves compliance on five of seven models. Finetuning with the same reward yields +38 and +17.5 percentage point gains in accuracy and compliance on held-out patterns, including unseen tool-name aliases. These findings are consistent with the model acquiring procedural structure rather than memorizing surface tool names and procedures.

</details>


### [103] [A Survey of LLM-Driven Penetration Testing: Taxonomy, Co-Evolution, and Open Challenges](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.02605)
*Zheyuan He,Jiaxun Dong,Zihao Li,Ting Chen,Gelei Deng,Feng Luo,Jinkun Ji,Yuanlong Cao,Xiapu Luo*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 该综述系统分析了2023-2026年间81篇关于LLM自主渗透测试系统（Agents4Pentest）的论文，提出了统一分类体系，揭示了从纯文本推理智能体到RLVR训练智能体的四阶段架构演进，并总结了评估可靠性、多阶段攻击性能、高质量训练数据稀缺三大开放挑战。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 该领域缺乏统一的分类法，对智能体架构与评估基准如何共同演进缺乏系统理解，且对现有能力与可靠性差距缺少清晰刻画。

Method: 对2023-2026年间81篇论文进行系统分析，将文献分为六类（评估基准、通用系统、领域特定框架、CTF系统、防御导向研究、综述），并追踪四阶段架构演化路径。

Result: (1) RLVR标志着能力获取从模仿专家演示转向奖励驱动的自我改进，可发现未记录的攻 击策略；(2) CTF平台从评估测试床演变为兼具评估与RL训练的双重用途基础设施；(3) 领域特定框架通过专有化机制提升效率，但增益局限于窄任务类且难以跨域比较；(4) 领域正从攻击自动化向防御与安全合规扩展。

Conclusion: 识别出三个结构性开放挑战：评估可靠性不足、多阶段攻击场景性能受限、高质量训练数据稀缺。

Abstract: Agents4Pentest, an emerging class of LLM-based autonomous penetration testing systems, has become a rapidly growing area in security research. Despite this growth, the field still lacks a unified taxonomy, a systematic understanding of how agent architectures and evaluation benchmarks have co-evolved, and a clear characterization of remaining capability and reliability gaps. This survey addresses these gaps through a systematic analysis of 81 papers between 2023 and 2026. We organize the literature into six categories: evaluation benchmarks, general-purpose systems, domain-specific frameworks, CTF-based systems, defense-oriented research, and surveys. We further trace a four-phase architectural evolution from text-only reasoning agents to agents trained with Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR), showing that each transition is driven by a distinct capability bottleneck. Our analysis yields several key findings. First, RLVR marks a shift in capability acquisition from imitation of expert demonstrations to reward-driven self-improvement, enabling agents to discover previously undocumented attack strategies. Second, CTF platforms have evolved from evaluation testbeds into dual-purpose infrastructure for both agent evaluation and RL training. Third, domain-specific frameworks improve efficiency through recurring specialization mechanisms, but their gains remain largely confined to narrow task classes and are difficult to compare across domains because existing evaluations rely on different benchmarks. Fourth, the field is expanding beyond offensive automation toward adversarial defense and security compliance. Across these categories, we identify three structurally linked open challenges: evaluation reliability, limited performance on multi-stage attack scenarios, and scarcity of high-quality training data.

</details>


### [104] [ChainSWE: Benchmarking Coding Agents on Multi-Bug Software Maintenance](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.02606)
*Qirui Jin,Lingching Tung,Kenan Li,Qiyang Shi,Yushi She,Huanzhong Jia,Harrison Zhao,Kejing Xia,Zhenbang Du,Yikai Zhang,Jiaxin Pei,Zhenyu Zhang,Zhen Qi,Yuyan Duan,Wenke Lee,Zijian Jin*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: ChainSWE是首个评估智能体在共享代码库中顺序修复相关缺陷的基准，包含来自54个Python项目的304个按时间排序的问题链。实验表明，随着链长度增加，模型性能下降高达70%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有SWE基准每次只评估单个独立bug修复，忽略了连续维护工作流中累积依赖关系的挑战，无法反映真实世界的bug修复场景。

Method: 从六个SWE-bench系列数据集中挖掘54个Python项目的304个按时间顺序排列的问题链，构建ChainSWE基准，用于评估智能体在共享代码库上执行连续、相关bug修复的能力。

Result: 随着问题链长度增加，各类智能体和模型的性能一致下降，最高降幅达70%。

Conclusion: 连续、依赖性的bug修复场景对当前LM智能体构成显著挑战，现有独立评估范式高估了模型在实际维护工作流中的能力。

Abstract: Language model (LM) agents are increasingly deployed to maintain codebases over extended periods, fixing streams of related defects while carrying context from one fix to the next. Yet existing software engineering (SWE) benchmarks evaluate models one bug at a time: the repository is reset, the codebase is re-read, and a single self-contained issue is graded in isolation. This setting collapses a continuous maintenance workflow into a series of independent sessions, ignoring the cumulative dependencies that make real-world bug fixing challenging. To bridge this gap, we introduce ChainSWE, the first benchmark for evaluating agents on sequential, dependent bug fixes within a shared codebase. We collect chronological chains of 304 issues across 54 Python projects, mined from six SWE-bench-family datasets. Our evaluation across a range of agents and models reveals a consistent performance drop by up to 70% as the chain length increases.

</details>


### [105] [Knowledge-Centric Information Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.02609)
*Mariano Garralda-Barrio*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文提出"知识架构"（Knowledge Architecture）作为企业AI时代的新架构学科，将传统数据工程原则（ETL、CDC、血缘等）重新定义以适配知识制品管理，实现组织知识从被动信息资源向可操作资产的转变。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大语言模型的兴起暴露了传统数据工程在应对可执行知识管理时的局限性——组织知识正成为可检索、组装、推理和执行的基础设施，现有数据架构无法满足知识作为操作化资产的需求。

Method: 通过概念模型和分类学方法，系统性地将传统数据工程概念映射到知识工程领域：ETL→知识摄取、CDC→知识变更检测、血缘→溯源、目录→知识目录、物化视图→知识视图、奖章架构→原始-精选-操作化知识层，并引用LLM Wiki和OKF作为早期证据。

Result: 提出了"知识架构"这一新学科框架，明确了知识作为可操作资产（被人类、智能体、工作流和模型使用）时的架构原则，并给出了从数据工程到知识工程的概念映射谱系。

Conclusion: 知识架构在组织知识从被动信息资源转变为可操作资产时变得不可或缺，当前新兴的知识格式只是这一长期转型的起点而非终点。

Abstract: For decades, data engineering has developed mature architectural principles for integrating, governing, validating, cataloging, and serving organizational data. The rise of large language models does not eliminate these concerns; it exposes a broader version of them. Organizational knowledge is becoming executable infrastructure: systems increasingly retrieve it, assemble it, reason over it, and act on it. This paper argues that enterprise artificial intelligence (AI) systems suggest a transition toward an architectural discipline for representing, maintaining, governing, and operationally delivering organizational knowledge. We refer to this discipline as \emph{knowledge architecture}. We offer a conceptual model and taxonomy showing how classical data-engineering guarantees must be redefined when the managed unit shifts from records to knowledge artifacts: extract, transform, and load (ETL) becomes knowledge ingestion, change-data capture (CDC) becomes knowledge change detection, lineage becomes provenance, catalogs become knowledge catalogs, materialized views become knowledge views, and medallion architectures become raw--curated--operational knowledge layers. Emerging formats such as large language model (LLM) Wiki and the Open Knowledge Format (OKF) are treated as early evidence of this transition, not as its endpoint. The central claim is that knowledge architecture becomes useful when organizational knowledge ceases to be a passive information resource and becomes an operational asset used by humans, agents, workflows, and models to execute work.

</details>


### [106] [Dependencies that Bundle Code and Execution](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.02618)
*Aman Sharma,Martin Monperrus*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: LIBCACHE是首个将执行缓存作为一等制品通过包注册表分发的系统。库维护者将测试套件产生的执行缓存发布到Maven Central，构建时合并各依赖缓存形成统一缓存，加速应用启动最高达1.91倍，缓存体积约为JAR的18倍。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有应用依赖只分发编译代码而不包含执行状态，每次启动都需要重新构建执行状态，造成启动开销。没有现有系统将执行状态发布到注册表供下游消费者复用。

Method: 核心方法包括：(1) 库维护者从测试套件生成执行缓存并发布到Maven Central；(2) 构建时LIBCACHE将所有依赖缓存合并为统一缓存；(3) 合并后的缓存覆盖各依赖测试套件所执行的类。

Result: 在三个真实Java项目、12个工作负载上评估，应用启动加速最高1.91倍；在10/12个工作负载上优于单工作负载缓存；batik项目平均加速1.60倍（vs 1.27倍）；缓存生产增加10-47%构建时间；执行缓存体积平均为对应JAR的18倍。

Conclusion: LIBCACHE证明了执行缓存可作为可分发的供应链制品，且合并各依赖缓存比单一观测运行能提供更广泛的启动覆盖。

Abstract: Applications are built from many dependencies. Each dependency is distributed by package registries but it only contains compiled code and does not ship execution state, so runtimes rebuild that state from scratch on every startup. Execution caching records this preparation result so subsequent starts can skip it, but no existing system publishes execution state to a registry for downstream consumers to reuse. We introduce LIBCACHE, the first system to distribute per-dependency execution caches through a package registry as first-class artifacts alongside compiled code. Each library maintainer produces an execution cache from the library's own test suite and publishes it to Maven Central alongside the JAR. At application build time, LIBCACHE merges all per-dependency caches into a single unified cache that covers the classes exercised across every dependency's test suite. We evaluate LIBCACHE on three real-world Java projects across twelve workloads. LIBCACHE speeds up application startup by up to 1.91x and outperforms a cache built from a single workload in 10 of 12 workloads, with the largest average gain for batik (1.60x vs. 1.27x). Cache production adds 10-47% to build time for applications, and execution caches average 18x the size of the corresponding JAR. Our main contribution is LIBCACHE, which establishes that execution caches are distributable supply chain artifacts and that merging per-dependency caches delivers broader startup coverage than any single observation run.

</details>


### [107] [Schedulable Job-Level Dependencies for Cause-Effect Chains via Graph Neural Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.02624)
*Silviu S. Craciunas,Christian Hakert,Jian-Jia Chen,Zdeněk Hanzálek,Paul Pop*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文提出首个基于机器学习的作业级依赖（JLD）合成方法，采用两级图神经网络结合温度控制采样，并通过生成-验证架构（含DP数据年龄检查、EDF可行性检查及系统级需求边界测试）确保解的 correctness，在显著优于贪心启发式的同时实现数量级加速。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有JLD合成方法无法检查生成的JLD在具体调度策略下是否可执行，也无法保证系统级的可调度性。需要一种既能高效合成JLD又能确保其可执行性和可调度性的方法。

Method: 提出两级图神经网络（GNN）与温度控制采样，学习因果链配置到JLD解的结构模式；嵌入生成-验证架构，包含安全的数据年龄检查器、每链EDF可行性检查器和系统级需求边界测试，对候选解进行接受或拒绝。

Result: 基于ML的生成器在合成质量上大幅超越原始贪心启发式，同时合成时间降低数个数量级，表明学习到的结构先验能有效替代指数级传播树枚举。

Conclusion: 证明了在实时调度问题中，通过结构先验学习可以有效替代传统指数枚举方法，实现高效且正确的JLD合成。

Abstract: Modern automotive software architectures comprise large sets of mixed-criticality functions executing on shared multi-core platforms with strict real-time and end-to-end timing requirements. Sensor-to-actuator data propagation in such systems is typically expressed via cause-effect chains with worst-case data-age budgets. Job-level dependencies (JLDs) have been introduced to provide a schedule-agnostic mechanism for bounding the data age independently of the underlying scheduler. The state-of-the-art methods for synthesizing JLDs, however, do not check whether the produced JLDs are enforceable under a concrete scheduling policy or jointly schedulable at the system level. In this paper we propose the first machine-learning-based JLD synthesis method, built around a two-level Graph Neural Network with temperature-controlled sampling that learns the structural patterns connecting cause-effect chain configurations to their JLD solutions. Since learned outputs may not be correct by construction, we embed the GNN in a novel Generate-and-Verify architecture in which a safe DP data-age checker, together with a per-chain EDF feasibility checker and a system-level demand-bound test, accept or reject each candidate. We show that the ML-based generator substantially outperforms the original greedy heuristic while achieving orders-of-magnitude lower synthesis time, demonstrating that learned structural priors can effectively replace exponential propagation-tree enumeration on this class of real-time scheduling problems.

</details>


### [108] [A large-scale dataset of Android applications and their SDK dependencies](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.02627)
*Aurora Gori Savellini,Tiziano Squartini,Massimo Riccaboni*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文介绍了一个大规模Android应用与第三方SDK依赖关系的数据集，包含334,719个应用版本观测、99,722个应用和246个SDK，通过静态分析管道从AndroZoo和Exodus Privacy数据构建，支持依赖网络分析和移动生态系统的技术集中度研究。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 移动应用广泛依赖第三方SDK，但这些组件在移动生态系统中构成了重要但常被忽视的隐藏层，缺乏大规模、可复现的研究基础设施来支撑对第三方技术依赖、数据收集能力和隐私基础设施的研究。

Method: 采用可复现的静态分析管道：整合AndroZoo的APK包文件与元数据，结合Exodus Privacy提供的SDK检测规则，通过代码级签名匹配对APK进行编译代码分析以检测SDK，并将SDK映射到其所属运营公司。

Result: 构建了包含334,719个应用版本观测（对应99,722个Android应用）和246个第三方SDK的数据集，包含应用级元数据（类别、评论、文件大小、下载量、评分）和SDK级元数据（类别、代码根目录、代码版本、名称），支持构建大规模应用-SDK依赖网络。

Conclusion: 该数据集和管道已公开发布于GitHub和Zenodo，提供了可复用的研究基础设施，可用于研究第三方技术依赖、数据收集能力和隐私基础设施，支持移动生态系统中技术集中度和上游控制力的提供商级分析。

Abstract: Mobile applications (apps) increasingly rely on third-party Software Development Kits (SDKs) to provide services such as advertising, analytics, authentication, crash reporting, and location services. These components form an important, but often hidden, layer of the mobile ecosystem. Here, we present a large-scale dataset linking Android apps to the third-party SDKs they integrate. The dataset was constructed by combining app package files (APKs) and metadata from AndroZoo with SDK detection rules provided by Exodus Privacy. We implemented a reproducible, static-analysis pipeline that downloads APKs, inspects their compiled code, and detects SDKs through code-level signature matching: the released dataset contains 334,719 unique app-version observations (associated with 99,722 Android apps) and 246 third-party SDKs - including app-level metadata such as categories, comments, file size, download counts, ratings and SDK-level metadata such as categories, code roots, code versions, names. The dataset supports the construction of a large-scale app-SDK dependency network and its projection onto both layers; in addition, SDKs are mapped to their corresponding operating companies, enabling provider-level analysis of technological concentration and upstream control in the mobile ecosystem. To support reproducible research, the pipeline and dataset are publicly released on GitHub and Zenodo; more broadly, the project provides a reusable research infrastructure for studying third-party technological dependencies, data-collection capabilities, and privacy infrastructures across Android apps.

</details>


### [109] [Can Coding Agents Implement Missed Compiler Optimizations? Evaluating LLM Agents on LLVM Peephole Optimizations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.02684)
*Hongxu Xu,Chunhao Liao,Xintong Zhou,Chengnian Sun*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文提出PeepholeBench，一个基于LLVM的InstCombine pass中真实遗漏窥孔优化构建的评估框架。实验表明，当前最先进的编码智能体在正确性和收益性两个维度上均无法与人类开发者匹敌，主要失败模式为过于狭窄的变换和对LLVM特定机制的误用。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 探究基于大语言模型的编码智能体是否能够开发编译器优化，特别是针对LLVM中遗漏的窥孔优化。

Method: 从21个已解决的LLVM问题和19个合并的PR中构建评估任务，仅提供问题原始上下文，评估智能体生成的补丁的正确性和收益性。

Result: 无编码智能体能够在正确性和收益性两个维度上同时匹敌人类开发者；主要失败模式为过度窄化的变换和对LLVM特定机制的误用。

Conclusion: PeepholeBench是编码智能体在编译器优化开发任务上的现实且具有挑战性的基准，未来需要构建更可靠的智能体来辅助编译器优化开发。

Abstract: Coding agents built on large language models are now capable of patching sizable real-world codebases, yet whether they can develop compiler optimizations remains an open question. To study this question, we introduce PeepholeBench, an evaluation framework whose tasks are constructed from real-world missed peephole optimizations reported against LLVM's InstCombine pass. Since missed peephole optimizations are typically fixed with small, localized patches, they offer a well-scoped but demanding testbed for coding agents: a correct fix demands rigorous reasoning about program semantics along with familiarity with optimizer-specific conventions. PeepholeBench derives its tasks from 21 resolved LLVM issues and 19 merged pull requests (PRs), supplies agents with only the issue context that existed before each fix, and assesses the resulting patches for both correctness and profitability.
  With PeepholeBench, we benchmark state-of-the-art coding agents on fixing missed peephole optimizations in LLVM's InstCombine pass, measuring their patches against the corresponding human-written fixes. We observe a tension between correctness and profitability, and no agent matches human developers on both dimensions at once. The dominant failure modes are overly narrow transformations and misuse of LLVM-specific mechanisms, errors that existing test suites rarely expose. Together, these results establish PeepholeBench as a realistic and challenging benchmark for coding agents, and suggest future directions for building agents that can more dependably assist compiler optimization development.

</details>


### [110] [LLMoxie: Exploring Agentic AI for Scientific Software Development](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.02703)
*Landung Setiawan,Anant Mittal,Cordero Core,Anshul Tambay,Carlos Garcia Jurado Suarez,David A. C. Beck,Andrew J. Connolly,Vani Mandava*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文介绍LLMoxie，一个面向研究软件工程（RSE）中心的AI平台，采用三层架构支持多云和本地推理、身份认证/预算/PII脱敏/可观测性控制平面，以及应用增强层。其上构建的开源RSE-Plugins生态系统以"插件-智能体-技能"层级编码RSE累积知识，涵盖科学Python实践、领域知识、六阶段研究与实现工作流及项目生命周期管理。经过二十个月在跨天文学、地球气候、农业、健康等领域的RSE中心实践，该平台与插件将通用AI编码智能体转变为尊重社区规范、产生可审计技术推理轨迹的领域感知协作者。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有AI编码智能体针对商业软件基准优化，忽略了科学Python库的约定、对敏感/封禁数据处理不当、决策痕迹难以事后重建。而科学软件的评价标准并非原始代码质量，而是能否被引用、审计、复现和扩展。需要弥合通用AI编码工具与科学软件工程实践之间的差距。

Method: 设计LLMoxie三层平台架构（基础设施层+控制平面层+应用增强层），并构建开源RSE-Plugins生态，将RSE积累的知识编码为Plugin-Agent-Skill层级体系，涵盖科学Python实践、领域知识、六阶段研发展工作流、项目生命周期管理。在跨领域RSE中心进行二十个月实践验证。

Result: 通过二十个月在多个科学领域的RSE中心实践，平台和插件成功将AI编码智能体从通用代码生成器转变为领域感知协作者，能够尊重社区规范、处理敏感数据、并产生可审计的技术推理轨迹。

Conclusion: LLMoxie平台和RSE-Plugins生态系统有效解决了AI编码智能体在科学软件工程中的适配问题，证明了通过基础设施治理、领域知识编码和工作流嵌入，可以使AI工具真正服务于科学计算社区对可引用、可审计、可复现、可扩展的核心需求。

Abstract: In this paper, we describe LLMoxie, an institutional AI platform whose three-tiered architecture supports multi-cloud and on-premise inference, a LiteLLM/MLflow control plane for authentication, budgeting, PII masking, and observability, and an application augmentation layer for AI coding agents. Layered on top, an open-source RSE-Plugins ecosystem encodes accumulated RSE knowledge as a Plugin-Agent-Skill hierarchy spanning scientific Python practice, domain-specific knowledge, a six-phase research-and-implement workflow, and project lifecycle management. Scientific software is judged less by raw code quality than by whether it can be cited, audited, reproduced, and extended. Off-the-shelf AI coding agents, optimized against commercial software benchmarks, are poorly calibrated for this setting: they ignore the conventions of the scientific Python libraries they invoke, mishandle sensitive or embargoed data, and leave decision trails that are difficult to reconstruct after the fact. We report on twenty months of practice at a university-based research software engineering (RSE) center, where RSEs embedded across astronomy, earth and climate science, agriculture, and health projects worked to close this gap. We characterize the recurring infrastructure, governance, and process challenges of adopting Agentic AI inside a multi-domain RSE center, describe the platform and plugin design, and distill operational lessons from real scientific software deployments. Together, the platform and plugins shift AI coding agents from generic code generators into domain-aware collaborators that respect community norms and produce auditable provenance of technical reasoning.

</details>


### [111] [SMOCS: A Streaming Framework for Simplified Deployment, Monitoring, and Optimization of ML Systems in Production](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.02731)
*Armen Kasparian,Kishansingh Rajput,Malachi Schram,John Vennekate*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: SMOCS是一个基于Kafka和Docker的流式监控优化控制系统框架，通过三层抽象、三线程代理架构和配置驱动部署，解决了ML模型在科学设施中部署和运维的工程挑战，支持在线持续学习且无需软件工程专业知识。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在科学设施中部署和维护机器学习模型面临巨大的工程挑战，每个设施都有独特的数据协议、非标准格式和基础设施限制，导致团队需要为每个新应用重新构建集成管道。

Method: 1) 基于Apache Kafka的分层抽象，将基础设施与应用逻辑分离；2) 三线程代理架构，在时间上解耦数据摄取、模型训练和实时推理，支持从实时数据流中持续在线学习；3) 配置驱动的部署模型，使领域专家无需软件工程专业知识即可操作ML管道。

Result: SMOCS具有设施平台无关性、设计上的故障隔离性，并通过Docker容器化实现水平可扩展性，已作为开源软件发布在Jefferson Lab的Github上。

Conclusion: SMOCS提供了一个通用的、易于部署的框架，有效降低了ML模型在科学设施运维中的集成门槛，实现了持续在线学习能力。

Abstract: Machine learning has demonstrated significant potential for real-time monitoring, optimization, and control of scientific facilities. However, deploying and maintaining ML models in operational environments remains a substantial engineering challenge. Each facility presents unique data protocols, non-standard formats, and infrastructure constraints, forcing teams to rebuild integration pipelines for every new application. We present SMOCS (Streaming Monitoring Optimization and Control System), a Kafka-based containerized framework that addresses this challenge through three contributions: 1) a layered abstraction over Apache Kafka that separates infrastructure from application logic, 2) a three-thread agent architecture that temporally decouples data ingestion, model training, and real-time inference enabling continuous online learning from live data streams, and 3) a configuration-driven deployment model that enables domain experts to operate ML pipelines without software engineering expertise. SMOCS is facility platform-agnostic, fault-isolated by design, and horizontally scalable through Docker containerization. The framework is publicly available as open-source software on the Jefferson Lab Github.

</details>


### [112] [Benefits of Applying Software Design Patterns to Backend Rust Applications](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.02744)
*Leon Heuer*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文通过案例研究评估了Rust中typestate和newtype两种设计模式对软件质量的影响，发现typestate模式能显著提升无错性和可测试性但可能降低可读性，而newtype模式结合"解析不验证"原则能以低成本获得高质量收益。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 设计模式对代码质量的影响研究主要集中在面向对象语言中，而Rust作为一种具有新颖语言概念、编译时安全保证和独特类型系统的语言，相关设计模式研究极少。

Method: 选取三个生产后端应用的代表性组件进行案例研究，基于SQuaRE质量模型建立评估框架，综合运用基准测试、静态代码分析和专家访谈来评估重构后的代码质量。

Result: typestate模式能显著提升无错性和可测试性，但会增加结构性代码从而降低可读性；newtype模式结合"解析不验证"原则能以低成本获得高质量收益并防止运行时无效状态。

Conclusion: 本研究提供了Rust中设计模式的初步实证评估，为后续涉及更多用例和模式的研究奠定了基础。typestate模式最适合具有大量分支逻辑和不变量的代码，而newtype模式则是一种高性价比的质量改进方案。

Abstract: Software design patterns' effects on code quality have mostly been studied in the context of object-oriented languages. In the programming language Rust, which comes with novel language concepts, compile-time safety guarantees and a distinct type system, there has been little research on design patterns. This work investigates how patterns affect software quality and compile-time enforcement of invariants through a case study on three representative components of production backend applications. An evaluation framework based on criteria derived from the SQuaRE quality model, incorporating benchmarking, static code analysis and expert interviews, is developed to assess the refactored code. The patterns typestate and newtype are applied to address existing code smells in the selected use cases. While the typestate pattern improves faultlessness and testability significantly, it comes at the cost of more structural code that can degrade readability. Code with extensive branching logic and a high number of invariants is likely to benefit most from the pattern. The newtype pattern combined with the "Parse, don't validate" principle offers high returns in software quality at a low cost and prevents invalid states during runtime. Overall, this work provides an initial empirical assessment of design patterns in Rust and establishes a foundation for further studies involving additional use cases and patterns.

</details>


### [113] [From Codebases to LLMs: Non-Inclusive Naming in Linux Foundation Repositories](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.02772)
*Honghao Tan,Md Nafiu Rahman,Shin Hwei Tan*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文提出NISCAN框架，对461个Linux Foundation仓库进行非包容性术语检测，发现自2020年以来术语使用下降约47%，但62.7%的仓库仍存在Tier-1非包容性标识符；同时通过案例研究发现LLM在代码生成中会重建已被替换的遗留非包容性标识符。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Linux Foundation和INI自2020年起推动开源项目替换非包容性术语，但缺乏对这些建议长期采纳情况的大规模实证研究，也缺乏对AI辅助软件开发影响的评估。

Method: 开发NISCAN多语言静态分析框架，使用INI词表检测源代码及软件制品中的非包容性术语；对461个Linux Foundation仓库进行生态系统级分析；通过案例研究评估LLM从上下文重建遗留非包容性标识符的能力。

Result: 非包容性术语自2020年以来减少约47%；62.7%的仓库仍包含至少一个Tier-1非包容性标识符；大部分遗留术语位于文档、注释、配置文件中；仓库规模、语言、项目功能和生态系统是更强的预测因素，而非基金会治理；LLM在标识符被重命名后仍能从上下文重建历史非包容性术语。

Conclusion: 提供了Linux Foundation非包容性命名采纳的首个生态系统级评估，强调了解决术语残留问题对支持负责任命名和符合伦理的代码生成的重要性。

Abstract: Since 2020, the Linux Foundation and the multi-organization Inclusive Naming Initiative (INI) have encouraged open-source projects to replace non-inclusive terms such as master/slave and whitelist/blacklist. Although these recommendations have been widely adopted, there is limited empirical evidence on their long-term adoption across Linux Foundation (LF) projects or their implications for AI-assisted software development. In this paper, we present NISCAN, a multilingual static-analysis framework that detects non-inclusive terminology across source code and related software artifacts using the INI vocabulary. Using NISCAN, we conduct the first ecosystem-scale study of inclusive naming across 461 Linux Foundation repositories. Our analysis shows that non-inclusive terminology has declined by approximately 47% since 2020, yet adoption remains incomplete: 62.7% of repositories still contain at least one Tier-1 non-inclusive identifier, while most remaining terminology resides outside source code in documentation, comments, configuration files, and other software artifacts. We further show that repository size, programming language, project functionality, and ecosystem are stronger predictors of term inclusiveness in LF repositories rather than foundation governance. To examine the implications for AI-assisted software development, we conduct a case study evaluating whether large language models (LLMs) can reconstruct legacy non-inclusive identifiers from surrounding program context. The results show that historical naming decisions remain embedded in model predictions even after identifiers have been renamed. Overall, our study findings provide the first ecosystem-scale assessment of inclusive naming adoption within the Linux Foundation and highlight the importance of addressing terminology residue to support responsible naming and ethically sourced code generation.

</details>


### [114] [Was It Never Collected, or Rewritten Away? A Commit-Provenance Dataset Separating Ingestion Gaps from Upstream History Edits across the World of Code](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.02774)
*Audris Mockus*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 该论文通过对比GHArchive事件流与World of Code对象数据库，构建了一个提交来源标注数据集，区分了开源版本控制镜像中缺失提交的原因（force-push重写 vs 未被采集的缺口），并量化了不同类别的规模与影响。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 开源镜像中的提交缺失原因混杂（force-push导致上游已不存在 vs 镜像从未采集），现有方法无法区分两者，导致镜像完整性评估不准确，且历史编辑会扭曲基于提交的生产力度量。

Method: 通过GHArchive的事件时间线重建force-push结构（利用快进链断裂检测），将每个被通告的提交与WoC对象数据库中的成员资格进行三标签分类（存在/重写/从未采集），并构建force-push见证数据集和按项目汇总数据集。

Result: 在11.18亿个被通告提交中，53.35%存在于WoC，6.47%被重写（force-push导致孤儿化），40.18%从未被采集。force-push见证包含1.67亿事件，覆盖1992万个仓库；78.13%的仓库中25.47%观察到force-push，12.85%存在重写提交。历史编辑导致提交数被低估10.82%。

Conclusion: 该数据集能够将镜像完整性报告透明化，标识重写提交作为贡献计数的重复补丁来源，并提供按项目校正因子修正提交生产力度量。约每15个缺失提交中有1个是项目主动擦除的重写，而非镜像采集缺口。

Abstract: Any global mirror of open-source version control is incomplete, but the reasons a commit is missing are not interchangeable: a project may have force-pushed it away (so it no longer exists upstream), or the mirror may never have ingested it (a true collection gap). We release a commit-provenance dataset that separates these cases at scale by comparing two views of the same commit graph: the GHArchive event stream, a historical witness of what GitHub advertised at push time, and the World of Code (WoC) V2604 object database, an accumulated union of periodic fetches that never deletes a collected commit. Walking each reference's PushEvent chain reconstructs force-pushes structurally (a before that is not the prior head breaks the fast-forward chain; no recorded flag exists across eras), and joining every advertised commit against WoC membership yields a three-way label. Over 1,118,116,350 advertised commits, 53.35% are present in WoC, 6.47% are rewritten (orphaned by a later force-push, an upstream edit and a correct absence), and 40.18% are never-ingested (the candidate collection gap). About one missing-commit case in fifteen is a rewrite the project erased, not a mirror gap. We release the force-push witness (166,710,831 events over 19,926,250 repositories) and a per-project rollup (78,125,788 repositories; force-pushing observed in 25.47%, a rewritten commit in 12.85%). We treat the 40% never-ingested share as an upper bound on the collection gap and state five reasons it overcounts. The dataset makes mirror-completeness reporting honest, flags rewritten commits as duplicate patch sources for contribution counting, and corrects a 10.82% corpus-wide undercount that history editing imposes on commit-based productivity, with a released per-project correction factor. All artifacts ship as a self-contained, independently hosted replication package keyed to WoC V2604.

</details>


### [115] [A Preliminary Study on Explaining Risk of Code Changes using LLM-Based Prediction Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.02782)
*Yalin Liu,Kosay Jabre,Rui Abreu,Zachariah J. Carmichael,Vijayaraghavan Murali,Akshay Patel,Jun Ge,Weiyan Sun,Cong Zhang,Audris Mockus,David Khavari,Peter C. Rigby,Nachiappan Nagappan*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文提出基于LLM注意力权重的Diff风险评分（DRS）模型，通过将token级注意力聚合成可解释的代码单元（行、块、文件），向开发者高亮显示最可能包含风险的前K个单元，辅助代码审查。实验表明，高亮前2个hunk可覆盖53.85%的专家标注的故障行，开发者只需审查26.28%的变更行。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: ML/AI模型的预测结果常因缺乏可解释性而受到质疑；在即时缺陷预测场景中，现有方法缺乏对软件变更（diff）中高风险区域的细粒度高亮提示，无法有效引导开发者的代码审查注意力。

Method: 利用基于LLM的Diff风险评分（DRS）模型的注意力权重，将token级注意力聚合到可解释的代码单元（行、hunk、文件），向开发者展示前K个高风险代码单元作为轻量级审查指引。

Result: 在前2个hunk的高亮下，覆盖了53.85%的专家标注的故障行，开发者仅需审查平均26.28%的变更行。

Conclusion: 该方法由于注意力权重在模型标准推理过程中即可获得，具有良好的可扩展性，适用于大规模开发工作流，且可在代码审查界面中以较低的额外延迟呈现。

Abstract: Predictions by machine learning (ML) and artificial intelligence (AI) models are often received skeptically unless they are paired with intelligible explanations. In the context of just-in-time defect prediction, highlighting small portions of a software change (diff) -- beyond rule-based lints -- where risk may be concentrated has not yet been extensively investigated. In this work, we leverage attention weights from an LLM-based Diff Risk Score (DRS) model to highlight parts of a diff that the model focuses on when predicting risk. We aggregate token-level attention into interpretable code units (lines, hunks, and files), and present the top-K units to developers as a lightweight form of guidance during code review. We evaluate our approach using expert-labeled changes that have caused real outages.
