Results show that the highlighted snippets cover expert-labeled outage-causing change lines 53.85% of the time when highlighting the top-2 hunks, while requiring developers to review 26.28% of the changed lines on average. Because attention is produced during standard model inference, the approach is scalable for large development workflows and can be surfaced in the code review UI with low additional latency.

</details>


### [116] [A Systematic Methodology for Evaluating Failure Independence in LLM-Generated Code](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.02808)
*Rodrigo Pato Nogueira,Karthik Pattabiraman,Marco Vieira,João R. Campos*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文系统评估了LLM生成代码的失败独立性，发现相同模型生成的多版本代码高度相似，不同模型虽更具多样性但仍远未达到独立失败假设的要求，三版本和五版本集成仅能实现独立假设下0.43和0.44的可靠性增益。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: N-版本编程（NVP）通过多独立实现提升可靠性，但成本高且依赖失败独立性假设。LLM降低了多实现生成成本，但其失败独立性未知，本文首次系统评估LLM生成代码的失败独立性。

Method: 提出系统性评估框架，对224个问题、12个模型、5种语言和3种提示策略进行分析，从结构多样性（代码相似性）、行为多样性（测试用例失败重叠）、N版本可靠性分析和人工故障分析多维度评估。

Result: 同一模型实现高度相似；不同模型实现多样性更高但仍远未达到独立失败预期；三/五版本集成仅实现独立假设下0.43/0.44的可靠性增益，同模型集成低于0.3；不同失败模式常共享根源。

Conclusion: LLM生成方案不满足NVP的失败独立性假设，异构模型可部分缓解；本文方法论可作为随模型演进系统评估失败独立性的工具。

Abstract: N-Version Programming (NVP) improves software reliability by executing multiple independent implementations and combining outputs, but its adoption is limited by high cost and the assumption of failure independence, which empirical studies have challenged. Recent advances in Large Language Models (LLMs) reduce the cost of generating multiple implementations, shifting focus to whether their failures are independent. We propose the first systematic methodology to assess failure independence in LLM-generated code and apply it to 224 problems across twelve models, five languages, and three prompting strategies. We analyze both structural and behavioral diversity (i.e., whether implementations fail on the same test cases), complemented by N-version reliability analysis under majority voting and manual inspection of the generated code. Structural diversity analysis shows that implementations from the same model are highly similar, while different models produce more distinct solutions. The same trend appears in behavioral diversity, with implementations from different models showing higher diversity yet still failing on the same tests far more often than expected under independence. N-version reliability analysis reinforces this: three- and five-version ensembles realize only 0.43 and 0.44 of the reliability gain achievable under independence, dropping below 0.3 when ensembles are built from the same model. Manual fault analysis shows that even different failure patterns often share root causes. Overall, these results suggest LLM-generated solutions do not satisfy NVP's failure independence assumption, though heterogeneous models help partially. They also validate our methodology as a tool for systematically evaluating failure independence as models evolve.

</details>


### [117] [EvoOtter: Evolutionary Reproduction Test Generator](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.02854)
*Toufique Ahmed,Jatin Ganhotra,Avraham Shinnar,Martin Hirzel*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文提出EvoOtter方法，将进化编程与LLM结合，通过连续减半控制测试执行成本、批量交叉操作降低LLM调用成本、基于规则的代码突变以及专为BRT设计的新适应度评分，以更低的成本生成高质量的Bug复现测试（BRT）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于推理扩展（inference scaling）的方法利用LLM生成大量BRT和补丁并通过执行反馈选择改进，但成本高昂且反馈不可靠，亟需更高效且反馈更可靠的BRT生成方法。

Method: EvoOtter通过四种机制控制成本并提升效果：(1) 连续减半（successive halving）控制测试执行成本；(2) 批量交叉操作（batched crossover）在单次LLM调用中处理整个世代；(3) 基于规则的代码突变（rule-based code mutations）；(4) 专为BRT设计的新适应度评分（fitness score）。

Result: EvoOtter以远低于先前推理扩展方法的成本，生成了最先进质量的BRT。

Conclusion: 本文表明进化编程与LLM结合可以高效且有效地解决软件工程中的BRT生成问题，为二者的结合方式提供了新的思路。

Abstract: Before fixing an issue, it is useful to first reproduce it by generating a bug reproduction test (BRT). However, generating a BRT is itself a challenging task, because issue descriptions tend to be informal, making it difficult to determine whether a candidate BRT indeed fails for the reason in the issue. Prior work has attempted to tackle this problem via inference scaling, using large language models to generate many BRTs and patches, then using execution feedback to select and improve them. Unfortunately, this is expensive and the feedback is unreliable. This paper explores evolutionary programming for BRT generation to sharpen the feedback, while enhancing evolutionary programming to keep costs in check. Our new approach, EvoOtter, controls test execution costs via successive halving. Furthermore, it controls LLM costs via batched crossover for an entire generation in a single LLM call, as well as via rule-based code mutations, with a new fitness score tailored for BRTs. As a result, EvoOtter generates state-of-the-art quality BRTs at the fraction of the cost of prior inference-scaling approaches to this problem. More broadly, this paper points at how to efficiently and effectively combine evolutionary programming with large language models for software engineering.

</details>


### [118] [Determinants and Limits of LLM Security-Tool Orchestration: A Study with HexStrike-AI](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.02873)
*Romain Gerard,Assmaa Zeghaider,Yan Guo*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文以HexStrikeAI为测试平台，通过774次实验系统评估了LLM智能体在安全工具编排中的能力边界，发现驱动客户端是首要影响因素（两个DeepSeek客户端间存在2.1倍差距），通过针对性修复将总体解决率从55.4%提升至72.0%，剩余故障主要源于推理或环境限制而非工具缺失。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM智能体驱动安全工具套件的应用日益普遍，但其能力边界因素尚未得到系统描述：能力受限于模型还是驱动客户端、约束智能体使用编排器自有工具是否有帮助、能力受限源于推理缺失还是工具缺失等问题尚不明确。

Method: 使用开源编排器HexStrikeAI（暴露150+工具）作为测试平台，在86个picoCTF挑战（涵盖7类别、3难度层级）上，设置3种工具访问机制和3种模型/客户端配置进行774次实验。随后应用现有工具修正、智能体行为改变和11个新能力工具，重新运行先前失败的实验，并进行60次稳定性子研究。

Result: 诊断发现驱动客户端是固定模型下的首要因素（两个DeepSeek客户端间存在2.1倍差距），存在单调难度梯度（中等难度提升最大）。总体解决率从55.4%提升至72.0%，所有配置均有显著改进（配对McNemar p<0.001，95%置信区间不重叠）。60次稳定性研究中17/20次结果一致。

Conclusion: 剩余故障主要源于推理或环境限制，而非工具缺失。研究讨论了结果对编排器评估方式的启示，同时明确局限性：使用单一基准、修复方案在相同挑战上调优、客户端效应仅针对单一模型验证，其泛化性尚属假设。

Abstract: Large language model agents driving security tool suites over the Model Context Protocol are increasingly common. Yet the factors that bound their capability remain poorly characterized: how much depends on the model versus the client that drives it, whether constraining the agent to the orchestrator's own tools helps, and where capability is limited by reasoning rather than by missing tools. Using HexStrikeAI, an open-source orchestrator that exposes 150+ tools, as a testbed, we follow a methodology that evaluates the system, diagnoses its failures, and applies targeted improvements. We run 86 picoCTF challenges across seven categories and three difficulty tiers, under three tool-access regimes and three model/client configurations (774 trials). We then apply corrections to existing tools, agent-behavior changes, and eleven new capability tools, and re-run the previously-unsuccessful trials. The diagnosis isolates the driving client as a first-order factor for a fixed model (a 2.1 * gap between two DeepSeek clients) and a monotonic difficulty gradient, with the largest gains in the mid tier. The overall solve rate rises from 55.4% to 72.0%, and every configuration improves significantly (paired McNemar p < 0.001, non-overlapping 95% confidence intervals). The residual failures are reasoning- or environment-bound rather than missing-tool. A 60-run stability sub-study finds single-run verdicts reproducible (17/20 unanimous). We discuss what the results imply for how such orchestrators should be evaluated, and we are explicit about the limits: the study uses a single benchmark, the fixes were tuned on the same challenges they were evaluated on, and the client effect is demonstrated for one model only, so its generality to other models remains a hypothesis.

</details>


### [119] [Diagnosis-Driven Automatic Repair for Agentic Workflow via Symbolic Inference](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.02882)
*Xuyan Ma,Yawen Wang,Junjie Wang,Xiaofei Xie,Boyu Wu,Mingyang Li,Dandan Wang,Qing Wang*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: FlowFixer 是一种基于符号推理的诊断驱动自动化修复框架，用于修复平台编排的智能体工作流。它通过将工作流执行转化为统一符号迹、提取行为规范、进行故障归因与根因分析，并生成定向修复补丁。在 Dify、Coze 和 n8n 三个平台上，FlowFixer 的修复成功率达 71.3%，优于现有基线方法 11.9%–27.6%，故障归因准确率提升 4.8%–33.1%，根因分析准确率提升 15.3%–38.8%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有智能体工作流优化和增强方法主要依赖轨迹级反馈，未能显式识别底层故障根因，导致修复方案不够精准。因此，需要一种能够进行细粒度诊断和定向修复的自动化框架。

Method: FlowFixer 首先将工作流执行转化为统一符号迹，通过符号推理推导出可执行的行为规范（捕获节点正确性、时间依赖和因果关系）。基于规范验证进行故障归因和根因分析，生成定向补丁。为降低验证成本，采用多维预执行评估过滤不可行的修复方案。

Result: 在 Dify、Coze 和 n8n 三个平台上，FlowFixer 修复成功率达 71.3%，优于基线方法 11.9%–27.6%；故障归因准确率提升 4.8%–33.1%；根因分析准确率提升 15.3%–38.8%。

Conclusion: FlowFixer 通过符号建模与推理为智能体工作流的可靠诊断与修复提供了新视角，有效提升了修复的精准性和效率。

Abstract: Platform-orchestrated agentic workflows have become a popular paradigm for developing LLM-based applications. However, their reliability remains a major challenge due to the uncertainty of LLM outputs, complex inter-node dependencies, and heterogeneous tool interactions. Existing agentic workflow optimization and agent enhancement methods primarily rely on trajectory-level feedback. Without explicitly identifying the underlying failure root causes, their resulting repair plans are often insufficiently targeted. We propose FlowFixer, a diagnosis-driven automated repair framework for agentic workflows. FlowFixer first transforms workflow executions into unified symbolic traces and performs symbolic inference to derive executable behavioral specifications that capture node correctness, temporal dependencies, and causal relationships. Based on specification verification, it conducts failure attribution and root cause analysis, and then generates targeted repair patches. To reduce verification costs, FlowFixer further employs a multi-dimensional pre-execution assessment to filter infeasible repairs before dynamic verification. We evaluate FlowFixer on workflow failures collected from three popular development platforms: Dify, Coze and n8n. Results show that FlowFixer achieves a repair success rate of 71.3%, outperforming state-of-the-art baselines by 11.9% to 27.6%. It also improves failure attribution accuracy by 4.8% to 33.1% and root cause analysis accuracy by 15.3% to 38.8%. This work offers a new perspective on reliable diagnosis and repair of agentic workflows through symbolic modeling and inference.

</details>


### [120] [CoACT: Action-Preserving Observation Compression for Coding Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.02911)
*Haorui Chen,Yuancheng Zhu,Yitong Zhang,Jia Li*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文提出 CoACT，一种面向编码智能体的动作保持型观测压缩方法，通过"下一动作保持"（NAP）原则确保压缩后的观测不会改变智能体的后续行为，在 SWE-bench Verified 上平均减少33%的token消耗，同时保持任务解决效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM-based coding agents在软件开发任务中通过与环境交互迭代工作，返回的观测数据不断累积到上下文中，成为推理成本的主要来源。现有的观测压缩方法在效率与效果之间存在不理想的权衡，因为它们没有明确建模压缩如何影响智能体的后续行为。

Method: CoACT 基于"下一动作保持"（NAP）原则，要求压缩后的观测必须诱导出与原始观测相同的下一动作。训练时，教师模型首先生成每个观测的多个压缩候选，然后使用基于NAP的动作保持奖励过滤会改变智能体下一动作的候选，再使用长度缩减奖励选择紧凑的候选作为轻量级压缩器的监督信号。

Result: 在 SWE-bench Verified 上使用三种智能体模型的实验表明，CoACT 在保持任务解决效果接近未压缩智能体的同时，平均减少了33.0%的总token消耗。

Conclusion: 通过显式建模压缩对智能体后续行为的影响，CoACT 实现了更好的效率-效果权衡，为编码智能体的观测压缩提供了一种实用的解决方案。

Abstract: LLM-based coding agents solve software-engineering tasks through iterative interactions with development environments, where returned observations accumulate in the context and become a major source of inference cost. Observation compression reduces this cost by shortening observations before they are appended to the context. However, existing methods still exhibit an unsatisfactory efficiency-effectiveness trade-off, as they do not explicitly model how compression affects the agent's subsequent behavior. This paper proposes CoACT, an action-preserving observation compression method for coding agents. CoACT is built on next-action preservation (NAP), which requires a compressed observation to induce the same next action as the raw observation. By checking the agent's immediate next action, NAP provides a practical signal for whether a compression preserves the information needed for continued task solving. During training, a teacher model first generates multiple compressed candidates of each observation. CoACT then uses an action-preservation reward based on NAP to filter out candidates that would change the agent's next action, and uses a length-reduction reward to choose compact candidates as supervision for a lightweight compressor. Experiments on SWE-bench Verified with three agentic models show that CoACT reduces average total token consumption by 33.0% while maintaining task-solving effectiveness close to the uncompressed agent.

</details>


### [121] [BeSpec: Behavior-Level Specification Alignment for Code Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.02949)
*Qinghua Xu,Guancheng Wang,Boxi Yu,Lionel Briand*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: BeSpec是一种基于行为模型的规范对齐方法，通过构建显式行为模型、生成候选程序并对比观察行为与预测行为，在规范不明确或欠指定时进行规范精化或程序拒绝。在四个基准测试上，BeSpec在Pass@1和平均通过率上均优于九种基线方法，相对提升8.1%-25.3%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于执行引导的代码精化方法假设LLM对意图的理解已正确完整，但实际中意图往往模糊或欠指定，导致规范不匹配成为主要瓶颈。本文旨在解决规范对齐问题。

Method: BeSpec将任务描述视为意图的部分证据，首先构建显式行为模型（可检查的属性），然后生成候选程序并在探针输入上执行，将观察行为与预测行为对比。当不匹配时，要么精化规范，要么拒绝候选程序。

Result: 在CodeContests、xCodeEval、APPS和LiveCodeBench四个基准上，使用三种LLM，BeSpec在所有设置中获得最高Pass@1和平均通过率，相对最强基线提升8.1%-25.3%。失败分析表明对齐后多数错误源于算法难度而非规范误解。

Conclusion: BeSpec通过显式行为建模有效缓解了规范不匹配问题，各主要组件均有正向贡献，使得剩余错误主要来自算法难度而非规范理解。

Abstract: LLMs have made substantial progress on automated code generation from natural-language descriptions of desired behavior (intent). Most existing methods improve generated programs through execution-guided code refinement: they generate a candidate solution, execute it, and patch the implementation using feedback, while leaving the underlying specification unchanged. This workflow implicitly assumes that the LLM's understanding of the intent is already correct and complete. In practice, however, intents are often ambiguous or underspecified. As a result, even a capable model may produce a correct implementation of the wrong intent, making specification mismatch a central bottleneck.
  This paper presents BeSpec, a behavioral model-based approach to specification alignment. BeSpec treats the task description as partial evidence about the intended behavior of the correct program. It first builds an explicit behavioral model, which are checkable properties that valid outputs must satisfy. BeSpec then generates candidate programs, executes them on probe inputs, and compares their observed behavior with the predicted behaviors. When observed behavior does not match the predicted behaviors, BeSpec either refines the specification or rejects the candidate program.
  We evaluate BeSpec with three LLMs on four benchmarks: CodeContests, xCodeEval, APPS, and the contamination-free LiveCodeBench. Against nine baselines, BeSpec achieves the highest Pass@1 and average pass rate across all settings, improving average Pass@1 over the strongest baseline by 8.1%--25.3% relative across the three LLMs. A failure analysis shows that after alignment, most remaining errors stem from algorithmic difficulty rather than misunderstood specifications, while ablation studies confirm that each major component of BeSpec contributes positively.

</details>


### [122] [CAFÉ, an automated feedback tool to approach Formal Methods](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.03001)
*Géraldine Brieven,Ayman Labrahimi Kasdaoui,Benoit Donnet*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: CAFÉ是一个学习平台，通过图形化循环不变量编程（GLIBP）方法，帮助学生从操作思维转向结构化思维，并提供自动反馈功能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有计算机科学学生在学习形式化方法时面临思维模式转换困难（从操作思维转向结构化思维），缺乏有效的脚手架工具和自动化反馈机制。

Method: CAFÉ平台采用GLIBP方法，要求学生先构建图形化循环不变量（GLI），再推导对应代码；学生需完成空白GLI，系统基于此提供个性化反馈，并评估代码与GLI的一致性。

Result: CAFÉ支持从学生和教师两个视角使用：学生可设计GLI并获得反馈；教师可编码编程挑战及其对应的空白GLI。

Conclusion: CAFÉ通过GLIBP方法有效搭建形式化方法学习的脚手架，促进结构化思维训练，并实现自动化个性化反馈。

Abstract: We present CAFÉ, a learning platform designed to introduce computer science students to Formal Methods (FM). CAFÉ aims to scaffold students' structural thinking (in contrast with operational thinking) by promoting the practice of Graphical Loop Invariant Based Programming (GLIBP). In the GLIBP approach, students solve loop-based problems by first constructing a Graphical Loop Invariant (GLI) before deriving the corresponding code. The GLI is an informal diagrammatic representation of the loop invariant. It illustrates the variables involved in the loop, their properties, and the relationships between them. To enable automated feedback, students complete a blank GLI, a box-based version of the GLI. Beyond evaluating the code students submit, CAFÉ provides personalized feedback on students' GLI and its alignment with the code. In this demo, we walk through CAFE from both a student's and a teacher's perspective. We show how the tool supports GLI design and provides feedback. We then present how a teacher can encode programming challenges together with a corresponding blank GLI.

</details>


### [123] [Detection of LLM-assisted Code Plagiarism Using k-gram Software Birthmarks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.03014)
*Nikolay Fedorov,Akito Monden,Hiroki Inayoshi,Haruaki Tamada,Masateru Tsunoda*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文研究了k-gram软件水印在检测LLM辅助代码抄袭中的有效性。使用三种LLM（ChatGPT-5.1-Codex-Mini、DeepSeek-V4-Flash、Claude-Haiku-4.5）对Java代码进行 paraphrasing 攻击，采用基于Java操作码的1到6元k-gram水印及五种相似度度量进行检测。结果表明k-gram水印仍有效，其中ChatGPT-5.1-Codex-Mini生成的克隆最难检测，编程导向模型在抄袭任务中表现更优。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM大幅降低了软件抄袭的技术门槛，传统抄袭检测技术可能难以识别经过LLM变换的语义等价代码（代码释义攻击），因此需要探究软件水印方法能否有效检测此类LLM辅助的抄袭行为。

Method: 采用基于Java操作码唯一k-gram（k=1-6）的软件水印，使用三种LLM（ChatGPT-5.1-Codex-Mini、DeepSeek-V4-Flash、Claude-Haiku-4.5）对BSD-2-Clause许可的Java项目源码进行paraphrasing攻击，通过五种相似度度量（余弦相似度、Dice指数、Jaccard系数、Simpson指数、编辑距离相似度）进行水印匹配检测。

Result: k-gram软件水印对检测LLM辅助抄袭依然有效；ChatGPT-5.1-Codex-Mini生成的克隆最难被检测；编程导向模型在抄袭任务中表现更优。

Conclusion: k-gram软件水印可作为检测LLM辅助代码抄袭的有效手段，但不同LLM生成的克隆检测难度存在差异，编程导向模型的抄袭能力强于通用模型。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have significantly lowered the technical barrier to software plagiarism. By transforming existing source code while preserving its functionality, modern LLMs can generate semantically identical program that may evade traditional plagiarism detection techniques.
  Among such attacks, code paraphrasing modifies the syntax and structure of a program while preserving its behavior. This paper investigates whether software birthmarks can detect such LLM-assisted plagiarism. As a starting point, we employ k-gram software birthmarks based on unique k-grams of Java opcodes, with k ranging from 1 to 6.
  We employ three contemporary LLMs: ChatGPT-5.1-Codex-Mini, DeepSeek-V4-Flash, and Claude-Haiku-4.5. The dataset consists of individually compilable source files extracted from actively maintained BSD-2-Clause licensed Java projects. We further compare five similarity measures for birthmark matching: cosine similarity, Dice index, Jaccard coefficient, Simpson index, and edit-distance-based similarity.
  The results demonstrate that k-gram software birthmarks remain effective for detecting LLM-assisted plagiarism. Among the evaluated models, ChatGPT-5.1-Codex-Mini generated the most difficult-to-detect clones. Furthermore, the findings confirm the higher performance of coding-oriented models for plagiarism task.

</details>


### [124] [Compression, structure, and executor capability: a controlled real-cost decomposition of language-model agent skill optimisation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.03048)
*Xiaonan Xu,Wenjing Wu*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文通过在40个软件工程任务、10种技能交付条件、每条件3次重复（共1200次 rollout）的受控实验，系统评估了智能体技能优化策略（如确定性缩短、结构化渲染、作用域加载等）对执行质量与实际货币成本的影响。研究发现，执行器能力是提升通过率（+27%）的主导杠杆，但成本增加约5倍；所有表示优化策略在任一执行器层级上均未优于原始技能，且在实际价格下没有任何优化表示能达到盈亏平衡点。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前智能体技能优化普遍采用缩短、重写、编译、作用域加载等策略，但缺乏同时衡量质量与实际货币成本、并分离贡献因素的严格实验验证。本文旨在填补这一空白，系统分解技能交付条件对质量和成本的影响。

Method: 采用可控分解实验设计：10种技能交付条件（无技能、原始技能、确定性缩短、线性渲染、结构化渲染、作用域加载等）× 40个软件工程任务 × 3次重复 = 1200次rollout。质量指标为任务级验证器通过率，成本指标为求解阶段按标准提供商价格计算的token成本，同时进行token量归一化分析和编译成本摊销。统计上采用任务级聚类区间估计和多重性控制的对比族分析。

Result: 确定性缩短接近原始基线但未能在预设边界内建立非劣效性；结构化渲染和作用域加载在紧凑执行器上降低通过率且未降低成本；结构化渲染与线性文本在内容匹配时无差异。唯一通过多重性校正的对比是执行器能力：通过率提升27个百分点，但实际成本约为5倍。编译器层级无稳健效应。在实际价格下，所有优化表示均未达到实际盈亏平衡点。

Conclusion: 执行器能力是提升智能体技能执行质量的主导杠杆，所有表示优化策略在任一执行器层级上均未能超越原始技能。当前业界普遍采用的技能优化假设（小技能或结构化技能降低成本并保持质量）未得到实验支持。

Abstract: Agent skills, reusable instruction artefacts supplied to a tool-using language model, are increasingly optimised by shortening, structural rewriting, stronger-model compilation, and scoped loading, on the assumption that a smaller or better-organised skill lowers cost while preserving success. That assumption is rarely tested with quality and real monetary cost measured on the same runs and the contributing factors separated. This study reports a controlled decomposition over ten skill-delivery conditions, 40 software-engineering tasks, and three repetitions per cell (1,200 rollouts), separating no-skill execution, raw skills, deterministic shortening, linear and structured rendering from a shared semantic ledger, scoped loading, and the compiler and executor model tiers. Quality is the verifier pass rate at task level; cost is solve-stage token cost at standard provider prices, with a token-volume-normalised view for robustness and compilation cost amortised separately. The task is the unit of inference, intervals are task-clustered, and the contrast family is multiplicity-controlled. Deterministic shortening is close to the raw baseline but does not establish non-inferiority within the preset margin. Structured rendering and scoped loading lower pass rate on the compact executor without lowering cost, and structured rendering is indistinguishable from linear text at matched content. The only contrast surviving correction is executor capability, which raises pass rate by 27 percentage points at roughly five times the real cost, with compiler tier showing no robust effect. Under real prices no optimised representation reaches a practical break-even. The evidence indicates that executor capability is the dominant lever and that no representation strategy improves over the raw skill on either executor tier.

</details>


### [125] [A Measurement Study on the Adoption of Pledges and Unveils in the OpenBSD Operating System](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.03056)
*Jukka Ruohonen,Krzysztof Sierszecki,Abhishek Tiwari*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文对OpenBSD操作系统中pledge和unveil系统调用（用于程序沙箱化）的采用情况进行了纵向测量研究。基于19个版本的数据集，发现许多程序和库在系统调用正式发布前就已开始使用，采用率持续增长。标准I/O操作是最常见的pledge请求，读取操作是最常见的unveil请求。研究表明，系统调用最小化和沙箱化技术的采用并非如文献中常讨论的那样困难。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有文献常认为系统调用最小化和沙箱化技术的采用是困难的，但缺乏充分的实证数据支持。作者希望通过纵向测量研究，量化分析OpenBSD中pledge和unveil系统调用的实际采用情况，检验"采用困难"这一常见观点的合理性。

Method: 采用纵向测量研究方法，收集覆盖OpenBSD 19个版本的数据集，分析pledge和unveil系统调用在程序和库中的采用率、采用模式（包括发布前采用情况）、采用趋势（线性拟合），以及pledge和unveil的具体使用特征（如请求的操作类型、与程序大小的相关性等）。

Result: (1) 许多程序和库在系统调用正式发布前就已开始使用；(2) 采用率稳步增长，线性趋势可作为合理的粗略启发式；(3) /usr/bin和/usr/sbin中的程序修改最多；(4) 程序和库的大小与调用的pledge/unveil数量无显著相关性；(5) 标准I/O操作是最常见的pledge请求，读取操作是最常见的unveil请求。

Conclusion: 系统调用最小化和沙箱化技术的采用并非如文献中常讨论的那样困难，OpenBSD中的实际采用数据表明这一过程是可行且稳步推进的。

Abstract: The paper presents a longitudinal measurement study on the adoption of the pledge and unveil system calls in OpenBSD. These system calls are used to sandbox programs and libraries. Given a dataset covering 19 releases, many programs and libraries were modified to use the system calls already before their introductions in official releases. The adoption rates have also steadily grown; a linear trend provides a coarse but sensible heuristic. Although particularly programs residing in /usr/bin and /usr/sbin have been modified to use the system calls, the sizes of programs and libraries do not correlate well with the amounts of pledge and unveil system calls invoked. Regarding the pledges made, standard input and output operations have frequently been requested, although the full fine-grained arsenal offered by pledge has generally been utilized in OpenBSD. The same observation is seen in that particularly read operations to given paths have frequently been unveiled. All in all, the measurement results indicate that the adoption of system call minimization and sandboxing techniques is not necessarily as troublesome as has often been discussed in the literature.

</details>


### [126] [A Model-Based Framework for Developing DTs in Industry 4.0](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.03080)
*Lina Bilal,Benoit Combemale,Jean-Marc Jézéquel,Quentin Perez*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文提出一个自动化框架，通过利用物理孪生的现有工程模型（结构+行为模型），结合框架配置和少量额外开发，自动生成数字孪生实例。在四个用例中验证了可行性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前数字孪生构建缺乏标准化方法，且耗时耗力。物理孪生的工程模型通常已经存在，但未被有效利用来自动化DT的推导过程。

Method: 提出一个工具支持的自动化框架，利用物理孪生已有的结构和行为模型，扩展额外模型以构建全面的DT。通过框架配置和最小化的额外开发，自动从PT模型派生出DT实例。

Result: 在四个不同用例中成功自动推导出DT实例，验证了框架在满足假设和要求的上下文中的适用性。

Conclusion: 通过简单的框架配置即可派生与运营目标一致的数字孪生，表明该方法可有效降低DT构建的时间与资源成本。

Abstract: With the rise of Industry 4.0 driven by the integration of Cyber-Physical Systems (CPS) and the Internet of Things (IoT), the use of Digital Twins (DTs) has significantly increased over the past decade, as they provide detailed insights and support well-informed decision-making. However, the lack of standardized methodologies, in addition to the time and resources involved for building them remains an important challenge.  Building on the idea that engineering models of the physical twin (PT) are often available, we propose a tool-supported framework that automates the derivation of DTs by leveraging existing structural and behavioral models of the PT and extending them with additional models to build a comprehensive DT. To demonstrate the feasibility of our approach, we applied it to four different use cases, in which we automatically derived DT instances from (1) models of their PT, (2) configuration of our generic framework and (3) minimal ad hoc additional development for connecting the DT to the PT. These experiments illustrate the applicability of our framework for building DTs in contexts that satisfy our assumptions and requirements. By simply configuring the framework, we are able to derive a DT aligned with its operational purpose.

</details>


### [127] [Flow-A11y: Flow-Aware Accessibility Testing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.03100)
*Nasr Eddine Fliti,Leisan Kokorina,Florian Tambon,Michael Papadakis*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文提出 Flow-A11y，一种流感知的无障碍测试系统，通过浏览器执行自然语言场景流、记录运行时轨迹、构建可审计的证据包，实现对交互依赖型 WCAG 标准的自动化评估。在 19 个真实场景、45 个动态 WCAG 标准上，其 oracle 一致性比通用浏览器代理审计高 10 倍以上，失败精度从 23.5% 提升至 41.4%，消除了无效证据引用。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现代 Web 应用中的无障碍障碍往往隐藏在交互流程中，而非静态页面快照。键盘陷阱、焦点丢失、模态泄露、状态更新延迟、动态控件及页面区域变化等行为仅在用户具体操作后才显现。这些动态 WCAG 标准难以自动化测试，目前仍主要依赖人工检查。

Method: 给定目标页面和自然语言场景描述，Flow-A11y 在真实浏览器中执行流程，记录有序运行时轨迹，针对具体 WCAG 标准构建证据包，对无法支持的判断进行门控过滤，最终输出可审计的、基于可解析运行时证据的测试发现。

Result: 在涵盖 45 个动态 WCAG 标准的 19 个真实公共 Web 场景上评估，Flow-A11y 的 oracle 一致性比通用浏览器代理审计高 10 倍以上；证据校准层将失败精度从 23.5% 提升至 41.4%，并消除了无效证据引用。

Conclusion: 运行时轨迹能够为交互依赖型无障碍行为提供可操作的证据，展示了自动化评估页面级扫描器无法检测、传统上需人工评估的动态 WCAG 标准的可行路径。

Abstract: Modern web applications increasingly expose accessibility barriers through interaction flows rather than static page snapshots. Keyboard traps, focus loss, modal leakage, delayed status updates, dynamic controls, and changing page regions often become observable only after users perform concrete actions. These behaviors are directly related to dynamic WCAG criteria, yet they remain difficult to automate because their assessment depends on runtime interaction evidence and is still commonly performed through manual inspection. We present Flow-A11y, a flow-aware accessibility testing system for interaction-dependent WCAG criteria. Given a target page and a natural-language scenario, Flow-A11y executes the flow in a real browser, records an ordered runtime trace, constructs criterion-specific evidence packets, gates unsupported judgments, and emits auditable findings grounded in resolvable runtime evidence. Evaluated on 19 real public-web scenarios covering 45 dynamic WCAG criteria, Flow-A11y achieves over ten times higher oracle agreement than a generic browser-agent audit, while its evidence-calibration layer improves fail precision from 23.5% to 41.4% and eliminates invalid evidence references. These results show that runtime traces provide actionable evidence for assessing interaction-dependent accessibility behavior. They demonstrate a practical path toward automating dynamic WCAG criteria that page-level scanners cannot assess and that have traditionally required manual evaluation.

</details>


### [128] [Towards Automatically Inferring Constraints to Identify Implicit Assumptions in Data Analysis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.03114)
*Florian Sihler,Lars Pfrenger,Oliver Gerstl,Matthias Tichy*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文针对R/Python等数据分析脚本中因隐式假设（如包版本、数据表结构、手动步骤）导致的不可复现问题，提出通过静态分析技术识别并显式化这些假设为代码约束，从而实现自动化转换、运行时检查及文档化支持，提升可复现性和代码复用。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 数据分析脚本和notebook普遍存在可复现性问题，根本原因在于作者在代码中留下了大量隐式假设（如包版本、数据表形状、手动设置步骤），这些假设未被明确记录或检查，导致他人难以复现执行结果。

Method: 提出统一且基于示例的视角来定义和分类数据分析中的隐式假设；开发探索性的概念验证实现，采用静态分析技术自动识别代码中的隐式假设，并将其显式化为代码约束（code constraints），这些约束可用于自动化转换、运行时检查和文档化。

Result: 通过概念验证实现展示了静态分析技术可以有效识别数据分析脚本中的隐式假设，并将其转化为显式约束，从而实现脚本到可复现工件的自动转换、运行时假设检查以及辅助代码理解与复用的文档生成。

Conclusion: 隐式假设是导致数据分析脚本不可复现的关键因素；通过静态分析将其显式化为代码约束，能够从自动化转换、运行时验证和文档支持三个维度有效提升数据分析工件的可复现性。

Abstract: High-level languages such as R or Python are used frequently to analyze and visualize data in the form of scripts or notebooks. However, these artifacts suffer from reproducibility issues due to what we frame as implicit assumptions made by the authors. Such assumptions range from package versions and shapes of involved data tables, to manual and often undocumented setup steps. Within this work, we provide a unified, example-driven perspective on implicit assumptions in data analysis backed by an explorative proof-of-concept implementation. With this perspective, we propose the use of static analysis techniques to identify such assumptions and to make them explicit in the form of code constraints, focusing on the inclusion of data-analysis-specific issues. Such constraints can then be used to automatically transform these scripts into executable and reproducible artifacts, to check these assumptions at runtime, and to serve as documentation to support code reuse and comprehension.

</details>


### [129] [Copper: Unifying Correctness and Performance Specification in Code Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.03130)
*André Lizardo,Raul Barbosa*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: Copper是一个结合形式化验证与性能感知规范的AI代码生成框架，能够在保证代码正确性的同时提升运行时和内存效率，弥合AI编程中可信性与性能之间的鸿沟。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前生成式AI虽然能生成功能正确的代码，但同时保证代码的正确性和性能仍是一个悬而未决的挑战。

Method: Copper将AI驱动的代码合成、形式化验证工具以及自动化性能分析循环三者相结合，实现对代码的正确性证明和性能优化。

Result: 在多种算法和实际编程任务上，与基线AI生成代码相比，Copper生成的解决方案在满足严格正确性保证的前提下，显著提升了运行时效率和内存效率。

Conclusion: 该工作证明了在AI辅助编程中弥合可信性与性能之间的鸿沟是可行的，为生成可靠且高性能的代码提供了一条实用路径。

Abstract: Generative AI has made remarkable progress in producing functionally correct code, yet ensuring both correctness and performance remains an open challenge. We present Copper, a framework that combines formal verification with performance-aware specification to generate code that is provably correct and efficiently executable. Our approach integrates AI-driven code synthesis with formal verification tools, and automated performance profiling loops. Evaluated on a diverse set of algorithmic and real-world programming tasks, Copper produces solutions that satisfy strict correctness guarantees while delivering significant improvements in runtime and memory efficiency compared to baseline AI-generated code. This work demonstrates that it is feasible to bridge the gap between trustworthiness and performance in AI-assisted programming, offering a practical pathway toward reliable, high-performance code generation.

</details>


### [130] [Detecting Architectural Drift in Safety-Critical Firmware through Runtime Trace Analysis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.03135)
*Domenico Francesco De Angelis,Marco De Luca,Domenico Amalfitano,Pasquale Cimmino,Anna Rita Fasolino*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文提出一种运行时驱动的架构漂移检测方法，用于ISO 26262合规固件中。通过收集硬件辅助执行轨迹，抽象为组件间消息交换，与设计时序图进行确定性差分比较，并利用受限LLM生成可读报告。在26个工业案例中验证了该方法与专家评估的高度一致性，实践者认为报告有助于解释漂移、减少人工分析并支持安全文档活动。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在长寿命安全关键固件中，架构设计与运行时行为之间的一致性难以维持，现有方法难以有效检测架构漂移。

Method: 收集硬件辅助执行轨迹 → 抽象为固件组件间的消息交换 → 与设计时序图进行确定性差分比较（识别确认、缺失、额外、反转四类差异）→ 受限LLM生成人工可读报告供专家审查。

Result: 在26个工业测试案例上，生成的差分与专家策划的参考结果具有高度一致性；实践者调查报告显示该方法对解释漂移、减少人工分析、支持安全文档活动有用。

Conclusion: 结合运行时轨迹分析、确定性架构差分和受限LLM报告生成，能够有效支持演化中安全关键固件的架构漂移检测。

Abstract: Maintaining consistency between architectural design and runtime-observed behavior is challenging in long-lived safety-critical firmware. This paper presents a runtime-informed methodology for detecting architectural drift in ISO 26262-compliant firmware. The approach collects hardware-assisted execution traces, abstracts them into message exchanges among firmware components, and compares the resulting runtime behavior with design-time sequence diagrams through a deterministic differencing step. The computed delta identifies discrepancies as confirmed, missing, additional, or inverted, while a constrained LLM-based step generates a human-readable report only to support expert review. We evaluate the methodology in an industrial firmware context through agreement-based validation and a practitioner survey. Results over 26 test cases show strong agreement between the generated deltas and expert-curated references, while practitioners perceive the reports as useful for interpreting drift, reducing manual analysis effort, and supporting safety-oriented documentation activities. The findings suggest that combining runtime trace analysis, deterministic architectural differencing, and constrained LLM-based reporting can practically support architectural drift detection in evolving safety-critical firmware.

</details>


### [131] [Which Algorithm Specification Formats Help Language Models Implement Machine Learning Algorithms?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.03158)
*Masahiro Kato,Taka Kato*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本研究系统比较了七种算法规范书写格式（普通散文、LaTeX伪代码、PDF提取伪代码、Markdown字段、YAML类规范、JSON类规范和Python代码存根）对LLM首次实现准确性的影响。在5个ML任务、3个模型、4个实验设置下共生成4020个实现，发现LaTeX算法式伪代码在核心信息设置下平均格式效应最大，而代码存根并未一致提升正确性。研究建议作者应显式声明接口、计算步骤、数值规则和边界行为，而非依赖特定表层格式。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 研究论文中算法的实现细节往往隐含未明，而LLM被越来越多地用于根据论文实现算法。不同书写格式如何影响LLM首次实现的准确性尚不明确，本研究旨在系统量化这种影响，为论文作者提供基于证据的写作建议。

Method: 选取5个机器学习任务中的算法规范，将其分别写成7种格式（普通散文、LaTeX算法式伪代码、PDF提取伪代码、Markdown字段、YAML类、JSON类、Python代码存根），使用3个LLM（GPT-5.4 mini、Gemma 3 4B、Llama 3.2 3B）在4种实验设置下生成实现，共4020个实现。通过隐藏测试评估细节正确性，包括平局处理、数组形状、数值规则、返回结构和无效输入行为。

Result: 在核心信息设置下，LaTeX算法式伪代码的平均格式效应最大，YAML类规范和普通散文紧随其后。在完全信息设置下，GPT-5.4 mini的匹配比较中无格式差异，但Gemma 3 4B和Llama 3.2 3B仍有差异。代码存根尽管指定了函数签名，但并未一致提升正确性。

Conclusion: 论文作者应明确声明接口、计算步骤、数值规则和边界情况行为，而不是依赖特定的表面格式来承载这些细节。不同格式对LLM实现准确性的影响因模型和信息完整度而异。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used to implement algorithms from research manuscripts, but papers often leave implementation choices implicit. This study examines how the written format of an algorithm specification affects first-pass LLM implementation accuracy. We compare ordinary prose, LaTeX algorithm-style pseudocode, PDF-like extracted pseudocode, Markdown fields, YAML-like specifications, JSON-like specifications, and Python code stubs across five machine learning tasks, three models, and four experimental settings, yielding 4,020 generated implementations. Hidden tests evaluate details that often determine correctness, including tie-breaking, array shapes, numerical rules, return structures, and invalid-input behavior. Under the core-information setting, LaTeX algorithm-style pseudocode has the largest average format effect, with YAML-like specifications and ordinary prose close behind. Under complete information, GPT-5.4 mini shows no format differences in the matched comparisons, whereas Gemma 3 4B and Llama 3.2 3B still do. Code stubs do not consistently improve correctness despite specifying the function signature. The results support a writing recommendation: authors should state the interface, computation steps, numerical rules, and boundary-case behavior explicitly, instead of relying on a particular surface format to carry those details.

</details>


### [132] [Effectiveness of LLM-based Software Diversity for Reliability Improvement -- an Empirical Study](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.03174)
*Gabriel Almeida,Ilir Gashi,Vladimir Stankovic,João R. Campos*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文研究了大型语言模型（LLM）作为软件多样性生成器的可行性，通过对比人类编写的程序和LLM生成的代码，评估了不同多样性维度（模型家族、解码温度、编程语言）对1-out-of-2容错配置下可靠性提升的影响。结果表明，LLM生成的程序，特别是在异构设置中，可以带来可靠性增益。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统软件多样性成本高昂（需多实现及相应验证、维护、部署），而LLM能快速、廉价地生成大量候选实现，这引出一个自然问题：LLM能否作为实用的软件多样性生成器？其多样性实际能提供多少可靠性改进？

Method: 选取三个规格说明，使用历史人工编写程序与LLM生成的大规模程序池，在统一的编译、沙箱和穷举测试套件下进行评估。沿多个多样性轴（模型家族、生成温度、编程语言）探索LLM多样性，并在1-out-of-2配置下评估同构/异构程序群体的可靠性改进，包括LLM内配对、跨编程语言配对以及LLM生成与人类编写程序之间的配对。

Result: 结合LLM生成的程序，尤其是在异构设置中，可以产生可靠性增益，但效果部分受编程语言和生成设置条件的影响。

Conclusion: LLM提供了一个可扩展的低成本程序来源，其多样性可用于可靠性改进。

Abstract: Software diversity has been extensively studied as a means of reducing the risk of common-mode failures. Classic work showed that the central issue is whether failures of diversely redundant components overlap in ways that limit the reliability gains. Traditional software diversity is costly to obtain, since it requires multiple implementations as well as the corresponding validation, maintenance, and deployment effort. Recent advances in Large Language Models (LLMs) may change this. LLMs enable inexpensive code generation: they produce many candidate implementations of the same specification quickly, across different models, decoding settings, and programming languages. This raises a natural question: can LLMs serve as practical generators of software diversity, and how much reliability improvement can that diversity actually provide? In this paper, we extend classical empirical studies of software diversity in human-written programs to LLM-generated code. We study three specifications using both historical human-written programs and large pools of LLM-generated ones evaluated under a common compilation, sandboxing, and exhaustive test suite. We explore LLM diversity along multiple axes, including model family, generation temperature, and programming language. Reliability improvement is evaluated in a 1-out-of-2 configuration across both homogeneous and heterogeneous program populations, including within-LLM pairings and pairings across programming languages and across LLM-generated and human-written programs. The results show that combining LLM-generated programs, especially in heterogeneous settings, can yield reliability gains, although this is partly conditioned by the programming language and generation setting. Taken together, these findings suggest that LLMs provide a scalable source of comparatively low-cost programs whose diversity can be leveraged for reliability improvement.

</details>


### [133] [CRRL: A Causality-Based Reinforcement Learning Framework for Autonomous System Recovery](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.03177)
*Safia Fatima,Kai Olav Ellefsen,Leon Moonen*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: CRRL提出了一种因果引导的强化学习框架，通过结合因果关系训练策略与基于规则的恢复机制协作，解决了传统RL在自主系统恢复中缺乏因果理解和泛化能力差的问题，显著提升了奖励、行驶距离和速度，并在环岛场景中45%的回合无需恢复干预。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统强化学习在自主系统故障恢复中缺乏因果理解能力，泛化到新故障场景表现差；RL策略常卡在故障状态（最高70%回合时间停滞不前）；基于规则的恢复单独使用效果不佳，而将启发式恢复添加到预训练PPO策略中反而因策略无法与干预协调而导致奖励下降。根本问题不在于缺少恢复机制，而在于缺乏训练有素能与恢复机制协作的策略。

Method: CRRL框架：(1) 遵循MAPE-K范式，分为Monitor（传感器数据采集）、Analyze（因果模型构建）、Plan/Execute（混合RL策略训练）；(2) 恢复机制检测停滞状态并辅助智能体；(3) 利用驾驶日志中的因果关系构建训练信号，教导策略预测停滞并在恢复上下文中调整动作。

Result: 在三个驾驶场景中进行四项消融实验（每条件20个回合），因果训练显著提高了奖励、行驶距离和速度；在环岛场景中，20个回合中有9个回合（45%）无需任何恢复干预，证明了导航能力。

Conclusion: 因果引导训练能够产生有效的RL策略，使其与基于规则的安全组件良好协作，解决了策略与恢复机制不协调的核心问题。

Abstract: Traditional reinforcement learning (RL) for recovery in autonomous systems lacks causal understanding and generalizes poorly to novel failure scenarios. RL policies often stall in failure states, spending up to 70% of an episode immobilized. Rule-based recovery alone is inadequate, and adding heuristic recovery to a pretrained PPO policy worsens rewards because policies cannot coordinate well with unanticipated interventions. The issue is not missing recovery mechanisms but a lack of policies trained to collaborate with them.
  We introduce CRRL, a causal-guided RL framework that trains policies to work effectively with rule-based recovery. The recovery detects stalled states and assists the agent. Causal relations from driving logs shape the training signal, teaching the policy to anticipate stalls and adjust actions in recovery contexts. The framework follows MAPE-K, with sensor collection, causal model construction, and hybrid RL policy training corresponding to Monitor, Analyze, and Plan/Execute, respectively.
  We evaluate CRRL through a four-condition ablation study across three driving scenarios, with 20 episodes per condition. We find that causal training significantly improves reward, distance, and velocity. Moreover, 9 of 20 roundabout episodes required zero recovery intervention, confirming navigation competence. These results show that causal-guided training produces effective RL policies that cooperate with rule-based safety components.

</details>


### [134] [TATG: Tracking-Aware Testing Objective for LLM-based Test Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.03194)
*Guancheng Wang,Qinghua Xu,Lionel C. Briand*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: TATG是一种基于LLM的跟踪感知单元测试生成方法，通过统一目标表示来追踪测试需求满足情况，采用两阶段工作流（结构轮次+变异引导强化轮次），在141个复杂Java方法上相比KTester和PANTA，行覆盖率、分支覆盖率和变异评分分别平均提升22.15、20.14和37.66个百分点。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LLM-based单元测试生成方法（如KTester、PANTA、MUTGEN）未显式表示和跟踪各迭代中的单个测试需求，导致重复生成已满足需求而忽略未解决分支和弱断言，且结构覆盖与变异有效性优化相互分离。

Method: 提出TATG方法：1) 引入统一目标表示，捕获来自静态分析和动态反馈的测试需求；2) 实现细粒度跟踪已满足和未解决的需求；3) 采用两阶段工作流——结构轮次提升覆盖率，变异引导强化轮次增强断言和故障检测能力。

Result: 在141个复杂Java方法上评估，相比KTester和PANTA，平均行覆盖率提升22.15个百分点，分支覆盖率提升20.14个百分点，变异评分提升37.66个百分点；在选定的焦点方法子集上，性能与专有工业级测试生成工具相当，且行覆盖率和变异评分更高。

Conclusion: TATG通过跟踪感知机制有效解决了现有方法在测试需求追踪上的不足，两阶段工作流同时优化了结构覆盖和故障检测能力，显著优于现有LLM-based方法，并接近工业级工具水平。

Abstract: Complex Java methods remain challenging for automated unit test generation because achieving high coverage and fault detection often requires satisfying branch-specific testing requirements that are not directly visible from a focal method. Recent LLM-based approaches, such as KTester, PANTA, and MUTGEN, leverage project context, static analysis, coverage feedback, or mutation guidance. However, they do not explicitly represent and track individual testing requirements across iterations. As a result, generation may repeatedly target satisfied requirements while overlooking unresolved branches and weak assertions. Existing approaches also optimize structural coverage and mutation effectiveness separately.
  We present TATG, a tracking-aware LLM-based unit test generation approach. TATG introduces a unified objective representation that captures testing requirements derived from static analysis and dynamic feedback. The representation enables fine-grained tracking of satisfied and unresolved requirements throughout generation. TATG further employs a two-stage workflow: structural rounds improve coverage, followed by mutation-guided hardening rounds that strengthen assertions and improve fault detection.
  We evaluate TATG on 141 complex Java methods, including the 110 KTester subjects and 31 additional challenging methods. Compared with KTester and PANTA, TATG improves line coverage, branch coverage, and mutation score by 22.15, 20.14, and 37.66 percentage points on average. On a selected subset of focal methods, TATG also achieves performance comparable to a proprietary industrial test generation tool while achieving higher line coverage and mutation score.

</details>


### [135] [Round-Trip Mutation Testing: Translating Code to Natural Language Intent and back](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.03223)
*Asma Hamidi,Cedric Richter,Ahmed Khanfir,Mike Papadakis*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种名为“往返变异测试”（RTM）的新方法，该方法利用大语言模型在程序代码与自然语言意图之间的生成能力，通过代码→意图→代码的往返转换生成变异体，并进一步通过有意篡改意图来产生更多变异体。实验表明，RTM能生成语法更多样化的变异体，比传统模式变异方法更有效地暴露故障，在仅选择4个和30个测试用例时，分别平均检测到4倍和1.7倍以上的故障。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统变异测试依赖预定义的语法级变异算子，难以模拟因规范误解导致的细微语义差异故障。LLM在代码与自然语言间的生成能力为从语义层面生成更真实的变异体提供了新途径。

Method: 给定输入程序，首先利用LLM预测其自然语言意图（代码→意图），再利用该意图生成多个程序版本（意图→代码），其中与原始程序不同的即为变异体。此外，通过人为篡改意图（即引入误译）再生成程序，可额外产生更多变异体。这些变异体源自意图中微小变化的传播，模拟规范理解错误导致的实际故障。

Result: 在40个真实buggy方法上评估，RTM生成的变异体在语法上更多样化，能暴露传统变异算子无法揭示的故障。在测试套件选择上，RTM优于传统模式变异：仅选4个测试时平均检测到4倍以上故障，选30个测试时平均检测到1.7倍以上故障。

Conclusion: 往返变异测试是一种有效且具有成本效益的新型变异测试方法，通过语义级变异生成，能产生更小但更强的测试套件，显著提升故障检测能力，尤其在测试预算有限时优势更为突出。

Abstract: This paper presents Round-Trip Mutation Testing (RTM), a novel approach that generates mutants from LLM mistranslations between a program code and its intent. Leveraging the generative capability of LLMs from and to programming and natural language, and given an input program, our approach predicts its intent, that is used to generate programs, which when different from the original one, constitute the output mutants. The approach produces additionally mutants, stemming from artificially provoked mistranslations, by mutating the intent prior to the final programs (mutants) generation. Originating from the propagation of small changes in the intent to the code, our intuition is that these programs would present subtle semantic differences from the original one, simulating likely-to-occur faults that could result from specification misunderstandings, and enabling mutation testing. To evaluate RTM, we run it on 40 real buggy methods and evaluate its effectiveness and cost-efficiency in guiding testing towards detecting the bugs. Our results demonstrate the potential of round-trip mutation testing to produce syntactically more diverse mutants, potentially exposing faults that traditional mutation operators fail to reveal. More interestingly, RTM outperforms traditional pattern-based mutation in producing smaller and stronger test-suites, detecting on average over 4 and 1.7 times more faults when selecting only 4 and 30 tests respectively.

</details>


### [136] [An Empirical Study of Downstream Adaptation for Agent Skills](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.03238)
*Xinjian Wu,Jingzhi Gong,Gunel Jahangirova,Zhenpeng Chen,Jie M. Zhang*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文首次对LLM智能体技能（skills）的下游适应进行实证研究，分析了6个主流技能仓库中的1,126个适应实例，归纳出13个家族46种适应模式。研究发现存在"重用悖论"：技能本应易于重用，但开发者却花费大量精力重写功能、修复可发现性、进行跨工具翻译，且近五分之一的适应引入了安全敏感内容。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM智能体技能作为新型软件复用单元日益普及，但下游开发者在复用已发布技能时常需进行适配修改，而此类适应的本质特征尚未被系统理解。

Method: 对6个广泛采用的技能仓库中的1,126个技能适应实例进行系统分析，归纳构建了包含13个家族、46种适应模式的分类体系。

Result: 发现"重用悖论"：开发者大量时间用于重写功能、修复可发现性、跨工具和语言翻译；适应高度相互依赖，一个组件的变更常需协调更新其他部分；近五分之一的适应在行为控制的指令文本中引入了安全敏感内容。

Conclusion: 需要更好的抽象机制、标准化接口和自动化支持来改进技能适应，同时需开发检测不一致修改和安全敏感内容的自动化工具。

Abstract: As Large Language Model (LLM) agents become integral to modern software systems, ``skills'' have emerged as a novel unit of software reuse, enabling developers to package workflows, decision procedures, and prompt-based policies. While skills are intended for reuse, downstream developers frequently modify published skills to fit local contexts, yet little is known about the nature of such adaptations. This paper presents the first empirical study of downstream skill adaptation in public forks, to understand how published skills are adapted, and to provide implications for researchers and engineers on improving skill design, evolution, and orchestration. Specifically, we analyze 1,126 skill-adaptation instances from six widely adopted skill repositories and develop a taxonomy comprising 46 adaptation patterns organized into 13 families. Our key findings reveal a reuse paradox: although skills are intended to be easily imported and reused, developers spend a lot of effort rewriting what the skills do, fixing skill discoverability, and translating them for different tools and languages, indicating a need for better abstractions, standardized interfaces, and automated support for skill adaptation. Furthermore, adaptations are highly interdependent, with changes in one component often requiring coordinated updates elsewhere, motivating automated support for detecting inconsistent modifications. We also find that nearly one-fifth of adaptations introduce security-sensitive content within the same instruction text that governs behavior.

</details>


### [137] [Socio-Technical Anti-Patterns in Building ML-Enabled Software: Insights from Leaders on the Forefront](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.03270)
*Alina Mailach,Norbert Siegmund*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文通过对MLOps社区66小时讲座的手动分析，识别出17种反模式，这些反模式通常源于组织或管理问题，并提出了从技术方案到组织重构的应对建议。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 尽管ML系统经济影响力巨大，但企业和从业者持续报告将ML模型投入生产面临困难；现有研究多聚焦纯技术方面，缺乏对社会技术维度的关注。

Method: 对该领域最大规模的定性实证研究，手动分析MLOps社区（Slack工作区超过11,000名成员）录制的66小时从业者讲座。

Result: 发现17种反模式，大多根植于组织或管理问题；提出从技术解决方案、指导方针到组织重构的系列建议；与前人研究进行对比验证。

Conclusion: ML生产化的核心挑战不仅在于技术层面，更在于组织与管理等社会技术因素，需多维度综合应对。

Abstract: Although machine learning (ML)-enabled software systems seem to be a success story considering their rise in economic power, there are consistent reports from companies and practitioners struggling to bring ML models into production. Many papers have focused on specific, and purely technical aspects, such as testing and pipelines, but only few on socio-technical aspects. Driven by numerous anecdotes and reports from practitioners, our goal is to collect and analyze socio-technical challenges of productionizing ML models centered around and within teams. To this end, we conducted the largest qualitative empirical study in this area, involving the manual analysis of 66 hours of talks that have been recorded by the MLOps community. By analyzing talks from practitioners for practitioners of a community with over 11,000 members in their Slack workspace, we found 17 anti-patterns, often rooted in organizational or management problems. We further list recommendations to overcome these problems, ranging from technical solutions over guidelines to organizational restructuring. Finally, we contextu-alize our findings with previous research, confirming existing results, validating our own, and highlighting new insights.

</details>


### [138] [Regulatory compliance-readiness in the AI Supply Chain: examining datasets in Hugging Face](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.03310)
*Georgia M. Kapitsaki*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文对Hugging Face上11,682个数据集进行了监管合规性（特别是数据隐私）的初步分析，发现极少数数据集明确说明数据创建过程和数据来源，部分数据集在数据模式中提及PII或敏感数据，表明需要更详细的监管合规检查和自动化合规工具研究。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大量AI模型使用Hugging Face数据集进行训练，但这些数据集可能存在监管合规问题（如数据隐私实践、数据来源和预处理流程不透明），可能引发AI供应链中的监管风险。

Method: 收集了11,682个Hugging Face数据集（有数据集卡、非门控且下载量≥500），以数据集卡和数据集结构概览为起点，结合自动化技术和样本手动分析，对数据集的监管合规性（特别是与GDPR、CCPA等隐私法律的合规性）进行分析。

Result: 极少数数据集明确说明数据创建过程和提及数据来源；部分数据集在数据模式中提及PII或其他敏感数据。

Conclusion: 研究结果揭示了AI数据集和模型中监管合规检查的必要性，以及需要开发能够为从业者提供指导并自动化合规流程的研究工具。

Abstract: A very large number of datasets are made available via Hugging Face (HF). These datasets are used to train a vast number of AI models, also available via HF. There are regulatory issues that might arise in the AI supply chain when those datasets do not follow, for instance, data privacy practices, or do not disclose their data sources, cleaning and preparation processes. In this preliminary work, regulatory compliance-readiness is examined as a quality attribute in the framework of HF datasets, with a main focus on data privacy (e.g. GDPR, CCPA). Towards this direction, an analysis on regulatory compliance (e.g. with privacy laws) of the dataset using the dataset card and the dataset structure overview as starting points has been performed. We collected 11,682 HF datasets that have a dataset card, are not gated and have at least 500 downloads and analyzed the datasets using automated techniques and manual analysis on a sample of the dataset. The results show that a very small number of datasets are explicit on the datasets creation processes and mention data sources, while some make mentions to Personally Identifiable Information (PII) or other sensitive data in their data schemas. These results show the need for more detailed examinations of regulatory compliance in AI datasets and models, and research on tools that provide guidance to practitioners and automate the compliance process.

</details>


### [139] [Is Agentic Code Review Helpful? Mining Developers' Feedback to CodeRabbit Reviews in the Wild](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.03316)
*Hong Yi Lin,Mingzhao Liang,Kla Tantithamthavorn,Patanamon Thongtanunam*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 通过对CodeRabbit在239个GitHub仓库中的10,191个PR的31,073对代码审查与开发者反馈进行实证研究，发现AI代理审查中56.3%被拒绝，主要源于无效建议（假阳性、冗余、范围不符）及与开发者意图/编码实践的偏差；相比可演化性评论，功能性评论更易被拒。轻量级学习方法可达到76% F1分数预测拒绝结果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 尽管Agentic代码审查正被集成到开发流程中，但缺乏开发者如何响应这类审查意见的实证证据，亟需填补这一认知空白。

Method: 以CodeRabbit为案例，收集239个GitHub仓库中10,191个PR的31,073对审查意见与开发者反馈数据，进行定量统计分析和基于LLM的拒绝预测建模。

Result: 36.4%审查被接受，7.3%引发讨论，56.3%被拒绝；拒绝主因是无效建议（假阳性、冗余、超出范围）以及开发者意图和编码实践的不对齐；功能性问题比可演化性问题更易被拒；轻量级学习方法实现76% F1分数预测拒绝。

Conclusion: 当前CodeRabbit的代理审查存在明显改进空间，尤其在减少无效建议和提升与开发者意图对齐方面；审查拒绝中存在可学习的模式，可通过轻量级方法进行预测。

Abstract: Agentic code review, where autonomous agents provide code review comments on pull requests, is increasingly integrated into development workflows, yet there is limited empirical evidence on how developers respond to such comments in practice. In this paper, we present an empirical study of agentic code reviews using CodeRabbit as a case study. Through an empirical study of 31,073 pairs of code reviews and developer feedback from 10,191 pull requests across 239 GitHub repositories, our results show that agentic reviews receive mixed reception: 36.4% were accepted and 7.3% triggered discussion, while 56.3% were rejected. Rejections were primarily associated with invalid suggestions that were false positives, redundant, or out of scope, as well as misalignment with developer intent and coding practices. We further found that agentic reviews tend to focus more on functional concerns than evolvability-related comments, yet they were more likely to be invalid. To improve effectiveness in review practices, we explored various LLM-based approaches for predicting review rejection. We found that lightweight learning-based methods achieve up to 76% F1 score, suggesting learnable patterns exist between code reviews and their corresponding feedback. Our results highlight the current state of CodeRabbit's agentic code reviews, showing opportunity gaps for improvement, as well as shortcomings hindering its effectiveness.

</details>


### [140] [AtomicCommitBench: Can Coding Agents Reconstruct Commit Histories from Squashed Patches?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.03332)
*Zhihao Lin,Mingyi Zhou,Li Li*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文研究代码智能体在完成开发任务后，将混杂的代码变更（一个squashed patch）自动拆解为符合历史结构的原子化提交序列。作者形式化定义了hunk-to-commit分区任务，构建了包含800个真实提交片段的AtomicCommitBench基准，并提出PPAR、ARI、TCR三项互补评估指标。实验表明，真实回构任务远难于合成场景，GPT-5.4（Codex CLI）和GLM-5（Claude Code）表现领先，而依赖感知方法DACE可有效缓解同文件合并与支持块漂移等失败模式。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有编码智能体通常将一次开发会话中的所有改动（功能实现、bug修复、重构、测试、配置修改等）合并为一个squashed patch，虽然最终代码正确，但丢失了提交历史的结构信息，导致代码审查困难、无法选择性回滚、维护成本增加。因此，作者希望研究如何自动将squashed patch重构为可复现的原子化提交序列，恢复提交历史的有序结构。

Method: 作者形式化定义了hunk-to-commit分区任务，要求将代码变更块（hunk）分组到不同提交中并生成可回放执行的提交序列。构建AtomicCommitBench基准，包含800个来自10个Python项目的真实连续提交片段。提出三项评估指标：PPAR（回放有效性）、ARI（分组质量）、TCR（失败隔离能力）。评估多种方法（含GPT-5.4+Codex CLI、GLM-5+Claude Code、MiniMax、Kimi等），并提出DACE（Dependency-Aware Commit Evidence）方法，利用依赖线索和hunk角色信息改善分组质量。

Result: 几乎所有非随机方法都能达到高回放有效性（PPAR >= 0.988），但分组质量差异显著（ARI范围0.03-0.46）。合成场景的任务难度远低于真实同作者squashed diff（ARI提升+0.333）。GPT-5.4+Codex CLI（ARI 0.46）和GLM-5+Claude Code（ARI 0.43）表现最佳，优于MiniMax（0.31）和Kimi（0.29）。定性分析识别出"同文件合并"和"支持块漂移"两类典型失败模式。DACE方法使低分方法提升0.05-0.08 ARI。

Conclusion: 回顾性提交历史重构是一项具有挑战性的任务，真实场景远难于合成数据。依赖感知和角色识别有助于缓解分组错误。AtomicCommitBench为评估代码智能体的提交历史质量提供了标准基准，推动编码智能体在产出最终代码的同时生成可维护、可审查的提交历史。

Abstract: Coding agents often finish a session by returning one squashed patch that mixes feature implementation, bug fixes, refactorings, tests, and configuration edits. While the final code may be correct, collapsing unrelated edits into one patch removes the history structure needed for review, selective revert, and later maintenance. We study retrospective commit-history reconstruction: given a completed squashed change, an agent groups its hunks into commits and materializes a replayable commit sequence. We formalize the task as hunk-to-commit partitioning with a replay requirement and build AtomicCommitBench, containing 800 real consecutive-commit episodes from 10 Python projects. Because multiple decompositions may be reasonable, we evaluate outputs using complementary metrics: PPAR for replay validity, ARI for reference-based grouping quality, and TCR for failure containment on scoreable modified-test episodes. Natural retrospective reconstruction proves substantially harder than replay checking or synthetic tangling. Although nearly all non-random methods achieve replay validity (PPAR >= 0.988), grouping quality ranges from 0.03 to 0.46 ARI. Matched synthetic composites are much easier than real same-author squashed diffs (+0.333 ARI). In our evaluation, the GPT-5.4 setup driven by Codex CLI (0.46 ARI) and the GLM-5 setup driven by Claude Code (0.43 ARI) outperform MiniMax (0.31) and Kimi (0.29). Qualitative analysis identifies same-file lumping and support-hunk drift as recurring failure modes. Dependency-Aware Commit Evidence (DACE) improves the lower-scoring setups by 0.05 to 0.08 ARI, indicating that dependency cues and hunk-role information help agents avoid locality-driven grouping errors. AtomicCommitBench enables evaluation of the commit histories produced by coding agents alongside the final code.

</details>


### [141] [SkillOpt-Lite: Better and Faster Agent Self-evolution via One Line of Vibe](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.03451)
*Yifei Shen,Bo Li,Xinjie Zhang*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文提出SkillOpt-Lite，一个基于零阶优化的最小可行技能优化流水线，通过文件系统轨迹探索、共识属性挖掘和独立验证门控三大原则，在无需复杂组件的情况下实现技能收敛与泛化。实验表明，该框架显著提升模型性能（如GPT-5.5上LiveMath提高8.8分），并能自然推广到完整工具链优化（HarnessOpt），使小模型超越大模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有自主智能体技能优化方法依赖复杂流水线，缺乏对"最小可行流水线"中每个组件是否在理论上或经验上必要的基本追问。本文旨在形式化技能优化问题并构建一个精简高效的最小流水线。

Method: 将技能优化形式化为零阶优化问题，映射经典方法（中心差分、信任域）到现有文献。基于Claude Code哲学和PAC学习理论，建立三个原则：基于文件系统的轨迹探索、共识属性挖掘、独立验证门控。据此提出SkillOpt-Lite，消除冗余组件。

Result: SkillOpt-Lite加速收敛且全面超越完整SkillOpt：LiveMath上GPT-5.5提升8.8分，GPT-5.4-nano提升25.4分，使nano模型超越完整SkillOpt优化的标准GPT-5.4。在SpreadsheetBench上，HarnessOpt使GPT-5.4-nano达到0.7758准确率，超越标准流水线下的更大模型GPT-5.5（0.7620）。

Conclusion: 该最小可行流水线因将所有智能体组件视为标准可编辑代码，自然泛化到完整工具链优化（HarnessOpt），并已集成到生产级编码智能体（如VSCode Copilot）中，开发者可通过一行"vibe"指令进化智能体技能。

Abstract: While skill optimization for autonomous agents has gained traction, existing methods rely on complex pipelines. This leaves a fundamental question unaddressed: What constitutes a minimal viable pipeline for skill optimization, where every component is justified by theory or empirical necessity? We formalize skill optimization via Zeroth-Order (ZO) optimization, mapping classical counterparts (central difference, trust regions) to recent literature. Noting that unlike blind numerical perturbations in classical ZO, skill trajectories serve as interpretable debugging feedback. Grounded in Claude Code philosophy and PAC learning, we establish three principles for convergence and generalization: file-system-based trajectory exploration, consensus attribute mining, and independent validation gating. Eliminating redundancies, we propose SkillOpt-Lite. It accelerates convergence and outperforms full SkillOpt: improving LiveMath by +8.8 points on GPT-5.5 and +25.4 points on GPT-5.4-nano, allowing the nano model to surpass standard GPT-5.4 optimized by SkillOpt. Finally, we integrate our framework into production coding agents like VSCode Copilot, enabling developers to evolve agent skills via one line of vibe. Because our framework treats all agent components simply as standard editable code, this minimal pipeline naturally generalizes to full harness optimization (HarnessOpt). On SpreadsheetBench, HarnessOpt enables GPT-5.4-nano to achieve 0.7758 accuracy, outperforming the larger GPT-5.5 running standard pipelines (0.7620). Code is available at https://github.com/EvolvingLMMs-Lab/SkillOpt-Lite.

</details>


### [142] [CAGE-1: Control, Assurance, and Governance Evaluation for Enterprise Agentic AI](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.03510)
*Roopam W. Sure*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文提出CAGE-1评估框架，用于企业级AI代理在部署前的控制、保证和治理评估，涵盖权限、策略执行、检索质量、记忆完整性、工具安全、可审计性、人工监督等12个维度，并引入Prebind Assurance概念来验证代理行动在产生约束性后果前是否可控。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 企业AI正从实验阶段进入运营工作流，代理系统开始规划、检索、记忆、调用工具并协调跨应用工作，但现有评估仅关注答案准确性和流畅性，无法满足企业对授权、策略合规、证据时效、记忆有效性、工具调用权限、决策可重放性和紧急停止等治理需求。

Method: CAGE-1框架从12个维度进行评估：权限、策略执行、检索质量、记忆完整性、工具安全性、可审计性、人工监督、冲突处理、安全失败、Prebind Assurance、运营就绪性和业务适配性。Prebind Assurance用于验证代理行动在被执行前是否被允许、保留、限制、拒绝、升级、隔离或失效。

Result: 提出了一个系统化的企业级AI代理部署就绪评估框架，建立了Prebind Assurance概念来确保代理行动在产生约束性后果前受到控制。

Conclusion: CAGE-1为企业代理AI提供了全面的控制、保证和治理评估框架，帮助企业判断代理系统是否适合部署到生产环境中。

Abstract: Enterprise artificial intelligence is moving from experimentation into operational workflows. Early programs focused on model access and retrieval-augmented generation, but enterprises are now beginning to deploy agents that plan, retrieve, remember, call tools, update systems, and coordinate work across applications.
  This changes the evaluation problem. Leaders are no longer asking only whether an answer is accurate or fluent. They need to know who authorized an action, which policy applied, whether evidence was current, whether memory was valid, whether a tool call was permitted, whether the decision can be replayed, and whether the agent can be stopped before it creates business impact.
  This paper introduces CAGE-1: Control, Assurance, and Governance Evaluation for Enterprise Agentic AI. CAGE-1 is an evaluation framework for deciding whether enterprise agents are ready for deployment. It evaluates authority, policy enforcement, retrieval quality, memory integrity, tool safety, auditability, human oversight, conflict handling, safe failure, Prebind Assurance, operational readiness, and business fitness.
  CAGE-1 introduces Prebind Assurance to describe the evaluated ability to prove that an agentic action is controlled before it becomes binding, effective, or operationally consequential. The framework tests whether a proposed action is admitted, held, narrowed, refused, escalated, quarantined, or made non-effective before protected consequence forms.

</details>


### [143] [AGL-1: The Enterprise AI Governance Layer as a Control Plane for Trusted Enterprise Intelligence](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.03516)
*Roopam W. Sure*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文提出AGL-1，一个面向企业AI治理的供应商中立参考模型，将治理问题从检索特定控制扩展到完整AI执行路径治理，涵盖身份感知检索、策略执行、溯源管理、记忆治理、知识完整性监控、代理执行控制和信任可观测性七大治理域。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 企业AI正从孤立实验转向运营依赖，主要挑战已不再是模型访问或推理规模，而是在分布式AI生态中实现治理型智能操作，包括授权执行、上下文溯源、持久记忆控制、陈腐或冲突知识检测、代理执行约束以及可审计证据生成。

Method: 基于GKS-5中引入的治理知识系统原则，将治理问题从检索特定控制泛化为完整AI执行路径治理，定义七大治理域并识别常见失效模式（如未授权检索、陈旧接地、未管理记忆、弱溯源、策略漂移、碎片化可观测性和失控自主执行）。

Result: 提出AGL-1作为跨基础模型、检索系统、编排框架、企业记忆、策略引擎、可观测性系统、工具、API和业务应用的统一控制平面参考模型。

Conclusion: 企业AI的持久价值将日益依赖于规模化治理智能的能力。在复杂企业中，信任不是模型本身的属性，而是围绕模型的系统属性——身份、知识、策略、记忆、工具、人工监督和证据协同作为受管控的控制平面。

Abstract: Enterprise artificial intelligence is moving from isolated experimentation toward operational dependency across copilots, retrieval-augmented generation systems, autonomous agents, and AI-enabled business workflows. As this transition accelerates, the primary enterprise challenge is no longer only model access or inference scale. It is governed intelligence operations: the ability to enforce authorization, preserve contextual lineage, control persistent memory, detect stale or conflicting knowledge, constrain agentic execution, and produce audit-ready evidence across distributed AI estates.
  This paper introduces AGL-1, the Enterprise AI Governance Layer, as a vendor-neutral reference model for the control plane that should operate across foundation models, retrieval systems, orchestration frameworks, enterprise memory, policy engines, observability systems, tools, APIs, and business applications.
  Building on governed knowledge-system principles introduced in GKS-5, AGL-1 generalizes the governance problem from retrieval-specific controls to full AI execution-path governance. It identifies recurring failure modes such as unauthorized retrieval, stale grounding, unmanaged memory, weak provenance, policy drift, fragmented observability, and uncontrolled autonomous execution. It then defines seven governance domains: identity-aware retrieval, policy enforcement, provenance management, memory governance, knowledge integrity monitoring, agentic execution control, and trust observability.
  The central claim is that durable enterprise value from AI will increasingly depend on the ability to govern intelligence at scale. In complex enterprises, trust is not a property of the model alone. It is a property of the system around the model: identity, knowledge, policy, memory, tools, human oversight, and evidence working together as a managed control plane.

</details>


### [144] [Anchored Self-Play for Code Repair](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.03523)
*Caroline Choi,Zeyneb Kaya,Shirley Wu,Tengyu Ma,Tatsunori Hashimoto,Ludwig Schmidt*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文提出锚定自博弈（ASP）方法，通过在生成奖励中引入代码嵌入相似度并将参考bug混入修复器训练，解决了标准自博弈中模型向不真实但困难的bug漂移的问题，在涵盖人类编写、LM生成和人类编辑LM生成代码bug的BugSourceBench上，相比标准自博弈绝对修复率提升7.0个百分点。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 代码修复数据有限，希望利用LM自我生成bug-fix任务来扩展监督信号，但需防止生成任务与真实bug分布偏离。

Method: 提出生成器-修复器自博弈框架，单一模型通过强化学习同时训练生成bug和修复bug；进一步提出锚定自博弈（ASP），在生成奖励中添加代码嵌入相似度项（锚定到参考集分布），并在修复器训练中混合参考bug数据。

Result: 在BugSourceBench上，ASP相比标准自博弈平均修复率绝对提升7.0个百分点（相对提升24%），在人类和LM来源的bug上均有改善。

Conclusion: 锚定自博弈有效防止了自博弈向不真实bug漂移，实现了对多种真实bug来源的泛化修复能力提升。

Abstract: Code repair is an important capability for language models (LMs): given a buggy program and unit tests, an LM must produce a fixed program that passes the tests. Because code repair data is limited, we aim to scale supervision by using an LM to generate bug--fix tasks. We propose __generator--fixer self-play__, in which a single model is trained with reinforcement learning to generate bugs and fix them. As the fixer improves, the generator adapts to produce more difficult bugs, yielding an automatic curriculum. To test whether this curriculum generalizes, we introduce BugSourceBench, a repair benchmark spanning realistic bug sources: bugs in human-written code, LM-generated code, and human-edited LM-generated code. On BugSourceBench, we find that self-play drifts toward difficult but unrealistic bugs, improving on synthetic bugs but degrading on human-authored ones. We propose Anchored Self-Play (ASP), which anchors self-play with a small reference set by adding a code-embedding similarity reward for generation and mixing reference bugs into fixer training. Across bug sources, ASP achieves the best fix rates, improving average fix rate over standard self-play by $+24\%$ relative / $+7.0$ pp absolute, with gains on bugs from both LMs and humans.

</details>


### [145] [GameEngineBench: Evaluating Coding Agents on Real C++ Runtime Environments](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.03525)
*Brian La,Sejoon Chang,Ben Kim,Junyoung Bae,Aamish Ahmad Beg,Sei Chang,Gonzalo Gonzalez-Pumariega*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: GameEngineBench是一个基于Unreal Engine 5的基准测试，包含110个真实游戏项目的C++实现任务，用于评估编码智能体在实时交互系统中修改原生C++代码的能力。最强模型达到55.5% pass@1，31个任务完全未被解决，表明前沿编码智能体在深度集成的实时交互式C++开发中仍存在显著困难。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有软件工程评估缺乏对实时交互式系统（如游戏引擎）中C++代码修改能力的专门测试，而游戏开发因其系统成熟度高、公开可用性好，为评估编码智能体在带状态、交互式、实时系统中的表现提供了理想的试验场。

Method: 从9个真实游戏仓库构建Unreal Engine 5项目，设计110个涵盖玩法机制、多人行为、AI与场景编排、动画与运动、UI与会话代码、加载行为、在线服务集成、持久化、数据序列化、XR行为及渲染插件等领域的C++实现任务，要求模型修改原生C++代码并通过编译和行为测试。

Result: 在12种评估配置下，最强模型达到55.5% pass@1，31个任务未被任何配置解决。前沿编码智能体在深度集成的实时交互式C++开发中表现不佳。

Conclusion: 游戏引擎基准测试是对现有软件工程评估的有价值补充，实时交互式软件的C++开发对前沿编码智能体仍是重大挑战。

Abstract: Game engines provide real-time simulation, rendering, physics, interaction, networking, and asset pipelines, making them valuable not only for games but also for 3D applications in healthcare, robotics, architecture, manufacturing, and related domains. Because game development is where these systems are most mature and publicly available, it offers a practical testbed for evaluating coding agents that must modify C++ code within stateful, interactive, real-time systems. We present GameEngineBench, a benchmark for evaluating coding agents on scoped C++ implementation tasks inside Unreal Engine 5 projects, built from nine real-world game repositories. The evaluation set consists of 110 tasks spanning gameplay mechanics, multiplayer behavior, AI and world orchestration, animation and movement, UI and session code, loading behavior, online-service integration, persistence, data serialization, XR behavior, and rendering-oriented plugins. These tasks require models to make native C++ changes that compile and satisfy behavioral tests within executable Unreal Engine projects. Across twelve evaluated configurations, the strongest model reaches 55.5\% pass@1, while 31 tasks remain unsolved by every configuration. Our results demonstrate that frontier coding agents continue to struggle with deeply integrated C++ development for real-time interactive software, highlighting game-engine benchmarks as a valuable complement to existing software engineering evaluations.

</details>


### [146] [LogSemFuse: Semantic Evidence Fusion for Explainable Log Anomaly Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.03599)
*Hassan Jabri,Zeyang Ma,Zhijie Wang,Tse-Hsun Chen*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: LogSemFuse是一个证据引导的即插即用框架，通过融合局部事件模式、LLM语义推理和聚类可执行规则，增强现有日志异常检测模型，同时输出异常标签和可解释的语义证据，在三个数据集上使非完美基线模型性能提升，恢复98.8%的假阴性，且推理开销稳定可控。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于模型的日志异常检测器虽然能提供异常信号，但仍会遗漏异常会话，且通常只输出分数或标签，缺乏异常背后的操作语义（operational semantics），无法解释为何某个会话被判定为异常。这种语义证据的缺失使得运维人员难以区分紧急故障和良性偏差，也无法将可疑会话追溯到具体操作行为。

Method: LogSemFuse是一种证据引导的即插即用框架，不替换原有检测管线，而是将主干检测器的预测结果与三类可复用语义证据相融合：1）局部事件模式（local event patterns）；2）基于LLM的语义推理（LLM-based semantic reasoning）；3）聚类衍生的可执行规则（cluster-derived executable rules），最终同时输出异常决策及其支持的语义证据。

Result: 在HDFS、BGL和Liberty数据集上，以DeepLog、LogAnomaly、LogBERT和NeuralLog为主干检测器进行实验。LogSemFuse提升了所有非完美基线的性能，保留了原本完美的检测结果，恢复了98.8%的主干检测器假阴性样本，人类偏好实验表明其产生的解释优于直接使用LLM生成的解释，且推理阶段开销适中且稳定。

Conclusion: 语义增强（semantic augmentation）可以在不引入过大运行时开销的前提下，有效提升日志异常检测的效果和可解释性，表明该方向具有实际应用价值。

Abstract: Log anomaly detection is critical for reliability monitoring and failure diagnosis in modern software systems. Existing model-based detectors provide useful anomaly signals, but they can still miss anomalous sessions and typically expose only scores or labels rather than the operational semantics behind a decision. This lack of semantic evidence limits their ability to explain why a session is anomalous, even when the final anomaly label is correct. The gap matters in practice because operators need to distinguish urgent failures from benign deviations and trace suspicious sessions back to concrete operational behavior. LLMs can recover richer log semantics, but using them as standalone detectors or repeatedly generating free-form explanations can be costly and difficult to reuse. We present LogSemFuse, an evidence-guided plug-in framework that enhances existing backbone detectors without replacing their original pipelines. LogSemFuse combines backbone predictions with reusable semantic evidence from local event patterns, LLM-based semantic reasoning, and cluster-derived executable rules to produce both anomaly decisions and evidence-based explanations. The resulting output reports the final label together with the semantic evidence that supports it, such as fired local patterns, triggered rules, and LLM rationale. We evaluate LogSemFuse on HDFS, BGL, and Liberty using DeepLog, LogAnomaly, LogBERT, and NeuralLog as backbones. LogSemFuse improves every non-perfect baseline, preserves the already perfect case, recovers 98.8% of backbone false negatives, and produces explanations preferred over direct LLM explanations in a human study. These gains require only modest and stable inference-time overhead, showing that semantic augmentation can improve detection effectiveness and interpretability without imposing large runtime costs.

</details>


### [147] [AutoCedar: An Agentic Framework for Verifier-Guided Access Control Policy Synthesis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.03656)
*Adarsh Vatsa,Sachi Shome,Yingming Zhou,William Eiers*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: AutoCedar是一个验证器引导的系统，它将自然语言访问控制需求转化为可审查的形式化目标，然后综合出Cedar策略。通过将策略编写分解为小型意图原子，并结合机械验证和人类意图审查，系统能在CedarBench基准的221个任务上全部收敛，并在医疗、教育、会议管理三个案例研究中将嘈杂的需求文本转化为经过审查和全局验证的策略库。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大语言模型将自然语言需求转化为代码时存在安全隐患：生成的策略虽能编译通过且读起来正确，但可能授予未经批准的权限。问题不仅在于编写策略代码，更在于在编写代码前明确需求含义，并检查最终策略是否满足该意图。

Method: AutoCedar将模式与策略编写分解为小型意图原子（关于词汇和行为的可审查声明），通过机械验证和人类意图审查后，由模型提出候选策略，验证器检查策略是否满足已批准的目标，每个失败转为修复信号（放宽、收窄或重构策略），形成端到端的闭环。

Result: 在CedarBench基准的221个授权任务上全部收敛。在医疗、教育、会议管理三个需求语料库案例研究中，将嘈杂的散文和提取的访问控制片段转化为经过审查的模式、形式化检查以及全局验证的Cedar策略库。

Conclusion: 通过将工作分解为小问题，每个问题基于已审查的意图并由验证器反馈支持，端到端的策略编写变得可行，有效解决了从自然语言到安全策略合成的可靠性问题。

Abstract: Large Language Models are increasingly used to turn natural-language requirements into code. In access control, that shortcut is dangerous: a generated policy can compile and read correctly while granting access that no one approved. The difficulty is not only writing policy code. It is fixing what the requirements mean before code is written, and then checking that the final policy actually satisfies that intent. We present AutoCedar, a verifier-guided system that first turns natural-language access-control requirements into a reviewed, checkable target, and then synthesizes Cedar policies against that target. AutoCedar decomposes schema and policy authoring into small intent atoms: reviewable claims about vocabulary and behavior. Once those atoms pass mechanical validation and human intent review, the model proposes a candidate policy, the verifier checks it against the approved target, and each failure is turned into a repair signal that tells the model whether to broaden, narrow, or restructure the policy without changing the target. Because the model's work is split into small problems, each grounded in reviewed intent and backed by verifier feedback, end-to-end policy authoring becomes tractable. AutoCedar converges on all 221 tasks of CedarBench, our benchmark of authorization tasks paired with executable semantic boundaries. Across three requirements-corpus case studies covering healthcare, education, and conference management, AutoCedar converts noisy prose and extracted access-control fragments into reviewed schemas, formal checks, and a globally verified Cedar policy store for each scenario.

</details>


### [148] [Don't Blame the Large Language Model: How Scaffolding Evolution Shapes Coding Agent Quality](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.03691)
*Oussama Ben Sghaier,Hao Li,Bram Adams,Ahmed E. Hassan*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文首次通过控制变量的纵向研究，固定底层LLM、仅改变脚手架层，评估了35个顺序发布的Qwen Code CLI版本对编码智能体质量和效率的影响，发现质量波动与具体开发模式和架构组件相关。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 编码智能体脚手架以极高速度迭代演进，但尚无研究考察这种演进如何影响智能体质量（有效性和效率）。实践者常将回归归因于底层模型而非脚手架本身，因此需要隔离脚手架贡献进行系统研究。

Method: 首先实证研究5个主流开源脚手架的开发和发布演进（Codex、Qwen Code、Gemini、OpenCode、OpenHands），然后对Qwen Code CLI的35个顺序版本进行受控深度评估，固定底层LLM，使用50个分层SWE-bench Verified任务，将质量波动追踪到具体开发模式和架构组件。

Result: 揭示了极端发布速度（每天超过2次发布，数月内数千个issue），发现质量波动与特定开发模式和架构组件存在可追溯的关联，并通过具体pull request链接到质量变化的定性证据。

Conclusion: 脚手架层的演进是智能体质量波动的重要来源，不应被忽视；研究者与实践者需关注脚手架设计的质量控制，而不仅仅是模型升级。

Abstract: Coding agents, autonomous systems that use large language models (LLMs) to resolve software engineering tasks, rely on agentic scaffolding: a middleware layer in between a developer and a large language model that orchestrates system prompts, tool execution, context management, and iterative reasoning loops. While these scaffoldings evolve at extreme velocities, no study has examined how this evolution affects agent quality (i.e., effectiveness and efficiency) over time. Practitioners regularly report quality regressions after scaffolding updates, yet consistently attribute them to the underlying model rather than the scaffolding itself. In this paper, we address this gap by conducting the first controlled longitudinal study that isolates the scaffolding's contribution. Unlike prior work that fixes the scaffolding and varies the model, we fix the model and vary only the scaffolding, evaluating 35 sequential releases to measure their impact on agent effectiveness and efficiency. We first empirically study the development and release evolution of five major open-source scaffoldings (i.e., Codex, Qwen Code, Gemini, OpenCode, and OpenHands), revealing extreme release velocities exceeding two releases per day and thousands of issues within months. We then perform a controlled deep dive into 35 sequential releases of the Qwen Code CLI, evaluating each against 50 stratified SWE-bench Verified tasks while holding the underlying LLM constant. We trace the resulting quality fluctuations to specific development patterns and architectural components, and illustrate our findings with concrete qualitative evidence linking individual pull requests to measured quality shifts.

</details>


### [149] [Fault Detection and Explainable Classification in Automotive HIL Validation via Denoising Autoencoders and In-Context Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.03734)
*Mohammad Abboush,Hamza Ouarrad,Andreas Rausch*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 提出了一种可泛化且可解释的两阶段框架，用于实时验证中的故障检测与分类。第一阶段使用仅训练于健康信号的去噪自编码器，通过重构误差分析检测异常；第二阶段将异常窗口编码为紧凑的统计文本证据，通过冻结的大语言模型在零样本和少样本提示下进行分类。在两种动力总成和三种驾驶模式下，检测器平均F1分数达0.97-0.98，少样本提示优于零样本，提示策略比参数数量更关键。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有汽车软件验证依赖人工审查和基于规则的评估，难以检测超出预定义规则的故障；监督学习模型需要大量标注数据、泛化能力差且缺乏可解释性。

Method: 两阶段框架：(1) 去噪自编码器（仅训练健康信号）通过重构误差分析检测异常；(2) 异常窗口编码为紧凑统计文本证据，由冻结的大语言模型在零样本/少样本提示下分类，返回预测类别、排名备选、置信度、故障位置和基于证据的解释。

Result: 检测器在两种动力总成上平均F1为0.97，三种驾驶模式下平均F1为0.98，平均误差低于0.03。零样本提示最佳F1为0.519，少样本提示在稳定条件下达到完美区分。9B参数模型超越所有零样本的中等和大型模型。最终选用Mistral Small 24B作为主流水线模型。

Conclusion: 所提框架无需故障标签即可实现高精度检测与分类，提示策略比模型参数量更决定分类质量，为工程师提供可解释的诊断报告，提升了验证效率。

Abstract: Validating automotive software systems produces large multivariate test recordings that are still examined through effort-intensive manual review and rule-based evaluation, which detects faults beyond predefined rules poorly. Machine and deep learning have advanced fault diagnosis, yet most supervised models require large labelled datasets, generalise poorly to unseen conditions, and offer little insight into their decisions. We propose a generalisable and explainable two-phase framework for fault detection and classification during real-time validation. A denoising autoencoder trained only on healthy signals first flags abnormal behaviour through reconstruction-error analysis, removing the need for fault labels.
