*Manfredi Napolitano,Alessandra Somma,Alessio Gambi,Andrea Stocco,Nicola Mazzocca*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文提出E-CoDrive框架，用于自动驾驶电动汽车（AEVs）在城市场景下的能量感知场景测试。该框架整合了能耗模型、微观交通模拟器和高保真驾驶模拟器，实现可复现的闭环驾驶协同仿真，评估交通动态对AEV能耗的影响。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有自动驾驶研究主要关注安全性，忽视了能耗和可持续性等非功能方面。随着自动驾驶电动汽车在城市场景日益普及，理解复杂交通动态对其能耗的影响对于验证车辆能否在电池耗尽前完成行程至关重要。

Method: E-CoDrive框架采用集成式架构，将能耗模型、微观交通模拟器（SUMO）和高保真驾驶模拟器（CARLA）相结合，实现可复现的闭环驾驶协同仿真，用于测试基于Autoware的AEV软件栈在城市场景中的表现。

Result: 实验评估表明，不同的交通条件会导致车辆能耗产生显著差异，验证了该框架在能量感知场景测试中的有效性。

Conclusion: E-CoDrive为自动驾驶电动汽车的能量感知场景测试提供了可行框架，填补了自动驾驶研究中能耗与可持续性评估的空白，工具有公开获取渠道。

Abstract: Autonomous driving research has largely focused on safety while giving limited attention to non-functional aspects such as energy consumption and sustainability. As Autonomous Electric Vehicles (AEVs) become increasingly common in urban traffic, understanding how complex traffic dynamics influence their energy consumption is paramount to test whether AEVs can complete trips before battery depletion. To support energy-aware scenario-based testing of AEVs, we present E-CoDrive, a framework for reproducible closed-loop driving co-simulations that integrates an energy consumption model, a micro-traffic simulator, and a high-fidelity driving simulator to test AEV software stacks in urban scenarios. This tool paper describes the architecture of E-CoDrive and demonstrates its applicability by testing an Autoware-based AEV stack. Our evaluation shows that varying traffic conditions produce substantial differences in vehicle energy consumption. The artifact is publicly available at https://doi.org/10.6084/m9.figshare.32244783, and a screencast showing the tool is available at https://youtu.be/yX9fWHqCvgc.

</details>


### [186] [Teaching LLMs a Low-Resource Language: Enhancing Code Completion in Pharo](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.04939)
*Kilian Kier,Alessandro Giagnorio,Omar AbedelKader,Oleksandr Zaitsev,Robert Peharz,Romain Robbes,Gabriele Bavota,Stéphane Ducasse*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文报告了将基于LLM的代码补全引入低资源语言Pharo的经验，通过端到端流水线（数据整理、持续预训练、微调）构建了Pharo专用模型，其性能显著超越原始基线和更大规模模型，且模型足够小以支持实时IDE内补全。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM在主流语言上表现优异，但低资源语言（如Pharo）因训练数据稀缺而缺乏高质量的代码补全工具，现有IDE仅支持单token补全，亟需改进。

Method: 构建了端到端流水线，包括Pharo特定数据整理、对开源代码LLM进行持续预训练和微调；同时设计了Pharo代码补全基准，评估模型对语法的学习和真实GitHub仓库中掩码代码的补全准确性。

Result: Pharo专用模型在补全准确性上大幅超越原始基线和更大规模代码LLM，且模型规模足够小，支持实时IDE内推理。

Conclusion: 该案例研究证明了将强LLM代码补全引入低资源编程语言的可行性，为类似语言社区提供了可复现的技术路径。

Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) unlocked new possibilities in automated code writing, becoming the backbone of most code completion tools. While LLMs excel in mainstream languages, they often lack support for the so-called low-resource languages where training data is scarce. As a result, these languages lag behind in the quality of code completion tooling available to their communities. A concrete example is Pharo, a Smalltalk-inspired language whose IDE currently offers only single-token completion. In this work, we report on our experience bringing LLM-based code completion to Pharo. First, we describe an end-to-end pipeline that combines Pharo-specific data curation, continued pre-training and fine-tuning of open code LLMs. Second, we introduce a set of Pharo code completion benchmarks designed to evaluate whether models (i) learn Pharo's syntax and (ii) accurately complete masked Pharo code from real-world GitHub repositories. Third, we show empirically that Pharo-specialized models substantially outperform their original base checkpoints and also exceed the accuracy of substantially larger code LLMs on Pharo completion. Overall, our case study demonstrates the feasibility of bringing strong LLM-based code completion to low-resource programming languages, with models small enough to provide ``real-time'' in-IDE support.

</details>


### [187] [Using Process Mining to Generate AI Agents from Software Engineering Process Records](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.04948)
*Saimir Bala,Fabiana Fournier,Lior Limonad,Andreas Metzger*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文提出一种结合面向对象、命令式和声明式流程挖掘的方法，从软件仓库事件日志中发现项目特定的AI智能体角色，并生成匹配的智能体规范与实现，以解决人机混合软件工程团队中智能体粒度和职责划分的难题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 将AI智能体集成到软件工程中面临一个关键挑战：如何确定合适粒度和职责划分的智能体，使其在混合人机团队中有效协作。粗粒度智能体会引入不可管理的复杂性，而微智能体则会造成严重的协调开销。现有多智能体SE框架通常依赖预定义角色结构，未能考虑项目特定特征或过程适应性。

Method: 结合面向对象、命令式和声明式三种流程挖掘方法，从软件仓库提取的事件日志出发，利用预定义的SE角色词汇表（基于仓库行为），发现项目特定的智能体角色，并生成匹配的智能体规范与实现代码。

Result: 在成熟的开源项目上进行了概念验证，通过了功能测试，并进行了探索性用户研究来评估生成的AI智能体规范与人类期望的匹配程度。

Conclusion: 所提出的方法能够从项目仓库行为中自动发现合适的智能体角色并生成规范与实现，有助于AI智能体在混合SE团队中更有效地与人类协作。

Abstract: Integrating AI agents into Software Engineering (SE) raises an important challenge: how can we specify and realize AI agents that work effectively alongside humans in hybrid SE teams? Determining the right granularity and separation of concerns for such agents is non-trivial. Coarse-grained agents may introduce unmanageable complexity, whereas micro-agents may create severe coordination overhead. Moreover, existing multi-agent SE frameworks typically rely on predefined role structures and do not account for project-specific characteristics or process adaptations. We address this by combining object-centric, imperative, and declarative process mining. Using event logs extracted from software repositories, our approach discovers project-specific agent roles using a predefined SE role vocabulary grounded in repository behavior and generates matching agent specifications and implementations. As proof-of-concept, we applied our approach to a well-established open-source project. We performed functional tests and an exploratory user study to determine how well the generated AI agent specifications are aligned with human expectations.

</details>


### [188] [Real-World Perturbation Testing of Autonomous Driving Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.04953)
*Stefano Carlo Lambertenghi,Matthias Weil,Andrea Stocco*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文通过大规模实验（72种传感器扰动、三种测试模态）系统性地揭示了自动驾驶系统在不同测试层级（离线模型、硬件在环、封闭实车）之间鲁棒性评估存在显著差距，证明模型级指标不足以预测真实世界中的系统级故障，强调实车闭环评估的必要性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有自动驾驶鲁棒性测试主要基于离线数据集或仿真环境，缺乏将扰动测试结果与真实世界驾驶行为进行系统对照的研究，无法回答离线评估结果能否有效迁移到实际驾驶场景这一关键问题。

Method: 对72种相机和LiDAR扰动，在三个测试层级上评估：（1）离线模型级分析；（2）硬件在环执行；（3）全尺寸自动驾驶车辆的闭环系统级测试。覆盖端到端视觉驾驶模型和模块化LiDAR感知规划栈两种架构。

Result: 离线影响小的相机扰动仍可导致实车控制不稳定；LiDAR感知级退化与系统级故障弱相关；模型级指标不足以识别最有害扰动；实时可行性是实车测试的关键约束；基于记录数据的鲁棒性观察无法一致迁移到物理车辆的闭环行为。

Conclusion: 自动驾驶鲁棒性评估必须结合实车、系统级的闭环测试，仅依赖模型级或离线数据评估结果是不可靠的，互补的多层级评估框架对于安全验证至关重要。

Abstract: Autonomous Driving Systems (ADS) must operate reliably under diverse conditions, yet representative data for rare or adverse scenarios is difficult to obtain. Perturbation-based testing is widely used to assess robustness, but most studies focus on offline datasets or simulation, leaving open questions about how such results translate to real-world driving. We present a large-scale study of 72 camera and LiDAR perturbations, evaluated across three testing modalities: offline model-level analysis, hardware-in-the-loop execution, and closed-loop system-level testing on a full-scale autonomous vehicle. The study covers both an end-to-end vision-based driving model and a modular LiDAR-based perception and planning stack. Our results reveal a clear gap between testing levels. For camera-based systems, perturbations with limited offline impact can still induce unstable control and failures in real-world driving. For LiDAR-based systems, degradation is more consistent at the perception level but weakly predictive of system-level failures. Across both modalities, model-level metrics alone are insufficient to identify the most harmful perturbations. We further show that real-time feasibility is a key constraint in real-world testing, and that robustness observations obtained from recorded data do not consistently transfer to closed-loop behavior on a physical vehicle, highlighting the importance of complementary real-world, system-level evaluation.

</details>


### [189] [A Comprehensive Study of Implementation Bugs in Multi-modal Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.04974)
*Suwan Li,Lei Bu,Shangqing Liu,Yile Wang,Guangdong Bai,Fuman Xie,Kai Chen,Chang Yue*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文首次系统研究了多模态智能体（M-agent）的实现缺陷。通过收集34个代表性M-agent并筛选1268个问题报告，最终识别158个M-agent特有缺陷。研究构建了包含全局症状、功能组件症状和根本原因的三层分类体系，并开发了自动化缺陷识别工具MATester。在额外12个M-agent上测试，MATester覆盖了61.4%已知开放问题并发现31个新缺陷。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多模态智能体在实际部署中存在感知过时、规划不可信、执行不可用等独特问题，可能导致交通事故和财务损失。尽管已有对传统智能体问题的研究，但缺乏对M-agent特有实现缺陷的系统性研究。

Method: 收集34个多源M-agent，通过细致筛选从1268个问题报告中识别出158个M-agent特有缺陷。采用自顶向下策略，构建了包含全局症状、功能组件级别症状和根本原因的综合分类体系。开发了MATester自动化缺陷识别工具，通过分析运行时组件间输出来检测缺陷。

Result: 在额外12个M-agent上测试，MATester成功覆盖了61.4%的已知开放问题，并发现了31个额外缺陷，验证了研究的实用价值。

Conclusion: 本研究为M-agent缺陷的分类、预防和修复提供了全面的参考和指南，填补了该领域系统研究的空白。

Abstract: Multi-Modal Agents (M-agents), empowered by Large Language Models (LLMs), excel in various complex, open-world scenarios such as autonomous driving and robotics. However, their unique requirements to interact with dynamic and diverse multi-modal environments introduce novel implementation challenges beyond those faced by traditional agents. Outdated perception, untrustworthy planning and inapplicable execution could cause traffic accident and financial loss. Despite growing study on agent issues, there has not been a systematic study focusing on M-agent-specific implementation bugs. To address this gap, we conducted the first systematic study of implementation bugs in M-agents. We collected 34 representative M-agents from diverse sources and, through meticulous filtering,identified 158 M-agent-specific bugs from 1,268 issue reports. Using a top-down strategy, we developed a comprehensive taxonomy that classifies bugs by global symptoms, functionality component-level symptoms, and root causes. We then implemented MATester, an automatic proof-of-concept bug identifier by analyzing runtime inter-component outputs. When applied to 12 extra M-agents, MATester successfully covered 61.4% of known open issues and discovered 31 additional bugs, demonstrating the practical usefulness of our study. Our work provides a comprehensive reference and guideline for classification, prevention and fix of M-agent bugs.

</details>


### [190] [LLM-Based Test Oracles: Source-of-Authority Taxonomy -- A Systematic Literature Review](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.05031)
*Ali Hassaan Mughal,Muhammad Bilal*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文通过系统文献综述（PRISMA 2020指南），从54篇纳入研究中分析了LLM生成测试Oracle的权威来源，发现规范派生权威仅覆盖约半数研究（28/54），其余26篇在无规范情况下作出裁决；提出了基于权威来源、表现形式和裁决机制的三轴分析框架，并指出权威来源与裁决机制相互交叉，LLM-as-a-judge等标签仅描述机制而非信任基础。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有研究缺乏对LLM测试Oracle权威来源（即裁决可信度的基础属性）的系统性分析，先前的二次研究仅按Oracle形式或LLM技术组织，未涉及权威来源这一根本性问题。

Method: 遵循PRISMA 2020指南进行系统文献综述：从2,436条记录出发，经LLM预过滤、独立双人人工筛选（Cohen's kappa=0.79）和全文评估，最终纳入54篇研究；沿权威来源、表现形式和裁决机制三个维度进行分析。

Result: 规范派生权威是最大单一权威来源，但仅覆盖约半数研究（28/54）；其余26篇在无任何规范的情况下作出裁决。权威来源与裁决机制存在交叉关系：同一来源可由多种机制检查，同一机制也可服务多种来源。文章还报告了Oracle的评估方式和失败模式。

Conclusion: 领域缺乏对Oracle权威来源的清晰理解；LLM-as-a-judge等常见标签实为机制描述而非信任基础；文中识别的稀疏和空白区域可作为未来研究方向。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used to produce test oracles, the part of a test that decides whether observed behavior is correct. Yet a clear account of where these oracles draw their authority is missing. Prior secondary studies organize the area by oracle form or by LLM technique. None organizes it by the source of the verdict's authority, the property that governs how far a verdict can be trusted. This article presents a systematic literature review, conducted and reported under the PRISMA 2020 guidelines. From 2,436 records, an LLM pre-filter followed by independent dual human screening (reviewer agreement, a Cohen's kappa of 0.79) and full-text assessment yielded 54 included studies. We analyze these along three axes: the source of an oracle's authority, the form it takes, and the mechanism that adjudicates it. We characterize the landscape of domains, languages, models, and adaptation strategies. Specification-derived authority, though the most common single source, covers about half of the studies (28 of 54). The remaining 26 reach a verdict with no specification at all. The source of authority and the adjudication mechanism cross-cut: the same source is checked by several mechanisms and one mechanism serves several sources, so a label such as LLM-as-a-judge names a mechanism rather than a basis for trust. We further report how these oracles are evaluated and how they fail, and read the sparse and empty regions of the taxonomy as a research agenda. The protocol, search query, and per-study coding sheet are released as supplementary material.

</details>


### [191] [When AI Is Wrong on Purpose: How Students Respond to Buggy GenAI Code](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.05068)
*Victor-Alexandru Pădurean,Kaitlin Riegel,Alkis Gotovos,Jyotika Mahapatra,Ahana Ghosh,Paul Denny,Juho Leinonen,James Prather,Adish Singla*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 通过向GenAI生成的正确代码中注入现实可运行漏洞，促使CS1学生在审核和修复中练习调试与提示词优化，研究发现注入漏洞更易引发直接代码编辑，而提示相关失败则促使学生完善提示词描述。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: GenAI在CS教育中日益普及，但学生在使用自然语言提示生成代码时缺乏对输出仔细审核和验证的动机，因为当前模型在CS1级别任务中往往能正确生成代码，削弱了学生审查代码的积极性。因此，需要设计能培养学生代码审查与修复习惯的教学活动。

Method: 采用现实、可运行的漏洞注入方法，将有意制造的bug插入原本正确的GenAI生成代码中。分析来自917名学生的2,636个编程会话，对比自然发生的提示相关失败（prompt-related failures）与人为注入漏洞（injected bugs）两种情况下学生的学习行为差异。

Result: 注入漏洞更常导致学生直接编辑代码并在下一次尝试中获得更高成功率，表现为对近似正确代码的局部修复。提示相关失败则更多促使学生通过澄清约束、更新函数签名、添加边界条件或重新阐述任务来完善提示词。学生反思中强调了代码理解、代码审查和调试方面的有益实践，以及更谨慎的验证心态和对GenAI局限性的更高认识。

Conclusion: 提示相关失败和注入漏洞共同支持了一种教学上有用的GenAI工作流：学生既能通过提示词练习规格精炼，又能通过代码编辑练习调试技能。这种混合设计有效培养了学生审慎验证的思维习惯。

Abstract: As Generative AI (GenAI) becomes increasingly central to software development, CS education is integrating prompt-centered workflows where students describe intended program behavior in natural language to elicit code. However, professional practice requires careful review and verification of GenAI-generated code that may appear correct while containing subtle faults. This creates a challenge for CS1-level activities, where current models often solve tasks correctly and reduce students' incentive to closely inspect generated outputs. We investigate how prompt-centered programming activities can be adapted to better foster these practices. Specifically, we explore an approach where realistic, runnable bugs are injected into otherwise correct solutions, thus requiring students to read and repair generated outputs. We analyzed 2,636 sessions from 917 students, and examined behavior across instances of naturally occurring prompt-related failures and deliberately injected bugs within each session. Our findings show that students responded differently across bug sources. Deliberately injected bugs more often led to direct code edits and higher next-attempt success, suggesting localized repair of near-miss solutions. Prompt-related failures instead more often led students to refine prompts by clarifying constraints, updating function signatures, adding edge cases, or reframing the task. Student reflections reinforce the emphasis on review and repair, describing useful practice in code understanding, code review, and debugging, as well as a more careful verification mindset and greater awareness of GenAI limitations. Ultimately, prompt-related failures and injected bugs together support a pedagogically useful GenAI workflow, where students practice both specification refinement through prompts and debugging through code editing.

</details>


### [192] [Can Code Specify a System Precisely Enough to Formally Verify It?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.05076)
*Jean-Jacques Dubray*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文对生产级餐厅POS系统的支付工作流进行形式化验证，发现核心协议在明确故障模型下正确，但审计暴露出7个故障处理漏洞（3个可复现），并通过系统化故障模型扩展和LLM规范生成实验，验证了合同结构而非语言决定LLM规范可靠性的结论。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 形式化验证很少应用于生产软件，因为编写和维护模型的成本通常高于收益。本文旨在探索一种低成本替代方案——通过从运行系统捕获的迹线对规范进行分级评估，并验证LLM编写规范时的可靠性决定因素。

Method: 1. 对生产级餐厅POS系统的支付工作流进行形式化验证，构建手写、行引用的模型并进行故障注入测试；2. 系统化扩展故障模型（崩溃重启、脏读、两次重试）；3. 对生产支付沙箱进行单次探测；4. 使用七个来自两家供应商的模型验证合同结构与语言对LLM规范可靠性的影响。

Result: 1. 核心协议在明确故障模型下正确，审计发现7个故障处理漏洞，其中3个可复现为真实执行，补丁修复后在所有故障门开启下重新检查又暴露出一个新缺陷；2. 生产支付沙箱探测暴露了响应形状差异导致整个恢复阶梯不可达，仿真器无法检测到（相关预言机故障）；3. 合同结构而非语言决定LLM规范可靠性，仅最强模型达到语料天花板，更困难的任务恢复了基准测试的区分能力。

Conclusion: 本文验证了合同结构是LLM编写规范可靠性的关键因素而非语言，同时揭示了生产系统形式化验证中真实API与仿真器之间的差异可能导致关键故障无法被检测（相关预言机故障），为生产软件的低成本形式化验证提供了实践依据。

Abstract: Formal verification is seldom applied to production software, because writing and maintaining a model has historically cost more than it returns. A companion study [1] extended SysMoBench [4] with a lower-cost alternative: specifications are graded against traces captured from the running system. It found that when large language models write the specifications, reliability is governed by the structure of the specification contract, not the language. This paper evaluates both on production software: the payment workflow of an operational restaurant point-of-sale system, which must keep the register, payment terminal, and payment processor in agreement. We report three results. First, the core protocol is correct relative to a hand-built, line-cited model under a precisely stated failure model. The audit found seven failure-handling gaps, nearly all with a common root cause; three were reproduced as real executions, and a patch closing them was re-checked with all failure gates enabled, after which a follow-up patch closed a defect the re-check itself exposed. Systematic extensions of the failure model (crash-restart, stale reads, two attempts) each found the windows they were designed to probe. Second, a single probe of the production payment sandbox exposed a response-shape divergence that makes an entire recovery ladder unreachable against the live API. The emulator-based audit could not detect it, because code and emulator share the same misreading: a correlated-oracle failure. Third, the companion study's central finding replicates across seven models from two vendors: contract structure, not language, governs what LLMs specify reliably. The replication concerns the ordering of contracts and the failure taxonomy, not the absolute level: only the strongest models reached the corpus ceiling, and the harder task restores discriminating power the benchmark had lost.

</details>


### [193] [RepoTrace: Browser-Assisted Evidence Collection for GitHub Research Datasets](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.05106)
*Xue Yao,Zehua Zhang,Jiatong Liu,Yongqiang Tian*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: RepoTrace 是一个浏览器辅助研究工具，通过 Chrome 侧面板扩展、Express 后端和 React 仪表盘，将 GitHub issue 和 PR 的证据收集到本地 SQLite 工作区，解决手动数据收集过程中 provenance、更新追踪和多评审标签难以审计的问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有手动从 GitHub issues 和 PR 构建数据集的工作流程中，页面证据、研究代码和决策理由分散在不同标签页和文件中，导致来源追踪（provenance）、更新跟踪和多评审者标注难以审计。

Method: RepoTrace 结合 Chrome 侧面板扩展、Express 后端和 React 仪表盘，将页面快照、评论、标签、笔记、筛选和标注决策、刷新历史和限定导出整合到本地 SQLite 工作区，保持源证据与研究解释的关联。

Result: 在 Matplotlib 的 20 个 issue 上验证，生成了 22 个快照、38 条评论、20 条研究笔记、98 个标注、20 个筛选评审、20 条修复证据条目和 4 个模拟未解决共识冲突。

Conclusion: RepoTrace 能够支持手动构建 GitHub issue 和 PR 数据集的完整本地证据收集工作流。

Abstract: Empirical software engineering studies frequently build datasets from GitHub issues and pull requests. In many projects, researchers inspect pages in a browser, copy selected fields into spreadsheets, keep side notes in separate documents, and later run scripts to normalize or export the data. This workflow is flexible, but the page evidence, the research codes, and the rationale behind each decision end up spread across tabs and files, which leaves provenance, update tracking, and multi-reviewer labeling hard to audit.
  RepoTrace is a browser-assisted research tool that collects GitHub issue and pull-request evidence into a local SQLite-backed workspace. It combines a Chrome side-panel extension, an Express backend, and a React dashboard to capture page snapshots, comments, labels, notes, screening and labeling decisions, refresh history, and scoped exports, keeping the source evidence and the research interpretation linked together.
  A validation pass collected and checked 20 Matplotlib issues across two study projects. The resulting dataset preserves 22 snapshots, 38 comments, 20 research notes, 98 annotations, 20 screening reviews, 20 fix-evidence entries, and 4 simulated unresolved consensus conflicts. The results show that RepoTrace can support a complete local evidence-collection workflow for manually constructed GitHub issue and pull-request datasets.

</details>


### [194] [From Failing to Passing: Evolving Natural Language Prompt Optimization Rules for LLM Code Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.05121)
*Amal Akli,Melissa Akli,Cedric Richter,Mike Papadakis,Yves Le Traon*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文提出DUALFIX，一种结合搜索优化的自然语言变换规则与执行反馈修复的两阶段流水线，用于修复大语言模型在代码生成中的失败案例。该方法在LiveCodeBench和APPS基准上，相比基线方法修复了10-30%的失败案例，其中12-17%是纯执行反馈修复无法解决的，且学到的规则可跨模型零样本迁移。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大语言模型对提示词表述高度敏感，微小的措辞变化会导致性能显著下降。这种敏感性揭示了潜在机会：如果提示措辞会损害性能，那么是否可以利用它来提升性能？本文旨在探索利用自然语言变换规则的系统性搜索来改善模型输出的代码质量。

Method: 提出DUALFIX两阶段修复流水线：1) 搜索阶段：对一组自然语言变换规则进行搜索和演化，这些规则具有强大的下游编码效果，且与具体错误无关；2) 修复阶段：将演化后的变换规则与执行反馈修复相结合，同时处理规约级别和实现级别的失败。规则具有错误无关性、跨问题可重用性和跨模型可迁移性。

Result: 在LiveCodeBench和APPS两个基准上，针对三个模型评估。演化变换修复了10-30%的失败案例，其中12-17%是纯执行反馈修复无法解决的。DUALFIX整体恢复高达30%的基线失败，修复数量是Self-Fix的3-5倍。演化出的规则可零样本迁移到其他模型，且无需重新优化即可优于执行反馈修复。

Conclusion: 提示变换规则的系统性搜索和演化能有效提升代码生成质量，且DUALFIX的两阶段策略能互补性地解决规约和实现层面的失败。规则的错误无关性和跨模型迁移性表明该方法具有良好的通用性和实用性。

Abstract: Large language models are known to be sensitive to prompt formulation. Even minor variations in wording can substantially degrade performance. This sensitivity reveals an opportunity: if prompt phrasing can harm performance, can it be used to improve it? To investigate this question, we introduce a search-based approach that identifies and evolves a set of natural language transformation rules with strong downstream effects on coding performance. We then propose DUALFIX, a staged repair pipeline that combines the evolved transformation rules with execution-feedback repair, addressing both specification-level and implementation-level failures. A key strength of our approach lies in its generality: the evolved rules are error-agnostic, reusable across problems, and transferable across models. We evaluate DUALFIX against execution-feedback repair baselines across three models on two challenging benchmarks, LiveCodeBench and APPS. Our results show that the evolved transformations fix from 10-30% of failing cases, including 12-17% of failures that execution-based repair alone cannot resolve. Overall, DualFix recovers up to 30% of baseline failures and fixes 3-5 times more failing cases than Self-Fix across all evaluated settings. Furthermore, we also show that rules evolved on one model transfer zero-shot to other models, outperforming execution-feedback repair without any re-optimization.

</details>


### [195] [Three-Phase Evaluation of AI-Assisted Software Development Life Cycle](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.05125)
*Joshua Strubel,Professor Carrie Russell,Carson Crockett,Jason Ferraro,Nathan Londhe,Uzayr Syed,Jacob Viehe*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文通过四名开发者分三阶段（部分AI辅助、GitHub Copilot独占、AWS Kiro独占）重写同一全栈应用，评估了AI自主性提升对开发效率、需求符合度和认知负荷的影响。结果显示：更高AI自主性减少了开发工时、提高了需求符合度、降低了主观心智负荷，但开发者挫败感略有上升。AWS Kiro阶段在多数维度表现最佳，提示工具架构可能独立于AI自主性水平影响结果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有研究缺乏对AI自主性不同层次（从辅助到独占）对软件开发全流程影响的系统性量化评估，特别是在多工具、多阶段下的横向比较。

Method: 四位开发者以三阶段顺序（部分AI辅助→GitHub Copilot独占→AWS Kiro独占）重写同一全栈应用，采集开发工时、需求符合度（RITM评分）、AI交互效率及NASA-TLX工作负荷量表数据。

Result: AI自主性提高与开发工时减少、需求符合度提升、主观心智负荷降低正相关；开发者挫败感小幅上升。AWS Kiro阶段在多数指标上优于其他两阶段。

Conclusion: 更高AI自主性整体有利于开发效率和需求质量，但工具架构本身（而非仅是自主性等级）也是重要影响因素；挫败感上升提示人机协作体验仍需优化。

Abstract: This paper presents an exploratory evaluation of how increasing levels of AI autonomy affect software development productivity, requirement adherence, and developer cognitive workload. A team of four developers reimplemented the same full-stack web application across three sequential phases: partial AI-assisted development using GitHub Copilot, an AI-exclusive workflow using GitHub Copilot, and an AI-exclusive workflow using AWS Kiro. Evaluation metrics included development effort (hours), requirement adherence (RITM score), AI-interaction efficiency, and NASA-TLX workload measures. Across phases, higher levels of AI autonomy were associated with reduced development effort, improved requirement adherence, and lower self-reported mental workload, while developer frustration increased modestly. The AWS Kiro phase achieved the strongest overall performance on most measured dimensions, suggesting that tooling architecture may influence outcomes independently of AI autonomy level.

</details>


### [196] [On the risk of coding before testing: An empirical study on LLM-based test generation workflow](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.05139)
*Michael Konstantinou,Florian Tambon,Mike Papadakis*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文研究了LLM在生成代码后生成测试时，错误会从代码传播到测试中，导致错误实现与测试相互一致（即“虚假一致性”），从而掩盖缺陷。实验表明，先有错误代码再生成测试时，缺陷检测率从25%降至14%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有软件开发工作流（如测试优先和智能体工作流）假设LLM生成的测试是独立且可靠的预言（oracle），但这种假设可能不成立——因为生成代码和生成测试使用的是同一个模型，测试可能受代码偏差影响而失去独立性。

Method: 定义并实证研究“错误传播”现象：评估多种编程任务和智能体工作流下，代码生成与测试断言之间的一致性，特别关注“对齐失败”（aligned failures）场景。研究了三种情况：(i)错误代码是否偏差测试生成；(ii)不同提示策略（包括CoT）下偏差是否持续；(iii)多步工作流中错误如何通过上下文复用传播。

Result: 错误传播普遍且影响显著：在错误代码后生成测试，缺陷检测有效率为14%，而独立生成测试为25%。这意味着耦合的生成管线会系统性降低测试质量。

Conclusion: 当前LLM工作流中生成工件之间缺乏独立性，这破坏了自动化测试的可靠性。同时，依赖耦合生成管线的实证研究面临一种此前未被充分探索的有效性威胁。

Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly used in software engineering workflows to generate both source code and test suites. This dual capability has enabled emerging development paradigms, including test-first and agentic workflows, where a single model is producing and validating implementations. However, these approaches assume that generated tests act as independent and reliable oracles - a fundamental requirement for effective software testing. In this paper, we challenge this assumption and investigate whether LLM-generated code biases the generation of subsequent tests. We introduce and empirically study the phenomenon of error propagation, where faults in generated code are systematically replicated in associated test artifacts. This leads to cases where incorrect implementations and tests are mutually consistent, masking defects rather than revealing them. We evaluate this effect across a range of programming tasks and agentic workflows, analyzing the consistency between generated code and test assertions, with particular focus on scenarios of aligned failures. Our study examines (i) whether erroneous code artifacts bias test generation, (ii) whether such bias persists under different prompting strategies, including chain-of-thought reasoning, and (iii) how errors propagate across multi-step workflows in which intermediate outputs are reused as context. The results show that error propagation is prevalent and impactful: generating tests after faulty code significantly reduces fault detection effectiveness compared to generating tests independently (14% vs. 25%). These findings highlight a fundamental limitation of current workflows, where lack of independence between generated artifacts undermines the reliability of automated testing. Furthermore, our results expose a previously underexplored threat to validity in empirical studies relying on coupled generation pipelines.

</details>


### [197] [Intent-Based Mutation Testing: From Naturally Written Programming Intents to Mutants](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.05149)
*Asma Hamidi,Ahmed Khanfir,Mike Papadakis*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文提出基于意图的变异测试方法，通过大型语言模型（LLMs）修改程序中的编程意图来生成突变体，而非传统的语法级修改。实验表明，该方法能生成语法复杂、语义多样且与传统突变不同的变异，其中55%的意图突变不被传统突变所包含，可作为传统变异测试的有效补充。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统变异测试仅对程序语法层面进行修改，生成的突变体无法有效捕捉与程序规范/意图相关的错误类型，且变异多样性不足。作者希望探索一种更高层次（意图层面）的变异方式，以覆盖传统方法无法检测的故障类别。

Method: 利用LLMs对程序中的编程意图进行变异（而非对代码语法进行变异），生成实现不同意图的突变体。这些意图变异代表可能的边界情况和行为误解，从而生成与原始意图接近但行为不同的测试用例。

Result: 在29个程序上的实验表明：（1）意图变异生成的突变体语法复杂、语义多样；（2）与变异在语义上与传统变异有显著差异；（3）55%的意图变异不被传统变异所包含。

Conclusion: 基于意图的变异测试能够有效补充传统语法级变异测试，扩展了测试覆盖的故障类型范围。

Abstract: This paper presents intent-based mutation testing, a testing approach that generates mutations by changing the programming intents that are implemented in the programs under test. In contrast to traditional mutation testing, which changes (mutates) the way programs are written, intent mutation changes (mutates) the behavior of the programs by producing mutations that implement (slightly) different intents than those implemented in the original program. The mutations of the programming intents represent possible corner cases and misunderstandings of the program behavior, i.e., program specifications, and thus can capture different classes of faults than traditional (syntax-based) mutation. Moreover, since programming intents can be implemented in different ways, intent-based mutation testing can generate diverse and complex mutations that are close to the original programming intents (specifications) and thus direct testing towards the intent variants of the program behavior/specifications. We implement intent-based mutation testing using Large Language Models (LLMs) that mutate programming intents and transform them into mutants. We evaluate intent-based mutation on 29 programs and show that it generates mutations that are syntactically complex, semantically diverse, and quite different (semantically) from the traditional ones. We also show that 55% of the intent-based mutations are not subsumed by traditional mutations. Overall, our analysis shows that intent-based mutation testing can be a powerful complement to traditional (syntax-based) mutation testing.

</details>


### [198] [Is Three the Magic Number? An Empirical Evaluation of LLM-Based Repair Loops](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.05197)
*Tobias Kiecker,Eik Reichmann,Hosung Kang,Gabin An,Lars Grunske*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文研究了LLM软件工程系统中修复循环的迭代次数限制对效果的影响，发现前三到四次修复迭代贡献了大部分收益，后续迭代改进甚微；修复行为更多受工作流编排和反馈设计影响而非底层模型；建议将修复预算作为显式实验变量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 修复循环是LLM软件工程系统的核心设计模式，但现有工作大多采用固定且随意的修复预算，迭代次数限制对效果的影响未被充分理解。

Method: 在代码生成、测试生成、代码翻译等多个软件工程任务上，使用代表性工作流、数据集和当代低成本LLM，系统性地研究修复循环的迭代次数对效果的影响模式。

Result: 观察到一致的收益递减模式：前三到四次修复迭代贡献了大部分可实现的收益，后续迭代仅带来边际改进；修复行为受工作流编排和反馈设计的影响比底层模型更强。

Conclusion: 修复预算应被视为显式实验变量，因为它直接影响评估结果、计算成本、运行时和可重复性。

Abstract: Iterative repair loops have become a core design pattern in LLM-based software engineering systems. These workflows repeatedly generate, validate, and repair artifacts using feedback such as compiler errors or test failures. Despite their widespread use, the impact of repair-loop iteration limits remains poorly understood, as most prior work adopts fixed, often arbitrary, repair budgets. We study repair-loop effectiveness across multiple software engineering tasks, including code generation, test generation, and code translation. Across several representative workflows, datasets, and contemporary low-cost LLMs, we observe a consistent pattern of diminishing returns: the first three to four repair iterations account for most achievable gains, while later iterations contribute only marginal improvements. We further find that repair behavior is influenced more strongly by workflow orchestration and feedback design than by the underlying model itself. These results suggest that repair budgets should be treated as an explicit experimental variable, as they directly affect evaluation outcomes, computational cost, runtime, and reproducibility in LLM-based software engineering research.

</details>


### [199] [An Investigation of the AUTOSAR Adaptive Platform from an Industry Perspective](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.05227)
*Bengt Haraldsson,Srijita Basu,Miroslaw Staron,Erika Mayer*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文通过设计科学研究方法，开发最小化AUTOSAR Adaptive Platform（AP）原型，发现开发AUTOSAR Adaptive应用时的痛点源于平台规范本身、供应商实现和本地使用实践三方面的综合作用。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 汽车行业对软件的依赖日益增加，AUTOSAR Adaptive Platform作为标准化平台规范旨在实现复用，但其实际开发中的痛点来源尚不明确，需要系统性地探究其根源。

Method: 采用设计科学研究（Design Science Research）方法，开发一个最小化AP作为实验原型，通过实际构建和测试来识别痛点。

Result: 痛点由规范固有因素、实现基础因素和本地实践因素三方面共同导致，而非单一来源。

Conclusion: AUTOSAR规范本身的架构选择和复用目标存在固有痛点，开发组织需要通过改进工具（如配置文件管理和减少培训时间）来缓解这些负面影响。

Abstract: The reliance on software as a distinguishing factor in the automotive industry is increasing. With a combined reliance on vendor-supplied software and cost-effective implementation, the AUTOSAR consortium was initialized to provide standardized platform specifications that enable re-use. Specifically, the AUTOSAR Adaptive Platform (AP) specification aims to provide a high-performance service-oriented architecture.
  Objective: The goal of this study is to investigate what pain-points emerge when developing AUTOSAR Adaptive applications and whether they originate from the platform specification, its vendor-implementation, or its local usage. Methods: We conduct a Design Science Research study, developing a minimal AP that serves as an experimental prototype for our investigation.
  Results: We find that a combination of specification-inherent, implementation-based, and local practices contributes to the emergence of pain-points.
  Conclusions: We conclude that there are AUTOSAR specification-inherent reasons for pain-points, resulting from architectural choices and re-use goals. The implication for development organizations is the need to mitigate these effects through tooling that better supports configuration file management and reduces developer training time to properly understand the adaptive application runtime life-cycle.

</details>


<div id='cs.IR'></div>

# cs.IR [[Back]](#toc)

### [200] [Long-Term Optimization for Large-Scale Generative Retrieval with Off-Policy REINFORCE](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.02818)
*Artem Matveev,Sergei Makeev,Aleksei Krasilnikov,Vladimir Baikalov,Sergei Liamaev,Kirill Khrylchenko*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于自回归强化学习（REINFORCE）的生成式检索方法，用于优化推荐系统中的长期用户满意度。通过在预收集数据上进行多步重要性权重修正、训练用户反馈模型实现离策略评估，并引入基于反馈模型的测试时缩放策略，在Yambda-5B数据集上验证了该方法在累计会话奖励和检索质量上的优势。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统的生成式检索方法使用有监督的下一项预测目标进行训练，无法直接优化长期用户满意度。现有工作仅进行单步离策略修正，缺乏对序列决策问题的多步处理能力。

Method: 1) 将会话级推荐建模为序列决策问题，使用自回归生成检索器；2) 采用off-policy REINFORCE进行训练，并提出基于自回归形式的多步重要性权重近似；3) 训练用户反馈模型模拟用户响应，支持离线评估；4) 引入doubly robust off-policy evaluation用于序列决策推荐；5) 提出基于反馈模型的测试时缩放（test-time scaling），模拟未来响应以选择高长期回报的推荐。

Result: 在Yambda-5B数据集上，RL agent在离线评估的累计会话奖励上优于下一项预测和下一正样本预测基线，同时基本保持检索质量。增加推理时的计算量（模拟更多未来响应）可在不更新策略的情况下提升模型预测的长期回报。

Conclusion: 自回归强化学习框架能有效优化生成式检索中的长期用户满意度，多步重要性权重和测试时缩放策略均带来了显著收益。

Abstract: Generative retrieval has become a popular paradigm for large-scale recommendation. However, it is typically trained with supervised next-item prediction objectives that do not directly optimize long-term user satisfaction.
  In this work, we formulate recommendation as a session-level sequential decision-making problem and introduce an autoregressive approach for training generative retrievers with off-policy REINFORCE on pre-collected data. Unlike the one-step off-policy correction used in prior work, we propose a multi-step approximation of importance weights enabled by the autoregressive formulation. To support offline evaluation, we train a user feedback model that simulates user responses to generated recommendations. This lets us adapt doubly robust off-policy evaluation for sequential decision-making to recommendation, a setting that has received limited attention. We further introduce a feedback-model-based test-time scaling procedure that simulates future responses and selects recommendations with the highest predicted long-term returns.
  Experiments on the public large-scale Yambda-5B dataset show that our RL agent improves offline estimates of cumulative session reward over next-item and next-positive prediction baselines, while largely preserving retrieval quality. Moreover, allocating more inference-time compute to simulating future responses improves model-based long-term return estimates without updating the policy.

</details>


### [201] [HETERQA: Benchmarking Record Retrieval over Multiple Heterogeneous Sources](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.03028)
*Yaodong Su,Hanchang Li,Quanqing Xu,Chuanhui Yang,Yixiang Fang*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: HETERQA是一个包含857个QA对、覆盖五种异构数据源（Yelp商户记录）的记录检索基准，采用答案驱动方式构建，通过混合检索、Self-RAG等方法评估，结果显示现有方法远未饱和，为异构源记录检索提供了有效测试平台。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有检索基准大多基于单一数据源构建，少数考虑了两到三种源，但现实场景中数据记录往往来自异构源（关系表、文本、图像、空间数据库、知识图谱等），缺乏覆盖多种异构源的综合性基准来评估QA任务中的记录检索能力。

Method: 采用答案驱动方式构建基准：先用记录字段约束初始化候选记录，再通过异构源丰富记录信息，最后在保留自然语言问题前跨所需源交叉验证。基于Yelp商户记录，每个记录由多种源支撑。通过矛盾检测和人工验证确保质量。

Result: 稀疏、密集、混合、延迟交互和基于智能体的检索器评估结果显示：混合检索在Recall@10上最强，Self-RAG在MRR@10上最优，但所有方法均远未达到饱和，说明基准具有挑战性。

Conclusion: HETERQA为异构源记录检索提供了有效的测试平台，现有方法仍有较大提升空间，为未来检索方法研究留下了充足空间。

Abstract: In emerging systems (e.g., social media and e-commerce platforms), data records are often drawn from heterogeneous sources, such as relational tables, text documents, image repositories, spatial databases, and knowledge graphs. Accordingly, retrieving target records for question-answering (QA) tasks requires us to jointly exploit these heterogeneous sources. However, most existing benchmarks are constructed from individual sources, and only a very few recent benchmarks have considered two or three sources. To alleviate this issue, we introduce HETERQA, a comprehensive benchmark with 857 QA pairs for record retrieval over five heterogeneous sources. HETERQA instantiates this setting with Yelp business records, each of which is grounded by multiple sources. We build HETERQA in an answer-driven manner: candidate records are first initialized with record-field constraints, then enriched through heterogeneous sources, and finally cross-verified across required sources before the natural-language question is retained. We validate the benchmark through contradiction detection and human validation, and further evaluate sparse, dense, hybrid, late-interaction, and agentic retrievers under the same metrics. The results show that HETERQA is challenging: hybrid retrieval achieves the strongest Recall@10, Self-RAG achieves the best MRR@10, and all evaluated methods remain far from saturating the benchmark. These findings indicate that HETERQA provides an effective testbed for record retrieval over heterogeneous sources and leaves substantial room for future retrieval methods. The benchmark dataset and source code are publicly available at https://huggingface.co/datasets/hanchang02/HeterQA and https://github.com/hanchang02/HeterQA, respectively.

</details>


### [202] [HGenPush: A Heterogeneous Generative Recommendation Architecture for Industrial Push Notification Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.03362)
*Xiao Liang,Jiali Feng,Xin Feng,Yiqing Wang,Baolin Ye,Siyao Feng,Zhihui Deng,Cunyi Zhang,Huajin Sun,Xuanping Li,Kaiqiao Zhan,Yanan Niu,Kun Gai*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种端到端异构生成式推荐架构HGenPush，通过混合用户行为理解、双分支异构生成推荐、轻量级多token预测和消费偏好对齐模块，在快手推送通知系统中实现日活跃用户提升0.181%，同时满足用户对高质量内容和可信作者的双重需求。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有生成式推荐系统主要生成单一类型推荐内容（如仅推荐视频），且采用低效的自回归范式生成语义ID，无法同时满足用户对高质量内容和可信作者的双重需求。

Method: 提出HGenPush架构，包含四个模块：1）混合用户行为理解模块，整合多场景多视角行为捕捉用户兴趣；2）双分支异构生成推荐模块，在统一框架内融合视频推荐和作者推荐；3）轻量级多token预测方法，摒弃自回归范式提升生成效率；4）用户消费偏好对齐模块，利用用户反馈作为奖励信号引导模型生成更高质量内容。

Result: 在快手推送通知系统中部署，日活跃用户显著提升0.181%。

Conclusion: HGenPush能够同时满足用户对高质量内容和可信作者的需求，通过端到端异构生成式推荐架构有效提升用户体验和平台参与度。

Abstract: With the explosive growth of content platforms, recommendation systems need to better satisfy user demands to enhance user satisfaction and retention. Taking short-video platforms as an example, users not only seek high-quality content but also trusted authors. Although generative recommendation systems have achieved breakthroughs in recent years, existing methods primarily generate single-type recommendation content and typically employ the inefficient autoregressive paradigm to generate semantic IDs. In this paper, we propose an end-to-end heterogeneous generative recommendation architecture called HGenPush. First, we design a hybrid user behavior understanding module that integrates multi-scenario and multi-perspective behaviors to capture precise user interest. Then, we design a dual-branch heterogeneous generative recommendation module that integrates video recommendation and author recommendation within a unified framework. In addition, to improve generation efficiency, we design a lightweight multi-token prediction method that discards the autoregressive paradigm. Finally, we design a user consumption preference alignment module, which leverages user feedback as reward signals to guide the model toward generating higher-quality content, thereby enhancing user experience and engagement. Through these designs, HGenPush simultaneously fulfills users' demands for high-quality content and trusted authors. We have deployed HGenPush on the push notification system of Kuaishou, a large-scale short-video platform, achieving a significant 0.181% increase in daily active users.

</details>


### [203] [AI Overviews in Academic Search: Evaluating AI-generated Summaries of Search Results in a Domain-specific Search Engine](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.03421)
*Kevin Schott,Kanishka Silva,Ingo Frommholz,Philipp Mayr,Dagmar Kern,Daniel Hienert*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 本研究通过混合方法设计，评估了AI生成的搜索结果页（SERP）摘要作为学术搜索支持功能的可行性。人工评估10个查询的5条结果摘要，建立六类错误分类法和五项安全部署指南。30人用户研究显示，AI摘要虽在主观工作负荷、感知有用性、满意度和决策信心上呈积极趋势但未达统计显著，行为上用户较少展开摘要且点击和查询重构略减。基于信息觅食理论，AI摘要可能浓缩SERP层面的信息线索以支持早期筛选。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在学术搜索中，评估搜索结果页的相关性是一个高认知负荷的步骤。研究旨在探索AI生成的SERP摘要作为辅助功能，以降低用户的认知负担并提升搜索效率。

Method: 采用形成性混合方法设计：(1) 对两个通用大模型（一个商业、一个开源）在10个查询上的前5条结果摘要进行人工评估，建立错误分类法和安全指南；(2) 开展30名被试的受试者内设计用户研究，比较有/无AI摘要的界面在主观工作负荷、感知有用性、满意度、决策信心及行为指标上的差异。

Result: 确认性分析显示AI摘要在各主观指标上有积极但非显著的趋势；探索性分析表明心理需求和挫败感有降低倾向；行为上用户较少展开摘要，结果点击和查询重构次数略有减少。

Conclusion: SERP层面的AI摘要是一种情境和用户依赖的辅助工具，而非普适性改进。研究贡献了错误分类法、安全感知部署指南及学术搜索的具体设计启示。

Abstract: Evaluating search engine results pages (SERPs) to assess result relevance is a demanding step in academic search. In a formative mixed-methods design study, we examine AI-generated SERP-level summaries as a support feature in an academic search engine for social science information. First, we manually evaluated summaries of the top five results for 10 queries using two general-purpose models, one commercial and one open, deriving an exploratory six-category error taxonomy and five safeguards for scholarly deployment. We then conducted a within-subjects user study (n = 30) comparing interfaces with and without AI summaries. Confirmatory analyses showed consistent but non-significant trends favoring AI summaries for subjective workload, perceived usefulness, satisfaction, and decision-making confidence. Exploratory analyses suggested lower mental demand, with frustration also tending to be lower. Behaviorally, participants rarely expanded the summaries and descriptively made slightly fewer result clicks and query reformulations when summaries were available. Drawing on Information Foraging Theory and participant feedback, we suggest that AI summaries may concentrate SERP-level information scent to support early triage. Overall, the findings indicate that SERP-level AI summaries are a context- and user-dependent aid rather than a universal improvement, while contributing an error taxonomy, safeguard-aware deployment guidance, and concrete design implications for scholarly search.

</details>


### [204] [Improving Access to Historical Archives with Real-time RAG-based Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.03440)
*Stergios Konstantinidis,Hayman Lotfy,Alexis Erne,Faruk Zahiragic,Min-Yen Kan,Michalis Vlachos*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 本文提出一个端到端的历史档案处理与检索框架，将大语言模型（LLM）集成到档案流水线中，包含基于LLM的OCR文本精炼模块和语义检索与交叉编码器重排序流水线。在包含50万份瑞士报纸片段、跨越三个世纪（1762-2001）的数据集上，OCR错误率降低达44.52%（CER）和60.95%（WER），NDCG@10提升31.9%（从65.99%到87.05%），在答案正确性和上下文相关性上均有显著提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 数字化历史档案规模大且异构，但现有访问方法面临OCR输出噪声大和基于关键词的刚性检索等挑战，限制了检索质量。因此，需要一种将LLM集成到档案流水线中的端到端框架，以提升文本质量和语义检索能力。

Method: 提出一个端到端档案处理与检索框架，包含两个核心组件：(i) 基于LLM的OCR精炼模块，用于改善文本质量；(ii) 语义检索与交叉编码器重排序流水线，通过检索增强生成（RAG）支持自然语言问答。

Result: 在50万份瑞士报纸片段（1762-2001年）和384个自然语言测试查询上的实验表明：LLM精炼将OCR错误率降低44.52%（CER）和60.95%（WER）；重排序流水线相比传统关键词基线，NDCG@10提升31.9%（从65.99%到87.05%），并在答案正确性和上下文相关性上取得统计显著提升。

Conclusion: 将LLM与现有文档处理与检索流水线集成，能够将数字图书馆从静态存储库提升为交互式、可语义搜索的档案系统。

Abstract: Digitized historical archives are large, heterogeneous cultural heritage repositories, but access methods for such archives face challenges such as noisy optical character recognition (OCR) output and rigid keyword-based retrieval, which limit retrieval quality. In this work, we present an end-to-end archival processing and retrieval framework that integrates large language models (LLMs) into the archival pipeline. Our system introduces two core components: (i) an LLM-based OCR refinement module that improves text quality, and (ii) a semantic retrieval and cross-encoder reranking pipeline supporting natural-language question answering via retrieval-augmented generation (RAG). Our evaluations are done on a historical archival dataset of 500,000 Swiss newspaper segments spanning over three centuries (1762 to 2001). Experiments are conducted across 384 natural-language test queries. Our results highlight that LLM refinements reduce OCR errors by up to 44.52% (CER) and 60.95% (WER). More importantly, this is accompanied by downstream information retrieval improvements. Compared to traditional keyword baselines, our reranking pipeline increases NDCG@10 by 31.9% (from 65.99% to 87.05%) and achieves statistically significant gains in both answer correctness and context relevance. These results demonstrate that integrating LLMs with established document processing and retrieval pipelines can elevate digital libraries from static repositories to interactive, semantically searchable archival systems.

</details>


### [205] [TRIAGE: Trustworthy Retrieval Instrumentation And Graph Evaluation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.03447)
*Axel TahmasebiMoradi,Lucas Schott,Martin Royer*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: TRIAGE是一个面向自动化构建的大模型驱动知识图谱的阶段性可诊断框架，通过在KG实现、验证和使用三个阶段设置独立可解释的指标，结合必要条件诊断链，实现错误的精确定位与修复。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有Graph-RAG系统通常由LLM自动构建知识图谱，但缺乏对各阶段（提取、图构建、推理）的独立评估手段，导致某一阶段的错误只能在最终推理结果中显现，难以定位和修复故障。

Method: TRIAGE框架将评估划分为三个核心阶段：KG实现（三元组置信度、源覆盖率、模式与规范化检查）、KG验证（专家驱动的图级结构质量，含正确性与完整性离线校准）、KG使用（检索覆盖率、忠实度与检索成本）。各阶段设置独立可解释的指标，形成必要条件诊断链，首个断链点即为故障所在，并映射至对应的修复杠杆（提取、图/模式、检索）。

Result: 提出了一个理论框架，附带概念验证方案与可复现的评估协议。部署阶段指标无需黄金标注，需黄金标注的指标仅用于离线校准。

Conclusion: TRIAGE为自动构建KG的Graph-RAG系统提供了系统化的阶段性评估与故障定位方法，能够将最终错误归因至具体阶段并给出修复方向。

Abstract: Knowledge graphs (KGs) that underpin Graph-based Retrieval-Augmented Generation (Graph-RAG) are increasingly built automatically by LLM-driven extraction rather than curated by experts. Proper evaluation would require instrumenting all pertinent stages: extraction, graph construction, and inference, coherently enough to localize failures, so that a failure at one stage is not discovered as a wrong answer at the end. We introduce TRIAGE, a stage-aware instrumentation framework for automated, document-grounded graph-RAG that asks not only whether the underlying graph can be trusted but at what cost it can be queried. TRIAGE attaches stage-specific, independently interpretable metrics to three stages: the KG Implementation (triple confidence, source coverage, and schema and canonicalization checks), the KG Validation by expert (graph-level structural quality, with correctness and completeness computed only as offline calibration when a reference is available), and the KG Usage (retrieval coverage, faithfulness, and retrieval cost); the deployed metrics need no gold annotations, the gold-requiring ones serving only as offline calibration. At usage time these metrics form a diagnostic chain of necessary conditions whose first broken link localizes the failure, and the diagnosis maps to the stage levers that can remedy it: extraction, graph and schema, or retrieval. TRIAGE is a theoretical framework with a proof of concept and a reproducible evaluation protocol.

</details>


### [206] [SentAttack: A Sentence-Level Black-Box Adversarial Attack Method for Dense Retrieval Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.03456)
*Luping Wei,Yamin Hu,Sihan Shang,Shiyin Wang,Wenjian Luo*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 提出SentAttack，一种针对密集检索模型的黑盒句子级对抗攻击方法，通过两阶段流程（代理模型训练+句子级质心引导优化）有效提升低排名目标文档的检索排名。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有RAG系统的鲁棒性研究主要关注重排序模型，而针对密集检索模型的对抗攻击大多限于词级扰动。对于与查询不相关的低排名目标文档，简单的词级攻击不足以误导DR模型显著提升其排名。

Method: 两阶段方法：第一阶段通过迭代检索与黑盒RAG系统交互，收集排名文档和排序信息来训练代理DR模型；第二阶段利用代理模型对目标查询相关文档进行编码和聚类，得到多个聚类质心，将这些质心与目标文档在句子级拼接形成初始对抗候选集，然后使用查询和质心引导的目标函数结合梯度引导的波束搜索进行优化。

Result: 实验表明SentAttack在攻击DR模型方面优于现有对抗攻击方法，尤其对低排名目标文档表现出色。

Conclusion: 句子级对抗攻击能够有效突破词级攻击的局限，显著提升低排名文档在DR模型中的排名，揭示了RAG系统中检索阶段的鲁棒性风险。

Abstract: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems typically consist of a dense retrieval (DR) model for initial retrieval and a neural ranking model (NRM) for re-ranking.Existing robustness studies in RAG mainly focus on NRMs, while adversarial attacks on DR models are mostly limited to word-level perturbations.For low-ranked target documents that are irrelevant to the query, simple word-level attacks are insufficient to mislead DR models into substantially promoting their rankings.To solve these problems, we propose SentAttack, a sentence-level black-box adversarial attack method for DR models.SentAttack is designed as a two-stage method.In the first stage, SentAttack interacts with the black-box RAG system via iterative retrieval to collect ranked documents and ranking information for training a surrogate DR model.In the second stage, SentAttack uses the surrogate DR model to encode and cluster documents relevant to the target query, yielding multiple cluster centroids.These centroids are concatenated with the target document at the sentence level to form an initial set of adversarial candidates.SentAttack then optimizes these candidates using a query- and centroid-guided objective combined with gradient-guided beam search.Extensive experiments demonstrate that SentAttack outperforms existing adversarial attacks on DR models, with especially strong performance on low-ranked target documents.

</details>


### [207] [Relevance-Based Embeddings: Lightweight Candidate Retrieval via Heavy-Ranker Calls](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.03515)
*Kirill Shevkunov,Andrey Ploskonosov,Liudmila Prokhorenkova*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 本文提出一种利用昂贵相似度模型得分来改进查询和物品表示的方法，通过将每个查询/物品描述为与一组支持物品/查询的相关性，从而无需单独训练嵌入模型即可进行高效候选检索。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在机器学习应用中，昂贵的相似度模型无法支持穷举搜索，现有方案（训练单独嵌入模型+近似最近邻搜索+重排序）存在质量损失，本文旨在探索一种替代性的候选选择方法，利用昂贵模型的得分直接改进查询和物品的表示。

Method: 将每个查询（物品）通过其与一组支持物品（查询）的相关性得分来描述，利用这些新表示获得查询和物品的嵌入向量。理论上证明了这种嵌入在温和条件下能够逼近任意复杂相似度模型，并研究了支持物品的选择策略。

Result: 在多种学术数据集和生产数据集上的实验验证了所提方法的有效性。

Conclusion: 该方法可作为传统嵌入+近似搜索+重排序范式的有效替代方案，通过直接利用昂贵模型得分构建表示，在保持检索效率的同时提升候选质量。

Abstract: In many machine learning applications, the most relevant items for a query should be efficiently retrieved. The relevance function is usually an expensive similarity model, making the exhaustive search infeasible. A typical solution is to train another model that separately embeds queries and items to a vector space, where similarity is defined via the dot product or cosine similarity. This allows one to search the relevant items through fast approximate nearest neighbor search at the cost of some reduction in quality. To compensate for this reduction, the found items (candidates) are re-ranked by the expensive ranking model. In this paper, we investigate an alternative approach to candidate selection that utilizes the scores of the expensive model to improve the representations of queries and items. The idea is to describe each query (item) by its relevance to a set of support items (queries) and use these new representations to obtain query (item) embeddings. We theoretically prove that such embeddings are powerful enough to approximate any complex similarity model (under mild conditions). We also investigate the choice of support items, which is a crucial ingredient of the proposed approach. The experiments on diverse academic and production datasets illustrate the power of our method.

</details>


### [208] [The Powerless Noise: How Experimental Settings Shape the Reported Power of Noise](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.03615)
*Michal Mazuryk,Fleur Dolmans,Louis Gehringer,Ina Klaric,Jia-Huei Ju,Mohammad Aliannejadi*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 本文复现了"噪声增强RAG"现象（Power of Noise），发现该效应在高泛化性场景下不稳健：提示词微调和解码约束的微小变化即可导致效应出现、减弱或消失，且错误分析表明截断和畸形生成为主要贡献因素。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 验证Cuconasu等人提出的"在RAG输入中添加无关文档可提升问答性能"这一反直觉现象的稳健性，并探究其底层机制。

Method: 先在原始设置（早期LLM、约束性提示、受限解码）下复现结果，然后通过替换模型、放宽指令和输出长度约束进行消融实验，并结合错误分析（截断、畸形生成）评估效应稳定性。

Result: Power-of-Noise效应对推理配置高度敏感：提示措辞和解码限制的微小变化可导致效应出现、减弱或消失；截断和畸形生成为主要错误来源。

Conclusion: 原始"噪声增强效应"在实验条件下不能作为噪声检索的普适优势被稳健确认；RAG系统的推理设计需要仔细审视。

Abstract: Recent work has suggested that adding irrelevant documents to the input of retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) systems can improve question-answering performance, a phenomenon referred to as the ``\textit{Power of Noise}.'' This motivated investigations into the role of noise in information retrieval. In this paper, we reproduce the main findings of Cuconasu et al. \cite{cuconasu2024power} and evaluate the robustness of the effect under extended experimental settings. We first confirm that the phenomenon holds under the original setup, which uses earlier-generation LLMs, restrictive prompting and constrained decoding settings. We subsequently introduce a series of extensions to investigate the underlying causes of the noise effect, examining the authors' original design choices including the use of different models, instruction prompting, and relaxed output length constraints. Across these ablations, the Power-of-Noise pattern proves highly sensitive to inference configuration: it can appear, weaken, or disappear under small changes to prompt formulation and decoding limits. Combined with our error analysis, which shows substantial contributions from truncation and malformed generations, this variance indicates that the original effect cannot be robustly confirmed as a general benefit of noisy retrieval under these experimental conditions. More broadly, our work highlights the importance of carefully scrutinizing inference design in retrieval-augmented generation systems. Our code is available at https://github.com/ina0105/The-Power-of-Noise-Reproduction.

</details>


### [209] [Next-Gen Sponsored Search: Crafting the Perfect Query with Inventory-Aware RAG (InvAwr-RAG) Based GenAI](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.03880)
*Md Omar Faruk Rokon,Weizhi Du,Zhaodong Wang,Musen Wen*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 本文提出InvAwr-RAG模型，通过集成语义检索和实时库存数据，动态生成和改写查询以匹配可用广告库存，在Walmart平台上实现了填充率提升68%，同时保持广告相关性平衡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大量搜索查询无法检索到任何赞助广告，导致广告收入损失和用户参与度下降，亟需一种能够动态适配库存和广告活动的查询优化方法。

Method: 提出Inventory-Aware RAG-based Generative AI模型（InvAwr-RAG），集成先进语义检索和实时库存数据，结合动态生成的查询与历史成功查询，多样化改写查询以适配可用库存和广告活动。

Result: 初步结果显示填充率显著提升68%，相关性指标保持平衡，表明广告收入增长潜力巨大。

Conclusion: InvAwr-RAG模型在动态查询优化方面树立了新标准，显著提升了广告相关性、广告主ROI以及Walmart数字平台的用户体验。

Abstract: Sponsored search plays a crucial role in e-commerce revenue generation, where advertisers strategically bid on keywords to capture the attention of users through relevant search queries. However, the process of identifying pertinent keywords for a given query presents significant challenges because of a vast and evolving keyword landscape, ambiguous intentions, and topic diversity. This paper highlights an opportunity for to earn a considerable amount of Ads revenue and user engagement where a significant proportion of queries fail to retrieve any sponsored ads. To utilize this opportunity, we introduce the Inventory-Aware RAG-based Generative AI model (InvAwr-RAG), which integrates advanced semantic retrieval and real-time inventory data. This model combines dynamically generated and historically successful queries to align with available inventory and ad campaigns while diversifying rewritten queries to enhance relevance and user engagement. Preliminary results show a significant 68% increase in fill rate and balanced relevance metrics, indicating a strong potential for increased ad revenue. The InvAwr-RAG model sets a new standard in dynamic query optimization, significantly improving ad relevancy, advertiser ROI, and user experience on Walmart's digital platform.

</details>


### [210] [Enhancement of E-commerce Sponsored Search Relevancy with LLM](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.03886)
*Md Omar Faruk Rokon,Andrei Simion,Weizhi Du,Musen Wen,Hong Yao,Kuang-chih Lee*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于LLAMA2 7B和LoRA微调的广告相关性模型，用于电商赞助搜索，在Walmart.com数据集上达到89.43%的准确率，优于基线模型和GPT-4。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 赞助搜索中关键词匹配面临关键词空间庞大且不断变化、用户和广告主意图模糊、涉及多主题多语言等挑战，现有方法难以保证广告与查询的相关性，影响用户满意度和业务效率。

Method: 采用LLAMA2 7B作为基座模型，通过Low-Rank Adaptation（LoRA）进行参数高效微调，针对电商赞助搜索场景适配预训练模型；设计了一个查询与广告标题的三分类器（相关、部分相关、不相关）。

Result: 在大型测试数据集上达到89.43%的广告相关性准确率，优于基线模型和GPT-4等先进语言模型。

Conclusion: LoRA与LLAMA2的结合在电商赞助搜索中显著提升了搜索精度、成本效率和运营隐私，为现代数字市场中的语言模型定制提供了有效途径。

Abstract: Sponsored search plays a crucial role as a revenue stream for search engines, wherein advertisers competitively bid on keywords that align with the users' search queries. The task of matching relevant keywords to these queries is complicated by the vast and ever-evolving space of keywords, the ambiguity of user and advertiser intentions, and the wide range of topics and languages involved. Consequently, ensuring that ads are pertinent to user queries presents significant challenges. In the fast-paced world of e-commerce, the accuracy of sponsored search results is vital for boosting user satisfaction and optimizing business operations. This paper presents the development of an advanced Ad Relevance Model within a sponsored search framework, utilizing the power of a pretrained large language model. We detail a pioneering adaptation of the LLAMA2 7B model through Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA), which markedly enhances search precision and operational efficiency, thus opening new avenues for improving user interactions in extensive online marketplaces such as Walmart.com. We introduce a novel query and ad title classifier, which discerns the relevance of search interactions across three categories: Relevant, Partially Relevant, and Irrelevant. Our approach involved adapting the pretrained model specifically for the e-commerce sponsored search context, training it on a large dataset. The fine-tuned model demonstrated a marked improvement in ad relevance accuracy, achieving 89.43% accuracy on a comprehensive test dataset -- outperforming both the baseline model and other advanced language models like GPT-4. The integration of LoRA with the based model represents a significant stride in customizing language models for e-commerce applications, resulting in enhanced search accuracy, cost efficiency, and operational privacy -- a triad essential for the modern digital marketplace.

</details>


### [211] [Beyond Item Order: Temporal Gap Tokenization for Generative Recommendation with Semantic IDs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.03918)
*Chengkai Huang,Tianqi Gao,Hongtao Huang,Quan Z. Sheng,Lina Yao*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: ChronoSID 是一个轻量级时间增强框架，通过时间感知的掩码自编码（TA-FAMAE）和离散化时间间隔令牌嵌入，在语义ID生成式推荐中引入时序信号，显著提升了长期间隔场景下的推荐性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于语义ID的生成式推荐方法使用静态物品标识符构建用户历史序列，忽略了交互之间的时间间隔信息，导致模型无法捕捉兴趣连续性和偏好漂移等时间相关的用户行为模式。

Method: 提出ChronoSID框架，包含两个互补模块：(1) 时间感知的场感知掩码自编码（TA-FAMAE），通过辅助时间间隔预测任务正则化物品表示学习；(2) 将历史交互间隔离散化为对数尺度间隔令牌，与语义ID元组交错输入序列到序列生成器的编码器。

Result: 在Amazon评论基准数据集上，ChronoSID一致优于ReSID及其他生成式推荐基线方法。消融实验验证了两个时序组件的贡献，诊断分析显示在长间隔场景（用户兴趣更易漂移）中增益更明显。

Conclusion: 通过在语义ID管道的表示学习和生成阶段注入时间信号，ChronoSID在保持紧凑SID生成范式的同时，有效捕获了时间感知的转移模式，证明了时间信息对生成式推荐的重要性。

Abstract: Semantic-ID-based generative recommendation has recently emerged as a scalable paradigm for sequential recommendation, where each item is represented by a compact sequence of discrete codes and next-item prediction is formulated as code generation. Existing methods, however, typically construct user histories as sequences of static item identifiers, leaving the elapsed time between consecutive interactions outside the generative input. This temporal blindness is problematic because inter-interaction gaps provide useful cues about interest continuity and preference drift. In this paper, we propose ChronoSID, a lightweight temporal augmentation framework for semantic-ID-based generative recommendation. ChronoSID injects temporal signals into the standard three-stage semantic-ID pipeline from two complementary perspectives. First, we introduce Time-Aware Field-Aware Masked Auto-Encoding (TA-FAMAE), which regularizes item representation learning with an auxiliary time-gap prediction objective. Second, we discretize historical interaction intervals into fixed log-scale gap tokens and interleave them with semantic ID tuples as the encoder input of the sequence-to sequence generator. This design preserves the compact SID generation paradigm while enabling the model to capture time-aware transition patterns. Experiments on Amazon review benchmarks show that ChronoSID consistently improves over ReSID and other competitive generative recommendation baselines. Ablation studies further verify the contribution of both temporal components, and diagnostic analyses show clearer gains under long-gap scenarios where user interests are more likely to drift.

</details>


### [212] [Patient-Conditioned Dual Hypergraph Reasoning for Auditable Traditional Chinese Medicine Prescription Support](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.04025)
*Weizhi Nie,Shaojin Bai,Weijie Wang,Yuting Su*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 提出了一种患者条件双超图框架，用于可审计的中医处方支持。该框架通过两个动态加权的超图分别组织辨证推理和处方构建证据，实现个性化诊疗路径激活，同时保留病例级别的可审计性。实验在多个数据集上取得了良好效果，并通过50例真实世界CAP审计验证了其实用潜力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 直接语言模型生成处方虽流畅但难以审计；静态中医知识资源无法针对个体患者确定应强调哪些诊断和处方关系。需要一种既能个性化推理又保留审计能力的处方支持方法。

Method: 提出患者条件双超图框架：第一个超图围绕证候和治疗原则推理组织症状、舌脉等临床证据；第二个超图围绕处方构建组织证候、治疗、疾病上下文、草药检索和剂量先验证据。两个超图均通过患者表示进行动态加权，实现个性化路径激活。

Result: 在TCM-SD上，第一个超图的动态加权使MacBERT证候区分准确率达0.8297，macro-F1为0.3288。在TCM-BEST4SDT上，第二个超图在三个种子下平均Herb-F1最佳为0.3111，完整流水线达到0.3074 Herb-F1。50例真实世界CAP审计验证了实用审查潜力。

Conclusion: 动态加权双超图框架在保持审计性的同时实现了个性化的中医辨证和处方推荐，接近oracle设置性能，但需进一步进行前瞻性剂量安全性验证。

Abstract: Traditional Chinese medicine (TCM) prescription support requires patient-specific reasoning from clinical narratives to syndromes, treatment principles, herbs, and doses. Direct language-model generation can produce fluent prescriptions, but its decisions are difficult to audit against explicit clinical evidence. Static TCM knowledge resources provide useful priors, but they cannot determine which diagnostic and prescription relations should be emphasized for an individual patient. We propose a patient-conditioned dual hypergraph framework for auditable TCM prescription support. The first hypergraph organizes symptom, tongue, pulse, and other clinical evidence around syndrome and treatment-principle reasoning. The second hypergraph organizes syndrome, treatment, disease-context, herb, retrieval, and dose-prior evidence for prescription construction. Unlike static knowledge graphs or fixed hypergraphs, both hypergraphs are dynamically weighted by the patient representation. This design enables individualized activation of diagnostic and prescription paths, supporting personalized syndrome differentiation and herb-dose recommendation while preserving case-level auditability. Experiments on TCM-SD show that dynamic weighting in the first hypergraph improves MacBERT syndrome differentiation to 0.8297 accuracy and 0.3288 macro-F1. On TCM-BEST4SDT, the second hypergraph achieves the best mean Herb-F1 of 0.3111 across three seeds, and the full connected pipeline reaches 0.3074 Herb-F1, close to the oracle setting. A 50-case real-world CAP audit further suggests practical review potential, while highlighting the need for prospective dose-safety validation.

</details>


### [213] [Claim2Source at CheckThat! 2026: Improving Multilingual Scientific Claim-Source Retrieval with Verification-based Re-Ranking](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.04043)
*Tobias Schreieder,Harsh Khandelwal,Yu-Ling Zhong,Michael Färber*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种多阶段检索框架，用于多语言科学声明-来源检索，结合结构化表示与渐进式候选优化，在CheckThat! 2026竞赛中取得第一名（平均MRR@5=0.7628）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 社交媒体上的科学声明与其来源出版物之间存在语言、措辞和详细程度的差异，导致声明与证据之间的关联弱化，现有方法难以有效处理多语言场景下的声明-来源检索任务。

Method: 提出多阶段检索框架：(1) 构建双语声明表示、元数据增强的来源表示及语言特定稠密检索模型适应；(2) 第一阶段检索器生成候选来源池；(3) 基于相似性的重排序提升高相关来源排名；(4) 基于验证的重排序利用验证信号识别最佳支撑来源。

Result: 在英语、德语和法语声明上平均MRR@5得分为0.7628，在CheckThat! 2026排行榜上排名第一。

Conclusion: 所提出的多阶段检索框架有效解决了多语言科学声明-来源检索中的语言差异与声明-证据关联弱化问题，验证了双语表示与验证信号在提升检索性能方面的价值。

Abstract: Multilingual scientific claim-source retrieval aims to identify the scientific publication supporting a claim shared on social media. This task is challenging because claims often differ from source publications in terms of language, wording, and level of detail, which weakens the connection between claims and their underlying evidence. In this paper, we present our approach for the CheckThat! 2026 Lab Task 1: Source Retrieval for Scientific Web Claims. We propose a multi-stage retrieval framework for multilingual scientific claim-source retrieval that combines structured claim and source representations with progressive candidate refinement. To address multilingual retrieval challenges, the framework employs bilingual claim representations, metadata-enhanced source representations, and language-specific adaptation of dense retrieval models. Building on this setup, a first-stage retriever generates an initial pool of candidate sources, after which similarity-based re-ranking improves the ranking of highly relevant sources and verification-based re-ranking identifies the candidate source that best supports the claim using verification signals. Our approach achieves an average MRR@5 score of 0.7628 across English, German, and French claims, ranking first on the CheckThat! 2026 leaderboard.

</details>


### [214] [UniSGR: Unified Framework for Semantic ID Generation and Ranking](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.04068)
*Jiawei Sun,Jun Yang,Ziyue Guo,Dongyue Xu,Jianan Yan,Lifang Deng,Xiaoyi Zeng*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: UniSGR是一个统一的语义ID生成与排序框架，采用两阶段训练范式（多场景预训练+场景特定对齐），通过VA-PMTP、TAT和STARK等技术解决生成式检索在细粒度多目标排序中的局限性，在大规模电商平台上验证了有效性和可扩展性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有生成式检索方法难以实现细粒度的多目标排序，需要桥接生成与下游排序之间的差距。

Method: 采用两阶段训练范式：（1）多场景预训练阶段学习混合业务场景数据；（2）场景特定对齐阶段联合优化VA-PMTP和统一多目标排序模块。引入TAT和漏斗感知对比学习对齐生成与排序，提出STARK推理策略消除传统束搜索的效率瓶颈。

Result: 在大规模电商平台上的离线实验验证了UniSGR的有效性和可扩展性。

Conclusion: UniSGR通过统一的语义ID生成与排序框架，有效解决了生成式检索在多目标排序中的局限性，并具备良好的可扩展性。

Abstract: Recommendation systems play a pivotal role in modern e-commerce platforms. While generative retrieval has emerged as a promising paradigm for alleviating the limitations of multi-stage cascade architectures, existing methods still struggle with fine-grained multi-objective ranking. To bridge this gap, we propose UniSGR, a Unified framework for Semantic ID Generation and Ranking. UniSGR adopts a two-stage training paradigm: a multi-scenario pre-training stage that learns from mixed business-scenario data, followed by a scenario-specific alignment stage that jointly optimizes Value-Aware Parallel Multi-Token Prediction (VA-PMTP) and a unified multi-objective ranking module. To better align generation with downstream ranking, we introduce Task-Aware Tokens (TAT) guided by Funnel-Aware Contrastive Learning. Furthermore, we propose Semantic Tree Attention with Reorganized KV cache (STARK), an inference strategy that removes key efficiency bottlenecks in conventional beam search. Extensive offline experiments on a large-scale e-commerce platform demonstrate the effectiveness and scalability of UniSGR.

</details>


### [215] [Submitted and Diagnostic Analysis of Full-Text Temporal Retrieval for LongEval-Sci](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.04088)
*Yingdong Yang,Haijian Wu*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 本文报告了LongEval-Sci 2026科学文献检索任务的结果，比较了多种检索方法，发现全文检索结合时间信息在纵向评估中表现最佳，而引文特征尚未带来可测量的额外增益。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 科学检索系统需要在语料库持续变化的动态环境中保持有效性，即系统在当前语料上表现良好，且随文档积累仍保持可用。LongEval-Sci旨在评估这种随时间变化的集合变更场景下的检索性能。

Method: 对比官方PyTerrier BM25和Qwen3稠密基线，测试了全文BM25、加性变体、路由变体、时间化全文检索、时间+引文检索、RM3查询扩展、交叉编码器重排序和倒数秩融合（RRF）等多种方法。使用DCTR评估官方任务结果，并辅以内部快照诊断和定性周级IR系统更新监测分析。

Result: 官方DCTR评估中，时间化全文检索（FT BM25+temporal和FT BM25+temporal+citation）在三个快照上获得最佳ARP（nDCG@10分别为0.285、0.267、0.180），并将快照3的相对变化从BM25基线的0.481降至0.368。内部诊断显示全文BM25是最强单检索引擎（nDCG@10=0.3302, MAP=0.2853），RRF实现最佳深度召回（Recall@1000=0.9667）。引文特征未提供可测量的额外增益。

Conclusion: 全文检索是最强的基础检索方式，时间整合可有效提升纵向评估效果，引文证据仍需更干净的消融和校准研究。

Abstract: LongEval-Sci evaluates scientific retrieval under collection change, where a system should be effective on the current corpus and remain usable as documents accumulate over time. This paper reports both official Task 1 results and development diagnostics for LongEval-Sci 2026. We compare the official PyTerrier BM25 and Qwen3 dense baselines with full-text BM25, additive and router variants, temporal full-text retrieval, temporal+citation retrieval, RM3 query expansion, cross-encoder reranking, and reciprocal rank fusion (RRF). In the official DCTR evaluation, the temporalized full-text runs are our strongest submissions: FT BM25+temporal and FT BM25+temporal+citation obtain the best ARP on all three snapshots (0.285, 0.267, and 0.180 nDCG@10) and reduce snapshot-3 relative change from 0.481 for the BM25 pivot to 0.368. Citation features match the temporal-only variant but do not provide a measurable additional gain in the official summary. Our internal snapshot-1 diagnostics show a complementary pattern: full-text BM25 is the strongest single development retriever (DCTR nDCG@10 = 0.3302, MAP = 0.2853), RRF gives the best deep recall (Recall@1000 = 0.9667), and some uncalibrated overlays can sharply degrade top-rank quality. We therefore conclude that full-text retrieval is the strongest foundation, temporal integration can improve official longitudinal effectiveness when applied to that foundation, and citation evidence still requires cleaner ablation and calibration. Beyond ranking, we also report a qualitative weekly IR-system update-monitoring analysis based on ingestion velocity and stale-coverage drift.

</details>


### [216] [LBR: Towards Mitigating Length Bias in Large Language Models for Recommendation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.04270)
*Hongchen Li,Bohao Wang,Jingbang Chen,Weiqin Yang,Hang Pan,Bingde Hu,Can Wang,Jiawei Chen*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 本文发现LLM推荐系统中存在长度偏差问题（长文本在输入和输出阶段均被偏向），并提出LBR框架，通过长度感知注意力校准和有效信息长度归一化来缓解该偏差，实验表明该方法能显著提升推荐准确性和公平性，平均NDCG@5提升16.82%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM作为推荐系统骨干时，由于物品描述文本长度不同，导致输入侧和输出侧均存在系统性长度偏差，影响推荐公平性和准确性，而现有研究对此问题关注不足。

Method: 提出LBR框架：1) 输入侧：长度感知注意力校准（Length-Aware Attention Calibration），通过在注意力logits中加入长度相关偏移来中和注意力偏斜；2) 输出侧：有效信息长度归一化（Effective Information Length Normalization），基于前缀树的分支结构推导信息论长度替代指标，替代简单词元计数。

Result: 在三个真实Amazon数据集和两个代表性LLM推荐器上，LBR显著缓解了长度偏差，持续提升了推荐准确性和公平性，平均NDCG@5提升16.82%，且额外训练和推理开销可忽略不计。

Conclusion: LBR是一种轻量级、模型无关的框架，能有效解决LLM推荐中的长度偏差问题，在提升推荐性能的同时保证公平性，且易于集成到现有系统中。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have recently emerged as powerful backbones for recommender systems by reformulating recommendation as a token-level generation task. Despite their promise, we identify a pervasive yet underexplored issue: $\textit{Length Bias}$. Because items are represented by textual descriptions of varying lengths, LLM-based recommenders can be systematically biased in two ways. On the input side, longer item descriptions occupy more tokens in the context and thus receive disproportionately large aggregate attention mass during user preference modeling. On the output side, decoding based on summed autoregressive log-likelihood score inherently disfavors long items. Worse still, conventional length normalization can introduce an additional bias and even degrade recommendation performance.
  To address this problem, we propose $\textbf{LBR}$ ($\textbf{L}$ength $\textbf{B}$ias $\textbf{R}$eduction), a lightweight and model-agnostic framework for mitigating length bias in LLM-based recommendation. LBR mitigates input-side bias via Length-Aware Attention Calibration, which incorporates a length-dependent offset into attention logits to neutralize attention skew. For the output side, LBR introduces Effective Information Length Normalization, replacing naive token count with an information-theoretic length surrogate derived from the branching structure of the prefix tree. Extensive experiments on three real-world Amazon datasets and two representative LLM-based recommenders demonstrate that LBR substantially alleviates length bias while consistently improving recommendation accuracy and fairness, with negligible additional training and inference overhead (with an average NDCG@5 gain of 16.82%). The code is available at https://github.com/Void-JackLee/LBR.

</details>


### [217] [Autonomous Information Seeking: A Roadmap for Agentic Recommender Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.04433)
*Xinyu Lin,Yashar Deldjoo,Sunhao Dai,Honghui Bao,Xiaopeng Ye,Fatemeh Nazary,Wenjie Wang,Tommaso Di Noia,Jun Xu,Tat-Seng Chua*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 这篇综述论文系统性地介绍了基于大语言模型智能体的推荐系统，提出了统一分类体系（三种范式：智能体辅助推荐、智能体即推荐器、智能体即用户模拟器）和自治性框架，分析了不同范式下的架构、评估方法及挑战，为自主、可靠、对齐人类偏好的推荐智能体研究奠定基础。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大语言模型智能体快速融入推荐系统，推动了从静态排序管道向自主交互系统的范式转变，但缺乏系统性综述来组织这一新兴领域的研究进展、分类方法和评估体系。

Method: 提出了基于自治性程度和三种核心范式的统一分类体系（智能体辅助推荐、智能体即推荐器、智能体即用户模拟器）；沿自主性、上下文感知、交互灵活性和适应性四个维度组织现有方法；分析了不同范式中的智能体架构（档案、记忆、工具使用、工作流、优化机制）以及评估方法（自动指标、LLM评判、模拟评估）。

Result: 建立了涵盖三种范式、自治性框架、组件分析和评估方法的统一体系，识别了轨迹级评估、智能体贡献分析、用户模拟校准等未解决的评估问题，以及终身用户建模、上下文抽象、多模态对齐、可控性、可信性、隐私、可扩展性和效率等开放挑战。

Conclusion: 该综述为智能体推荐系统建立了统一的进展理解基础，指出了发展更自主、可靠且与人类对齐的推荐智能体的重要研究机会。

Abstract: The rapid integration of large language model-based agents into recommender systems has driven a shift from static, ranking-based pipelines toward autonomous and interactive systems that can reason, plan, and act. This survey provides a comprehensive overview of this emerging landscape by introducing a unified taxonomy grounded in the level of autonomy and three core paradigms of agentic recommender systems: agent-assisted recommendation, agent-as-recommender, and agent-as-user-simulator. The autonomy framework organizes existing methods along increasing capabilities in proactivity, context awareness, interaction flexibility, and adaptivity. Building on this framework, the survey analyzes how each paradigm adopts different agentic architectures and how agents enhance key components such as profiles, memory, tool use, workflows, and optimization mechanisms. We further examine evaluation methodologies for agentic recommendation, covering automated metrics, LLM-based judging, and simulation-based assessment, and discuss their limitations in capturing reasoning quality, user experience, and system behavior. Beyond existing evaluation protocols, we further discuss unresolved issues in evaluating agentic recommender systems, including trajectory-level assessment, agent contribution analysis, and calibration of user simulation. Lastly, the survey outlines open challenges in lifelong user modeling, contextual abstraction, multimodal alignment, controllability, trustworthiness, privacy, scalability, and efficiency. Together, these analyses establish a unified foundation for understanding the current progress of agentic recommender systems and highlight promising opportunities for developing more autonomous, reliable, and human-aligned recommendation agents.

</details>


### [218] [Evaluation and Explainability of Unsupervised Scholarly Collaboration Recommendations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.04529)
*Md Asaduzzaman Noor,John W. Sheppard,Jason A. Clark*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 本文系统比较了三种无监督内容协作推荐方法（TF-IDF、主题模型、嵌入检索）在学术合作推荐中的表现，发现TF-IDF在信息完整时最优，但主题模型和嵌入方法在信息缺失时更稳健，并探讨了两种可解释性视角的互补性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有无监督协作推荐方法缺乏系统比较，且过度依赖直接词汇匹配，无法有效捕获研究人员的学术相似性。本文旨在探索不同方法在信息受限场景下的稳健性，并研究可解释性如何辅助推荐决策。

Method: 采用三种方法族：TF-IDF基线、主题模型（LDA和BERTopic及其变体）、基于嵌入的检索（SciBERT+Faiss）。设计约束实验，逐步移除研究者的论文重叠，以历史合作作为代理真实标签进行后验评估。可解释性从两个角度分析：内在主题解释和事后检索解释（使用语言模型生成）。

Result: TF-IDF在信息完整时表现最好，但随着论文重叠减少性能显著下降；主题模型和嵌入方法在信息受限时表现更稳定。两种可解释性视角各有优劣：内在主题解释提供透明性，事后检索解释提供更好的人类可读性。

Conclusion: 无监督内容协作推荐中，不同方法存在显著的性能-稳健性权衡；混合使用主题/嵌入方法可在信息不完备场景下实现更可靠的推荐；可解释性需要根据实际应用场景在透明性与可读性之间取舍。

Abstract: In this paper, we examine unsupervised, content-based collaboration recommendations using publication text in scholarly settings. We compare three families of methods: a TF-IDF baseline, topic-based models (LDA and BERTopic, including clone variants), and embedding-based retrieval using SciBERT with Faiss. To evaluate model behavior beyond simple lexical matching, we introduce a constrained setting where publication overlap between researchers is partially removed while still using historical co-authorship as proxy ground truth for post-hoc evaluation. Results show clear differences across methods. TF-IDF performs best under full information but drops significantly as overlap is reduced. In contrast, topic-based and embedding-based approaches show more stable performance, suggesting they capture broader distributional similarities, rather than relying only on direct lexical overlap. We also examine explainability through two perspectives: intrinsic topic-based explanations and post-hoc, retrieval-based explanations generated using language models. These provide complementary trade-offs between transparency and human readability.

</details>


### [219] [Do All Visual Tokens Matter Equally? Object-Evidence Preserving Token Merging for Vision-Language Retrieval](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.04605)
*Suhyeong Park,Junha Jung,Jungwoo Park,Jaewoo Kang*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: SaMer是一个对象感知的token合并框架，通过将图像端token压缩为K个代表性质心（K=64时可移除93%以上token，存储减少16.09倍），同时保留原始后期交互接口，在Flickr30K和MSCOCO上提升R@1指标，优于剪枝和特征池化等压缩基线方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多向量视觉-语言检索通过最大相似度后期交互保留细粒度视觉证据，但密集的图像端token导致存储和评分成本高昂。现有token压缩方法可能移除或坍缩未来查询token需要选择的对象级和区域级证据。

Method: 提出SaMer框架：1) 仅在训练阶段使用对象标注作为合并先验，抑制跨实例混合；2) 将图像端后投影器token压缩为K个代表性质心；3) 保留原始后期交互接口；4) 仅适配共享投影层，视觉和语言骨干网络冻结；5) 推理时不需真实边界框或检测器。

Result: K=64时移除93%以上图像端token，ColPali存储减少16.09倍，在Flickr30K和MSCOCO上R@1指标提升，优于压缩基线方法，并展现出更强的短语级定位能力。

Conclusion: 有效的多向量检索不仅依赖于减少token数量，更依赖于保留未来查询token需要选择的证据。对象感知的合并策略能够保留查询可选取的对象证据，而这些证据在剪枝或仅特征池化中会被移除或坍缩。

Abstract: Multi-vector vision-language retrieval preserves fine-grained visual evidence through maximum-similarity late interaction, but dense image-side tokens make storage and scoring expensive. Existing token compression methods reduce this cost, yet they can remove or collapse object- and region-level evidence that future query tokens may need to select. We propose SaMer, an object-aware token merging framework that compresses image-side post-projector tokens into $K$ representative centroids while preserving the original late-interaction interface.
