We then use generative models, including discrete and continuous conditional normalizing flows, to infer posterior distributions within a simulation-based inference framework. Across a range of signal-to-noise ratios, the proposed method achieves improved accuracy, sharper posteriors, and faster inference compared to physics-agnostic baselines. While presented for deterministic white-noise signals, the modular framework readily generalizes to realistic PTA analyses incorporating red noise and additional components. This work highlights the potential of physics-aware deep learning models as scalable alternatives to conventional inference pipelines for next-generation PTA datasets.

</details>


### [327] [NeuroOnline: Bridging Pretraining and Online Adaptation for EEG Foundation Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.03925)
*Weibin Li,Wendu Li,Yushan You,Chen Wei,Quanying Liu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出NeuroOnline，一个用于EEG在线场景的统一框架，通过多视角一致性学习和上下文感知表征调制两种互补机制，解决预训练-静态部署范式中目标任务对齐不足和分布漂移适应性问题，在多个EEG基准上取得优于强基线的在线性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有EEG基础模型采用预训练-静态部署范式，存在两个关键局限：(1)预训练目标与下游任务之间的对齐不足；(2)在线场景中面对分布漂移时适应性有限。因此需要一种能够支持在线连续适应的统一框架。

Method: NeuroOnline包含两种互补机制：(1)多视角一致性学习，通过跨视角对齐促进一致且任务相关的表征；(2)上下文感知表征调制，利用可学习的上下文提示结合交叉注意力机制，动态调整表征以适应演化中的数据分布。两种机制共同实现表征对齐与动态适应的统一。

Result: 在多个EEG基准上的实验表明，NeuroOnline在在线设置中持续优于强基线方法，在分布漂移条件下取得更好的性能。消融研究和敏感性分析进一步验证了每个组件的必要性和整体设计的有效性。

Conclusion: NeuroOnline通过统一表征对齐与动态适应，有效解决了EEG在线场景中分布漂移带来的挑战，为EEG基础模型从静态部署向在线适应范式的转变提供了一种可行的框架。

Abstract: EEG foundation models have shown strong potential in learning generalized representations across subjects and tasks. However, most existing approaches follow a pretraining-static deployment paradigm, which suffers from two key limitations: (1) misalignment between pretraining objectives and downstream tasks, and (2) limited adaptability to distribution shifts in online settings. We propose Online Neural Adaptation (NeuroOnline), a unified framework that enables continuous adaptation in online scenarios. NeuroOnline integrates two complementary mechanisms: (1) multi-view consistency learning, which enforces cross-view alignment to promote consistent and task-relevant representations, and (2) context-aware representation modulation, which leverages a learnable context prompt with cross-attention to dynamically adapt representations to evolving data distributions. Together, these mechanisms unify representation alignment and dynamic adaptation. Experiments on multiple EEG benchmarks show that NeuroOnline consistently outperforms strong baselines in online settings, achieving better performance under distribution shifts. Ablation and sensitivity studies further validate the necessity of each component and the effectiveness of the overall design.

</details>


### [328] [Auto: The AGI Compiler](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.04542)
*Jaber Jaber,Osama Jaber*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出Auto编译器，通过将LLM agent运行时中确定性的行为模式提取为已验证的WebAssembly程序或蒸馏模型，并采用分层运行时和适应性保护机制，在保证输出质量的前提下大幅降低推理成本。在AUTO-BENCH基准上，87.1%的agent运行片段是确定性的，边际成本从59降至2微美元/项，代价是6.4倍的端到端成本增加，同时保持96.9%的一致性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前LLM agent每次运行时都从头开始在大型前沿模型上逐token生成行为，虽效果卓越但成本高昂、速度慢且不可控。作者希望将这种"每次重新发现"的模式转变为"一次发现，永久复用"的模式，将agent运行时产生的确定性行为自动编译为低成本、可验证的永久技能。

Method: Auto系统包含三个核心组件：(1) 记录器：记录agent行为并度量哪些部分是确定性的；(2) 编译器：将确定性部分提取为已验证的WebAssembly程序或蒸馏后的专用模型；(3) 分层运行时：通过校准的保护机制（guards）执行编译行为，当guard触发时回退到原始参考agent，并将捕获的轨迹重新编译。系统采用"认知二进制"（cognition binaries）格式，其声明的能力由沙箱物理执行。

Result: 在AUTO-BENCH基准上，560个记录的frontier-agent运行片段中87.1%被证明是确定性的（四个任务族中有三个达到100.0%）。在包含三次分布漂移的300项流式测试中，闭环系统编译了三代工件，边际成本从59降至2微美元/项（端到端降低6.4倍），在已见证输入上达到96.9%的一致性和零错误。失败模式分析显示：松散的guard导致48.9%的编译答案被错误标记，不忠实的参考agent导致验证门拒绝重新编译。

Conclusion: 校准的精确性和参考agent的忠实度，而非模型能力本身，决定了低成本方案是否能保持正确性。Auto展示了"AGI编译器"在一个狭窄但可测试的定义下的可行性：将新经验自主转化为永久的、已验证的、近乎免费的技能，同时度量自身未知的部分。

Abstract: Every LLM agent run re-derives its behavior token by token on a frontier model: brilliant, expensive, slow, and unbounded. We present Auto, a compiler that records live agent behavior, measures which parts are secretly deterministic, extracts them into verified programs or distilled specialists, and emits cognition binaries: WebAssembly artifacts whose manifests carry measured guarantees and whose declared capabilities are physically enforced by the sandbox. A tiered runtime executes compiled behavior behind conformally calibrated guards; guard trips deopt to the reference agent, and the captured trace recompiles back down, so nothing is figured out twice. We use "AGI compiler" in one narrow, testable sense: a system that autonomously converts novel experience into permanent, verified, near-free skill while measuring what it does not know. On AUTO-BENCH, a benchmark we introduce and pre-register, 87.1% of 560 recorded frontier-agent spans are witnessed-deterministic (three of the four censused task families measure 100.0%). On a 300-item stream with three scheduled distribution shifts, the closed loop compiles three artifact generations and drives marginal cost from 59 to 2 micro-dollars per item (6.4x end-to-end) at 96.9% parity on witnessed inputs with zero errors. The same stream also quantifies the failure modes: a loose guard silently mislabels 48.9% of compiled answers, and an unfaithful deopt reference causes the verification gate to refuse recompilation. Calibration and reference fidelity, not model capability, decide whether cheap stays correct. Code: https://github.com/RightNow-AI/auto

</details>


### [329] [MPSelectTune: Prompt-type Selection for Fine-tuning improves Concept Unlearning in LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.03932)
*Shubhadip Nag,Srinjoy Das,Agniva Saha,Anushree Ghosh,Soumi Das,Tarun Kumar,Suparna Bhattacharya,Sourangshu Bhattacharya*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出MPSelectTune方法，通过对抗性多提示联合训练，在保持主任务性能的同时，更有效地消除预训练LLM中的有害概念，相比基线方法在主任务准确率上提升2-15%，在最坏情况下的概念准确率上降低高达17%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有遗忘方法通常忽略提示变化的影响，导致无法在不同提示类型下鲁棒地移除LLM中存在的偏见或有害概念（如性别、生物武器等），这使得模型在面对多样化提示时仍可能产生不安全或不道德的响应。

Method: 提出MPSelectTune两阶段方法：首先使用多种提示类型进行多任务损失微调；然后通过对抗性方法最小化概念预测准确率最高的提示类型（即"最差提示类型"）的概念准确率，实现联合主任务与概念任务预测的提示优化。

Result: 在四个基准测试上，相比最近基线方法，主任务准确率提升2-15%，同时最坏情况下的概念准确率降低高达17%。

Conclusion: 聚焦"最差提示类型"（概念准确率最高者）进行对抗性微调，比简单组合所有提示类型的微调方法能更有效地提升平均遗忘性能，为鲁棒性概念移除提供了新思路。

Abstract: LLMs can be conveniently adapted to a diverse set of tasks, e.g, prediction, question-answering tasks, etc, using appropriate prompts with few-shot examples. Biased or harmful concepts, e.g. gender or bio-weapons, present in pre-trained LLMs can lead to unsafe or unethical responses for many such prompts. Removing such undesirable concepts robustly across different prompt types remains a challenging problem, since existing unlearning methods typically ignore the impact of prompt variation. In this paper, we explore a novel adversarial approach to use a joint prompt for the main task and concept task prediction. We show that fine-tuning using the ``worst prompt type'' for concept prediction (with the highest concept accuracy) improves the average unlearning performance over a fine-tuning method that uses a combination of all prompt types. Our proposed method, MPSelectTune, is a two-stage approach that minimizes the concept accuracy of the highest accuracy-prompt type, after fine-tuning using a novel multi-task loss using multiple prompt types. Experimental results on four benchmarks show $2 - 15\%$ main task accuracy improvements over recent baselines and while reducing the worst-case concept accuracy by up to $17\%$ compared to recent baselines.

</details>


### [330] [Beyond the Need for Speed: Energy-Aware Code Generation via Simulation-Guided Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.04577)
*Saurabhsingh Rajput,Tushar Sharma*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出Green Tea语料库（350万次评估，1474个C++问题），通过确定性架构仿真替代硬件功耗测量，结合监督微调与闭环强化学习（GRPO）训练能效感知代码模型。在143个保留问题上实现12.63%的CARET指标提升，58.4%的输出超过人类专家能效。同时揭露IPC陷阱：67.8%的问题中IPC会错误排序真实能效，证明直接能耗仿真的必要性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有代码模型严格优化功能正确性，软件能效作为未优化的副产品被忽视。训练能效代码模型需要可复现的规模级反馈，但物理硬件测量因方差无法可靠提供，亟需确定性仿真替代方案。

Method: 1) 构建Green Tea语料库：使用确定性架构仿真（而非硬件功耗测量）对1474个C++问题生成350万次能效评估；2) 两阶段训练：先在能效对比对上监督微调，再通过仿真循环的闭环强化学习（GRPO）优化；3) 提出CARET指标，惩罚牺牲功能换取效率的行为。

Result: 在143个保留问题上实现12.63% CARET提升（接近纯微调的三倍），58.4%有效输出超过人类专家能效。发现IPC在67.8%问题上错误排序真实能效，证实直接能耗仿真的必要性。公开数据集和基础设施，节省263,000 CPU小时的重现成本。

Conclusion: 确定性架构仿真可以替代硬件测量为能效代码模型提供可靠训练信号，直接能耗仿真不可或缺，IPC等代理指标具有误导性。开源工作为社区部署本质上能效感知的代码生成模型奠定基础。

Abstract: Code models strictly prioritize functional correctness, leaving software energy efficiency as an unoptimized byproduct. Training models to generate energy-efficient code requires reproducible feedback at scale, which physical hardware measurement cannot reliably provide due to variance.
  In this paper, we replace hardware profiling with a deterministic architectural simulation harness to build Green Tea, a corpus of $3.5$ million evaluations across $1{,}474$ C++ problems. We train an energy-aware code model via supervised fine-tuning on energy-contrastive pairs, followed by closed-loop reinforcement learning (GRPO) using simulation-in-the-loop feedback. To rigorously evaluate deployment readiness, we introduce the Correctness-Adjusted Reduction in Energy Total (CARET), a metric that explicitly penalizes code that sacrifices functionality for efficiency.
  On $143$ held-out problems, our simulation-in-the-loop pipeline achieves $12.63\%$ CARET, nearly tripling the gain of fine-tuning alone, and successfully beats the energy efficiency of human-expert references on $58.4\%$ of its valid outputs. Furthermore, our analysis exposes the IPC trap: standard throughput proxies like Instructions-Per-Cycle (IPC) actively misrank true energy efficiency on $67.8\%$ of problems, proving the absolute necessity of direct energy simulation. By releasing our dataset and infrastructure, we bypass the $263{,}000$ CPU-hours required for reproduction, structurally empowering the community to deploy inherently energy-efficient code generation models.

</details>


### [331] [Order-based Causal Discovery for Multistage Processes](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.03971)
*Eun-Yeol Ma,Junsub Jung,Heeyoung Kim*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种名为OCDM的因果发现方法，专门用于多阶段过程数据，通过结合过程知识推断因果顺序并利用随机门控神经网络剪枝虚假边，在保持层次和序列结构的同时提升计算效率和准确性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多阶段过程在众多领域普遍存在，但现有因果发现方法在处理这类数据时可能产生反直觉结果，且计算效率低，无法有效利用已知的过程知识。

Method: 提出Order-based Causal Discovery for Multistage Processes (OCDM)方法。包含两个核心模块：(1) 结构知识引导的顺序推断算法，基于有序因果发现框架，利用变量所属阶段信息推断因果顺序；(2) 使用随机门控神经网络进行剪枝，去除虚假边，提升计算效率。

Result: 在多种数据集上的实验表明，OCDM能够有效推断多阶段过程的因果结构，性能优于现有方法。

Conclusion: OCDM通过显式融入过程知识，解决了多阶段数据中因果发现的反直觉和低效问题，为多阶段过程因果结构推断提供了有效方案。

Abstract: Causality has become an increasingly important tool for gaining a deeper understanding of complex systems. Among various causal analysis methods, causal discovery, which identifies causal relationships among variables from data, has been widely used to uncover underlying causality in diverse processes. However, while multistage processes are prevalent in many fields, existing causal discovery methods may produce counterintuitive results, given the known process knowledge, and may not be computationally efficient for handling large datasets typical of multistage processes. To address this gap, we propose a novel causal discovery method called Order-based Causal Discovery for Multistage Processes (OCDM). OCDM is designed to infer the causal structure of multistage data while preserving their inherent hierarchical and sequential structure by explicitly incorporating process knowledge into the causal discovery process. Specifically, we propose a structural knowledge-informed order-inferring algorithm that infers the causal order of variables by incorporating information about the stage from which each variable originates, based on an order-based causal discovery framework naturally suited for inherently ordered multistage data. Furthermore, to eliminate spurious edges from the initial causal graph generated based on the inferred causal order, we introduce a novel pruning technique using stochastic gated neural networks, which offers greater computational efficiency compared to existing methods. Through experiments on various datasets, we demonstrate that OCDM effectively infers the causal structure of multistage processes, outperforming existing methods.

</details>


### [332] [Latent Programming Horizons in Coding Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.05188)
*André Silva,Han Tu,Martin Monperrus*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文发现编码智能体中的语言模型在残差流中线性编码了代码的多种属性（如解析正确性、测试通过率等），并且这些表征能够提前预测未来编辑的结果，即存在“潜在编程视界”（latent programming horizon），探针可在无需重新训练的情况下跨基准迁移。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 尽管编码智能体在执行软件工程任务时需要多步推理、编辑代码和运行测试，但关于底层语言模型内部如何表示正在处理的程序，目前知之甚少。作者旨在揭示这些内部表征的属性和能力。

Method: 使用逻辑回归探针（logistic-regression probe）对语言模型隐藏状态进行解码，检测当前代码是否可解析、是否通过测试、是否减少失败测试数、是否引入回归等属性；并训练探针预测未来编辑的结果（在编辑实际写入磁盘之前），定义“潜在编程视界”。

Result: 探针在正确性预测上AUC最高达0.83（跨两个模型和两个基准）；表征能够提前约25步预测未来编辑结果（高于随机水平）；探针可在不同基准之间无需重新训练即可迁移。

Conclusion: 编码智能体中的语言模型存在关于代码状态的前瞻性线性表征，这为编码智能体的机械可解释性研究开辟了新方向。

Abstract: A coding agent solving a software-engineering task spends dozens of steps reasoning, editing code, and running tests, yet little is known about what the underlying language model internally represents about the program it is working on. We show that the residual streams of language models under coding agents linearly encode properties of the evolving program: a logistic-regression probe on hidden states is able to decode whether the current code parses, passes its test suite, reduces the number of failing tests, and introduces regressions, reaching AUC up to 0.83 for correctness across two models and two benchmarks. Our second finding is more surprising: these representations run ahead of the agent's own edits. Probes trained to predict the outcome of future edits (before they are materialized and written on disk) achieve performance above chance up to roughly 25 steps in advance. We call this the agent's latent programming horizon. As a proof of external validity, we show that the probes transfer across benchmarks without retraining. Our positive results open calls for more research in mechanistic interpretability of coding agents.

</details>


### [333] [MANCE: Manifold Aware Concept Erasure](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.03973)
*Matan Avitan,Yoav Goldberg,Yanai Elazar*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出流形约束假设（MCH），指出自然表示集中在结构化低维流形上，因此概念擦除干预应约束在该流形内以更好地保留其他信息。基于此提出MANCE方法，通过将更新投影到估计的流形上实现非线性概念擦除，在119个文本和视觉设置中达到SOTA。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 概念擦除需要移除目标概念同时保留其他编码信息，但表示中编码的许多概念往往与擦除目标相关，直接移除会损伤其他信息。现有方法未考虑表示的自然流形结构。

Method: 1. 提出流形约束假设（MCH）：自然表示集中在结构化低维流形上，干预应约束在该流形内；2. 提出MANCE：使用分类器信号对表示进行迭代更新，从自然输入中估计流形，将概念移除更新投影到估计流形上；3. 提出MANCE+和MANCE++：先采用闭式擦除算法再使用MANCE。

Result: 在119个设置（13个语言模型、3个NLP概念、40个CelebA-CLIP属性）上评估，MANCE在现有方法基础上持续改进泄漏结果；MANCE++在非线性概念擦除上达到SOTA。

Conclusion: 支持流形约束假设：干预应约束在自然表示流形内。MANCE++在泄漏-外科手术性权衡上优于全空间更新方法。

Abstract: Concept erasure aims to remove a target concept from a representation while preserving the other information encoded in it. This is difficult because representations encode many concepts that are often correlated with the erasure target, so removing the target risks damaging them. We propose the Manifold Constraint Hypothesis (MCH): if natural representations concentrate on a structured, lower-dimensional manifold, then interventions should be constrained to that manifold and better preserve other information encoded in the representation during interventions. We instantiate MCH in a new concept erasure method: MANifold aware Concept Erasure (MANCE). MANCE performs iterative updates to the representations using signals from a classifier that predicts a target concept. We estimate the manifold using representations obtained from natural inputs, and then we project the concept removal update to the estimated manifold. We perform extensive evaluation on 119 settings spanning text and vision, including 13 language models, three NLP concepts, and 40 CelebA-CLIP attributes. Employing MANCE on top of previous methods shows consistent improved leakage results. We also introduce MANCE+ and MANCE++, which prepend a closed-form erasure algorithm before employing MANCE, achieving better leakage--surgicality tradeoffs relative to matched full-space updates. MANCE++, our best method, achieves state-of-the-art results on nonlinear concept erasure. These results support MCH in the erasure setting: interventions should be constrained to the natural representation manifold.

</details>


### [334] [Knowing When to Stop: Predicting Execution-Consistency Convergence in Text-to-SQL](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.03991)
*Yaron Anavi,Mor Aisenberg,Nadav Nesher,Elena Khabibullina,Isabella Cattinelli*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种轻量级1-D模型，用于预测Text-to-SQL结果一致性何时收敛，从而动态决定重复调用的停止时机，在BIRD基准和两个生产数据集上验证了有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 重复LLM调用是估计Text-to-SQL结果可信度的标准方法，但何时停止重复（即一致性何时收敛）是一个未解决的问题，需要一种自适应停止机制来平衡计算成本与可靠性。

Method: 将问题形式化为收敛预测问题，训练一系列轻量级1-D模型，观察运行中的一致性轨迹，在每一步决定是否继续运行；与Beta-Bernoulli停止规则和基于运行次数的基线进行对比；利用运行间弱序列相关性，以可调洗牌权重进行顺序重排作为训练增强。

Result: 在BIRD基准和两个生产数据集上，该方法能针对每个用户问题自适应调整停止点，在一致性早期收敛时提前停止，晚期收敛时继续运行。性能在三个数据集上保持一致，且注入噪声后仍能可靠预测收敛。

Conclusion: 该动态停止方法能有效平衡Text-to-SQL一致性评估的计算成本与可靠性，对不完美的评判者具有鲁棒性。

Abstract: Repeated LLM calls are the standard way to estimate how trustworthy a Text-to-SQL result is: run the pipeline multiple times, judge each SQL execution, and use the consistency of the verdicts as a confidence signal. The open question is when to stop, when the consistency has converged. We formulate this as a convergence-prediction problem and train a family of lightweight 1-D models that observe the running consistency trajectory and decide, at each step, whether further runs are unlikely to shift it materially, and we benchmark them against a principled Beta-Bernoulli stopping rule and a learned run-count baseline. On the BIRD benchmark and two production customer datasets, our method adapts its stopping point to each user question, halting sooner when consistency converges early and continuing longer when it converges late. We further show that the weak serial correlation between runs lets us permute their order as a training augmentation, controlled by a tunable shuffling weight. Performance stays consistent across the three datasets, and to mimic an imperfect production judge we inject noise into the correct/incorrect verdicts obtained by comparing the generated and ground-truth SQL results, showing that the method still predicts convergence reliably.

</details>


### [335] [Directional Curvature from Armijo Backtracking: A Low-Cost Sharpness Probe and a Calibration-Free Learning-Rate Safeguard for Adam](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.03998)
*Ashmitha R,Jörg Frochte*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出利用Armijo回溯线搜索中的步长α来低成本估计损失曲面的局部尖锐度（最大Hessian特征值λ₁），两者在多个基准上呈高度负相关（Pearson -0.91至-0.95）。初始化时进行一次该测量即可获得学习率上限，使Adam在10⁻³至3.0的超宽学习率范围内保持鲁棒，开销仅约1%。沿Adam自身更新方向进行探测可消除架构依赖的校准需求，单一安全因子κ=2即可在9种架构和4个基准上避免发散，且该方案可直接迁移至AdamW。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 测量损失曲面的局部尖锐度（最大Hessian特征值λ₁）通常需要Lanczos或Hessian-vector迭代，计算成本高。本文旨在寻找一种低成本的替代测量方法，并利用其指导学习率选择，使优化器对初始学习率更加鲁棒。

Method: 观察到Armijo回溯线搜索中接受的步长α与方向曲率q=gᵀHg/∥g∥²成反比，且被回溯因子约束在乘法带内。通过实验验证logα与logλ₁在CIFAR-10、Fashion-MNIST、Imagenette上呈高度负相关（Pearson -0.91至-0.95）。利用初始化时的一次测量获得学习率上限，作为Adam的安全保护机制。进一步提出沿Adam自身更新方向进行探测，使用固定安全因子κ=2消除架构依赖的校准需求。

Result: 该方法使Adam在10⁻³到3.0超过三个数量级的学习率范围内保持鲁棒，额外开销仅约1%。当所选学习率原本安全时，该机制相当于no-op。沿Adam方向探测配合κ=2在9种架构和所有基准的完整学习率网格上避免发散，且直接迁移至AdamW。

Conclusion: 提出了一种低成本、无需额外复杂计算的在线Edge-of-Stability读数方法，能有效提供学习率安全上限，使优化器对超参数选择更加鲁棒。沿优化器方向探测的方案无需架构特定的校准，具有良好泛化性。

Abstract: The local sharpness of the loss, the top Hessian eigenvalue $λ_1$, determines the largest stable gradient step, but measuring it normally requires Lanczos or Hessian-vector iterations. We observe that a single Armijo backtracking line search already carries this information at the cost of a few forward passes: the accepted step $α$ brackets the \emph{directional} curvature $q = g^\top H g/\|g\|^2$ within the multiplicative band set by the backtracking factor. Across CIFAR-10, Fashion-MNIST and Imagenette, $\logα$ tracks $\logλ_1$ at Pearson $-0.91$ to $-0.95$, giving a low-cost online Edge-of-Stability reading. Used once at initialisation, this measurement yields a learning-rate cap (a safeguard, not a faster optimiser) that makes Adam robust to a too-large initial learning rate across more than three orders of magnitude ($10^{-3}$ to $3.0$), at about one percent overhead, and it is a no-op when the chosen rate is already safe. One probe is enough: periodic in-training probing adds no robust benefit. The raw-gradient probe exposes the mechanism but needs a safety factor calibrated to the architecture by a one-minute divergence sweep. Probing along Adam's own update direction removes this calibration: a single fixed safety factor $κ= 2$ avoids divergence on all nine architectures we test and across the full learning-rate grids of all four benchmarks, and the recipe transfers to AdamW unchanged.

</details>


### [336] [When Does Small Data Work? Accuracy and Efficiency Trade-offs Between Tabular Foundation Models and Conventional Methods for Crowd-State Classification at Hajj and Umrah](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.04013)
*AlJawharh S. AlOtaibi,Mohamed Eltahir,Jude AlSubaie*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究了在标注数据稀缺的表格机器学习场景下（以朝觐人群监控为例），对比基础模型（tabular foundation models）与标准机器学习方法在人群状态分类任务上的表现。结果表明：没有一种方法在所有情况下最优，选择取决于标签预算——标签极少时基础模型领先，标签增多时传统调优模型赶上甚至超越基础模型，二者在计算效率上也有显著差异。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标签稀缺是表格机器学习的核心挑战，尤其在标注成本高昂的领域（如朝觐和副朝人群监控）。近期提出的表格基础模型声称无需任务特定训练即可从少量样本预测，但缺乏系统性的实证对比研究，因此需要评估其在稀缺标签场景下的实际帮助程度。

Method: 使用三个真实数据集，在未调优和调优两种形式下，评估多种标准机器学习模型与三种表格基础模型在人群状态分类任务上的表现。通过标签预算（标签数量）和计算预算两个维度系统比较准确率与效率的权衡。

Result: 没有单一方法在所有场景下最优。标签极少时基础模型领先；标签增多时调优的传统机器学习模型赶上并显著超越基础模型（尤其是在具有结构几何特征的目标上）。效率方面，调优的ML模型有较大调优成本，基础模型虽免于调优但每次推理需重新处理上下文。

Conclusion: 总结为一张实用选择地图：在给定标签预算和计算预算下，应优先选择哪种方法。基础模型适合极低标签场景，传统ML模型在标签充足时表现更优且效率更高。

Abstract: Learning from few labeled examples is a central challenge in tabular machine learning, and it becomes the binding constraint in domains where labeling is costly, such as crowd monitoring during Hajj and Umrah. Tabular foundation models, which predict from only a handful of examples without task-specific training, were recently introduced to address this very-few-label regime. In this study we test them on crowd-state classification to assess how much they help when labels are scarce, and we compare them against standard machine learning methods to characterize the accuracy and efficiency trade-offs between the two approaches. Using three real datasets we evaluate different machine learning models, in untuned and tuned forms, against three foundation models. Results show that no single family is best everywhere. The right choice depends on the label budget. When labels are very few, foundation models lead. As labels grow, tuned conventional models catch up and significantly surpass the foundation models on the more structural geometry target. Efficiency separates them further where tuned machine learning models incur a large tuning cost that foundation models avoid, although foundation models reprocess their context at every prediction. We summarize these results as a practical map of which approach to prefer under a given label budget and computational budget.

</details>


### [337] [A Unified Algebraic Framework for Classification Performance Evaluation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.04028)
*Ronaldo C. Prati*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出一个统一的代数框架，通过二元指示矩阵和三种聚合算子（全局、列向、行向，对应微/宏/样本平均），将二分类、多分类、多标签、序数、分层、代价敏感和软标签等所有分类评估场景统一在一个形式化体系内，并建立了若干理论结果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有分类性能评估方法在不同场景（二分类、多分类、多标签等）下各自独立发展，缺乏统一的代数形式化体系，导致度量迁移需要重新推导，且不同聚合方式（微/宏/样本平均）的理论关系不明确。

Method: 将真实标签和预测标签表示为二元指示矩阵，定义三种聚合算子（全局、列向、行向）对应微平均、宏/加权平均和样本平均；通过替换算子自动扩展任意二元度量到多分类和多标签；使用argmax/阈值处理软分类器输出，t-范数处理软标签，代价矩阵处理代价敏感评估。

Result: 建立了微平均等于分母加权宏平均的等式；证明乘积t-范数是唯一保持混淆矩阵划分的t-范数；刻画了偏斜不变度量为召回率和特异度的函数；证明多分类下微精度、微召回率和微F1均等于准确率。

Conclusion: 该框架统一了多种分类评估场景，简化了度量的跨场景迁移，并为不同聚合方式之间的关系提供了理论保证。

Abstract: We propose a unified algebraic framework for classification performance evaluation that encompasses binary, multiclass, multilabel, ordinal, hierarchical, cost-sensitive, and soft-label settings within a single formalism. The foundation is a representation of actual and predicted labels as binary indicator matrices, combined with three aggregation operators -- global, column-wise, and row-wise -- that correspond exactly to micro, macro/weighted, and exemplar averaging. Any binary performance measure expressed in terms of true/positive/negative counts extends automatically to all settings by substituting these operators, generating multiclass and multilabel versions without measure-specific derivations. The framework further accommodates soft classifier outputs via argmax or thresholding, soft ground truth via triangular norms, ordinal classification via membership functions or cumulative encodings, and cost-sensitive evaluation via a cost matrix that subsumes MAE and MSE as special cases. We establish several theoretical results: micro-averaging equals denominator-weighted macro-averaging; the product $t$-norm is the unique one preserving the confusion-matrix partition; skew-invariant measures are characterised as functions of recall and specificity; and micro-precision, micro-recall, and micro-$F_1$ are all equal to accuracy in multiclass settings. Empirical illustrations on synthetic and real data confirm the theoretical findings.

</details>


### [338] [OmniOpt: Taxonomy, Geometry, and Benchmarking of Modern Optimizers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.04033)
*Siyuan Li,Jiabao Pan,Yumou Liu,Zhuoli Ouyang,Xin Jin,Xinglong Xu,Jingxuan Wei,Shengye Pang,Jintao Che,Xuanhe Zhou,Conghui He,Cheng Tan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: OmniOpt提供了一个统一的优化器调查和基准测试框架，通过五阶段元流水线、线性最小化预言机统一、双维度分类法以及跨领域基准测试，为大规模模型训练中的优化器选择提供系统化的决策坐标。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大规模模型训练中，优化器选择已成为受计算、内存、调参预算和任务多样性共同约束的系统级设计决策，但现有百余种优化器方法碎片化严重，缺乏统一的比较和选择框架。

Method: (1) 将每个优化器更新视为通过五阶段元流水线的结构化变换；(2) 使用范数约束的线性最小化预言机统一不同优化器；(3) 构建双维度分类法，按机制族和可测量的训练目标进行分类；(4) 在代表性优化器、模型规模和训练范式上进行跨领域基准测试。

Result: 建立了跨领域统一基准，涵盖语言模型预训练到图像分类等任务，系统分析了各方法族在多个效果目标上的表现和权衡。

Conclusion: 为研究社区提供了在明确机制和目标假设下选择优化器的操作坐标系统，并指明了优化器社区未来的发展方向。

Abstract: Optimizer selection for large-scale model training has become a system-level design decision constrained jointly by compute, memory, tuning budget, and task diversity, yet the landscape of over one hundred methods remains fragmented. We therefore present OmniOpt, a unified survey and benchmark cookbook of optimizers for the research community. OmniOpt rests on four coupled components. First, we treat every optimizer update as a structured transformation through a five-stage meta-pipeline, and show that most methods engage only one or two of these stages. Second, we use norm-constrained linear minimization oracles (LMOs) to unify different optimizers. Third, these two views ground a dual-dimension taxonomy, one dimension assigning each method to a mechanism family and the other recording the measurable training objectives it aims to improve. Fourth, and at the core of this paper, we instantiate the full taxonomy in a unified cross-domain benchmark spanning representative optimizers, model scales, and training regimes from language model pretraining to image classification, systematically analyzing each method family across multiple effect objectives and laying out their trade-offs. OmniOpt thus supplies the research community with an operational coordinate system for selecting optimizers under explicit mechanism and objective assumptions, and charts a direction for the future development of the optimizer community.

</details>


### [339] [Reward-Gated On-Policy Distillation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.04037)
*Mohammad Sadegh Akhondzadeh,Vijay Lingam,Atula Tejaswi,Chanakya Ekbote,Sujay Sanghavi,Aleksandar Bojchevski*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出RG-OPD（奖励门控在线策略蒸馏）方法，通过验证器反馈决定何时信任教师logits，解决在线策略蒸馏中教师监督不可靠的问题，在推理和代码基准上优于现有方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在线策略蒸馏中，教师对学生的token级监督不可靠：教师可能给不正确的解决方案分配高概率，或给不同推理路径的正确学生解决方案分配低概率，无条件蒸馏会强化错误模式或消除有用的学生行为。

Method: RG-OPD使用验证器反馈作为门控机制，决定何时信任教师logits，桥接稀疏的验证器奖励和密集的教师logits，在保留token级监督的同时过滤误导性的教师信号。

Result: 在1K生成长度下，RG-OPD比reverse-KL蒸馏提升2.9个点，比TSD-KD基线提升4.9个点；在长生成长度下，比未调优的学生提升8.2个点。

Conclusion: RG-OPD通过奖励门控机制有效过滤不可靠的教师信号，在推理和代码基准上产生更强的蒸馏学生模型。

Abstract: On-policy distillation is a powerful way to transfer reasoning ability from a strong teacher to a smaller student: the student samples trajectories from its own policy, and the teacher provides dense token-level supervision on the states the student actually visits. However, this supervision is not always reliable: a teacher can assign high likelihood to plausible but incorrect solutions, or low likelihood to correct student solutions that follow different reasoning paths. Unconditionally distilling the teacher can therefore reinforce bad modes or erase useful student behavior. To address these limitations, we introduce RG-OPD: Reward-Gated On-Policy Distillation that uses verifier feedback to decide when teacher logits should be trusted. RG-OPD bridges sparse verifier rewards and dense teacher logits, preserving token-level supervision while filtering misleading teacher signals. Across reasoning and coding benchmarks, RG-OPD produces stronger distilled students, outperforming both vanilla reverse-KL distillation and the recent TSD-KD baseline. At 1K generation length, RG-OPD improves over reverse-KL by 2.9 points and over TSD-KD by 4.9 points; in the long-generation setting, it improves over the untuned student by 8.2 points. Our code is available at https://github.com/UoC-tail/RG-OPD.

</details>


### [340] [A Unified Framework for In-Context Learning with Causal and Masked Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.04081)
*Chenrui Liu,Chuanlong Xie,Falong Tan,Yicheng Zeng,Lixing Zhu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文建立了统一的统计学习框架，分析了掩码语言模型和自回归语言模型在上下文学习（ICL）中的泛化误差上界，证明了二者在Wasserstein正则性条件下具有相同阶的k-shot过剩风险上界，并通过实验验证了掩码模型（MPE）在ICL任务上可达到与GPT-2相当的性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有ICL理论分析主要聚焦于因果语言模型（如GPT），对掩码语言模型在ICL中的表现缺乏理论理解。本文希望统一分析这两种预训练目标下ICL行为的理论保证。

Method: 利用经验测度表示上下文示例，将预训练与推理阶段的过剩风险统一纳入统计学习框架。在Wasserstein型正则性条件下，推导预训练（T个任务、每任务N样本）与k-shot推理过剩风险的上界关系；同时分析任务分布偏移情况，引入提升Wasserstein距离控制额外项。

Result: 1）掩码目标与自回归目标具有相同阶的过剩风险上界；2）任务分布偏移下，误差上界含由提升Wasserstein距离控制的附加项；3）固定预训练数据预算下存在最优分配策略，低维结构可改善收敛速率；4）MPE在控制函数学习任务上表现与GPT-2相当。

Conclusion: ICL行为并非因果语言模型特有，掩码语言模型在合适的框架下同样具备ICL能力，且理论保证与自回归模型一致。

Abstract: In-context learning (ICL) has emerged as a central capability of pretrained language models, yet its theoretical analysis has focused primarily on causal language models trained by left-to-right autoregressive prediction, such as GPT-style models. Masked language models instead recover masked tokens from bidirectional context, and their role in ICL remains less understood. We develop a statistical learning framework that represents the context examples by their empirical measure and models prediction as a function of the context and the query. This formulation places autoregressive and masked pretraining objectives within a common excess-risk analysis. Under Wasserstein-type regularity conditions, we relate pretraining with T tasks and N samples per task to k-shot excess risk at inference, obtaining same-order upper bounds for masked and autoregressive objectives. We also study task-distribution shift, where pretraining tasks are sampled from P and inference tasks from Q; the resulting bound contains an additional term controlled by the lifted Wasserstein distance between P and Q. The bounds further imply an order-optimal allocation under a fixed pretraining data budget and refined rates under intrinsic low-dimensional structure. Experiments on controlled function-learning tasks show that the Masked Pair Encoder (MPE) can achieve performance comparable to GPT-2-style causal Transformers, suggesting that ICL behavior is not specific to causal language models.

</details>


### [341] [FedSPM: Routing-Enabled Federated Learning under Dual Heterogeneity via Semiparametric Mixture](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.04085)
*Zijian Wang,Pengfei Li,Guangyu Yang,Qiong Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出FedSPM框架，通过半参数混合模型同时捕捉客户端间和客户端内异质性（双重异质性），利用经验似然估计的密度比建模特征分布，并设计联邦EM算法，在路由预测联邦学习中实现更优的路由与预测性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有路由预测联邦学习将客户端视为内部同质的整体，忽略了客户内部存在的潜在子群（如医院中同一诊断的不同疾病亚型）。这种客户端间和客户端内异质性并存（即双重异质性）会损害路由和预测性能，亟需一种能同时建模双重异质性的方法。

Method: 提出FedSPM半参数混合框架：每个客户端由多个潜在成分表示，每个成分包含分类预测分布和路由特征分布；特征分布通过相对于公共非参测度的密度比建模，并利用经验似然进行估计；开发联邦EM算法优化可处理的替代目标，并证明在替代误差可控时精确剖面目标以O(1/√T)速率收敛。

Result: 在受控基准和真实医学数据上的实验表明，FedSPM在双重异质性下持续改善了路由和预测性能。

Conclusion: FedSPM通过半参数混合模型有效应对了联邦学习中的双重异质性挑战，在路由和预测方面均优于现有方法。

Abstract: Routing-prediction federated learning has emerged as a new paradigm that reframes inter-client heterogeneity as a resource for system-level intelligence: at inference time, the server routes each external query to the best-matched client for prediction. Existing approaches, however, typically treat each client as internally homogeneous, overlooking latent subpopulations within local data. For example, patients with the same diagnosis at one hospital may exhibit morphologically distinct disease subtypes. The coexistence of inter-client and intra-client heterogeneity, which we call dual heterogeneity, can impair both routing and prediction. To address this challenge, we propose FedSPM, a routing-enabled semiparametric mixture framework that represents each client using client-specific latent components. Each component combines a predictive distribution for classification with a feature distribution for routing. To flexibly model feature distributions while effectively sharing information across clients, FedSPM models their density ratios relative to a common nonparametric measure estimated via empirical likelihood. We develop a federated expectation-maximization algorithm that optimizes a tractable surrogate and prove convergence of the exact profiled objective at the standard $\mathcal{O}(1/\sqrt{T})$ rate when the surrogate errors are properly controlled. Experiments on controlled benchmarks and real-world medical data demonstrate consistent improvements in routing and prediction under dual heterogeneity. Code is available at https://github.com/zijianwang0510/FedSPM.

</details>


### [342] [Target-Aware Interaction-Guided Reinforcement Learning for Black-Box Node Injection Attacks on Graph Neural Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.04091)
*Yi Lan,Ye Yuan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出TIRBA，一种基于目标感知交互引导强化学习的黑盒节点注入攻击方法，通过将攻击建模为马尔可夫决策过程并在异构动作空间中联合优化节点特征生成和边构建，显著优于现有方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有黑盒节点注入攻击方法将恶意节点的特征生成和边连接解耦处理，导致在严格预算下攻击效果次优。

Method: 1) 目标感知交互编码器融合节点特征和边信息；2) 类中心引导机制利用先验类别分布信息指导高维特征空间探索；3) 拓扑差异感知状态值评估捕获注入节点引起的局部结构异常以稳定强化学习训练。

Result: TIRBA在多个数据集上显著优于现有最先进的黑盒节点注入攻击方法。

Conclusion: TIRBA通过联合优化节点特征和边连接，有效提升了黑盒节点注入攻击在严格预算下的攻击效能。

Abstract: Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) have achieved remarkable performance in graph representation learning, yet their inherent vulnerability to adversarial attacks poses severe security risks. Especially, black-box node injection attacks have become a major threat to GNNs since they inject malicious nodes without altering the original graph topology. However, they typically decouple the generation of malicious node features and edge connections, thereby resulting in suboptimal attack efficacy under stringent budgets. To address this critical issue, this study proposes a novel Target-aware Interaction-guided Reinforcement learning for Black-box node injection Attacks on GNNs (TIRBA), which formulates the attack as a Markov Decision Process and jointly optimizes node feature generation and edge construction in a heterogeneous action space. Firstly, TIRBA designs a target-aware interaction encoder to fuse information of node features and edges. Further, it introduces a class-center guidance mechanism to utilize prior class distribution information, thereby guiding efficient exploration of the high-dimensional feature space. Finally, a topology difference-aware state value evaluation is adopted to explicitly capture local structural anomalies caused by injected nodes, thereby stabilizing the reinforcement learning training process. Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed TIRBA significantly outperforms state-of-the-art black-box node injection attack methods.

</details>


### [343] [Dictionaries, Not Darwin: Set-Level Selection Beats LLM Evolution in Scientific Equation Discovery](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.04108)
*Pan Li*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文揭示科学方程发现中，基于LLM的迭代进化循环（生成-选择-反馈）在有限样本下与独立随机采样无异，无法有效提升发现能力。作者诊断该循环实质仅产生候选词字典，进而提出PTB-Search单代方法：一次独立采样后提取可复用组件，在训练集上执行集合级稀疏选择。实验表明，集合级选择器性能远超单词条缩减，PTB-Search在标准LLM-SRBench上以十分之一调用预算达到73.2%-77.0%准确率，远超基线49.2%。结论：LLM充当物料供应商，真正的发现由外部集合级选择驱动。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 审计LLM驱动的迭代进化循环（生成-选择-反馈）在科学方程发现中是否真正能复合累积发现成果。在有限样本导致结构欠定且插值容易的场景下，该循环的效果存疑。

Method: 首先通过对照实验证明父代条件化进化与独立采样无显著差异；然后提出PTB-Search方法，包含三步：一次独立LLM采样提案、提取可复用术语构建词典、在训练集上执行集合级稀疏选择（基于最小二乘系数），核心思想是欠定数据中集合行为可靠而单术语信用不可靠。

Result: 1) 父代条件化进化与独立采样无显著差异（OOD NMSE 0.045 vs 0.049）；2) 集合级选择器（165-169/717）远超单术语缩减（74-78/717）；3) PTB-Search在LLM-SRBench上达到73.2%-77.0% Acc0.1，为基线49.2%的1.5倍以上，仅用十分之一调用预算。

Conclusion: LLM应被视为物料供应商而非发现引擎；科学发现的核心机制是外部集合级选择作用于可复用组件。程序域压力测试表明生成计数不可靠，保留外部状态在更困难非线性空间中有帮助。

Abstract: Large language models are increasingly used as evolutionary engines for scientific discovery: generate candidates, select winners, feed them back as parents, and repeat. We audit whether this loop actually compounds discovery in scientific equation discovery, a setting where finite samples make structure underdetermined and interpolation easy. Under matched LLM-call budgets, parent-conditioned evolution is indistinguishable from fresh independent sampling: median OOD NMSE is 0.045 vs. 0.049, instructed multi-parent crossover is worse, final success is predicted by initial proposal quality, and multiple iteration schemes fail to add solved problems. Operationally, the loop reduces to what it produces: a dictionary of candidate terms. We turn that diagnosis into PTB-Search, a one-generation method for componentized scientific discovery. PTB-Search samples independent LLM proposals once, extracts reusable terms into a per-problem dictionary, and performs train-only set-level sparse selection with least-squares coefficients. Its central principle is that underdetermined data identifies the joint behavior of term sets, not reliable per-term credit. On identical dictionaries and zero additional LLM calls, set-level selectors solve 165--169 of 717 cells, while single-term reductions solve only 74--78. On the official 239-problem LLM-SRBench split, PTB-Search reaches 73.2% Acc0.1 with Llama-3.1-8B and 77.0% with a single-seed DeepSeek-V4 anchor, versus 49.2% for the best reported baseline, using one tenth of the standardized call budget. A program-domain stress test gives a scoped boundary: generation count remains unreliable, while retained external state can help in harder non-linear spaces. Across these results, LLMs are best understood as material suppliers; discovery is carried by external set-level selection over reusable components.

</details>


### [344] [DynaVieW: Schema-Guided World Modeling for Understanding Hierarchical Visual Dynamics](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.04112)
*Silin Gao,Hao Zhao,Zeming Chen,Sepideh Mamooler,Antara Raaghavi Bhattacharya,Qiyu Wu,Hiromi Wakaki,Yuki Mitsufuji,Li Mi,Syrielle Montariol,Antoine Bosselut*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出DynaVieW，一种动态模式引导的世界模型，通过层次化模式学习视觉序列中的状态-转换动态，在视觉叙事生成和世界模拟任务上提升了一致性、可控性和指令跟随能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多模态大语言模型在视频或多图像序列中难以系统建模视觉场景的时间演化，无法有效预测或模拟动态成分（如动作及其导致的视觉环境变化）。

Method: 学习交错的**状态-转换序列**（状态来自视频关键帧的广泛视觉场景，转换捕获层次化模式中的动态成分）；采用**混合专家架构**联合建模转换预测与状态模拟，结合**跨专家选择性注意力**和**模式令牌重加权损失**。

Result: 在视觉叙事生成和世界模拟的下游任务中，DynaVieW在一致性、可控性和指令跟随方面均取得提升。

Conclusion: 动态模式引导的层次化状态-转换建模能有效提升多模态模型对视觉动态的理解与生成能力。

Abstract: Multimodal LLMs struggle to systematically model the temporal evolution of visual scenes in videos or multi-image sequences. Such inputs require models to predict or simulate multiple levels of dynamic constituents, such as actions taken in the visual sequence, and the associated changes to the visual environment that result. To address this challenge, we propose a dynamic schema-guided world model, DynaVieW, optimized for visual dynamic prediction and simulation. DynaVieW achieves an in-depth understanding of visual dynamics by learning interleaved state-transition sequences, where states cover broad visual scenes from video keyframes, and transitions capture comprehensive dynamic constituents within a hierarchical schema. DynaVieW jointly models transition prediction and state simulation under a mixture-of-experts architecture, with a cross-expert selective attention and a schema token re-weighted loss, to ensure effective and robust learning. DynaVieW's understanding of visual dynamics boosts its downstream performance in visual narrative creation and world simulation, showing improved consistency, controllability, and instruction-following.

</details>


### [345] [GlacierCastAI: Predicting Glacier Retreat from Multi-Modal Satellite Imagery and Climate Signals](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.04117)
*Arunkumar Ramachandran*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出 GlacierCastAI，融合多时相 Landsat 影像、ERA5 再分析气候变量和 DEM 地形特征，将冰川边界预测重构为多模态时空预测问题。在五个冰川上的实验表明，加入 ERA5 气候信号可将 IoU 从 0.326 提升至 0.337（+3.4%），且纯气候 MLP 基线用 85 倍更少参数达到了影像模型 98% 的性能。SHAP 分析显示春季太阳辐射是主导气候驱动因子。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有深度学习方法仅关注从卫星影像映射当前冰川边界，而忽略了 ERA5 季节性气候变量中包含的预测未来冰川退缩的信息。本文旨在将冰川边界预测从当前映射问题扩展为未来预测问题。

Method: 将冰川边界预测建模为多模态时空预测问题，使用 Landsat 多时相影像、ERA5 再分析气候变量和 Copernicus DEM 地形特征，构建耦合 ResNet50 空间编码器、ConvLSTM 时序模型和交叉注意力气候融合模块的架构。

Result: 加入 ERA5 气候信号使 IoU 从 0.326 提升至 0.337（+3.4%）；深度学习模型大幅超越持久性和线性趋势基线（IoU 0.160 和 0.169），相对 IoU 提升 89-99%；纯气候 MLP 基线（661K 参数）达 IoU 0.320，为影像模型 98% 性能，参数减少 85 倍。

Conclusion: 大气强迫（尤其春季太阳辐射）携带超越影像本身的预测信号，气候变量可独立于卫星影像编码显著的预测信息，将气候数据纳入深度学习模型能有效提升冰川边界预测能力。

Abstract: ERA5 seasonal climate variables contain predictive information about future glacier retreat beyond what satellite imagery alone provides, yet existing deep learning methods focus on mapping current boundaries rather than forecasting future ones. This paper presents GlacierCastAI, which reframes glacier boundary prediction as a multi-modal spatiotemporal forecasting problem, fusing multi-temporal Landsat imagery with ERA5 reanalysis climate variables and Copernicus DEM terrain features to forecast glacier boundaries across five glaciers spanning four climate regimes. The architecture couples a ResNet50 spatial encoder with a ConvLSTM temporal model and a cross-attention climate fusion module. Because forecasting is inherently more uncertain than mapping current boundaries, the reported IoU values (0.320-0.337) are not directly comparable to state-of-the-art mapping models. Comparisons are against traditional baselines and experimental conditions. Through a pre-registered ablation study, adding ERA5 climate signals improves image-only IoU from 0.326 to 0.337 (+3.4%), suggesting that atmospheric forcing carries predictive information beyond imagery alone. All deep learning models substantially outperform persistence and linear trend baselines (IoU 0.160 and 0.169 respectively), with improvements of 89-99% relative IoU. A lightweight climate-only MLP baseline (661K parameters) achieves an IoU of 0.320 (98% of image-only performance) using 85x fewer parameters, suggesting that ERA5 variables encode substantial predictive signal independently of satellite imagery. SHAP attribution analysis suggests that spring solar radiation (MAM) is the dominant climate driver, consistent with the known role of spring insolation in setting melt season trajectories.

</details>


### [346] [Parametric Memory Decoding for Zero-Shot Routing in LoRA-Based External Parametric Memory](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.04118)
*Fengxian Ji,Zhuohan Xie,Jingpu Yang,Fan Zhang,Zirui Song,Xiuying Chen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出参数记忆解码（PMD）框架，将零样本LoRA路由重构为对外部参数记忆的激活解码过程，并基于该框架实例化PMDRouter方法，通过单次基模型预填充的响应幅度对LoRA进行评分，在构建的PMD-Bench基准上实现了最优的内部信号路由性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于LoRA的外部参数记忆（EPM）路由方法需要维护额外的路由组件，带来训练、部署和维护开销。虽然已有零样本LoRA路由方法，但存在两个问题：(1) 评估分散在不同任务设置中，未围绕EPM访问进行组织；(2) 路由信号缺乏统一视角来指导系统性改进。因此需要一种无需额外路由组件的零样本LoRA路由方案。

Method: (1) 构建PMD-Bench基准，覆盖文档级、领域级知识和任务技能三种EPM访问场景；(2) 提出PMD框架，将零样本LoRA路由重新定义为"在外部参数记忆上的激活解码"；(3) 基于PMD实例化PMDRouter方法，通过对单个基模型预填充计算每个LoRA的响应幅度来评分。

Result: 在PMD-Bench上的实验表明，PMDRouter在多种零样本路由设置下取得了最强的内部信号性能，验证了零样本LoRA路由的可行性。

Conclusion: PMD可以作为通用框架用于改进零样本路由方法，证明了在不维护额外路由组件的情况下实现LoRA路由的可行性。

Abstract: With the rise of parametric memory, LoRA-based External Parametric Memory (EPM) has emerged as a modular solution, but existing routing methods often introduce additional training, deployment, and maintenance overhead. This raises a natural question: can a LoRA-based EPM bank be routed without maintaining an additional routing component? However, existing zero-shot LoRA routing methods still face two problems under the EPM setting: (1) their evaluations are scattered across different task settings rather than organized around EPM access, and (2) their routing signals lack a unified perspective to guide systematic improvement. To address these problems, we organize PMD-Bench, covering document-level, domain-level knowledge, and task-skill, and propose Parametric Memory Decoding (PMD), the first framework designed to systematically improve zero-shot LoRA routing by reframing it as decoding activations over external parametric memory. Based on PMD, we further instantiate PMDRouter, which scores each LoRA by its response magnitude from a single base-model prefill. Experiments on PMD-Bench show that PMDRouter achieves the strongest internal-signal performance across multiple zero-shot routing settings. These results demonstrate the feasibility of zero-shot LoRA routing and suggest that PMD can serve as a general framework for improving zero-shot routing methods. Sources: Github (https://anonymous.4open.science/r/Parametric-Memory-Decoding-872A/)

</details>


### [347] [CertMix: Certified, Data-Efficient Metamaterial Design by Affine Mixing of Aligned Neural-Implicit Weight Spaces](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.04123)
*Yifan Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出CertMix框架，通过少量样本（50个）即可实现力学超材料的逆向设计，将均化弹性张量近似为混合系数的线性函数，实现高精度外推和分布自由证书，性能比传统方法提升2-3个数量级。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于学习的力学超材料逆向设计方法数据需求量大、多为插值型且无法保证生成设计满足规格要求。

Method: 1) 将每个单元单元表示为小型周期神经隐式场（SIREN有符号距离解码器），使权重向量对齐可比；2) 在对齐的权重空间中，均化弹性张量近似为混合系数的线性函数；3) 将目标设计转化为带约束的仿射混合问题，使用可微分周期均化器求解；4) 负系数支持外推，线性失配置信域保证混合有效性，分裂保形校准提供无分布证书。

Result: 仅需50个样本，缩放属性误差达10^{-4}，比条件生成基线低2-3个数量级；远超出样本范围仍保持准确；比逐目标拓扑优化快57倍，避免棋盘格和封闭空洞；可扩展到空间梯度场、3D三周期表面及认证的跑鞋中底应用。

Conclusion: CertMix是一种数据高效、可外推、带证书保证的力学超材料逆向设计框架，在精度、泛化能力和效率上均显著优于现有方法。

Abstract: Inverse design of mechanical metamaterials seeks a periodic unit cell whose homogenized elastic properties meet a prescribed target, but current learning-based methods are data-hungry, mostly interpolative, and provide no guarantee that the generated design satisfies the specification. We introduce CertMix, a data-efficient framework that represents each exemplar unit cell as a small periodic neural implicit field, specifically a SIREN signed-distance decoder overfit from a shared anchor, so that exemplar weight vectors become aligned and directly comparable. The key observation is that, in this aligned weight space, the homogenized elasticity tensor is approximately linear in the mixing coefficients. Targeted design therefore reduces to a small constrained affine-mixing problem solved with a differentiable periodic homogenizer in the loop. Negative coefficients enable extrapolation beyond the exemplar range, a linearity-mismatch trust region keeps blends valid, and split-conformal calibration converts the mismatch signal into a distribution-free certificate on achieved-property error. From as few as 50 exemplars, CertMix attains a scaled property error of $10^{-4}$, roughly two to three orders of magnitude below conditional generative baselines trained on 1000 cells. It remains accurate far outside the exemplar range, is $57\times$ faster than per-target topology optimization while avoiding checkerboards and enclosed voids, and extends to spatially graded fields, 3D triply periodic surfaces, and a certified running-shoe midsole application.

</details>


### [348] [MDL Meets Latent Confounders: LNML-based Causal Discovery](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.04133)
*Zhongyi Que,Shin Matsushima,Kenji Yamanishi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出了一种基于MDL（最小描述长度）的非线性因果发现框架PCG-CD，通过最小化LNML编码长度来处理潜在混淆变量，并引入Δ-伪共线性概念识别混淆变量引发的依赖关系，实验表明该方法能准确恢复有向因果关系并检测潜在混淆变量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有因果发现方法在处理非线性机制和潜在混淆变量时面临局限：要么依赖线性假设，要么要求因果充分性（无潜在混淆变量），限制了其在实际复杂场景中的应用。

Method: 基于MDL（最小描述长度）原理，通过最小化运气归一化最大似然（LNML）编码长度来建模；引入Δ-伪共线性概念识别潜在混淆变量引发的依赖关系；采用贪心算法PCG-CD进行搜索优化。

Result: 在合成数据集和真实世界数据集上的实验表明，该方法能够准确恢复有向因果关系，并有效检测潜在混淆变量的存在。

Conclusion: 提出了一种能够同时处理非线性机制和潜在混淆变量的因果发现框架，通过编码长度优化和伪共线性检测实现了更广泛的适用性。

Abstract: Causal discovery with nonlinear mechanisms and latent confounders remains challenging. Existing methods often rely on either linear assumptions or causal sufficiency, limiting their applicability. We propose an MDL-based causal discovery framework that explicitly accounts for latent confounders while allowing flexible nonlinear mechanisms by minimizing the luckiness normalized maximum likelihood (LNML) code-length. The causal relationship between each variable pair is determined by selecting the shortest code-length of the causal model, and we introduce the notion of $Δ$-pseudo-collinearity to identify dependencies induced by latent confounders. Based on these ideas, we develop a greedy algorithm, termed Pseudo-Collinearity Guided Causal Discovery (PCG-CD). Experiments on synthetic and real-world datasets demonstrate that the proposed method accurately recovers directed causal relationships and effectively detects latent confounders.

</details>


### [349] [Masked Generative-Contrastive Representation Learning for Cross-Dataset EEG-Based Emotion Recognition](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.04139)
*Huqin Weng,Jiayang Huang,Yimin Wen,Jie Du,Chi-Man Vong,Chuangquan Chen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出MGCRL，一种专为基于EEG的情绪识别设计的掩码生成-对比表示学习框架。它通过区域感知时空编码器、生成式学习（JEPA架构）和对比学习策略，有效捕捉细粒度与全局表示，在跨数据集泛化上表现出色。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自监督学习在EEG情绪识别中应用不足，现有方法难以处理不同通道配置下的时空依赖、提取抗噪的细粒度表示以及获得跨被试泛化的全局特征。

Method: 提出MGCRL框架，包含三个核心设计：1) 基于区域图卷积的时空编码器，捕获局部空间与功能关系；2) 基于JEPA的生成式学习，利用掩码特征学习抗噪细粒度表示；3) 对比学习策略，利用掩码与原始特征学习时间稳定且跨被试不变的表示。

Result: 在大型FACED数据集上预训练，并在多个SEED系列数据集上微调，实验验证了MGCRL的有效性。

Conclusion: MGCRL通过生成-对比联合学习，能够学习通用表示，显著提升EEG情绪识别的跨数据集和跨被试泛化能力。

Abstract: Self-supervised learning (SSL) shows strong potential for cross-dataset transfer by improving feature representation and generalization. However, its application to EEG-based emotion recognition remains largely unexplored. Existing SSL methods struggle to capture the intricate spatiotemporal dependencies of EEG signals under varying channel configurations, extract fine-grained representations resilient to noise, and derive global features that generalize well across subjects. To address these challenges, we propose Masked Generative-Contrastive Representation Learning (MGCRL), a novel SSL framework specifically designed for EEG-based emotion recognition. Built upon a region-aware spatiotemporal encoder, MGCRL integrates generative and contrastive learning to achieve both fine-grained and global discriminative representations for cross-dataset generalization. MGCRL introduces three key designs: 1) a spatiotemporal encoder that incorporates region-based graph convolution to capture localized spatial and functional relationships, enhancing region-specific feature learning and mitigating the impact of varying EEG channel configurations across datasets; 2) a generative learning mechanism based on the joint embedding predictive architecture (JEPA) that utilizes masked features to capture noise robustness fine-grained representations, improving the model's capability to characterize subtle emotional states; and 3) a contrastive learning strategy that leverages masked and original features to learn temporally stable and cross-subject-invariant representations across the same stimuli, boosting emotion discrimination and cross-subject generalization. Under these designs, MGCRL exhibits remarkable ability to learn universal representation. Extensive experiments involving pretraining on the large FACED dataset and fine-tuning on multiple SEED-series datasets demonstrate the effectiveness of MGCRL.

</details>


### [350] [Binary Iterative Method for Non-targeted Adversarial Attack](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.04145)
*Naman Goyal,Milan Chaudhari*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出了一种名为"二进制迭代法"(BinIM)的新型非目标对抗攻击方法，采用分治策略优化参数和超参数，在ImageNet数据集上优于现有梯度方法，能够使分类器以高达0.995的置信度错误分类，并将正确标签概率降至接近零。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有非目标对抗攻击方法（如快速梯度法、基本迭代法、虚拟对抗法）在寻找最优输入数据点和超参数方面仍面临挑战，需要一种更有效的优化方法。

Method: 提出了Binary Iterative Method (BinIM)，采用分治范式（divide-and-conquer）来优化生成非目标攻击的参数和超参数。

Result: 在ImageNet数据集1000张随机采样图像上，在InceptionV3、InceptionV2、ResNet V2 152预训练网络上评估，BinIM在所有梯度方法中表现最优，使分类器误分类置信度高达0.995，真实标签概率降至2.21e-09（近似为零）。

Conclusion: BinIM作为一种新的非目标对抗攻击方法，有效解决了参数与超参数优化难题，显著优于现有梯度方法，可用于更严格的鲁棒性测试。

Abstract: Adversarial attacks guide and provide additional training and test data for both adversarial training and adversarial robustness validation, and expose the 'piecewise linearity' of deep learning based models. Since adversarial attacks and adversarial robustness are mathematically defined problems that can be optimised directly with end-to-end differentiable search, adversarial robustness is more widely applicable than other robustness metrics such as corruption and perturbation robustness, and new kinds of adversarial attacks are beneficial for robustness testing. Attacks are targeted or non-targeted depending on whether the image is modified to misclassify to a particular class or to any incorrect class; we focus on the non-targeted setting. Finding the optimal input data points and hyper-parameters for generating non-targeted adversarial attacks remains a challenge for current methods like the Fast Gradient Method, Basic Iterative Method and Virtual Adversarial Method. We propose a new method, the "Binary Iterative Method" (BinIM), which uses a divide-and-conquer paradigm to optimise parameters and hyper-parameters for the generation of non-targeted attacks. We compare our method to other gradient-based adversarial attacks evaluated over pre-trained networks (InceptionV3, InceptionV2, ResNet V2 152) on classification tasks. On 1000 randomly-sampled images from the standard ImageNet dataset, the Binary Iterative Method outperforms all other gradient-based methods, qualitatively making the classifier misclassify with confidence up to 0.995 while reducing the probability of the true label to 2.21e-09 (approximately 0).

</details>


### [351] [Mask-based Predictive Representations for Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.04153)
*Kai Zhao*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于掩码预测的自监督辅助任务，结合Transformer在潜在空间重建掩码输入序列，从高维图像输入中学习有效状态表征，从而提升深度强化学习的样本效率，在多个连续和离散控制基准上超越现有最先进方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 解决基于视觉的深度强化学习中从高维图像输入和有限样本中提取有效状态表征的难题，提升样本效率。

Method: 提出掩码预测作为自监督辅助任务，利用智能体与环境交互收集的序列信息及序列上下文预测被掩码信息，结合Transformer在潜在空间重建掩码输入序列，学习压缩表征并馈入强化学习模型。

Result: 该方法提升了强化学习的样本效率，在多个连续和离散控制基准任务上超越当前最先进的样本高效强化学习方法。

Conclusion: 掩码预测作为一种非重建的自监督辅助任务，能够有效增强智能体对任务的理解并学习有效表征，进而提升深度强化学习的样本效率与性能。

Abstract: Vision-based deep reinforcement learning involves dealing with high-dimensional inputs of image information. It is crucial to abstract effective states from high-dimensional image inputs and limited samples for sample-efficient reinforcement learning. To address this challenge, inspired by fields such as natural language processing and computer vision, we propose a self-supervised task based on mask prediction as an auxiliary task for reinforcement learning. This non-reconstruction method uses the sequence information collected by the agent from the environment and the context information in the sequence to predict the masked information, thereby strengthening the agent's understanding of the task and learning effective representations. Combined with transformers, we find that the model reconstructs the masked input sequence in the latent space. By feeding the compressed representations learned by this method into reinforcement learning models, we observe an improvement in the sample efficiency of reinforcement learning. Moreover, the model outperforms state-of-the-art sample-efficient reinforcement learning methods on multiple continuous and discrete control benchmarks.

</details>


### [352] [Geometry of Ordinal Representations in Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.04167)
*Saksham Bassi,Sharvi Tomar*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究语言模型在四项序数任务（括号深度、缩进、表格位置、数值大小）中的表征几何结构，发现当序数变量可从token身份局部计算时，1D流形+位置细胞特征平铺会涌现；跨位置整合或语义提取任务则产生高维或非相干表征。几何计算具有架构依赖性，激活修补验证了流形子空间集中了任务相关信息。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 已有工作表明语言模型在1D曲线上表示字符计数，注意力头执行几何变换以实现计算。本文旨在检验这种几何表征模式是否能推广到更广泛的序数任务，并探究不同任务特性（局部可计算性 vs. 跨位置整合/语义提取）以及不同模型架构对表征几何的影响。

Method: 在Gemma-2-2B、Gemma-2-9B、Qwen3-4B上测试四项序数任务（括号深度、缩进、表格位置、数值大小）。分析表征的几何维度（1D流形 vs. 高维）、位置细胞特征平铺现象、几何计算（twisting）特性；通过激活修补验证流形子空间对任务信息的集中程度，比较流形方向消融与随机方向控制的探针准确率下降差异。

Result: 1) 当序数变量可从token身份局部计算时（括号深度、缩进），1D流形+位置细胞特征平铺涌现；需要跨位置整合（表格位置）或语义提取（数值大小）的任务产生高维或非相干表征。2) 几何计算具有架构依赖性：Qwen3-4B的缩进twisting显著强于Gemma模型，且其缩进twister保持序数顺序，而数值twister不保持。3) 激活修补证实流形子空间集中任务信息，流形方向消融导致探针准确率大幅下降，远大于随机方向控制。

Conclusion: 语言模型中序数任务的几何表征并非通用，而是取决于任务是否支持局部计算和模型架构特性。位置细胞特征平铺和几何计算在特定条件下涌现，为理解语言模型内部计算机制提供了新的视角。

Abstract: Recent work showed that language models represent character counts on curved 1D manifolds, with attention heads performing geometric transformations to enable computation. We test whether this generalizes across four ordinal tasks (bracket depth, indentation, table position, numeric magnitude) in Gemma-2-2B, Gemma-2-9B, and Qwen3-4B. We find that 1D manifolds with place-cell feature tiling emerge for tasks where the ordinal variable is locally computable from token identity, while tasks requiring cross-position integration or semantic extraction produce higher-dimensional or incoherent representations. Geometric computation is architecture-dependent: Qwen3-4B shows substantially stronger twisting than Gemma models for indentation, and its twisters preserve ordinal order, unlike its numeric twisters. Activation patching confirms that the identified manifold subspaces concentrate task-relevant information, with manifold-direction ablation causing dramatically larger probe accuracy drops than random-direction controls.

</details>


### [353] [FedFFT: Taming Client Drift in Federated SAM via Spectral Perturbation Filtering](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.04170)
*Liyang Yuan,Yibo Yang,Dandan Guo*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出FedFFT方法，通过频率域滤波去除SAM扰动中的低频不一致成分，以解决联邦学习中客户端漂移和泛化差的问题，实验表明该方法在非独立同分布场景下显著优于现有SAM联邦学习方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 联邦学习面临统计异构性导致的客户端漂移、泛化差和尖锐极小值问题。SAM虽能改善泛化，但在联邦设置中因局部扰动计算反映客户端特有损失几何，导致发散问题。现有研究缺乏从频率域视角理解该问题的分析。

Method: 提出FedFFT：一种轻量级即插即用方法，通过频率域滤波去除SAM扰动中的低频成分，抑制客户端更新中的不一致信号，同时保留一致的学习信号，无需额外通信开销。

Result: 在多个基准测试和不同骨干网络上，FedFFT在严重非独立同分布场景下持续优于基于SAM的联邦学习方法，展示了其有效性、可扩展性和通用适用性。

Conclusion: 频率域视角为锐度感知联邦优化提供了新思路，FedFFT通过过滤低频扰动不一致成分有效缓解了客户端漂移问题，是一种高效且通用的联邦学习增强方法。

Abstract: Federated Learning (FL) enables decentralized training without data sharing, but suffers from statistical heterogeneity across clients, leading to client drift, poor generalization, and sharp minima compared to centralized training. Sharpness-Aware Minimization (SAM) has emerged as a promising approach to improve generalization, yet its application in federated learning still suffers from divergence problems, since perturbations are computed locally and reflect client-specific loss geometries. To better understand this issue, we provide experimental evidence from a new perspective, the frequency domain, for SAM perturbations in federated settings, revealing that inter-client perturbation inconsistencies are predominantly concentrated in the low-frequency spectrum. Motivated by this insight, we propose Federated learning with Frequency-domain Filtering of SAM perturbations (FedFFT). It is a lightweight and plug-and-play method that filters out low-frequency components of SAM perturbations without requiring additional communication, thereby suppressing inconsistent components in client updates while preserving consistent learning signals. Extensive experiments across multiple benchmarks and diverse backbones demonstrate that FedFFT consistently outperforms SAM-based FL methods, particularly under severe non-IID distributions. These results highlight the effectiveness, scalability, and general applicability of our frequency-domain perspective for sharpness-aware federated optimization.

</details>


### [354] [Physics-Informed Graph Learning with Uncertainty Awareness for Open-Set Domain Generalization in Fault Diagnosis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.04188)
*Jinfeng Zhu,Shiyu Long,Ye Yuan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出PGU-OD框架，一种物理信息引导的图学习与不确定性感知方法，用于旋转机械的开放集域泛化故障诊断，在特征提取、图结构学习和决策阶段级联抑制不确定性，在公开数据集上优于现有方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 智能工业维护面临未知故障类型和变工况域偏移的双重挑战（即开放集域泛化问题），现有数据驱动方法忽视了特征提取、拓扑学习和决策三个阶段的级联不确定性传播。

Method: 1) 物理信息引导的频谱注意力模块提取工况鲁棒特征，抑制频率偏移导致的感知不确定性；2) 不确定性感知自适应图学习机制，通过类级高斯分布参数动态调整样本图边权重，缓解结构不确定性传播；3) 基于高斯分布的自适应边界损失函数和双准则开放集推理策略，优化决策边界并可靠拒绝未知故障。

Result: 在两个公开旋转机械故障数据集上，PGU-OD在已知故障分类和未知故障拒绝两项任务中均优于现有基线方法。

Conclusion: 物理信息引导与不确定性级联建模相结合，能有效解决开放集域泛化下的旋转机械故障诊断问题，提升模型在复杂工况下的泛化性和鲁棒性。

Abstract: Intelligent industrial maintenance critically relies on reliable fault diagnosis of rotating machinery. However, it faces formidable challenges from unknown fault types and domain shifts induced by varying operating conditions, which is formally formulated as the open-set domain generalization (OSDG) problem. Existing methods are mainly data-driven, thereby overlooking the cascaded propagation of uncertainty across feature extraction, topological learning, and decision-making stages.To tackle this challenge, we propose PGU-OD, a novel Physics-Informed Graph Learning framework with Uncertainty Awareness for Open-set Domain generalization. First, it designs a physics-informed spectral attention module to extract condition-robust fault features, thereby suppressing perceptual uncertainty caused by frequency shifts. Further, it constructs an uncertainty aware adaptive graph learning mechanism to dynamically adjust the edge weights of the sample graph guided by class-scale Gaussian distribution parameters, which mitigates the structural propagation of uncertainty. Finally, a Gaussian-distribution-based adaptive boundary loss function and a dual-criteria open-set inference strategy are developed to optimize decision boundaries and reliably reject unknown faults. Extensive experimental evaluations on two public and widely used rotating machinery fault datasets demonstrate that the proposed PGU-OD outperforms state-of-the-art baselines in both known fault classification and unknown fault rejection under domain shifts.

</details>


### [355] [SpecGradFilter: A Spectral Gradient Filtering Framework for Taming Federated Heterogeneity](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.04189)
*Liyang Yuan,Yibo Yang,Dandan Guo,Peter Richtarik,Zhouchen Lin*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出SpecGradFilter，一种从频域视角解决联邦学习中统计异质性导致的客户端漂移问题的统一频谱梯度过滤框架。研究发现客户端梯度差异主要集中在低频分量，通过抑制这些低频信号可有效缓解漂移，该方法在高度Non-IID场景下显著提升性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 联邦学习面临统计异质性（Non-IID数据）挑战，现有方法仅从空间域进行梯度校正或正则化，忽略了优化信号内在的频谱结构。

Method: 提出SpecGradFilter频谱梯度过滤框架：从频域视角揭示客户端漂移的频谱偏差——梯度分歧集中在低频分量；通过FFT精确截断或空间近似（如高斯去趋势）抑制不一致的低频信号。

Result: 在CIFAR-10/100和Tiny-ImageNet等基准上，SpecGradFilter在高度Non-IID设置下显著优于现有方法，且通信开销极小。

Conclusion: SpecGradFilter建立了鲁棒联邦优化的新范式，证明频谱梯度过滤是一种可泛化的有效原则，可通过多种方式实现。

Abstract: Federated Learning (FL) is fundamentally challenged by statistical heterogeneity, where non-identically distributed (non-IID) data induces client drift that severely hampers global convergence. While existing approaches attempt to mitigate this drift through spatial-domain gradient correction or regularization, they overlook the intrinsic spectral structure of optimization signals. In this work, we revisit client drift from a novel frequency-domain perspective and uncover a critical Spectral Bias of Drift: inter-client gradient divergence is predominantly concentrated in low-frequency components which encode client-specific distributional shifts, while high-frequency components representing fine-grained features remain relatively consistent. Motivated by this, we propose SpecGradFilter, a unified Spectral Gradient Filtering Framework that tames heterogeneity by suppressing discordant low-frequency signals. Crucially, we demonstrate that SpecGradFilter is a generalizable principle, effective not only via precise FFT-based truncation but also through spatial approximations like Gaussian detrending. Extensive experiments on benchmarks such as CIFAR-10/100 and Tiny-ImageNet demonstrate that SpecGradFilter significantly performs better performance in highly Non-IID settings with negligible communication overhead, establishing a new paradigm for robust federated optimization.

</details>


### [356] [Exploring Convolutional Neural Processes for Weather Downscaling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.04190)
*Francisco Passos*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究ConvCNP模型用于瑞士地区日最高气温统计降尺度，将ERA5-Land（~11km）降尺度至~1km，最佳模型MAE为1.31°C，CRPS技能分0.524，但存在过度自信的不确定性估计问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 全球再分析数据（如ERA5-Land）分辨率粗糙，难以满足山地等复杂地形区域的局部应用需求，亟需有效的统计降尺度方法。

Method: 基于Vaughan et al. (2022)的ConvCNP架构，融入瑞士高分辨率DEM（swisstopo DHM25），采用高程MLP、季节特征和地形位置指数，使用十年数据（2014-2023）进行五折时间交叉验证训练。

Result: 最佳模型MAE为1.31°C，CRPS技能分0.524；消融实验表明高程MLP不可或缺；稀疏网格输入下模型性能优雅退化；零样本离网部署未能实现正技能分；所有配置均呈现严重过度自信的不确定性估计。

Conclusion: ConvCNP在复杂地形的气候降尺度中是一种可行且有效的方法，但不确定性校准和对非网格输入的本地支持是实际部署的关键挑战。

Abstract: Global reanalysis products such as ERA5-Land provide spatially complete weather fields but at resolutions too coarse for local applications, particularly in mountainous regions where temperature can vary by several degrees over short distances. This project investigates Convolutional Conditional Neural Processes (ConvCNPs) for statistical downscaling of daily maximum temperature from the ~11km resolution ERA5-Land grid to ~1km resolution over Switzerland, building upon the architecture of Vaughan et al. (2022) and adapting it to the topographically complex Swiss domain with high-resolution elevation features from the swisstopo DHM25. The best model, trained on ten years of data (2014-2023) with five-fold temporal cross-validation, achieves a mean absolute error of 1.31 Celsius and a CRPS-based skill score of 0.524 relative to bilinear interpolation, reducing the expected prediction error by more than half. An ablation study reveals that the elevation MLP is the indispensable component - without it, the model diverges entirely - while explicit seasonal features and Topographic Position Index provide secondary benefits. Under sparse on-grid input the model degrades gracefully, maintaining positive skill down to approximately 10% of the input grid; however, zero-shot deployment on off-grid station observations does not achieve positive skill at any density tested. All configurations exhibit severely overconfident uncertainty estimates, a structural limitation of the Gaussian likelihood training objective. These results demonstrate that ConvCNPs are a viable and effective approach to climate downscaling in complex terrain, and identify uncertainty calibration and native support for non-gridded input as the key challenges for operational deployment.

</details>


### [357] [Channel-Adaptive Robust Aggregation for Over-the-Air Federated Learning in Heterogeneous Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.04218)
*Zubaida Fatima,Zubair Shaban,Yusuf Jamal,Nazreen Shah,Ranjitha Prasad,B. N. Bharath*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出CHARGE-FL框架，通过自适应聚合调度和双用途预编码，在6G网络的空中联邦学习中联合解决噪声、衰落和客户端异构性问题，显著提升准确率、稳定性和收敛速度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有空中联邦学习方法依赖固定聚合调度，未能联合处理噪声、信道衰落和客户端异构性问题，亟需一种能自适应信道动态和应用程序就绪状态的鲁棒聚合框架。

Method: 提出CHARGE-FL框架，包含：(1)基于信道动态和应用就绪状态的自适应聚合调度策略；(2)定制化优化策略；(3)双用途预编码机制，同时缓解信道失真和部分更新带来的偏差。

Result: 在真实无线条件下，CHARGE-FL在准确率、稳定性和收敛性方面显著优于现有最先进的OTA-FL方法，尤其在存在掉队设备和高噪声场景中表现突出。

Conclusion: CHARGE-FL通过信道自适应调度和双用途预编码，有效解决了OTA-FL中噪声、衰落和异构性的联合挑战，为6G网络中隐私保护的数据密集型应用提供了高效的联邦学习方案。

Abstract: The growing demand for privacy-preserving, data-intensive applications such as IoT, augmented reality, and autonomous systems positions Federated Learning (FL) as a key enabler in 6G networks. Over-the-Air FL (OTA-FL) leverages the superposition property of the wireless multiple access channel for efficient aggregation via simultaneous transmissions. Existing methods rely on fixed aggregation schedules and do not jointly address noise, fading, and client heterogeneity. We propose CHARGE-FL (CHannel-Adaptive Robust agGrEgation), a framework that adaptively schedules aggregation based on channel dynamics and application readiness. By combining a tailored optimization strategy with a dual-purpose precoding mechanism, CHARGE-FL mitigates channel distortion and bias from partial updates, achieving superior accuracy, stability, and convergence under realistic wireless conditions. Empirical results under realistic wireless conditions show that CHARGE-FL significantly improves accuracy, stability, and convergence over state-of-the-art OTA-FL methods, particularly in straggler-prone and noisy scenarios.

</details>


### [358] [Quantize the Target, Quantize the Drafter: Efficient Inference with Qwen3.5-4B](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.04244)
*Jaeyeon Kim,Jewon Lee,Bo-Kyeong Kim*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文针对Efficient Qwen Competition，提出结合量化目标模型与推测解码的系统，通过量化感知蒸馏恢复精度、两阶段训练块扩散草稿模型加速解码，并在A10G GPU上实现6.978倍平均加速，排名第三。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在资源受限的NVIDIA A10G GPU上实现Qwen3.5-4B的低延迟推理服务，解决大规模语言模型在有限计算资源下的高效部署问题。

Method: 1) 量化目标模型结合推测解码；2) 量化感知蒸馏（保留原始量化网格）恢复精度；3) 两阶段训练块扩散草稿模型：先学习高精度目标再适配低精度目标；4) 对草稿模型进一步量化并采用滑动窗口注意力减少开销。

Result: 在满足质量阈值要求的前提下，相比基线实现了6.978倍的平均加速，整体排名第三。

Conclusion: 所提方法在资源受限环境下有效提升了LLM推理速度，为实际LLM推理部署提供了有价值的见解。

Abstract: This report describes our approach to the Efficient Qwen Competition, where the goal is to enable low-latency serving of Qwen3.5-4B on a resource-constrained NVIDIA A10G GPU. Our system combines a quantized target model with speculative decoding. To recover accuracy, we apply quantization-aware distillation to the target model while retaining the original quantization grid. To speed up decoding, a block-diffusion drafter specialized for the quantized target model is trained using a two-stage procedure: first learning from the high-precision target and then adapting to the low-precision target. Because the drafter is invoked at every speculative decoding step, we further reduce its overhead with quantization and sliding-window attention, preserving draft-token acceptance while improving long-context decoding latency. As a result, our submission achieves a 6.978$\times$ average speedup over the baseline while satisfying the required quality thresholds, ranking 3rd overall. We hope these results provide useful insights for practical LLM inference. The code and resources are available at https://github.com/nota-github/adaptfm-quant-dflash

</details>


### [359] [Signal or Noise? Understanding Generative Models for Real-World Sensor Time Series](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.04245)
*Zitao Shuai,Zongzhe Xu,Yuntian Wu,Sirui Li,Tianhong Li,Yuzhe Yang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出SensorGen，一个涵盖14种设置、4个领域、7个数据集和12种信号模态的大规模传感器信号生成研究。通过系统评估5大生成模型家族，发现：(1)流匹配模型在多数场景表现最优；(2)信号属性（如人口统计协变量、时频建模）对生成质量有重要影响；(3)生成信号具有实际效用（扩大规模提升质量，合成数据提升下游性能）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有传感器数据的生成建模在模态、数据集和任务公式上高度碎片化，缺乏对生成模型在真实场景中何时、如何以及为何成功或失败的系统性理解。

Method: 构建SensorGen基准（14种设置，跨4领域、7数据集、12信号模态），系统评估5大生成模型家族（包括流匹配模型等）在不同传感器信号上的性能。

Result: (1)流匹配模型在多数场景表现最佳；(2)人口统计协变量改善纵向生成，时频建模改善高频信号生成；(3)扩大规模提升生成质量，合成数据可改善下游任务性能。

Conclusion: SensorGen建立了对真实世界传感器数据生成中设计选择、评估协议和失败模式的更广泛理解。

Abstract: Generative models have changed how machine learning represents complex data distributions, especially in language and vision, yet many real-world systems are observed instead as continuous, high-dimensional, and noisy sensor time series. Existing generative modeling of sensor data, however, remains fragmented across modalities, datasets, and task formulations, limiting a systematic understanding of when, how, and why generative models succeed or fail in real-world settings. To address this gap, we introduce SensorGen, a large-scale study of sensor-signal generation spanning 14 settings across 4 domains, 7 datasets, and 12 signal modalities. Leveraging SensorGen, we systematically evaluate generative models from five major families and uncover three key findings: (1) flow-matching models provide strong overall performance across most settings; (2) signal properties matter, with demographic covariates improving longitudinal generation and time-frequency modeling improving high-frequency signal generation; and (3) generated signals have practical utility beyond visual realism, with scaling improving generation quality and synthetic data improving downstream performance. Together, SensorGen establishes a broader understanding of design choices, evaluation protocols, and failure modes in real-world sensor data generation.

</details>


### [360] [On Preserving Geometrical Invariance for Superpixel Image Classification using Graph Transformer](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.04262)
*Sarabeshwar Balaji,Shubham Mohanty,Akash Anil*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出SuperGT，一种基于图Transformer的图像分类框架，通过超像素图表示和预处理方案来捕获长程依赖并保持平移/旋转不变性，在CIFAR-10上取得与ShapeGNN相当的性能且无需边界点坐标。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: CNN和ViT在像素密集网格上处理冗余信息导致计算复杂度过高；GNN虽能利用超像素图降低冗余，但难以捕获长程依赖且多数方法未显式保持平移/旋转不变性。

Method: 提出SuperGT框架：将图像表示为超像素图，利用图Transformer捕获长程依赖；设计预处理方案以保持平移/旋转不变性。

Result: 在CIFAR-10数据集上显著优于多个基线模型，性能与之前最先进的ShapeGNN相当，且不需要ShapeGNN所需的超像素边界点坐标。

Conclusion: SuperGT通过图Transformer和不变性预处理，在降低计算冗余的同时有效解决了长程依赖和几何不变性问题，是一种高效且有竞争力的图像分类方案。

Abstract: Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) and Vision Transformer (ViT) for image classification exploit a dense grid of pixels containing redundant information. Consequently, for a larger image dataset, CNNs and ViTs face deployability challenges due to high computational complexity. Representing images as graphs of superpixels offers an efficient alternative that preserves key information while eliminating pixel-level redundancy. Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) have been utilized on such graphs to perform image classification. However, GNNs are known to struggle with capturing long-range dependencies which is important in the domain of image classification. Furthermore, a majority of these superpixel-based image classification approaches do not explicitly preserve translation/rotation invariance. Nevertheless, preserving translation/rotation invariance is important for robust image classification. Thus, this paper proposes SuperGT, a Graph Transformer-based framework for image classification, which captures the long range dependencies, along with a pre-processing scheme that preserves translation/rotation invariance. We evaluate SuperGT on CIFAR-10 dataset and observe that it performs significantly better than many baselines. Furthermore, we note that the overall performance of SuperGT is comparable to the previous state-of-the-art model, namely, ShapeGNN, without relying on coordinates of the boundary points of each superpixel required by ShapeGNN.

</details>


### [361] [HiFA4: Training-Free 4-bit FlashAttention on Ascend HIF4 NPUs for LLM Inference](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.04302)
*Hui Dong,Yanzhao Li,Jie Gao,Chunlu Li,Zhiyuan Zhang,Yupeng Sun,Zhenyuan Chen,Zhiqiang Zou*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: HiFA4 是一种面向 Ascend NPU 的 4 位 HIF4 后训练算子级设计，通过 Smooth-QK 和 P-Reordering 机制在 FlashAttention 中以 4 位精度执行 QK^T 和 PV 矩阵乘法，同时保持在线 softmax 状态为 FP16，有效减少量化引起的精度损失和决策漂移。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在 LLM 推理中，FlashAttention 的 QK^T 和 PV 操作是计算瓶颈，现有低精度量化方案会造成显著的精度损失；特别是在 Ascend NPU 上，缺乏针对 HIF4 数据格式的优化设计来同时兼顾推理效率和模型质量。

Method: 1) Smooth-QK：对 RoPE 后的 Q 和 K 进行校准静态的逐通道等价重缩放，将量化困难从 K 转移至 Q，避免推理时的逐 tile 在线缩减。2) P-Reordering：使用与 PV GEMM 相同的量化注意力权重 P_hat 累积 softmax 归一化因子，而非高精度重建版本，并将该归一化因子融合到 PV Cube GEMM 中，同时引入 Q-Mean 辅助量缓解输出缩放误差。

Result: 在 Qwen3-8B 上恢复 37.5% 的精度差距，样本加权准确率损失从 1.12 pp 降至 0.70 pp，BF16 不一致预测从 16.3% 降至 8.2%，MMLU 回归减少 57%（1071→465）。Gemma2-9B 上保持在 BF16 的 0.7 pp 以内，回归减少 27%。禁用 Smooth-QK 的模型（LLaMA3.1-8B、Mistral-7B、Phi-4B）中，P-Reordering 仍减少 41-52% 的 MMLU 回归。指令调度分析预估关键路径延迟较 BF16 降低 35.4%。

Conclusion: HiFA4 是首个在 Ascend NPU 上以 HIF4 为目标、在 FlashAttention 中同时以 4 位精度执行 QK^T 和 PV 的算子级设计，实验证明其在多种 LLM 上能有效降低量化精度损失和决策漂移，并具备显著的延迟优化潜力。

Abstract: We present HiFA4, a post-training operator-level design that executes both QK^T and PV in FlashAttention as 4-bit HIF4 Cube GEMMs for LLM inference on Ascend NPUs, while maintaining the online softmax state in FP16. To our knowledge, HiFA4 is the first Ascend-HIF4-targeted design of this kind evaluated on standard NLP benchmarks.
  HiFA4 combines two mechanisms. Smooth-QK applies a calibration-static per-channel equivalent rescaling to Q and K after RoPE, transferring quantization difficulty from K to Q without per-tile online reduction at inference. P-Reordering accumulates the softmax normalizer from the same quantized attention weights P_hat used in the PV GEMM, rather than from a higher-precision reconstruction. We show that this inconsistent formulation introduces a coherent output-scaling error, and validate the effect on a Qwen3-8B Layer-0 MMLU trace, where all 3.6M measured attention tiles exhibit net probability-mass loss with median epsilon_bar = -0.064. P-Reordering also allows the normalizer to be fused into the PV Cube GEMM.
  Across five LLMs, HiFA4 reduces quantization-induced decision drift. On Qwen3-8B, it recovers 37.5% of the accuracy gap introduced by direct HIF4 quantization, narrows the sample-weighted accuracy loss from 1.12 pp to 0.70 pp, reduces BF16-inconsistent MMLU predictions from 16.3% to 8.2%, and cuts MMLU accuracy regressions by 57% (1071 to 465). On Gemma2-9B, mild smoothing keeps HiFA4 within 0.7 pp of BF16 while reducing MMLU regressions by 27%. On LLaMA3.1-8B, Mistral-7B, and Phi-4B, where Smooth-QK is disabled, P-Reordering with the adopted Q-Mean auxiliary still reduces full-set MMLU regressions by 41-52%. A preliminary instruction-scheduling analysis projects a 35.4% critical-path latency reduction relative to BF16 by fusing the softmax normalizer into the PV Cube GEMM; on-hardware validation is left to future work.

</details>


### [362] [SAD-LoRA: Spectral Alignment for Low-Rank Knowledge Distillation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.04306)
*Omer Tariq,Syed Muhammad Raza,Jeongbae Son*

Main category: cs.LG
