To handle heterogeneous privacy levels and noise distortion, we design a two-stage solution consisting of a Personalized Perturbation Mechanism (PPM) and a weighted calibration strategy, FlexProp. Extensive experiments on six real-world graph datasets demonstrate that PPGNN effectively balances personalized privacy protection and data utility in decentralized graph learning scenarios.

</details>


### [397] [Predicting Drafted Deck Strength for "Magic: the Gathering"](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.04782)
*Tomas Rigaux,Hisashi Kashima*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文针对《万智牌》轮抽这一复杂决策场景，提出了基于编码器的集合上下文卡片嵌入模型，用于编码选牌决策序列，在大规模真实数据上优于线性基线，建立了首个学习型结果预测基准。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 许多现实游戏不具备固定的规则集，其动态由大量且不断演化的游戏组件间交互定义，使得通用策略学习不实用。MTG轮抽通过隔离选牌过程与游戏过程，提供了一个可处理但非平凡的决策研究场景。

Method: 提出基于编码器的模型，生成集合上下文化的卡片嵌入，对轮抽决策序列进行编码，用于预测结果。

Result: 在大规模真实数据上，该方法一致优于线性基线，建立了首个学习型MTG轮抽结果预测基准。

Conclusion: 编码器模型能有效捕捉卡片间的协同效应，在组合性决策任务中具有优势。

Abstract: Many real-world games do not admit a fixed, compact rule set: instead, their dynamics are defined by interactions among a large and often evolving collection of game pieces, making general-purpose policy learning impractical. Magic: the Gathering (MTG) exemplifies this setting, where the cards themselves define and alter gameplay rules, strategic constraints, and long-term outcomes, while the pool of available cards is ever-changing. We study Draft, a constrained deck-building format of MTG in which eight players make 39-45 sequential selections from semi-random packs to construct a 40-card deck under partial information. By isolating the card selection process from gameplay, Draft provides a tractable yet non-trivial setting for studying decision-making driven by combinatorial card synergies. We propose an encoder-based model that produces set-contextualized card embeddings to encode the draft decision sequence, with a consistent improvement over linear baselines on large-scale real-world data, establishing a first learned benchmark for outcome prediction in MTG Draft. Our code is available at github.com/akulen/MtGDraftEncoder.

</details>


### [398] [Compressed Computation under $L^4$ Loss is likely Computation in Superposition](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.04800)
*Francisco Ferreira da Silva,Stefan Heimersheim*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究了单隐藏层ReLU网络在稀疏输入下用50个神经元计算100个特征的问题，发现在L4损失下训练会诱发出一种叠加计算方案，并成功逆向工程了该方案：网络为每个特征分配稀疏二进制码字，通过伪逆解码，仅需三个标量即可描述大部分性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 神经网络的叠加表示已被较好理解，但叠加计算（用少于函数数量的神经元计算多个函数）尚不明确，且缺乏通过训练自然涌现的玩具模型。本文旨在填补这一空白。

Method: 采用压缩计算设置：一个50神经元的单隐藏层ReLU网络需计算100个稀疏输入特征的ReLU值。使用L4损失（误差的四次方均值）而非标准L2损失进行训练，然后对涌现的解进行逆向工程分析。

Result: 网络学习到一种叠加计算方案：每个特征被分配一个稀疏二进制码字（编码矩阵），解码通过编码器的伪逆完成。整个方案仅需三个标量参数就能恢复大部分网络性能，且可用手工设计的码字验证该描述的正确性。

Conclusion: L4损失能有效诱发叠加计算，其解决方案可被简化为编码-伪逆解码框架。这表明叠加计算可以通过训练自然涌现，且其内部机制具有可解释性。

Abstract: Neural networks are thought to represent concepts as directions in their activation space, and superposition lets them encode more concepts than they have dimensions. It is natural to ask whether they can also compute more functions than they have neurons, i.e., perform computation in superposition. In this regime many functions of sparse inputs are evaluated by a layer with fewer neurons than there are functions to compute. Representation in superposition is by now fairly well understood, but computation in superposition is not, and there are few toy models of it arising through training rather than being hand designed. As a toy model of computation in superposition we study the compressed-computation setup: a single-hidden-layer ReLU network with 50 neurons that must compute the ReLU of each of 100 sparse input features. We show that training it under an $L^4$ loss (the mean fourth power of the error), rather than the usual $L^2$, elicits a solution that appears to compute all features in superposition. We then reverse-engineer this solution. We find that the network assigns each feature a sparse binary codeword over neurons and decodes it with a pseudoinverse of the encoder. Given these codewords, a description with only three scalars recovers most of the network's performance, and we validate it by building equivalent networks from hand-designed codes.

</details>


### [399] [Layer-Parallel Inference Reduces Encrypted Nonlinear Depth in Transformers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.04819)
*Ligong Han,Kai Xu,Hao Wang,Ruijiang Gao,Akash Srivastava*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出结构化牛顿层并行性（SNLP），将Transformer推理中的逐层非线性深度从L层减少到少量求解器迭代加线性修正，在0.5B模型上实现2.65倍符号自举减少，仅增加1.2%困惑度损失。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 全同态加密（FHE）支持密文计算，但实际应用中加密Transformer推理受限于大量非线性块的顺序组合造成的性能瓶颈，需要降低层间顺序非线性深度。

Method: 提出结构化牛顿层并行性（SNLP），通过少量求解器迭代加线性结构化修正替代传统逐层顺序推理，使用基于切比雪夫多项式近似的仿真框架评估误差累积。

Result: 在8个模型4个架构族上，SNLP将0.5B模型的符号自举从53降至20（2.65倍），困惑度仅增加1.2%，误差放大系数1.36倍优于顺序推理的1.42倍。所有测试模型上SNLP的误差放大均低于顺序推理。

Conclusion: softmax近似主导误差预算，CKKS算术噪声可忽略；SNLP与块级FHE友好算子设计互补而非替代。

Abstract: Fully homomorphic encryption (FHE) enables computation on encrypted data, but practical encrypted Transformer inference is bottlenecked by the sequential composition of many nonlinear blocks. We study whether Structured Newton Layer Parallelism (SNLP) can make this inter-layer composition more FHE-friendly: each Transformer block still requires polynomial approximations for operations such as softmax and RMSNorm, but SNLP reduces the layerwise sequential nonlinear depth from L stages to a small number of solver iterations plus linear structured corrections. Using a simulation framework based on Chebyshev polynomial approximations, we measure error accumulation under sequential versus SNLP inference across 8 models and 4 architecture families. On a 0.5B IDN-trained model, SNLP reduces symbolic bootstraps from 53 to 20 (2.65x) with only +1.2% perplexity degradation, while lowering error amplification (1.36x vs. 1.42x). Across all tested models, SNLP has lower amplification than sequential inference. Ablations show that softmax approximation dominates the error budget and CKKS arithmetic noise is negligible in our setting, suggesting that SNLP is complementary to block-level FHE-friendly operator design rather than a replacement for it.

</details>


### [400] [KinEMbed: Decoding Kinematics from Electromyography via Cross-Modal Contrastive Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.04820)
*Sofia Gilardini,Chenfei Ma,Kianoush Nazarpour*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出KinEMbed，一种跨模态对比学习框架，用于从表面EMG信号回归手部运动学（关节角度），在NinaPro DB8数据集上优于PCA、PLS、自编码器和CEBRA基线，尤其对拇指关节的预测提升最大。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有EMG表征学习主要聚焦于离散手势分类，缺乏针对连续运动学回归的有效方法，而连续手部运动学解码对假肢控制和运动康复具有重要临床意义。

Method: 采用跨模态对比学习框架，联合训练两个编码器——一个处理加窗EMG特征，另一个处理运动学（关节角度）目标，使学到的嵌入继承运动学空间的几何结构，推理时无需运动学信号。

Result: 在NinaPro DB8数据集（含健全人和肢体差异受试者，N=11）上，KinEMbed在留出会话测试中优于PCA、PLS、自编码器和CEBRA基线，对最具挑战性的拇指关节自由度提升最大。

Conclusion: 该工作是首次将对比表征学习应用于从结构化可穿戴生物信号回归手部运动学的探索，证明了跨模态对比学习在连续运动学解码中的潜力。

Abstract: Decoding hand kinematics from surface electromyography (EMG) is a core challenge in wearable biosignal processing with clinical relevance for prosthetic control and motor rehabilitation. Most representation learning approaches for EMG focus on discrete gesture classification, and few focus on continuous regression. We present KinEMbed, a cross-modal contrastive learning framework for hand kinematics regression that jointly trains dual encoders -- one for windowed EMG features and one for kinematic (joint angle) targets. The resulting embeddings inherit the geometric structure of the kinematic space without requiring kinematic signals at inference time. Evaluating on the NinaPro DB8 dataset that includes both able-bodied users and subjects with limb difference (N=11), KinEMbed outperforms PCA, PLS, autoencoder and contrastive (CEBRA) baselines on held-out sessions, with largest gains on the most challenging thumb degrees of articulation. We position this work as a first step toward contrastive representation learning for regression of hand kinematics from structured wearable biosignals.

</details>


### [401] [Probably Correct Optimal Stable Matching under Two-Sided Uncertainty](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.04824)
*Andreas Athanasopoulos,Anne-Marie George,Christos Dimitrakakis*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究了双边市场中稳定匹配的序列学习问题，在偏好未知且存在双向不确定性的集中式场景下，提出基于"普遍稳定匹配"概念的消除式算法，实现了纯探索和遗憾最小化双重目标，并给出了精细的样本复杂度分析。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有工作主要处理单侧不确定性或已知偏好情况，本文旨在处理双边市场中双方偏好均未知的更具挑战性的场景，并利用部分偏好信息来高效识别最优稳定匹配。

Method: 提出"普遍稳定匹配"概念作为核心工具，使得在部分偏好信息下仍能识别最优稳定匹配；设计基于消除机制的算法，其停止准则利用学习到的部分偏好结构；采用半强盗反馈结构（仅观察匹配对的奖励）。

Result: 在纯探索视角下给出了精细的样本复杂度分析；在遗憾最小化场景下建立了不依赖于最小奖励间隙 Δ_min 的遗憾界。

Conclusion: 本文成功将稳定匹配的序列学习从单侧不确定性推广到双侧不确定性，提出的方法论为处理部分偏好信息下的匹配学习提供了新途径，且纯探索与遗憾最小化的统一框架具有理论价值。

Abstract: We study a sequential learning problem for stable matchings in two-sided markets where preferences on both sides are initially unknown. We focus on a centralized setting where an algorithm matches agents at each time step and receives noisy rewards that reflect the preferences of the matched agents, following a semi-bandit feedback structure. We adopt a pure exploration perspective, aiming to efficiently identify the optimal stable matching with high probability. Our work extends prior results by handling \emph{two-sided uncertainty} and by exploiting \emph{partial preference} information. A central ingredient is the notion of \textbf{pervasive stable matching}, which enables the identification of optimal stable matchings under partial preferences. We propose elimination-based algorithms whose stopping criteria exploit the structure of the learned partial preferences, and provide a refined sample-complexity analysis. Beyond pure exploration, we extend our approach to regret minimization and establish regret bounds with respect to the \emph{optimal} stable matching that avoid dependence on the minimum reward gap $Δ_{\min}$.

</details>


### [402] [Representing and Detecting Label Ambiguity in IMU-Based Exercise Evaluation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.04842)
*Andreas Spilz,Heiko Oppel,Michael Munz*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于惯性测量单元(IMU)的家庭物理治疗动作评估方法，通过自动生成每轮重复的标签分布（而非传统独热标签）来建模边界样本的模糊性，使用KL散度损失训练网络，在四个数据集上达到或优于基线分类性能，并能可靠检测模糊样本及其相关类别。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 家庭物理治疗中无人监督导致动作执行不正确，需要自动评估系统。现有分类器将每轮重复硬性分入单一类别，但大量边界样本即使在训练有素的评估者之间也存在分歧，独热标签丢弃了这种模糊性。

Method: 提出一种无需大量评估者即可自动生成每轮重复标签分布的方法。训练网络使用KL散度作为损失函数（模糊方法），与使用独热标签的交叉熵基线方法在四个IMU运动数据集上进行比较。从网络输出中进一步判断重复动作是否模糊以及哪些类别与之相关。

Result: 模糊方法在四个数据集上均达到或超过了基线分类性能，并且在检测模糊性和相关类别方面更加可靠。在训练目标中表示标签分布可以在不损失分类性能的情况下增加模糊性信息。

Conclusion: 在训练目标中引入标签分布表示，能在不牺牲分类准确率的前提下，有效捕捉和表达边界样本的模糊性信息，为家庭物理治疗中的动作评估提供更丰富的反馈。

Abstract: Home-based physiotherapy is performed without supervision, which leads to incorrect execution and motivates systems that assess movement automatically from inertial measurement units (IMUs). Such systems assign each repetition to a category, yet a relevant share of repetitions falls near a class boundary, where even trained raters disagree. Classifiers trained with one-hot labels collapse these borderline repetitions onto a single class and discard this ambiguity. We address this with a method that automatically generates a label distribution per repetition without a large rater pool. We train a network to reproduce the full distribution with a Kullback-Leibler objective, the ambiguity approach, and compare it against a one-hot cross-entropy baseline on four IMU exercise datasets. From the network output we further determine whether a repetition is ambiguous and which classes are relevant to it. The ambiguity approach matched or exceeded the baseline classification on all four datasets, and detected ambiguity and the relevant classes more reliably. Representing the label distribution in the training target therefore adds information about ambiguity at no cost to classification.

</details>


### [403] [Pretraining Curricula Enable Selective Fine-tuning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.04846)
*Sebastian A. Bruijns,Jirko Rubruck,Mia H. Whitefield,Kai J. Sandbrink,Fazl Barez,Christopher Summerfield*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文发现，在预训练中使用不平衡课程（一个任务先学，另一个任务后学）能够促进上下文学习、提高模型对拒绝微调的选择性，并使任务在神经回路中分离，从而提升安全微调的精确性和可靠性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 探索显式预训练课程如何影响学习、泛化以及微调的选择性，这对于AI安全中通过微调选择性抑制不良行为至关重要。

Method: 对比平衡课程（均匀采样）与不平衡课程（一个任务先学，另一个后学）两种预训练策略，在冲突复制任务和合成语言学习任务上进行实验，并通过消融实验和激活修补分析神经机制。

Result: 不平衡课程促进了两个冲突任务在可分离神经回路中的解缠表示，而平衡课程使任务通过共同路径路由；不平衡课程还导致更局部化、更少纠缠的规则表示，产生更稳健的规则遵循行为。

Conclusion: 不平衡预训练课程可能是促进解缠表示的重要工具，对安全微调的精度和可靠性有直接影响。

Abstract: Transformers follow implicit curricula whereby some tasks are learned before others. However, how explicit pretraining curricula influence learning, generalization, and the selectivity of fine-tuning is unclear. This is important for AI safety, where fine-tuning is used to selectively suppress misaligned behaviors. Here, we compare curricula that pretrain tasks in a balanced (sampled uniformly) or an imbalanced (one task early, the other late) fashion. We show that imbalanced learning of two conflicting copy tasks promotes in-context learning and improves the selectivity of refusal fine-tuning. Ablations and activation patching show that this occurs because imbalanced pretraining encourages tasks to be disentangled in separable neural circuits, whereas balanced training routes both tasks through a common pathway. We extend these findings to a synthetic language learning task involving rule-consistent and rule-violating data, where imbalanced curricula similarly lead to more localized, less entangled rule representations, resulting in more robust rule-following behavior. Together, these results suggest that imbalanced pretraining curricula may be an important tool for promoting disentangled representations, with direct consequences for the precision and reliability of safety fine-tuning.

</details>


### [404] [Framework for Grouping Local Process Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.04856)
*Viki Peeva,Wil M. P. van der Aalst*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文指出局部过程模型（LPM）挖掘中存在模型爆炸和重复问题，证明仅采用最高分LPM作为样本存在高度重复性，不利于流程理解；提出基于过程模型相似度或事件日志上下文属性的分组框架，通过每组选取代表性LPM构建最优样本，实验表明该方法在重复性和覆盖性上优于传统最高分采样方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LPM挖掘算法会产生大量结构或行为相似的模型，分析师无法人工筛选数千个LPM；当前普遍采用最高分LPM作为样本，但不同应用场景需要不同的最优样本，而高分样本因高度重复并非理解流程的好选择。

Method: 提出LPM分组框架：通过已建立的过程模型相似度度量或基于事件日志中数据属性形成的上下文来度量LPM之间的相似性，将相似的LPM聚为一组，从每组中选取一个代表性模型构建最优样本。

Result: 通过在多个事件日志上的实验，比较了传统最高分样本与分组代表性样本的重复性和覆盖性，证明了分组方法的有效性。

Conclusion: 使用最高分LPM作为样本并非最优选择，基于相似度分组并选取代表性LPM的方法能有效降低重复性、提高覆盖性，为不同应用场景提供更合适的LPM样本。

Abstract: Local Process Models (LPMs) are an underexplored concept in process mining. LPMs describe patterns in event data considering sequence, choice, concurrency, and loop. In recent years, process mining has proved successful in the analysis and improvement of operational processes. More often than not, surprising findings are found when one does not consider the full process, making LPMs and their discovery highly valuable. However, similar to other pattern mining approaches, LPM discovery algorithms face the problems of model explosion and model repetition, i.e., the algorithms may create hundreds if not thousands of LPMs, and subsets of them are close in structure or behavior. Practically, no analyst would be able to comb through thousands of LPMs leading to using a sample of LPMs that are easily accessible. The current sentiment is that the top-scoring LPMs form the optimal sample to be presented. However, different applications should demand a different optimal sample. With this work, we show that if the goal of the mined LPMs is to understand a process, using the top-scoring LPMs as an optimal sample is a poor choice because of high repetition. We propose a framework for grouping LPMs and creating an optimal sample by taking one representative LPM for each group. We measure similarity between models via established process model similarity measures or by comparing the context in which an LPM appears. The context is formed using data attributes available in the underlying event logs. We demonstrate the usefulness of grouping on multiple event logs by comparing repetition and coverage between samples comprised of the top-scoring models and the representatives of discovered groups.

</details>


### [405] [Enhancing the Forecasting Capability of Multi-Model Blending Algorithms for Extreme Precipitation via Joint Use of Station and Gridded Observations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.04862)
*Yu Wang,Yong Cao,Kan Dai,Yue Shen,Xiaoqing Zeng,Ruixia Zhao*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出一种基于U-Net的两阶段框架（概率分类+数值重建），融合六个主要NWP模型的降水预报，并引入站点-网格联合监督机制。在2025年汛期独立样本评估中，暴雨TS提升38.4%，极端降水（≥100mm）TS突破0.1，具备业务应用价值。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统数值天气预报（NWP）模型对极端降水存在系统性强度低估和空间位移问题，而传统多模式融合算法基于像素级加权平均会导致降水区域扩大和极值平滑，亟需更有效的融合方法以提升极端降水预报精度。

Method: 构建U-Net两阶段融合框架：第一阶段进行概率分类，第二阶段进行数值重建；创新性地引入站点-网格联合监督机制，将全国2411个国家气象站观测数据融入损失函数，同时约束空间结构和峰值强度。

Result: 在2025年汛期独立样本评估中，暴雨（≥50mm）TS较最优NWP提升38.4%；极端事件（≥100mm）TS突破0.1，从几乎无参考价值变为具备业务可用性；站点观测使暴雨TS额外提升10.4%并有效平衡Bias；模型具备数据驱动的空间校正能力。

Conclusion: 多源联合监督机制能有效提升极端降水事件的捕捉能力，所提方法显著优于单个NWP模型和当前业务产品，具备实际应用潜力。

Abstract: Accurate extreme precipitation forecasting is critical for disaster mitigation but remains challenging for numerical weather prediction (NWP) models due to systemic intensity underestimation and spatial displacement. Traditional precipitation multi-model blending algorithms perform pixel-by-pixel blending on the forecast field based on weights, which may lead to the expansion of precipitation areas and the smoothing of extreme values. This study proposes an U-Net based two-stage framework: probability classification followed by value reconstruction, to blend forecasts from six major NWP models. A novel station-grid joint supervision mechanism is introduced by integrating observations from 2411 national meteorological stations in China into the loss function, simultaneously constraining spatial structures and peak intensities. Evaluations using independent samples from the 2025 flood season demonstrate that our model significantly outperforms both individual NWPs and current operational products. For rainstorms (>=50 mm), the Threat Score (TS) improved by 38.4% compared to the best NWP. Notably, for extreme events (>=100 mm) driven by extratropical cyclones and the subtropical high, the model successfully elevated the TS to above 0.1, transforming forecasts from having negligible reference value into those with certain operational utility. Furthermore, the model exhibits data-driven spatial correction capabilities, effectively realigning systematic rainbelt displacements with actual precipitation centers. The inclusion of station observations specifically enhanced the TS for rainstorms by 10.4% and effectively balanced the Bias. These results highlight the efficacy of multi-source joint supervision in enhancing the capture of extreme precipitation events.

</details>


### [406] [Active Learning on Adversarially Corrupted Graphs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.04869)
*Marco Bressan,Nicolò Cesa-Bianchi,Tommaso d`Orsi,Emmanuel Esposito,Silvio Lattanzi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文针对恶意实体篡改网络的实际场景，定义了 adversary 通过添加边来隐藏图中 corrupted vertices 的模型，并设计了一种主动学习算法，利用少量标签查询近似恢复被破坏的顶点。该算法的查询复杂度与 adversary 的能力和图$G^*$的顶点扩展性（vertex expansion）呈多项式关系。核心是一个基于和平方（sum-of-squares）算法、在基数约束下寻找最小顶点扩展集合的多项式时间算法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现实场景中，恶意实体通过篡改现有网络来隐藏被破坏的顶点（corrupted vertices），需要设计鲁棒的主动学习算法来有效识别这些顶点。作者希望探究顶点扩展性（vertex expansion）在抗结构性对抗攻击的主动学习查询复杂度中的关键作用。

Method: 首先定义对抗模型：adversary 可以向 corrupted vertices 之间以及它们与$G^*$之间添加边，其能力由 corrupted vertices 在$G^*$中的邻域大小衡量。然后设计主动学习算法，算法核心是通过适配 sum-of-squares 方法求解在基数约束下最小化顶点扩展的优化问题，进而近似恢复 corrupted vertices。

Result: 提出了一个高效的主动学习算法，能以多项式级别的标签查询次数（与 adversary 的能力和图$G^*$的顶点扩展性成多项式关系）近似恢复 corrupted vertices。这是首次证明顶点扩展性在抗结构性对抗攻击的主动学习查询复杂度中起关键作用。

Conclusion: 顶点扩展性是决定抗结构性对抗攻击主动学习查询复杂度的关键因素；基于 sum-of-squares 的方法能有效解决基数约束下的最小顶点扩展问题，从而实现鲁棒的 corrupted vertices 恢复。

Abstract: Motivated by real-world scenarios where malicious entities tamper with existing networks, we define a model where an adversary seeks to hide a set of \emph{corrupted vertices} inside a graph $G^*$. To this end, the adversary can add edges between the corrupted vertices, as well as edges between the corrupted vertices and $G^*$, and its power is then measured by the size of the \emph{neighborhood} of the corrupted vertices in $G^*$. Our goal is to design an active learning algorithm that efficiently finds the subset of corrupted vertices using a small number of label queries. We devise an efficient algorithm that approximately recovers the corrupted vertices with a query complexity that depends polynomially on both the power of the adversary and the \emph{vertex expansion} of $G^*$, a fundamental measure of graph connectivity. At the heart of this result is a polynomial-time algorithm, obtained by carefully adapting sum-of-squares algorithms for approximating minimum expansion, that finds a set with small vertex expansion subject to cardinality constraints. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first time that the vertex expansion is shown to play a key role in determining the query complexity of active learning algorithms robust to structural adversarial attacks.

</details>


### [407] [RL-Ballast: Ship Ballast Water Path Planning and Clog Prediction via Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.04906)
*Ming-Kuan Lin,Yi-Chung Lai,Ming-Hsin Chiang,Tsung-Wei Pan,Jung-Hua Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出RL-Ballast，一种基于图的深度强化学习框架，用于船舶压载水自适应路径规划与传感器精简的堵塞点评分。该框架将阀门排列问题转化为54条可行流体传输路径，利用帧堆叠的液位和动作结果近似部分可观测的压载环境，通过情节级失败动作记忆和动态动作掩码避免重复无效动作，并利用失败传输历史对可疑阀门或管段进行排序。蒙特卡洛模拟表明，RL-Ballast能完成所有意外单堵塞场景，将平均决策步骤从61.0降至41.5，并实现100%的Top-3命中率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自主化和减员船舶需要智能内部系统来维持操作安全与结构稳定性，而传统基于规则或手动方法的压载水控制对液压异常（如阀门故障、管道堵塞）适应性有限，且通常依赖密集的压力或流量传感器进行诊断。为解决这些局限性，本文提出一种在有限传感条件下具备自适应能力与堵塞诊断功能的强化学习框架。

Method: 采用图论与深度优先搜索生成54条可行流体传输路径；使用帧堆叠的液位与动作结果近似部分可观测的压载环境，避免显式建模高维POMDP；引入情节级失败动作记忆与动态动作掩码支持即时重新路由；累积失败传输历史对可疑阀门/管段进行评分诊断。

Result: 蒙特卡洛模拟中，RL-Ballast完成所有单堵塞场景，平均决策步骤从61.0降至41.5；诊断方面，Top-3命中率100%，严格Top-1命中率66.7%，Top-1平局命中率83.3%。

Conclusion: RL-Ballast能在有限传感条件下实现自适应重新路由与面向维护的堵塞诊断，为Shipping 4.0范式下的自主船舶压载水控制提供有效方案。

Abstract: Under the Shipping 4.0 paradigm, autonomous and reduced-crew vessels require intelligent internal systems to maintain operational safety and structural stability. Ballast-water control is essential for ship trim and integrity, but conventional rule-based or manual approaches have limited adaptability to hydraulic anomalies such as valve failures and pipe blockages, and often depend on dense pressure or flow sensors for diagnosis. To address these limitations, this paper proposes RL-Ballast, a graph-based deep reinforcement learning framework for adaptive ballast-water path planning and sensor-frugal blockage candidate scoring. The valve-permutation problem is transformed into 54 feasible fluid-transfer routes generated using graph theory and depth-first search. The partially observable ballast environment is approximated with frame-stacked tank levels and action outcomes, allowing the agent to infer hidden blockage effects without explicitly modeling a high-dimensional POMDP. During deterministic inference, episode-level failed-action memory and dynamic action masking prevent repeated ineffective actions and support immediate rerouting. Failed transfer histories are further accumulated to rank suspicious valves or pipe segments without dense instrumentation. Monte Carlo simulations show that RL-Ballast completes all unexpected single-blockage scenarios and reduces average decision steps from 61.0 to 41.5 compared with a Dijkstra rule-based baseline. For diagnostic support, the failure-history scoring scheme achieves a 100% Top-3 hit rate, a 66.7% strict Top-1 hit rate, and an 83.3% Top-1 tie-hit rate under serially indistinguishable blockage conditions. These results suggest that RL-Ballast enables adaptive rerouting and maintenance-oriented blockage diagnosis under limited sensing conditions.

</details>


### [408] [When Do Foundation Models Pay Off? A Break-Even Analysis of Pretrained Time Series Forecasters](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.04919)
*Nicholas Tan Jerome,Frank Simon*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文首次系统分析了时间序列基础模型（Chronos、Moirai、Lag-Llama）与传统方法（Naive、ETS、ARIMA、XGBoost）的盈亏平衡点。在30个基准数据集上，15个数据集上基础模型无条件优于传统方法，6个数据集上传统方法始终胜出，9个数据集存在盈亏平衡样本量阈值（24-8,361样本）。提出两阶段决策框架，并发现当样本量<700且季节性强时，应直接使用零样本基础模型而非微调。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 部署时间序列基础模型需要GPU基础设施和工程开销，且未必优于XGBoost等经典方法。现有研究缺乏系统的盈亏平衡分析来指导从业者何时值得投资基础模型。

Method: 在30个基准数据集上，以6种训练集比例（2%-100%），系统比较零样本和LoRA微调的基础模型（Chronos、Moirai、Lag-Llama）与经典基线（Naive、ETS、ARIMA、XGBoost）的性能。

Result: 1) 15/30数据集上基础模型无条件优于经典方法；2) 6/30数据集上经典方法始终更优；3) 9/30数据集存在盈亏平衡点（24-8,361样本）；4) 当n_train<700且季节性强时，零样本基础模型最佳；5) LoRA微调在短序列上可能降低性能。

Conclusion: 提出两阶段决策框架：先计算数据集长度和季节性强度，仅在必要时运行5-10%的试点测试。该框架可在投入完整基础设施前做出FM与传统方法的选择决策。

Abstract: Deploying a time series foundation model requires GPU infrastructure, engineering overhead, and carries no guarantee of improvement over XGBoost. We provide the first systematic break-even analysis answering when this investment pays off. Across 30 benchmark datasets, we compare zero-shot and LoRA fine-tuned foundation models (Chronos, Moirai, Lag-Llama) against classical baselines (Naive, ETS, ARIMA, XGBoost) at six training set sizes from 2% to 100% of available data. Foundation models outperform classical methods at every evaluated training fraction on 15 of 30 datasets -- GPU deployment is unconditionally justified on these regardless of data volume. On 6 datasets, classical methods surpass zero-shot foundation models with as little as 2% of training data (21-2,768 samples); on the remaining 9, break-even ranges from 24 to 8,361 samples. One robust deployment rule requires no model training: if n_train < 700 and seasonality is non-negligible, use FM zero-shot and skip fine-tuning -- this resolves 10 of 30 deployment decisions immediately. Contrary to common practice, LoRA fine-tuning can actively degrade performance on short series. We operationalise these findings as a two-step decision framework -- compute dataset length and seasonality strength, run a brief 5-10% pilot only if needed -- enabling practitioners to make the FM-versus-classical decision before committing to full infrastructure. Four dataset features motivate mechanistic hypotheses for the remaining cases, though reliable automated prediction at this benchmark scale remains an open problem. Code, benchmark, and decision tools are available at https://github.com/nicolaisi/fm-breakeven.

</details>


### [409] [Input Pathways Shape Few-Shot, Not Zero-Shot, Binding in Tiny Transformers: A Fully-Enumerable Study](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.04926)
*Yoshiyuki Ootani*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文通过在有限因子化世界中穷举训练约6-10K参数的Transformer，研究信息传递方式（符号token、干净oracle编码、纠缠感知向量）如何影响组合性绑定。主要发现：端点不变性（零样本组合失败）、双因素解释（少样本绑定效率由输入路径参数共享和代码可读性共同决定）、双重分离（训练早期分布式编码超越索引型编码，少样本效率追踪路径共享）、失败解剖（不同路径的失败模式各异）。核心主张是双因素解释。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 探究信息以不同方式（符号token、干净oracle编码、纠缠感知向量）到达Transformer时，是否以及如何影响模型将信息进行组合性绑定的能力。这关系到对Transformer组合泛化能力本质的理解。

Method: 在有限因子化世界中穷举训练约6-10K参数的Transformer，确保每个测量覆盖整个输入空间（零采样方差），信息路径实现信息匹配（精确贝叶斯上限1.0）。通过端点不变性测试、双因素分析、双重分离实验和失败解剖来系统评估不同信息路径下的组合绑定能力。

Result: (1)端点不变性：所有信息路径在零样本组合上均失败（≤随机水平）。(2)双因素解释：少样本绑定效率由输入路径参数共享和代码可读性共同解释；干净oracle并非最样本高效的路径。(3)双重分离：分布式编码在训练早期出现短暂的超越随机阶段，而索引型编码没有；少样本效率追踪路径共享。(4)失败解剖：符号路径在读出层丢失答案；索引路径错误绑定；纠缠路径继承输入的不可读性。

Conclusion: Transformer的组合绑定能力受到信息表示方式的显著影响，核心机制是双因素解释（参数共享和代码可读性）。即使信息量完全匹配，不同路径的零样本组合绑定仍普遍失败，且失败模式各异。这揭示了Transformer在组合泛化上的固有限制源于其归纳偏置。

Abstract: How does the way information reaches a transformer -- as symbolic tokens, a clean per-factor "oracle" code, or an entangled perceptual vector -- shape whether it binds that information compositionally? We study ~6-10K-parameter transformers on finite factored worlds enumerated exhaustively, so every measurement covers the whole input space (zero sampling variance) and the informative routes are information-matched (exact Bayes ceiling 1.0). We report four findings. (1) Endpoint invariance: on held-out binding queries no informative route reaches converged zero-shot composition -- each ends at or below chance despite a ceiling of 1.0, so within a bounded sweep the failure reflects inductive bias under a lookup-sufficient objective, not missing information. (2) A two-factor account of few-shot binding: sample efficiency is best explained by input-pathway parameter sharing and code readability; a dimension-matched control and a graded readability sweep isolate readability from input dimension, and the clean oracle is not the most sample-efficient readable route. (3) A double dissociation: early in training, distributed -- but not index-like -- codes pass through a transient above-chance phase (tracking code format), while few-shot efficiency tracks pathway sharing. (4) Failure anatomy: symbolic routes lose the answer at the readout; index routes mis-bind (the answer stays decodable, yet an input intervention shows the output tracks the wrong slot); entangled routes inherit their input's readability. The central claim is the two-factor account; the endpoint and anatomy results are diagnostic constraints. All code, manifests, and per-seed logs are released for exact reproduction.

</details>


### [410] [Lightweight ML-Based Automatic Sleep Staging Framework with Constrained CNN and Mamba for Small-Sample EEG Datasets](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.04934)
*Zihao Wei,Yulin Gong,Yudan Lv*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出GamSleepNet，一个轻量级低延迟的单通道EEG自动睡眠分期框架，通过FEB模块（改进Gabor核+可学习滤波器）、Mamba时序分类网络、对比损失和两阶段训练策略，在仅3.086万参数下达到87.86%准确率，显著提升N1和REM等困难分期识别精度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有自动睡眠分期方法面临三大挑战：参数过大导致小数据集过拟合、N1和REM等困难分期分类精度低、最优训练集大小不明确且难以部署，亟需轻量高效方案。

Method: 1) FEB模块：融合改进的Gabor核与可学习滤波器进行特征提取；2) 基于Mamba架构构建时序分类网络；3) 引入新型对比损失函数与两阶段训练策略；4) 实验验证单通道EEG睡眠分期模型的最优数据集规模。

Result: 在Sleepedf数据集上，仅用3.086万参数达到87.86%总体准确率，所有指标达到SOTA水平，显著提升了挑战性睡眠分期（如N1和REM）的识别准确率。

Conclusion: GamSleepNet以极低参数量实现了SOTA性能，有效解决了轻量部署与困难分期精度提升的双重难题，为便携式睡眠监测设备提供了可行方案。

Abstract: Automatic sleep staging is a key technology for precise diagnosis and treatment of sleep disorders as well as long-term home sleep monitoring. Portable electroencephalogram (EEG) devices have become the focus of research due to their convenience in data collection. However, current methods still face three major challenges: large parameter sizes that easily lead to overfitting on small datasets, low accuracy in classifying difficult stages such as N1 and REM, unclear optimal training dataset size, and difficulty in deployment. This paper proposes GamSleepNet, a lightweight and low-latency automatic sleep staging framework for single-channel EEG. The framework features the FEB module, which combines improved Gabor kernels with learnable filters for feature extraction, uses the Mamba architecture to build a temporal classification network, introduces a novel contrastive loss and a two-stage training strategy, and experimentally validates the optimal dataset size for single-channel EEG sleep staging models. On the Sleepedf dataset, this model achieves an overall accuracy of 87.86 percent with only 30.86 thousand parameters, with all metrics reaching SOTA levels and significantly improving the identification accuracy of challenging sleep stages.

</details>


### [411] [Sensitivity Sampling with Predictions for k-Means Clustering](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.04949)
*Cristian Boldrin,Fabio Vandin*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出利用预测来近似k-means敏感性采样中的重要性权重，从而在保持理论保证的同时大幅降低计算时间。实验表明，该方法在序列数据集上的聚类成本与运行时间权衡显著优于现有方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于敏感性采样的k-means核心集方法虽然理论上能提供高质量近似解，但计算每个输入点相对于所有可能中心的重要性（敏感性）极其耗时，导致在大数据集上运行时间不切实际。

Method: (1) 理论证明当前敏感性采样核心集结果在更粗的敏感性近似下仍然成立；(2) 提出利用先前数据集的低误差聚类中心作为预测来近似后续数据集的敏感性值；(3) 在序列数据集场景下进行实验验证。

Result: 所提方法在聚类成本与运行时间的权衡上显著优于均匀采样和现有最先进的敏感性采样方法，适用于序列数据集场景。

Conclusion: 利用预测可以大幅降低敏感性采样的计算开销，同时保持理论保证，为大规模k-means聚类提供更实用的解决方案。

Abstract: We study the problem of k-means clustering on large datasets. The state-of-the-art for the problem is given by coresets-based approaches, which build small weighted summaries of the input and derive approximate solutions with rigorous quality guarantees from them. One of the most popular and advanced approaches to derive coresets for k-means is sensitivity sampling. However, sensitivity sampling requires to compute the importance of each input point with respect to the whole dataset over all possible choices of centers. Since the exact computation of such quantities is unfeasible, current approaches work by approximating the sensitivity values. Nevertheless, the runtime of such approaches is still impractical for large datasets.
  In this work, we propose to reduce the runtime of sensitivity-based approaches for k-means by leveraging predictions to approximate the importance of input points. We first formally prove that current theoretical results on coresets construction via sensitivity sampling hold for coarser approximations of sensitivities compared to the one required by existing approaches. This implies that even fairly noisy predictors can be leveraged for sensitivity-sampling approaches. We then propose a natural predictor, which applies to the common scenario where clustering is performed (over time) on a sequence of datasets from the same problem. We prove that when the datasets in the sequence come from the same (unknown) distribution, centers resulting in a low error on one dataset can be used as predictions for sensitivity sampling in subsequent datasets, with guarantees on their quality. We perform an extensive experimental evaluation showing that our approach significantly improves, in terms of clustering cost vs runtime, over uniform sampling and state-of-the-art sensitivity sampling approaches when applied to sequences of datasets.

</details>


### [412] [Train Smarter, Not Longer: Memorization-Guided Data Reuse for Efficient LLM Training](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.04969)
*Jingwei Zuo,Cong Zeng,Ilyas Chahed,Maksim Velikanov,Dhia Eddine Rhaiem,Pasquale Balsebre,Abhay Kumar,Younes Belkada,Hakim Hacid*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出基于“记忆窗口”信号的自适应数据复用训练范式，发现模型性能在远超常规四轮训练后仍可持续提升，为高效利用有限高质量数据提供了理论基础。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大语言模型训练从单轮转向多轮，但何时及如何有效复用数据的问题尚未充分探索，过度重复存在过拟合和收益递减风险。

Method: 通过观察模型损失保留动态和下游评估分数中的“记忆窗口”信号，提出记忆引导的数据复用（Memorization-guided Data Reuse）训练范式，自适应决定数据复用的时机和方式。

Result: 初步实验表明存在一致的记忆驱动机制：模型性能在远超常规的四轮限制后仍随重复训练持续提升。

Conclusion: 该发现为记忆感知的训练调度奠定基础，有助于确定复用预算，推动以更智能而非更长时间的方式利用有限高质量数据训练大语言模型。

Abstract: The training paradigm of large language models has shifted from traditional one-pass training to multi-epoch training, as reasonable reuse of limited high-quality data can improve both model performance and sample efficiency. Meanwhile, excessive repetition introduces the risk of overfitting and diminishing returns. Determining when and how to reuse data effectively thus emerges as a natural but under-explored question. Through a novel observation of model's "Memorization Window" signals derived from loss retention dynamics and downstream evaluation scores, we propose "Memorization-guided Data Reuse", a training paradigm that adaptively determines when and how data should be reused, enabling principled decisions on the number of training epochs and the scheduling of data replays. Our preliminary experiments reveal a consistent memorization-driven regime: performance continues to improve with repetition far beyond current practice (e.g., the commonly cited four-epoch limit). While a full scheduler remains future work, these insights provide a foundation for memorization-aware training schedules, helping to determine reuse budgets and move toward training LLMs smarter rather than longer with limited high-quality data.

</details>


### [413] [Geometry-Aware Bayesian Quantification via Compositional Data Analysis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.04977)
*Alejandro Moreo,Pablo González,Juan José del Coz*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于Aitchison几何与对数比表示的核密度估计方法，用于多类标签偏移下的类别比例估计，解决了传统欧几里得高斯核忽略概率单纯形几何结构的问题，并通过收缩正则化提升了边界鲁棒性。在42个数据集上的实验表明，该方法在点估计和贝叶斯推断方面均具有竞争力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 准确估计未知目标标签分布是适应标签偏移的关键第一步（即量化/类别流行度估计）。现有基于KDE的方法使用欧几里得高斯核，忽略了后验向量位于概率单纯形上的组合数据几何结构，错误地将概率质量分配到单纯形边界之外。

Method: 1) 基于对数比表示和Aitchison几何构建几何感知的KDE模型；2) 引入收缩正则化以提高单纯形边界附近的鲁棒性；3) 结合KDE量化中的最大似然解释，推导了点估计和贝叶斯推断两种类别流行度估计流程。

Result: 在涵盖表格、文本和图像领域的42个数据集上，该方法与最先进的量化器具有竞争力，通常优于标准KDE基线，并在贝叶斯量化方法中取得了强劲结果。

Conclusion: 考虑单纯形几何结构的KDE方法能有效提升多类量化性能，对数比表示与Aitchison几何是处理组合数据分布估计的合理框架。

Abstract: Accurately estimating the unknown target label distribution is the critical first step for adapting to label shift. This task, widely known as quantification or class prevalence estimation, has recently seen significant advances through continuous KDE-based methods which model the density of multiclass classifier posteriors. Posterior vectors might be regarded as compositional data, since they lie on the probability simplex. However, existing KDE-based quantifiers typically rely on Euclidean Gaussian kernels, which ignore simplex geometry and incorrectly assign probability mass outside its boundaries. We introduce a geometry-aware KDE model for multiclass quantification based on log-ratio representations and Aitchison geometry, together with a shrinkage regularization that improves robustness near the simplex boundary. Combined with a maximum-likelihood interpretation of KDE-based quantification, we derive both point-estimation and Bayesian inference procedures for class prevalences. Experiments on 42 datasets across tabular, text, and image domains show that the proposed method is competitive with state-of-the-art quantifiers, often improving over standard KDE-based baselines, while also yielding strong results among Bayesian quantification methods.

</details>


### [414] [Qantara: Bridge-Flow Training for Multi-Paradigm JEPA Control](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.04978)
*Ruslan Rakhimov,George Bredis,Yuriy Maksyuta,Daniil Gavrilov*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: Qantara是一个端到端联合嵌入预测架构(JEPA)，通过结合布朗桥插值与流匹配的联合训练目标，使同一检查点支持三种推理范式（潜变量规划、行为克隆动作采样、逆动力学视频逆合成），无需重新训练。在LeWM控制套件上达到91.2 SR，在OGBench-Cube上超越SOTA，将JEPA从单一范式规划器扩展为多范式控制器。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有JEPA世界模型在训练时承诺单一的推理范式（轨迹优化或行为克隆），无法在推理时根据部署约束（滚动成本、观测可访问性）灵活选择最优路径。作者希望打破这一限制，使同一检查点能同时服务于多种推理范式。

Method: 提出Qantara，一种端到端JEPA架构。联合训练目标包含两部分：1) 在状态轴上构建相邻干净潜变量之间的布朗桥插值；2) 在动作轴上采用从噪声到数据的流匹配。训练将质量集中在(动作时间, 状态时间)噪声方块的边缘，对应推理时的预测器查询区域。支持三种推理范式：潜变量规划、行为克隆动作采样、通过视频逆合成实现逆动力学。

Result: 在LeWM控制套件上达到91.2 SR（三训练种子平均），在OGBench-Cube上超越DINO-WM 7.7 SR、超越LeWM 19.7 SR。同一权重的行为克隆和视频逆路径在Push-T上达到82-83 SR，在Cube上达到71-73 SR。用均匀内部采样替换边缘训练会导致Push-T规划从90.1降至53.3 SR（计算量匹配）。

Conclusion: Qantara成功将JEPA世界模型从单一范式规划器转变为多范式控制器，同一检查点无需重新训练即可在推理时根据部署条件选择规划、行为克隆或逆动力学路径。

Abstract: Joint-Embedding Predictive Architectures (JEPAs) underpin a growing family of latent world models for control from raw pixels, but every existing JEPA world model commits at training time to a single inference paradigm: either trajectory optimisation in a learned dynamics model, or direct behaviour cloning. A single checkpoint that serves both would defer this choice to inference, when deployment constraints (rollout cost, observation accessibility) determine which path wins. We present Qantara, an end-to-end JEPA whose joint training objective pairs a Brownian-bridge interpolant between consecutive clean latents on the state axis with noise-to-data flow matching on the action axis. The same checkpoint serves three inference paradigms without retraining: latent planning, behaviour-cloning action sampling, and inverse dynamics, which we query through a video-inverse composition that first predicts the next latent without action conditioning, then extracts the action. Training concentrates mass on the edges of the (action-time, state-time) noise square, where inference queries the predictor: replacing it with uniform interior sampling drops Push-T planning from 90.1 to 53.3 SR at matched compute. On the LeWM control suite, Qantara reaches a 91.2 SR three-train-seed average and sets new SOTA on OGBench-Cube (+7.7 SR over DINO-WM, +19.7 over LeWM). From the same weights, the behaviour-cloning and video-inverse paths reach 82-83 SR on Push-T and 71-73 SR on Cube. These results move JEPA world models from single-paradigm planners to multi-paradigm controllers.

</details>


### [415] [Data-Driven Soft Labeling Scales DNA Read Classification to Whole-Body Cell-Type Deconvolution](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.04987)
*Dmytro Rizdvanetskyi,Nathan Ross,Pavlo Lutsik*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: Syto是一个基于读段级分类的细胞类型反卷积新框架，通过提出数据驱动的软标签方案解决大规模多类别场景下硬标签冲突和分类器不收敛问题，在39种人类细胞类型数据集上MSE降低2.56倍，且泛化到16个组织的分布外数据。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于DNA甲基化的细胞类型反卷积方法大多使用聚合甲基化估计，丢弃了单个读段携带的模式级信息；已有的读段级方法局限于少数类别场景，难以扩展到大规模类别，因为非判别性读段占主导且硬标签无法处理甲基化模式与细胞类型之间的多对多映射，导致分类器不收敛。

Method: 提出数据驱动的软标签方案，估计每个读段的条件细胞类型分布；将该方案集成到Syto模块化框架中，实现基于读段级分类的反卷积。

Result: 在39种人类细胞类型全身体图谱上，Syto将均方误差（MSE）相比现有最优方法降低2.56倍，且在涵盖16个组织的分布外数据集上性能增益可迁移。

Conclusion: Syto为建模日益庞大的细胞类型面板奠定了基础，可改进生物学和医疗应用；提出的软标签方案可推广到任何具有多对多信号到标签映射的场景。

Abstract: Cell-type deconvolution, the task of estimating the proportions of constituent cell types in a heterogeneous biological sample, is a core problem in computational biology. Methods that rely on epigenetic marks such as DNA methylation typically operate on aggregated methylation estimates, discarding the pattern-level information carried by individual DNA reads. Existing read-level approaches that exploit this information are scarce, and all remain restricted to few-class settings; scaling them further is an open problem because, at scale, non-discriminative reads dominate and hard labels conflict with the many-to-many mapping between methylation patterns and cell types, preventing classifier convergence. To overcome this, we propose data-driven soft labels that estimate the conditional cell-type distribution for each read, and integrate this scheme into Syto, a new modular framework for read-level classification-based deconvolution. On a whole-body atlas of 39 human cell types, Syto reduces MSE by 2.56$\times$ over SoTA, with gains transferring to an out-of-distribution dataset spanning 16 tissues. Syto lays the foundation for modeling increasingly large cell-type panels, with improved applications in biology and healthcare. The proposed soft-labeling scheme is further translatable to any setting with a many-to-many signal-to-label mapping.

</details>


### [416] [Non-Convex Sparse Reinforcement Learning via Non-Monotone Inclusions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.04990)
*Kyohei Suzuki,onstantinos Slavakis*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出将非凸PMC惩罚项引入LSTD策略评估，形成非单调包含问题，并利用前向-反射-后向分裂（FRBS）方法求解，从理论和实验两方面证明了该方法在强化学习特征选择中的有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统正则化方案在强化学习特征选择中存在估计偏差，且LSTD策略评估的固定点问题在引入非凸惩罚后不再是单调包含问题，现有算法缺乏收敛性保证。

Method: 将稀疏诱导的非凸PMC惩罚项增强LSTD策略评估，将问题建模为单调Lipschitz算子与hypomonotone算子和的非单调包含问题，采用前向-反射-后向分裂（FRBS）方法求解。

Result: 在温和条件下建立了FRBS迭代序列的Lyapunov稳定性和极限点存在性；在弱Minty变分不等式假设下保证了精确收敛；基准数据集上的数值实验表明该方法在存在大量噪声特征时显著优于现有方法。

Conclusion: 非凸正则化与FRBS方法的结合为强化学习中的高效特征选择提供了理论与算法支撑，扩展了非单调包含问题的收敛性理论。

Abstract: This work delivers two key contributions: one to efficient feature selection in reinforcement learning
  (RL), the other to the theory of non-monotone inclusions. On the RL side, the estimation bias inherent
  in conventional regularization schemes is addressed by augmenting classical least-squares
  temporal-difference (LSTD) policy evaluation with the sparsity-inducing, non-convex projected minimax
  concave (PMC) penalty. Because the PMC penalty is weakly convex, the resulting fixed-point problem is
  no longer monotone; instead, it falls under a broader class of non-monotone inclusions involving the
  sum of a monotone Lipschitz operator and a hypomonotone operator. On the theory side, novel convergence
  conditions are developed for the forward-reflected-backward splitting (FRBS) method applied to this
  broader class of non-monotone inclusion problems. Under mild conditions, Lyapunov stability and the
  existence of a limit point of the sequence of FRBS iterates are established; alternatively, under the
  weak Minty variational inequality assumption, exact convergence is guaranteed. Numerical tests on
  benchmark datasets show that the proposed FRBS iterates, applied to the non-convexly regularized LSTD
  problem, substantially outperform state-of-the-art feature-selection methods, especially when many
  noisy features are present.

</details>


### [417] [The Map Behind the Flow: Finite-Step Gradient Descent as a Dynamical System](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.04993)
*Thomas Hofmann*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文通过一系列精确可解的模型，将固定步长梯度下降视为离散动力系统进行研究，发现学习率不仅是数值稳定性参数，更是决定训练动力学的吸引子与表征选择的结构性参数。边缘稳定性（Edge of Stability）并非优化崩溃，而是训练映射的首次分岔。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 深度学习的许多现象本质上是动力学的，涉及梯度下降如何到达、避免或选择极小值，而小步长梯度流极限无法捕捉边缘稳定性、尖峰振荡、弹射相、平衡化以及向更平坦表征移动等效应。现有研究缺乏对固定步长梯度下降作为离散动力系统的精确理解。

Method: 构建从深度线性链的标量约化（得到四次损失和三次梯度映射）出发的层级精确可解模型，在大深度标度下收敛到通用Ricker型映射。然后将标量动力学嵌入因子化模型、宽线性网络、数据耦合、非线性激活和随机目标等更复杂设置中，分析有限步长离散动力系统的行为。

Result: 边缘稳定性是训练映射的首次分岔；有限步长打破了梯度流的守恒律并压缩了因子化不平衡；残差振荡将参数推向更平坦、更平衡的表征；宽线性网络产生谱边阶梯，最优学习率可能位于首个谱边之后；数据耦合、非线性和随机目标都遵循相同组织原则：有限步振荡驱动对齐、平衡化和表征选择。

Conclusion: 学习率不仅是数值稳定性参数，更是训练动力学的结构参数，它决定了吸引子并塑造了梯度下降选择的表征。

Abstract: Many phenomena of deep learning are dynamical: they concern not only which minima exist, but how gradient descent reaches, avoids, or selects among them. Edge-of-stability behavior, sharpness oscillations, catapult phases, balancing, and movement toward flatter representations are effects of the training map itself, and are poorly captured by the small-step gradient-flow limit.
  This paper studies fixed-step gradient descent as a discrete dynamical system in a hierarchy of exactly solvable models retaining basic structures of deep learning: depth, factorization, width, data coupling, activation, and stochasticity. The starting point is the balanced scalar reduction of a deep linear chain, giving a quartic loss and a cubic gradient map whose post-edge behavior is explicit. Under the natural large-depth scaling, this dynamics converges to a universal Ricker-type map. The edge of stability is therefore not a breakdown of optimization, but the first bifurcation of the training map.
  Embedding the scalar dynamics back into factored models turns these regimes into learning phenomena. Finite steps break conservation laws of gradient flow and contract factorization imbalance; residual oscillations move parameters toward flatter, more balanced representations. Wider linear networks produce a ladder of spectral edges, so the optimal learning rate can lie beyond the first edge. Data coupling, nonlinear activations, and stochastic targets preserve the same organizing principle: finite-step oscillations drive alignment, balancing, and representation selection. Thus the learning rate is not merely a numerical stability parameter. It is a structural parameter of the training dynamics, determining its attractors and shaping the representations gradient descent selects.

</details>


### [418] [ImputeECG: Deep Learning Reconstruction of Complete 12-Lead Electrocardiograms from Incomplete Recordings for Cardiac Assessment](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.05009)
*Xiaocheng Fang,Haoyu Wang,Jieyi Cai,Qinghao Zhao,Jun Li,Shanwei Zhang,Guangkun Nie,Yujie Xiao,Shun Huang,Jiarui Jin,Hongmin Liu,Guodong Wang,Shuohua Chen,Liming Lin,Shouling Wu,Hongyan Li,Shenda Hong*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: ImputeECG是一种基于掩码条件一维Transformer自编码器的心电图补全方法，能够将不完整的12导联10秒心电图信号补全为完整信号，在PTB-XL、CPSC2018和真实世界Kailuan临床队列中显著降低了缺失区域的误差，并恢复了接近完整心电图的诊断性能（如分类AUROC达92%以上），支持将不完整心电图记录转化为AI可用的数字信号。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 临床心电图记录因短显示格式、波形数字化不完全、导联丢失或信号损坏等原因常不完整，尤其是从心电图像数字化而来的记录，这限制了AI辅助心血管评估的应用。亟需一种能够在不改变已观测样本的前提下补全缺失12导联心电图信号的方法。

Method: 提出ImputeECG，一种掩码条件的一维Transformer自编码器，在保留所有已观测样本的同时补全完整的12导联10秒心电图；在PTB-XL上训练，在PTB-XL和CPSC2018的模拟不完整设置下评估，并在43,633例Kailuan临床队列的真实心电图像数字化场景中验证。

Result: 在PTB-XL上，缺失区域MAE降低41.7-51.0%、MSE降低54.0-63.7%，优于最强基线；R峰时序、RR间期、QRS时限、QT间期及P波、QRS波群、T波重建误差更低。CPSC2018上MAE降低49.7-51.9%。下游分类中PTB-XL最不完整设置下AUROC达92.28%、AUPRC达33.88%，接近完整心电图性能；Kailuan中零样本性别预测AUROC从82.6%提升至85.8%，年龄预测MAE从10.72降至9.87年。

Conclusion: 心电图补全是将不完整心电图记录转化为AI可用的12导联10秒数字信号的有效实用策略，可扩展心电图档案在数字心脏评估中的可用范围。

Abstract: Complete digital 12-lead electrocardiograms (ECGs) are essential for AI-enabled cardiovascular assessment, yet many clinical ECG records, particularly those digitized from ECG images, remain incomplete because of short display formats, incomplete waveform digitization, lead loss, or signal corruption. We developed ImputeECG, a mask-conditioned one-dimensional Transformer autoencoder that completes 12-lead, 10-s ECGs while retaining all observed samples. The model was trained on PTB-XL and evaluated on PTB-XL and CPSC2018 under simulated incomplete settings, with additional real-world validation in a 43,633-record Kailuan clinical cohort after ECG image digitization. Metrics were computed over originally missing regions, with analyses of morphology and downstream diagnostic utility. On PTB-XL, ImputeECG reduced missing-region MAE by 41.7-51.0% and MSE by 54.0-63.7% versus the strongest baseline, with lower errors in R-peak timing, RR interval, QRS duration, QT interval, and P-wave, QRS-complex, and T-wave reconstruction. On CPSC2018, ImputeECG reduced MAE by 49.7-51.9%, supporting external generalization. In downstream multi-label classification, ImputeECG restored performance to 92.28% AUROC and 33.88% AUPRC in the most incomplete PTB-XL setting, approaching complete-ECG performance. On CPSC2018, completed ECGs achieved 94.75-95.89% AUROC and 78.83-81.86% AUPRC across settings. In Kailuan, ECG completion improved zero-shot sex prediction AUROC from 82.6% to 85.8% and reduced age prediction MAE from 10.72 to 9.87 years after image-based ECG digitization. These findings support ECG completion as a practical strategy for converting incomplete ECG records into AI-ready 12-lead, 10-s digital signals and extending the usable scope of ECG archives for digital cardiac assessment.

</details>


### [419] [Hyperparameter Transfer in Graph Neural Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.05017)
*Gage DeZoort,Boris Hanin*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究了图神经网络（GNNs）的超参数迁移方法，提出了适用于SGD、Adam和AdamW优化器的迁移参数化方案，通过理论缩放分析和实验验证，证明了该方法在宽度和深度增加时能保持稳定的特征更新、学习率迁移以及性能提升，并针对不同优化器给出了具体建议。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 超参数迁移在密集神经网络（如语言和视觉任务）中已有充分研究，但在图神经网络（GNNs）中仍相对缺乏探索。本文旨在填补这一空白，为GNNs建立系统的超参数迁移框架。

Method: 通过理论缩放分析和受控实验，提出适用于GNNs的迁移参数化方案。针对SGD引入图相关的第一层校正因子；针对Adam研究不同消息传递归一化对迁移行为的影响；针对AdamW调整参数化方案以实现权重衰减和学习率的联合迁移。

Result: 提出的参数化方案在宽度和深度增加时能保持稳定的特征更新、实现学习率迁移，并提升性能。SGD中图相关校正因子可加速稀疏词袋输入图的早期训练；Adam中消息传递归一化对迁移行为有显著影响；AdamW实现了权重衰减和学习率的联合迁移。

Conclusion: 本文为GNNs在不同学习任务和训练场景下的缩放提供了实用的方案，验证了超参数迁移在GNNs中的有效性。

Abstract: The performance of deep learning models crucially depends on the settings of hyperparameters like learning rate, initialization scale, and weight decay. Hyperparameter transfer aims to make near-optimal hyperparameter settings consistent across model scale, so that large models can be optimized by proxy tuning their smaller, cheaper-to-optimize counterparts. While transfer principles are well-studied in the context of dense neural networks in language and vision tasks, they remain comparatively under-explored for graph neural networks (GNNs). We develop and validate a transfer parameterization for GNNs trained with SGD, Adam, and AdamW. Through theoretical scaling analyses and controlled experiments, we show that the proposed parameterization yields stable feature updates, learning rate transfer, and improved performance as width and depth increase. For SGD, we identify graph-dependent first-layer correction factors and show that their use can accelerate early training in graphs with sparse bag-of-words inputs. For Adam, we explore how different message passing normalizations affect early- and late-training transfer behavior, illustrating the importance of message passing normalization and advocating for an associated hyperparameter. For AdamW, we adapt a parameterization that allows for the joint transfer of weight decay and learning rate. Together, these results provide a practical recipe for scaling GNNs across a variety of learning tasks and training scenarios.

</details>


### [420] [Beyond Modality Fusion: Deep Ensembles for Multimodal Classification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.05019)
*Ilya Burenko,Dmitry Vetrov*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文证明，在多模态分类中，深度集成（deep ensembles）单模态网络无需显式融合即可超越最先进的晚期融合（late-fusion）方法，尤其在模态不平衡场景下表现优异。作者提出了一种启发式方法选择每模态模型数量，并通过合成框架和缩放定律系统验证了结论。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有晚期融合方法在模态不平衡时性能下降，需要复杂的正则化技术来平衡学习过程。作者希望探索是否可以通过更简单的方式——即深度集成单模态网络——来有效分类多模态数据，而无需显式模态融合。

Method: 1. 系统比较深度集成与晚期融合网络（参数数量相同）；2. 提出启发式方法选择每模态模型数量，避免穷举搜索；3. 提出合成多模态框架，可控制模态数量和预测强度；4. 对双模态数据拟合缩放定律，估计集成的渐近性能。

Result: 1. 深度集成一致优于最先进的晚期融合方法及中间融合和混合方法；2. 极端模态不平衡且集成规模较小时，只用强模态训练的单模态模型集成更优；集成规模扩大后，引入弱模态模型有益；3. 合成数据与真实数据实验结果一致。

Conclusion: 深度集成单模态网络是一种简单有效的多模态分类策略，无需显式融合即可应对模态不平衡问题，启发式选择方法可指导实际应用中的模型配置。

Abstract: In multimodal classification, late-fusion approaches classify concatenated modality-specific features extracted by unimodal neural networks.
  When modality imbalance is pronounced, various regularization techniques have been proposed to balance the learning process and overcome the inferior performance of late-fusion networks.
  In contrast, this work demonstrates that multimodal data can be effectively classified without any explicit modality fusion, using deep ensembles of unimodal networks.
  We systematically compare deep ensembles to late-fusion networks at equal parameter count and show that ensembles consistently outperform state-of-the-art late-fusion methods designed to address modality imbalance.
  This advantage also holds over intermediate-fusion techniques we evaluated and over hybrid methods that combine unimodal and multimodal predictions.
  We propose and empirically validate a method for selecting the number of models per modality in an ensemble, avoiding computationally expensive exhaustive search.
  Under extreme modality imbalance and small ensemble sizes, the heuristic indicates that ensembles of unimodal models trained solely on the stronger modality are preferable; as the ensemble scales up, incorporating models from the weaker modality becomes beneficial.
  Both predictions align with our empirical findings.
  To systematically explore the challenges of optimizing multimodal models, we propose a synthetic multimodal framework that allows control over both the number of modalities and their predictive strength; our findings are consistent across synthetic and real-world datasets.
  Finally, by fitting scaling laws to bimodal datasets, we estimate the asymptotic performance of ensembles.

</details>


### [421] [Uncertainty-aware damage identification in short-span bridges via physics-informed variational autoencoder](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.05025)
*Ana Fernandez Navamuel,A. Javier Omella,Diego Zamora-Sanchez,David Pardo*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种物理信息高斯连接变分自编码器（PI-GCVAE）框架，通过嵌入可微分数值特征值求解器确保物理一致性，并利用高斯连接捕获空间相关性，在合成桥梁数据集上实现了77.2%的后验覆盖率的损伤识别与不确定性量化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基于振动的土木基础设施损伤识别是一个病态逆问题，受到测量噪声、稀疏传感器阵列和环境变化的影响。现有的确定性深度学习方法缺乏可靠的不确定性量化，且可能产生物理不一致的结果。

Method: 提出PI-GCVAE框架：1）在VAE架构中直接嵌入可微分数值特征值求解器，替代数据驱动代理模型，确保潜在空间样本满足结构动力学控制方程；2）使用高斯连接替代传统独立假设，捕获相邻结构单元间依赖于物理的空间交叉相关性；3）相比高斯混合模型，连接模型在高维强相关潜在空间中更高效。

Result: 在合成简支桥梁数据集（含多种损伤场景和高斯噪声）上验证，PI-GCVAE能够准确恢复真实后验分布，达到77.2%的覆盖率。

Conclusion: 该框架为运营中的桥梁早期损伤诊断提供了可靠、可扩展的工具，能够有效量化不确定性并确保物理一致性。

Abstract: Vibration-based damage identification in civil infrastructure is a challenging, ill-posed inverse problem due to measurement noise, sparse sensor arrays, and environmental variability. While deep learning is powerful for system identification, deterministic approaches lack reliable uncertainty quantification and can yield physically inconsistent results. This work proposes a robust probabilistic Scientific Machine Learning (SciML) framework: a physics-informed Gaussian copula variational autoencoder (PI-GCVAE) for structural health monitoring (SHM). First, we eliminate the need for data-driven surrogates by embedding a differentiable numerical eigenvalue solver directly into the VAE architecture. This ensures that latent space samples satisfy the governing equations of structural dynamics, reducing the trainable parameter space and improving generalization. Second, we replace the conventional independence assumption of latent variables with a Gaussian copula. This model captures complex, physics-dependent spatial cross-correlations between adjacent structural elements, defining feasible solutions while accounting for inherent system variability and measurement errors. Third, compared with alternatives such as Gaussian mixtures, our copula-based VAE provides an efficient distributional model for high-dimensional, strongly correlated latent spaces. We validate the approach using a synthetic dataset of a simply supported bridge subjected to various damage scenarios and corrupted with stochastic Gaussian noise. Synthetic data enables exhaustive validation against ground-truth stiffness values unavailable in practice. Results demonstrate that the PI-GCVAE accurately recovers the true posterior distribution, achieving 77.2% coverage. The proposed framework provides a reliable, scalable tool for early-stage damage diagnosis in operating bridges.

</details>


### [422] [CollabEval: Statistically Efficient Collaborative Model Evaluation via Matrix Completion](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.05046)
*Adam Fisch,Daniel Deutsch,Joshua Maynez,Alekh Agarwal,Jonathan Berant,William Cohen,Amir Globerson,Jacob Eisenstein*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出CollabEval方法，利用历史模型评估数据间的依赖关系，通过矩阵补全和预测驱动推断，在少量标注下实现高效、无偏的生成式AI模型评估，显著提升统计效率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 生成式AI模型的评估是一个资源密集型过程，需要在模型开发过程中反复进行。现有方法效率低下，未能充分利用历史评估运行之间的依赖关系来降低标注成本。

Method: 将模型评估建模为M×N评分矩阵的补全问题（M为模型数，N为评估提示数）。对目标模型仅标注p比例的提示，利用预测驱动推断（prediction-powered inference）构建矩阵的低秩近似，将重构值作为控制变量（control variates），保证评估指标均值的无偏估计和有效置信区间。

Result: 在多种数据集、模型和稀疏度p下，CollabEval相比基线方法，显著降低了平均置信区间大小和点估计的均方误差，在相同标注预算下取得更优统计效率。

Conclusion: CollabEval是一种简单、有效且有原则的方法，通过利用模型间的依赖关系，能在少量标注下实现高效、无偏的生成式AI模型评估，为模型评估的资源优化提供了新思路。

Abstract: Evaluating generative AI models is a routine, but resource-intensive, process that is conducted over and over again during the course of model development. In this work, we propose Collaborative Evaluation (CollabEval), a simple, effective, and principled method for exploiting dependencies between historical runs of different models on the same tasks to improve statistical efficiency. Specifically, our approach treats model evaluation as a matrix completion problem over an $M \times N$ matrix of evaluation scores, where $M$ is the total number of models and $N$ is the total number of evaluation prompts. We assume that a subset of these $M$ models are targeted for evaluation. For these target models only a small fraction, $p$, of prompts has been annotated with evaluation scores. Leveraging recent results in prediction-powered inference, we build a low-rank approximation of the score matrix, and use the reconstructed values as control variates in a manner that guarantees unbiased estimates of the true evaluation metric mean, in addition to statistically valid confidence intervals. Empirically, across a wide range of datasets, models, and sparsity levels $p$, we find that CollabEval substantially reduces the mean confidence interval size, and the mean squared error of the point estimate, compared to baseline methods at the same annotation budget.

</details>


### [423] [Grokking Is Conditional and Fragile: A Fully-Tractable, Multi-Seed Study at 12K Parameters](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.05104)
*Yoshiyuki Ootani*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文通过一个仅11,856参数的Llama风格变压器模型（Glimmer-1-Base）研究模块化算术任务中的“Grokking”（泛化延迟涌现）现象。在完全可追踪的规模下，发现Grokking是一个条件性、脆弱的相变，受训练集覆盖率门控，且对浮点计算环境（CPU线程数、CPU vs GPU执行）高度敏感。通过多种子率统计而非单次运行作为证据单位，推翻了多个单次运行叙事中的种子混淆。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统Grokking研究通常使用过大的模型且基于单次训练运行报告结果，难以全面解析其机制。本文旨在通过一个完全可追踪的小型变压器模型，系统性地测量Grokking的多种子率行为，揭示其条件性和脆弱性，并纠正单次运行研究中的种子混淆问题。

Method: 使用11,856参数的Llama风格变压器（Glimmer-1-Base）在模块化算术任务上训练；通过枚举权重、注意力和完整的输入-输出映射实现完全可追踪；采用多种子率统计代替单次运行；系统性地改变训练集覆盖率、权重衰减、浮点环境（CPU线程数、CPU vs GPU）等条件进行实验。

Result: Grokking是一个条件性相变，受训练集覆盖率门控，其阈值与模数（输出基数）而非任务结构相关；权重衰减在12K参数上复现了Omnigrok倒U形曲线；浮点环境的微小扰动（CPU线程数、CPU vs GPU）可在不改变聚合率的情况下翻转少数种子的结果；子任务专家分解主要通过降低覆盖率成本而非增加监督来帮助；多种子控制推翻了自身数据中三个戏剧性的单次运行叙事。

Conclusion: Grokking的证据单位必须是在固定数值环境下的多种子率统计，并尽可能通过直接读取模型进行验证。单次运行结果不可靠，容易因种子混淆而产生误导性结论。

Abstract: Grokking -- the delayed onset of generalization long after a network has fit its training set - -is usually studied in models too large to read completely and reported from single training runs. We instead study a publicly released ~11,856-parameter Llama-style transformer (Glimmer-1-Base) on modular arithmetic, small enough to enumerate its weights, attention, and full input-output map, and we measure grokking as a multi-seed rate rather than a single outcome. In this fully-tractable regime grokking is a conditional, fragile phase transition. It is gated by training-set coverage, whose threshold tracks output cardinality (the modulus) more than task structure, an ordering that holds above the transition and across a ten-fold change in domain size. Weight decay reproduces the Omnigrok inverted-U at 12K parameters, a positive control on the rate measurement. Grokking also sits on a numerical knife-edge: two perturbations of the floating-point environment -- CPU thread count (reduction order) and CPU-versus-GPU execution -- each flip a minority of same-seed outcomes without a detectable shift in the aggregate rate. Decomposition into sub-task specialists helps chiefly by making coverage cheap rather than by adding supervision. Methodologically, multi-seed control under a fixed numerical environment overturns three dramatic single-run narratives in our own data, each a seed confound. The unit of evidence for grokking must therefore be a multi-seed rate under a pinned numerical environment, checked where possible against a direct reading of the model.

</details>


### [424] [KVpop -- Key-Value Cache Compression with Predictive Online Pruning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.05061)
*Lukas Hauzenberger,Niklas Schmidinger,Anamaria-Roberta Hartl,David Stap,Thomas Schmied,Sebastian Böck,Günter Klambauer,Sepp Hochreiter*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: KVpop提出了一种基于未来注意力信号监督的KV缓存驱逐策略，通过直接学习保留/丢弃决策，在75%-88%压缩率下保持接近完整注意力的性能，优于现有基线方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: KV缓存增长是自回归解码的主要瓶颈，现有驱逐方法依赖静态启发式或代理分数，难以准确预测未来token的效用，且相关性变化时驱逐策略脆弱。

Method: 提出KVpop，直接监督keep-or-drop决策训练评分器；引入未来注意力（future-attention）目标，无需材料化密集注意力图即可高效计算；设计延迟记忆评分器，推迟评分固定步数以利用近期上下文。

Result: 在AIME和HMMT数学推理任务上，Qwen3-4B在75%压缩率下保留98%完整注意力性能，88%压缩率下保留97%；Qwen3-8B达到接近教师模型的性能，持续优于现有驱逐基线。

Conclusion: 用未来注意力信号监督驱逐可以在降低内存成本的同时保持生成质量。

Abstract: Key-value (KV) cache growth is a major bottleneck in autoregressive decoding, as memory and bandwidth scale linearly with context length. Existing KV eviction methods often rely on static heuristics or proxy scores, which poorly track future token utility and cause brittle eviction as relevance shifts. To address this, we introduce KVpop, which learns a fixed-budget KV eviction policy by directly supervising the keep-or-drop decision. The scorer is trained against a novel future-attention target, computed efficiently without materializing dense attention maps. We further introduce a delayed memory-based scorer that, uniquely among learned eviction methods, defers scoring for a fixed number of steps to exploit near-future context. On AIME and HMMT mathematical reasoning, KVpop retains 98% of full-attention performance on Qwen3-4B at 75% KV cache compression and 97% at 88% compression, consistently outperforming established eviction baselines. Qwen3-8B shows even stronger results, reaching near-full teacher performance. These results show that supervising eviction with future-attention signals cuts memory costs while maintaining quality.

</details>


### [425] [Localized LoRA-MoE: Block-wise Low-Rank Experts With Adaptive Routing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.05114)
*Babak Barazandeh,Subhabrata Majumdar,Vinay Prithyani,George Michailidis*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出Localized LoRA-MoE框架，通过局部化空间阻塞和动态上下文路由解决LoRA在参数高效微调中的梯度冲突和静态拓扑局限问题。设计了两种架构：集中式宏路由（Block-Wise）和去中心化微路由（Cell-Wise），后者实现的梯度防火墙使每个坐标单元具备自主专家门控能力，在多项基准上优于静态基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准LoRA方法受限于单瓶颈结构，在多任务流中易出现梯度冲突导致权重坍塌；现有空间分区方法仍陷于静态拓扑，无法适应动态任务切换和环境传感器故障。

Method: 提出Localized LoRA-MoE框架，包含两种范式：Block-Wise LoRA-MoE（集中式宏路由，通过单一上下文信号调控整体结构网格）和Cell-Wise LoRA-MoE（去中心化微路由，每个坐标单元具备自主的局部化专家门控）。

Result: 在SVD矩阵仿真、真实表格变换及传感器退化下的空间视觉感知等基准上，两种架构均解决了静态基线的优化死锁问题。去中心化单元级门控实现了与全知全局协调器相当的统计一致性，提供了鲁棒的梯度防火墙，保护存活路径免受故障传播影响。

Conclusion: 提出的方法在动态模型适应中持续优于静态基线，为跨粒度坐标场和变化运行场景提供了可扩展且参数高效的解决方案。

Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) and high-dimensional perception networks increasingly rely on parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) to adapt to diverse operational contexts. However, standard methods like LoRA are structurally limited by a monolithic bottleneck, making them highly susceptible to gradient warfare. Interleaved multi-task streams may trigger destructive optimization feedback, collapsing adapter weights into unspecialized averages. While recent spatial partitioning methods have introduced block-wise isolation, they remain trapped in static topologies, unable to adapt to dynamic task-switching or environmental sensor failure. In this work, we introduce Localized LoRA-MoE, a unified framework that fuses localized spatial blocking with dynamic, context-conditioned routing. We propose and evaluate two novel architectural paradigms: Block-Wise LoRA-MoE (Centralized Macro-Routing), which modulates the entire structural grid via a monolithic context signal, and Cell-Wise LoRA-MoE (Decentralized Micro-Routing), which empowers every coordinate cell in the matrix grid with autonomous, localized expert gating. Through a comprehensive suite of benchmarks, ranging from high-dimensional SVD matrix simulations and real-world tabular transformations to spatial vision perception under sensor degradation, we demonstrate that both architectures resolve optimization deadlocks inherent in static baselines. Our empirical results establish that decentralized cell-level gating achieves complete statistical parity with an omniscient global coordinator, providing a robust "gradient firewall" that protects surviving pathways from fault-propagated corruption. Our proposals consistently outperform static baselines, offering a scalable and parameter-efficient solution for dynamic model adaptation across granular coordinate fields and shifting operational regimes.

</details>


### [426] [Computing Monetary Risk Measures in Linear Time](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.05078)
*Palash Agrawal,Gersi Doko,Maeve Burwell,Marek Petrik*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出两种新算法（QuickVaR和QuickDivergence），能在期望线性时间内计算离散随机变量的VaR和φ-散度风险测度（包括CVaR），在大规模问题上实现数量级加速。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 货币风险度量（VaR和CVaR等）在表达决策者风险厌恶方面应用广泛，但现有算法在大规模离散域上的计算效率存在瓶颈，亟需更高效的算法。

Method: QuickVaR算法借鉴Quickselect算法的思想计算离散随机变量的VaR；QuickDivergence算法则利用QuickVaR并结合多拟阵优化算法来计算φ-散度风险测度（含CVaR）。

Result: 数值实验表明，新算法在大规模域上实现了数量级的加速；算法的Julia库已在GitHub开源。

Conclusion: 所提算法在离散随机变量的VaR和φ-散度风险测度计算上达到了期望线性时间复杂度，显著提升了大规模场景下的计算效率。

Abstract: Monetary risk measures have gained popularity for expressing decision-makers' risk aversion. Value-at-Risk (VaR) and Conditional-Value-at-Risk (CVaR), in particular, are used commonly for this purpose. This paper proposes new efficient algorithms to compute these risk measures for a discrete random variable in expected linear time with respect to the size of its domain. First, we propose a QuickVaR algorithm that computes the VaR of a discrete random variable. Then, we leverage QuickVaR to propose QuickDivergence, an algorithm for computing a class of $\varphi$-divergence risk measures, including the popular CVaR risk measure. The QuickVaR algorithm adapts the well-known Quickselect algorithm, while QuickDivergence builds on polymatroid optimization algorithms. Numerical results show that our new algorithms offer an order-of-magnitude speedup for large domains, and a library implementation of the algorithms is available at https://github.com/RiskAverseRL/RiskMeasures.jl.

</details>


### [427] [FAST: A Holistic Framework for Optimizing Memory-I/O, Computation, and Sampling in Temporal GNN Training](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.05095)
*Yushu Cai,Qingrui Zhu,Lei Liu,Kai Sheng,Hao Chen,Xin He*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: FAST是一个端到端加速TGNN训练的框架，通过联合优化采样、内存I/O和计算，在真实大规模动态图上实现了平均2.1倍（最高4.7倍）的加速，且不损失模型精度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有TGNN训练系统受限于内存I/O、不规则计算和时间邻居采样三个相互交织的性能瓶颈，且现有方法孤立优化各阶段，未能充分发挥性能潜力。

Method: 提出SlimCache（批内压缩+跨批缓存减少主机-设备数据传输）；设计面向稀疏时间子图的线程高效图算子（提升GPU缓存局部性，加速聚合和边softmax）；采用拓扑感知的采样策略（提升CPU缓存局部性，加速时间邻居采样）。

Result: 在真实大规模动态图数据集上，相较于最先进系统，平均加速2.1倍，最高达4.7倍，且不牺牲模型精度。

Conclusion: 通过端到端联合优化采样、内存I/O和计算三个瓶颈，FAST显著提升了TGNN训练效率，验证了整体协同优化比孤立优化各阶段更有效。

Abstract: Temporal Graph Neural Networks (TGNNs) are widely used for learning from dynamic graphs in applications such as recommendation, social network analysis, and traffic forecasting. However, scaling TGNN training to large dynamic graphs remains challenging due to three intertwined bottlenecks: memory I/O, irregular computation, and temporal neighbor sampling. Existing systems often optimize these stages in isolation, leaving substantial performance headroom on the table. We present FAST, a holistic framework that accelerates end-to-end TGNN training by jointly optimizing sampling, memory I/O, and computation. FAST introduces SlimCache, which exploits within-batch compression and cross-batch caching to reduce host-device data movement under limited GPU memory budgets. It further designs thread-efficient graph operators tailored to sparse temporal subgraphs, improving GPU cache locality and reducing the latency of aggregation and edge softmax. In addition, FAST employs a topology-aware sampling strategy that improves CPU cache locality and accelerates temporal neighbor sampling. Extensive experiments on real-world large dynamic graphs show that FAST achieves an average of 2.1x (up to 4.7x) speedup over state-of-the-art systems without sacrificing model accuracy.

</details>


### [428] [PDEFlow: Autonomous Agentic PDE Pipelines for Neural Operator Learning and Solver-Free Inference](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.05134)
*Akshat Jani,Prathamesh Gadekar,Sakhinana Sagar Srinivas,Venkataramana Runkana*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: PDEFlow是一个自主智能体框架，可将用户描述的ODE/PDE问题自动转化为基于求解器的神经算子流水线，涵盖问题规范、数据生成、算子训练和推理全流程，实验验证了其在基准任务上的有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 减少在科学计算和工程应用中，当需要处理大量相关物理配置时，从问题描述到神经算子训练部署过程中大量的人工干预，实现最小化手动操作的自动化工作流。

Method: 提出PDEFlow框架，包含：(1) 状态化输入图，将多轮自然语言输入和用户编辑转换为验证后的问题规范；(2) 数据生成模块，通过FEniCSx有限元求解器采样参数并生成求解数据；(3) 基于注册表的训练和推理接口，支持不同神经算子无缝替换；(4) 当前实例化为多分支贝叶斯DeepONet。

Result: 在基准ODE和PDE任务上，PDEFlow能够构建有效的规范、生成求解器支持的数据集、训练稳态和瞬态问题的神经算子，并从保存的检查点提供无求解器的预测。

Conclusion: PDEFlow为需要大量重复性物理配置指定、模拟、学习和查询的科学与工程工作流，提供了一种可复现的、最小化人工干预的自动化解决方案。

Abstract: We present PDEFlow, an autonomous agentic framework that turns user-level ODE and PDE descriptions into solver-backed neural-operator pipelines. The workflow links problem specification, data generation, operator training, and checkpoint-based inference. A stateful input graph converts multi-turn natural-language input and user edits into validated problem specifications. The data-generation module then samples parameters, solves the configured governing-equation with FEniCSx finite-element backend, and stores the solutions as operator-ready tensors. The training and inference stages use a registry-based interface, allowing different neural operators to be trained and deployed without changing the surrounding pipeline. In the current implementation, we instantiate this interface with a multi-branch Bayesian DeepONet. Experiments on benchmark ODE and PDE tasks show that PDEFlow can construct valid specifications, generate solver-backed datasets, train neural operators across steady and transient problem classes, and provide solver-free predictions from saved checkpoints. The framework is designed for repeatable scientific and engineering workflows where many related physics configurations must be specified, simulated, learned, and queried with minimal manual intervention.

</details>


### [429] [Functional Bilevel Optimization for Predictive Fairness](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.05098)
*Ieva Petrulionyte,Julien Mairal,Michael Arbel*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 针对连续高维敏感属性（如人口统计得分、后验分布等）的公平性-准确性权衡问题，本文提出均值人口奇偶性指标DPVar（条件均值预测的方差），并通过功能双层优化实现。提出了两种算法：FBO（利用平方损失闭式伴生梯度）和ITD（通过展开内步微分，适用于非平方损失）。在合成数据和60个表格回归数据集构建的基准上，两种方法均达到最低或接近最低的公平-准确遗憾值，持续优于HSIC、对抗、线性依赖和广义DP基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 敏感属性为连续高维变量时，强制执行完全统计独立性过于严格，现有松弛方法（如依赖惩罚或对抗方案）不能直接优化公平-准确性权衡。

Method: 提出DPVar（条件均值预测的方差）作为均值人口奇偶性指标，将该问题建模为功能双层优化。提出FBO算法（平方损失下推导闭式伴生梯度，计算精确超梯度）和ITD算法（通过展开内步微分，适用于非平方损失）。

Result: 在合成数据和60个表格回归数据集构建的半合成基准上，两种方法达到最低或接近最低的公平-准确性遗憾值，持续优于HSIC、对抗、线性依赖和广义DP基线。

Conclusion: 所提方法有效实现了连续高维敏感属性下的公平性-准确性权衡，为直接优化均值人口奇偶性提供了可行的算法框架。

Abstract: When sensitive attributes are continuous and high-dimensional $-$ demographic score vectors, posteriors over attributes, age or income profiles $-$ enforcing full statistical independence is often too restrictive, and existing relaxations rely on indirect dependence penalties or adversarial schemes that do not directly target the fairness-accuracy trade-off. We instead consider mean demographic parity through DPVar, the variance of the conditional-mean prediction given the sensitive attribute, and show that optimizing it yields a functional bilevel problem. We propose two algorithms for this problem: FBO, which uses a closed-form adjoint we derive for the squared-loss case to obtain an exact hypergradient, and ITD, which differentiates through unrolled inner steps and extends beyond squared loss. On synthetic data and a new semi-synthetic benchmark built from 60 tabular regression datasets, both methods achieve the lowest or near-lowest aggregate fairness-accuracy regret, and consistently match or outperform strong HSIC, adversarial, linear-dependence, and generalized-DP baselines.

</details>


### [430] [Relational Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning for Dynamic Pricing in High-Speed Railway Markets](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.05179)
*Enrique Adrian Villarrubia-Martin,David Muñoz-Valero,Luis Rodriguez-Benitez,Giovanni Montana,Luis Jimenez-Linares*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于实体图建模的多智能体强化学习框架，用于解决铁路定价问题。该方法将环境表示为运营单元图，通过关系图卷积网络和注意力机制处理特征，在铁路定价RL环境中相比基线方法实现了更高收益和稳定性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在放松管制的铁路系统中，运营商需要在部分可观测环境下动态定价，竞争对手之间因监管限制不能直接通信或交换信息以防止合谋，因此智能体必须仅从可观测市场数据中推断策略互动。标准多智能体强化学习方法将观测视为非结构化向量，忽略了市场拓扑结构，难以有效建模竞争与合作关系。

Method: 提出实体图建模方法：将环境表示为运营单元图（而非决策智能体或静态基础设施），编码竞争、协调和连通关系；扩展MATD3算法，使用多层关系图卷积网络处理实体特征，并通过学习的注意力机制进行聚合。

Result: 在铁路定价RL环境中，该框架在两种不同复杂度的市场设置下，相比代表性关系与非关系基线方法均实现了更高的收益和稳定性。

Conclusion: 实体图建模结合关系图卷积网络与注意力机制能有效捕捉市场拓扑结构中的策略互动关系，提升多智能体强化学习在铁路定价场景中的表现，代码已开源。

Abstract: In liberalised railway systems, operators must set prices dynamically in an environment with partial observability, as they retain private information about their objectives and performance, where regulatory constraints prohibit communication or direct information exchange between competitors to prevent explicit collusion. Consequently, agents must learn to infer strategic interactions only from observable market data which presents a significant challenge for multi-agent reinforcement learning, where standard approaches typically treat observations as unstructured vectors, ignoring the underlying market topology that governs strategic interactions. To address this, an entity graph modelling approach is proposed, which represents the environment as a graph of operational units, rather than decision-making agents or static infrastructure, encoding competition, coordination, and connectivity relations between entities. Then, an extension of the multi-agent twin delayed deep deterministic policy gradient algorithm with graph-based representation learning processes the features of the entities through a multi-layer relational graph convolutional network and aggregates them via a learnt attention mechanism. Experimental results in a rail pricing reinforcement learning environment show that this novel framework achieves higher revenue and stability in two different settings of increasing market complexity compared to a representative selection of relational and non-relational baselines. The code is publicly available at: https://github.com/Kinrre/RelationalRailPricing-RL

</details>


### [431] [Counterfactual Methods for Detecting Unfairness in Anti-Money Laundering Algorithms](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.05101)
*Lea Multerer,Michele Inchingolo,David Kletz,Adrian Cosma,Alessandro Antonucci,Martina Gogova*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究了反洗钱(AML)系统中机器学习算法的公平性问题，发现通过添加账户所属国家和平均行为等特征虽然能提升模型预测性能，但会导致更严重的公平性违规，揭示了预测准确性与公平性之间的权衡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 反洗钱系统广泛使用机器学习算法，这些算法不仅基于交易数据还基于敏感客户信息进行训练，可能引发公平性问题。然而，现有AML检测系统在公平性视角下研究不足，尽管反事实分析等深层分析方法已可用于评估敏感特征的直接影响和间接影响是否在公平性上可接受。

Method: 使用合成IBM AMLSim交易数据集，构建账户所属国家和平均行为等扩展特征，在多种机器学习模型（从基线决策树到先进图神经网络）上进行训练。通过反事实路径特定效应分析评估与这些特征相关的潜在不公平性。

Result: 扩展特征提升了模型预测性能，但性能提升越大的模型，其公平性违规越严重，揭示了预测准确性与公平性之间的具体权衡实例。

Conclusion: 在AML应用中存在预测准确性与公平性之间的权衡，凸显了对此类关键领域进行系统性公平性分析的紧迫性。

Abstract: The application of machine learning-based predictive algorithms to Anti-Money Laundering (AML) has grown rapidly, driven by the vast volume of financial transaction data available to banks. These algorithms are typically trained not only on transactional data but also on sensitive client information, which may raise fairness concerns. Despite this, AML detection systems remain largely underexplored from a fairness perspective, even though deeper analytical methods based on counterfactuals are now available. Such techniques enable the decomposition of the direct and indirect effects of potentially sensitive features on model predictions, thereby supporting the evaluation of whether their influence is acceptable from a fairness perspective. Closing this gap, we consider the synthetic IBM AMLSim transaction dataset and construct additional features of the country of an account and its average behaviour. This improves the predictive performance of diverse machine learning models, ranging from baseline decision trees to state-of-the-art graph neural networks. We assess the potential unfairness associated with these features through a counterfactual, path-specific effect analysis. This reveals that fairness violations tend to be more pronounced for models whose predictive performance benefits the most from the extended features. Such a finding highlights a concrete instance of the trade-off between predictive accuracy and fairness in AML applications, thus underscoring the urgency of a systematic fairness analysis in such critical domains.

</details>


### [432] [Noisy-Channel Minimum Bayes Risk Decoding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.05198)
*Yusuke Sakai,Hidetaka Kamigaito,Taro Watanabe*

Main category: cs.LG
